Job Title: Chief Data Officer (CDO)

Role Summary

The Chief Data Officer is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise data strategy, ensuring data is treated as a strategic asset to drive decision-making, innovation, and business growth. This role oversees data governance, data architecture, analytics, AI/ML initiatives, and regulatory compliance related to data.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute enterprise-wide data strategy aligned with business objectives
  • Establish data as a core asset for competitive advantage and innovation
  • Advise executive leadership on data-driven opportunities and risks

2. Data Governance & Quality

  • Establish data governance frameworks, policies, and standards
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, lineage, and ownership across the organization
  • Implement master data management (MDM) practices

3. Data Architecture & Platforms

  • Oversee design and implementation of modern data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, lakehouse)
  • Ensure scalability, performance, and accessibility of data systems
  • Drive integration across enterprise systems

4. Analytics, BI & AI/ML

  • Lead advanced analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML initiatives
  • Enable self-service analytics and data democratization
  • Deliver insights that drive business performance and innovation

5. Data Privacy, Security & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and industry standards
  • Partner with security teams to safeguard sensitive data
  • Manage data risk, ethics, and responsible AI practices

6. Data Monetization & Value Creation

  • Identify opportunities to monetize data and create new revenue streams
  • Optimize data usage across business units
  • Measure and track ROI of data initiatives

7. Culture, Talent & Enablement

  • Build and lead high-performing data and analytics teams
  • Promote a data-driven culture across the organization
  • Upskill business users on data literacy and tools

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 15–20+ years of experience in data, analytics, or technology leadership roles
  • Proven track record of building and scaling enterprise data platforms
  • Strong expertise in data governance, analytics, AI/ML, and data architecture
  • Experience working with cross-functional executive teams

Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and data-driven mindset
  • Strong technical and analytical expertise
  • Leadership and stakeholder influence
  • Governance, risk, and compliance awareness
  • Innovation and problem-solving capability

Job Description


Position: Business Development Executive

Company Overview: Boyd is the world’s leading innovator in sustainable engineered material and thermal solutions that make our customers’ products better, safer, faster, and more reliable. We develop and combine technologies to solve ambitious performance targets in our customers’ most critical applications. By implementing technologies and material science in novel ways to seal, protect, cool, and interface, Boyd has continually redefined the possible and championed customer success for over 90 years.

Position Overview: Boyd is seeking a dynamic and experienced Business Development Executive to join our sales team to drive revenue growth. The ideal candidate will have proven success in identifying new customers and growing existing business in the manufacturing industry. Reporting directly to the VP of Sales, the BDE will be responsible for identifying new customers within their market segment, building relationships, providing solutions, educating potential customers about Boyd’s capabilities, and improving overall sales performance in their segment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities, including expanding into new markets and industries.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients, understanding their needs and providing solutions that add value.

  • Collaborate with other departments, including marketing, product development, and operations, to ensure alignment and support for sales initiatives.

  • Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for growth and improvement.

  • Stay updated on industry developments, regulations, and best practices to inform sales strategies and decision-making.

  • Work directly with new customers to support and manage business growth by developing strong relationships with operating departments and various management levels.

  • Achieve intimate knowledge of customers and industries in which customers compete and completes market analysis and assessment of competitive landscape, including 1, 3, and 5-year projections on industry trends.

  • Develop and execute strategies for increased customer penetration by selling additional products and services to all customer divisions.

  • Set strategic goals and tactical plan to achieve significant growth and build on the culture of achieving those goals within a high success/high reward environment.

  • Directly engage at customer locations to win incremental business through active business development. Requires establishing strong relationships with various management levels. Periodic international travel may be necessary to develop opportunities collaboratively in foreign countries.

  • Work closely with customer engineers and purchasing to ensure product and design requirement are identified. Work closely with Boyd Engineering to manage the design and development of customer solutions.

  • Display and demonstrate products and solutions using prototypes, samples, and marketing support materials, providing value added guidance to customers. Utilizing knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes, illustrates, and emphasizes Boyd’s value-added propositions.

  • Manage the quotation process. In conjunction with the Sales Operations Team, performs technical review of engineering drawings and specifications, gathers, and prepares required information for formal quotation including, but not limited to, drawings, sample parts, technical data, volumes, and material sources for submittal to Boyd Estimating.

  • Manages the preparation of formal quotation packages with pricing to maximize revenue, while also maximizing Gross Margin.

  • In conjunction with the Sales Operations Team, monitors and manages progress of projects in order to successfully meet customers’ milestones and production schedules, from inception to implementation.

  • Engage with customers on all commercial topics including credit and shipping terms, legal requirements, payments, and so forth. Manages aspects of the relationship per terms and conditions of agreements, as well as negotiating new agreements in conjunction with Boyd management. Responds when necessary to special customer needs or complaints.

  • Utilizes Salesforce CRM package daily to capture all business opportunities, customer business intelligence, wins and losses. Uses this and other tools to frequently and transparently communicate opportunities and current state to colleagues and management.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, or related field.

  • 4-5 years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience in a technical selling role with a proven track record of success in the manufacturing industry.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and negotiate effectively with clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset and a focus on driving business growth.

  • Proven ability to develop and execute sales strategies, including market analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.

  • Experience working with CRM software and other sales tools to track performance and manage customer relationships.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office - excel, powerpoint, word

  • Ability to travel as needed, including international.

jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.description:
Job Post: Healthcare Billing Specialist (ASC Billing)

Position Code: GJ-MHS

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PDT

Work Days: Monday to Friday

Salary: Starting at $6 - 7 per hour (depending on experience)

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Healthcare Billing Specialist specializing in Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) billing to support accurate claims processing, efficient revenue cycle management, and timely reimbursement for U.S. healthcare providers.

In this role, you will primarily handle ASC medical billing, including surgical claims submission, insurance verification, payer follow-ups, denial management, appeals, and accounts receivable. You will ensure claims are accurately processed according to ASC-specific billing requirements, coding guidelines, and payer policies.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with ASC billing workflows, outpatient surgical procedures, CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, and reimbursement processes. Experience with home health billing, Notices of Admission (NOAs), and ALORA software is an added advantage.

Beyond billing responsibilities, you will also provide administrative, executive, and patient communication support to help maintain efficient daily operations.

If you are a proactive medical billing professional who enjoys resolving complex claims, improving reimbursement outcomes, and supporting healthcare providers, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

ASC Billing & Revenue Cycle Management (Top Priority)

  • Manage full-cycle Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) billing, including claims preparation, submission, tracking, follow-ups, denials, appeals, and reimbursement resolution.
  • Prepare, review, and submit claims for outpatient surgical procedures, ensuring accuracy and compliance with payer requirements.
  • Apply knowledge of ASC-specific CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, and billing guidelines to identify potential claim errors.
  • Verify that surgical claims include accurate procedure information, appropriate modifiers, and required supporting documentation.
  • Navigate Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance billing requirements applicable to ASC services.
  • Review payer-specific reimbursement guidelines, including applicable ASC payment methodologies.
  • Investigate rejected, denied, underpaid, or unpaid surgical claims and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Process corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals to resolve reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Manage accounts receivable (AR) and follow up on outstanding ASC claims.
  • Identify coding-related discrepancies, missing documentation, and potential reimbursement issues.
  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits before claim submission when needed.
  • Coordinate with insurance representatives and internal teams to resolve billing concerns.
  • Ensure claims are accurate, complete, and compliant with applicable payer requirements.
  • Meet the daily productivity target of 45 claim follow-ups per day.
  • Upload, track, organize, and maintain Explanation of Benefits (EOBs).
  • Maintain accurate records of submitted, pending, denied, corrected, and resolved claims.

Home Health Billing Support

  • Assist with home health agency billing and revenue cycle management as needed.
  • Review and process Notices of Admission (NOAs) for accuracy, completeness, and timely submission.
  • Support home health claims submission, insurance follow-ups, and denial resolution.
  • Utilize ALORA for billing, documentation, and claim tracking when applicable.
  • Ensure home health billing activities follow applicable payer requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and records of home health billing activities.

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Prepare and maintain billing reports, spreadsheets, claims trackers, and documentation.
  • Assist with administrative overflow and other operational responsibilities.
  • Provide executive and administrative support to ensure smooth daily operations.
  • Maintain organized records and communicate outstanding tasks or concerns promptly.
  • Support workflow improvements to increase billing efficiency and accuracy.

Patient Communication & Reception Support

  • Answer and manage inbound and outbound calls using Nextiva VoIP.
  • Respond to patient inquiries professionally, accurately, and promptly.
  • Provide receptionist-level support when needed.
  • Communicate with patients, insurance representatives, and internal staff regarding billing-related inquiries.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and provide professional, empathetic communication.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Accurate ASC Claims Processing & Submission

Ensure outpatient surgical claims are prepared and submitted accurately using appropriate CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, supporting documentation, and payer-specific billing requirements.

2. ASC Denial Management, Accounts Receivable & Reimbursement

Proactively manage outstanding surgical claims, denials, rejections, underpayments, and appeals. Conduct consistent payer follow-ups while meeting the daily target of 45 claim follow-ups to support timely reimbursement.

3. Billing Compliance, Documentation & Operational Support

Maintain accurate billing records, follow ASC-specific payer requirements, identify documentation discrepancies, and support administrative operations while ensuring HIPAA compliance.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Healthcare Billing Specialist consistently demonstrates:

  • Accurate and timely ASC claims submission.
  • Strong knowledge of outpatient surgical billing requirements.
  • Effective resolution of denied, rejected, and underpaid ASC claims.
  • Consistent management of accounts receivable and outstanding reimbursements.
  • Achievement of the daily KPI of 45 claim follow-ups.
  • Accurate application of relevant CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, and payer requirements.
  • Organized and complete EOB documentation and claims tracking.
  • Proactive identification of billing errors and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Reliable administrative support and professional patient communication.
  • Consistent compliance with HIPAA and healthcare billing policies.

Tools & Platforms

Experience with the following is preferred:

Billing, EHR & Practice Management Systems

  • ALORA
  • eClinicalWorks (eCW)
  • AdvancedMD
  • DrChrono
  • WebPT
  • Fair Bill
  • Elation
  • TheraBill

Communication Tools

  • Nextiva VoIP

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience in U.S. Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) billing.
  • Strong understanding of ASC billing workflows, outpatient surgical claims, and revenue cycle management.
  • Experience preparing, submitting, tracking, and following up on ASC claims.
  • Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, and ASC-related modifiers.
  • Familiarity with Medicare and commercial insurance billing requirements for outpatient surgical procedures.
  • Experience managing denied, rejected, underpaid, and unpaid medical claims.
  • Hands-on experience with accounts receivable, insurance follow-ups, claim corrections, and appeals.
  • Ability to identify billing discrepancies, coding-related errors, missing documentation, and reimbursement issues.
  • Experience verifying insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits.
  • Familiarity with EOBs, payment discrepancies, and claims tracking.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and meet daily productivity targets.
  • Strong understanding of payer-specific billing requirements and reimbursement guidelines.
  • Excellent attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing workflows.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple Ambulatory Surgery Centers or outpatient surgical specialties.
  • Familiarity with ASC Medicare payment methodologies and commercial payer reimbursement processes.
  • Experience resolving complex ASC denials, underpayments, and coding-related reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Knowledge of surgical procedure coding and applicable modifiers.
  • Experience with home health agency billing and NOA review and processing.
  • Familiarity with ALORA or other home health billing platforms.
  • Experience using eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, DrChrono, WebPT, Fair Bill, Elation, or TheraBill.
  • Experience using Nextiva or similar VoIP systems.
  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare billing organizations remotely.
  • Experience providing administrative, executive, or patient reception support.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced in ASC Billing: Has practical knowledge of outpatient surgical claims, payer requirements, and reimbursement workflows.
  • Detail-Oriented: Carefully reviews claims, codes, modifiers, and documentation for accuracy.
  • Proactive: Identifies billing discrepancies, denials, and reimbursement issues before they escalate.
  • Analytical: Can investigate complex claims and determine appropriate resolutions.
  • Organized: Effectively manages outstanding claims, follow-ups, and deadlines.
  • Productive: Consistently meets billing follow-up targets without compromising accuracy.
  • Adaptable: Comfortable handling additional home health billing or administrative responsibilities when needed.
  • Reliable: Takes ownership of assigned tasks and communicates progress transparently.
  • Patient-Focused: Maintains professional and empathetic communication with patients and healthcare teams.
  • Compliance-Conscious: Prioritizes HIPAA, payer requirements, and accurate billing practices.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English.
  • Must have relevant hands-on experience in U.S. medical billing, particularly ASC billing.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required.
  • Must be available to work full-time, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.description:
The Marketing AI & Automation Manager analyzes and improves business processes across SecureSpace Self Storage by designing, implementing, and governing AI-enabled workflows and integrated systems. This individual-contributor role has no direct reports and works under general supervision. The role evaluates operational needs and exercises independent judgment in selecting technical approaches, establishing workflow controls, and resolving complex process and integration issues within approved platforms, policies, and budgets.

Objective:

Advise marketing leadership and business owners on automation opportunities that improve operating efficiency, data quality, and decision-making. Analyze needs, define requirements, compare alternatives, and recommend priorities based on business impact, cost, feasibility, and risk. The role owns solution design and delivery for workflows used across teams, including content operations, reputation management, campaign tracking, reporting, and internal processes. Marketing leadership retains strategy, budget approval, and final business-priority decisions; the manager determines how approved objectives are achieved without step-by-step direction.

Responsibilities/Essential Functions:

•Evaluates cross-functional processes, identifies root causes of inefficiency, and recommends whether to redesign, automate, retain, or discontinue a workflow based on operational impact, risk, and cost.

•Defines business and technical requirements with stakeholders; independently selects workflow architecture, data structures, integration methods, and tools within approved platforms and budgets. Recommends new platforms or expenditures with documented trade-offs for approval.

•Designs and implements content-production systems with the SEO Manager and other business owners, determining workflow stages, validation rules, human-review controls, publishing safeguards, and performance measures for briefs, drafting, auditing, and approved distribution.

•Analyzes reputation-management needs and designs review-intake, categorization, escalation, response-approval, and follow-up systems; recommends controls that improve responsiveness while preserving compliant human decision-making.

•Evaluates and redesigns internal processes such as print-material requests, purchasing approvals, fulfillment handoffs, task routing, and recurring reporting; determines automation logic and exception controls within established business policies.

•Advises campaign and partnership owners on scalable execution and measurement approaches; designs ownership, handoff, tracking, and reporting frameworks for approved marketing initiatives without assuming ownership of marketing strategy.

•Determines alert logic and investigation criteria for ranking changes, lead trends, reputation issues, and system failures; evaluates false positives and business impact and recommends corrective priorities to the responsible business owners.

•Designs and implements integrations among CRM, call-tracking, content, reporting, and project-management systems; establishes field mappings, data-validation rules, location identifiers, campaign tags, and reconciliation controls.

•Analyzes data quality and measurement gaps affecting calls, inquiries, reservations, move-ins, and revenue reporting; recommends improvements and explains attribution limitations to support informed business decisions.

•Owns testing, rollout, monitoring, and ongoing improvement of new and existing AI and automation systems within the role's scope. Independently diagnoses failures, determines recovery and corrective actions, and pauses or rolls back unsafe workflows within established incident procedures; escalates material security, compliance, budget, or business-policy issues.

•Establishes solution-level access, credential, logging, and human-approval controls consistent with company policy; evaluates implementation risks and recommends safeguards before deployment. Business owners retain approval of publishing, spending, customer responses, and other sensitive actions.

•Maintains a prioritized automation roadmap for leadership review, documents design decisions and operating procedures, trains users, and evaluates adoption, net time savings, reliability, turnaround time, and ongoing costs. Recommends enhancements or retirement of systems that do not deliver sufficient value.

•Establishes and applies workflow-design, documentation, testing, and change-management standards for AI and automation systems within the role's scope, consistent with company IT policies and leadership-approved standards. Reviews requests and changes affecting those systems before deployment.

Compliance Requirements:

•Use only company-approved automation platforms, AI tools, and integrations; process customer and employee data only in approved systems and in accordance with company IT, information security, and data privacy policies and applicable privacy laws.

•Store credentials in approved secure systems only; do not use personal accounts, share credentials, or embed passwords, API keys, or tokens in workflows or documents.

•Do not create, write, solicit, or post reviews on behalf of customers or employees, and do not suppress, filter, or selectively request reviews based on expected sentiment, consistent with the FTC's rules on consumer reviews and testimonials.

•Ensure automated customer communications (including text messages, calls, and emails) comply with applicable consent, opt-out, and communication laws.

•Clearly identify AI-generated content for human review before any publishing, customer response, or other external use.

Other Functions:

•Plans deployment and maintenance activities with affected teams and determines the technical sequence, testing approach, and recovery procedures within approved project objectives.

•Evaluates emerging AI and automation capabilities and advises leadership on practical adoption based on comparative benefits, cost, reliability, and risk.

•Other duties as assigned.

•Clear written and verbal communication skills, including documenting processes and training nontechnical users.

•Ability to advise nontechnical stakeholders, recommend priorities based on business impact, and exercise independent judgment within approved policies and budgets while handling confidential information responsibly.

•Experience with CRM or CMS systems, reputation-management tools, Google Workspace, Wrike, dashboards, SQL, or version control (Git) is preferred. Familiarity with SEO and digital marketing concepts is helpful, but this role is primarily technical.

Additional Requirements:

•Occasional work outside normal business hours may be needed to resolve critical workflow failures; routine after-hours coverage is not expected.

Physical Requirements:

Vote Mama builds the political power of moms.

Vote Mama PAC is the first PAC in the country dedicated to supporting Democratic moms. Through endorsements and financial support, we elect moms up and down the ballot and across the country.

About the Role

The Vice President of Development joins Vote Mama at an exciting moment in the organization’s history. Since its inception seven years ago, Vote Mama has grown revenue annually and built a strong base of early supporters. We now recognize the need to diversify and expand our funding base to sustain and fuel future growth.

Vote Mama seeks a seasoned, strategic, mission-driven political fundraiser to lead and expand on a strong foundation laid by the existing Development team, overseeing a comprehensive fundraising strategy for Vote Mama PAC, Vote Mama Foundation (501(c)(3)), and Vote Mama Lobby (501(c)(4)). As part of their role, the VP of Development will be responsible for creating and executing a multi-million-dollar political finance plan as well as fundraising plans for the Foundation and Lobby, leading revenue generation across all three entities. The role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on fundraising leadership: the VP will personally cultivate, solicit, and steward a significant portfolio of high-net-worth (HNW) and political donors while overseeing the systems, team, partnerships, and pipeline necessary for sustained organizational growth. The VP of Development reports to the Chief Operating Officer and works closely with the CEO, staff, and Vote Mama’s Board of Directors to meet the organization's fundraising goals. The VP is also charged with managing the Senior Director of the Mamas Network and the Development Operations Director, who are responsible for day-to-day management of revenue streams, including the institutional portfolio, the Mama Fund, events, and other donor engagement programs. Additionally, the role collaborates with programmatic, communications, and events team members to ensure seamless integration of fundraising priorities across organizational goals and objectives.

This role is responsible for designing and executing high-impact political fundraising strategies, with a particular focus on acquiring, cultivating, and stewarding HNW individual and political donors and overseeing the continued expansion of revenue across multiple channels (individual, institutional, corporate, and mission-aligned donors). We’re seeking someone who thrives in high-visibility, high-stakes environments, brings deep knowledge of the political fundraising landscape, has extensive experience as a finance director on federal or statewide campaigns, has worked in a senior fundraising role with a PAC or organization, has led high-impact teams, and is excited to lead the charge in diversifying and growing Vote Mama’s donor base.

Working at Vote Mama

This is a fully remote role with flexible scheduling. Candidates must have reliable internet access and be available for travel to in-person events as needed (roughly 5-7 trips annually, dependent on your location). jobs.title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
jobs.excerpt: Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure.
jobs.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced InterimSenior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI, you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

  • Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
  • Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
  • Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
  • Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
  • Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
  • Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
  • Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

  • You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics, including at least three years working at a senior level
  • You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
  • You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
  • You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
  • You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
  • You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
  • You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
  • You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
  • You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
  • You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have:

  • French or German language skills
  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
  • Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
  • Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

  • By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm
  • By Day 90: Have the priority executive dashboards rebuilt and in use, agree metric definitions with the Head of FP&A, and bring the first acquired-company data into standard group reporting
  • By Day 180 (if extended): Complete the rebuild of all in-scope dashboards, incorporate all migrated acquisition data into standard reporting, convert recurring ad hoc requests into standard reports, and complete the handover to the permanent BI team

Why Shiftmove

Why should you join us? At Shiftmove, you can contribute to an established, product-led company focused on delivering real value to its customers, with meaningful recurring revenue and an ambitious agenda for growth

  • Autonomy: We bring you in for your expertise and give you the ownership and space to deliver meaningful results.
  • Impact: Play a direct role in shaping executive reporting and integrating acquired businesses into a consistent, group-wide view of performance
  • Fair and equitable compensation: Interim compensation will be discussed based on your expertise, experience and geographic location
  • Dog-friendly office: Because furry coworkers make everything better! 🐶

SOUNDS LIKE YOU?

If you don't tick all the boxes but believe you can thrive in this role, we would love to hear from you.

Shiftmove is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse experiences and demographic characteristics that have nurtured unique viewpoints benefit our growth and performance. Just be yourself, and maybe you'll bring something valuable to the role we didn't initially think of.

If you need specific accommodations (tools, time, etc.) due to any special needs, and you are happy to disclose this, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments, as support can make a decisive difference in the application process.

SUMMARY

The Substation Technical Trainer is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of classroom and field-based technical training for electrical construction with a focus on substations. This role serves as a subject matter expert for substation curriculum and partners with Operating Group and project leadership to strengthen craft knowledge, safe work practices, and consistent field execution.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and deliver substation-focused electrical training, including instructor-led modules, practical exercises, assessments, and performance evaluations.

  • Provide technical instruction on substation construction topics such as grounding, conduit and cable systems, equipment installation, bus work, control wiring, testing support, and energization readiness.

  • Partner with project leadership, field supervision, safety professionals, and subject matter experts to identify training needs and build project-specific training plans.

  • Schedule and coordinate classroom instruction, online learning, hands-on labs, and field evaluations for electrical team members supporting substation work.

  • Ensure training materials, tools, equipment, drawings, procedures, and other resources are prepared and available for each training session.

  • Coach, mentor, and support project-based instructors, performance evaluators, and proctors to promote consistent delivery and evaluation standards.

  • Coordinate training delivery across multiple projects and Operating Groups supporting an overall team training schedule.

  • Partner with the Manager of Apprenticeship and Learning and Development team members on completion, tracking, and storage of required training documentation.

  • Apply effective presentation methods, adult learning principles, and hands-on instructional techniques to support knowledge transfer and skill development.

  • Participate in electrical and substation subject matter reviews with internal stakeholders, NCCER, and other industry organizations, as appropriate.

  • Effectively work and build relationships with team members of diverse backgrounds and organizational levels.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced communication, presentation, and classroom and field training facilitation skills

  • Knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional methodology, and hands-on skill evaluation

  • Working knowledge of substation construction methods, drawings, equipment, systems, and safe work practices

  • Basic computer and software skills (Microsoft applications)

  • Bilingual English/Spanish fluency preferred

  • Ability to connect with and influence craft team members, project leaders, and other stakeholders

  • Active listening skills and effective communication, including an openness to diverse input and feedback

  • Ability to travel up to 75%

  • Journey-level or technician-level electrical knowledge, skills with substation construction, hands-on substation switching experience, commissioning support, or related high-voltage experience (at least five years)

  • Electrical Journeyman License (any state)

  • Successful completion of NCCER ICTP, or ability to complete after hire

  • Knowledge of OSHA requirements, FA/CPR and electrical safety practices applicable to substation construction

  • Experience with NCCER electrical curriculum, assessments, and performance profiles preferred

  • Classroom and hands-on technical training facilitation experience preferred

  • Current driver’s license

A few benefits offered include:

(for Non-Craft & Non-Union Craft working 25+ hours / week)

  • Medical and prescription drug plans that includes no additional cost vision coverage

  • Dental plan

  • 401k retirement plan with a generous Mortenson match

  • Paid time off, holidays, and other paid leaves

  • Employer paid Life, AD&D, and disability insurance

  • No-Cost mental health tool and concierge with extensive work-life resources

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Gym Membership Discount Program

The base pay range for this role is $78,700 - $106,300. (Actual range is higher for the following office locations: Denver, CO and Chicago, IL – 5%, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR – 10%, Washington, D.C. – 12.5%).

Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience, with consideration given to internal equity. This position is eligible for Mortenson’s incentive plan.

Please make note:

  • Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.

  • Our postings are typically open a minimum of 5 days and an average of 44 days.

As a top builder, developer, and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), our expertise spans markets like sports, renewable energy, data centers, healthcare, and more. We are builders at heart, working to ensure the built environment has a lasting positive impact.

jobs.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

The Enablement Operations & Analytics Manager is the operational and analytical backbone of Commercial Enablement. This role connects enablement strategy to the technology, data, and systems infrastructure that makes it scalable across our global commercial organizations.

You'll own the data that proves whether enablement programs work, the dashboards that make performance visible, and the systems and automations that let a lean team scale its impact. This is a builder role: you'll turn ambiguous problems into measurable frameworks and one-time wins into repeatable, scalable systems.

What you’ll be doing

  • Enablement Measurement & Analytics Design and own how we measure enablement effectiveness. Build measurement frameworks that connect enablement inputs (training completion, content engagement, coaching activity) to rep performance outputs (pipeline progression, deal velocity, close rates) at the individual level. Build and maintain self-service dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Omni, Tableau). Own conversation intelligence reporting (e.g., Gong scorecards, leaderboards). Turn data into clear recommendations on what to scale, iterate, or deprecate.
  • Systems, Automation & AI Own the build-out and adoption of AI and automation tools across Commercial. Design workflows, build agents and skills, and drive adoption of tools that reduce manual rep effort across CRM (e.g., Salesforce), conversation intelligence, email, and content platforms. Manage content retrieval and recommendation logic so reps get the right material at the right time. Maintain the infrastructure layer for how reps find and use approved content: folder architecture, metadata standards, and source-of-truth maintenance.
  • Scaling & Operationalizing Enablement Programs Take what works and systematize it. Onboarding frameworks, certification programs, methodology rollouts, and launch packages all run through this function. Define the operational requirements for new programs, build the tracking and reporting around them, and create repeatable playbooks that extend across teams and segments.
  • Cross-Functional Operations Work daily with data engineering, revenue operations, product/AI teams, and commercial leadership. Define data requirements, coordinate on tool integrations, and translate business problems into technical specifications. Manage stakeholder relationships across functions to drive enablement priorities forward.

To get to know more about our Tech Stack, check here.

What you need to have

  • 3 to 5 years in sales operations, analytics, enablement, or a related ops/analytics role
  • Strong analytical skillset: comfortable building measurement frameworks, reports, and dashboards independently
  • Experience with AI tools and automation platforms
  • Builder mentality: track record of turning ad hoc processes into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English

Nice to have

  • Background in or exposure to B2B sales environments or go-to-market teams
  • Consulting, industrial engineering, or process improvement background
  • Comfort working through ambiguous, undefined problems without a set methodology

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

jobs.description:
Senior Director, Assessment Exceptions & Integrity

Operations, Assessment Delivery Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team

College Board’s Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. The Resolve team serves as trusted experts in post-administration issue resolution for SAT and AP assessments, ensuring issues reported by educators and students are resolved efficiently, protecting the integrity of our assessments and the validity of student scores.


About the Opportunity

As Senior Director, Assessment Exceptions & Integrity, you will lead the team that resolves testing irregularities, incidents, and complaints for College Board assessments, protecting the integrity of our assessments and ensuring every student tests on a level playing field. You will set the strategy and operating model for how issues are identified, investigated, and resolved at scale, leading the shift from manual case handling to automated, insight-driven operations. You will directly manage a team of ~10 that owns Resolve’s day-to-day execution, building the habits and infrastructure to turn case trends, operational metrics, and root-cause findings into action. Partnering closely with Deliver, Technology, and Product leaders, you will drive the improvements that prevent issues before test day.


In this role, you will:

Set Resolve Strategy and Performance (40%)

  • Own the performance of post-administration issue resolution for College Board assessments, ensuring incident reports, irregularities, complaints, score holds, and score verifications are resolved accurately and on time
  • Set Resolve’s multi-year strategy for moving from manual case handling to automated, insight-driven operations, and secure the resources to deliver it
  • Design and evolve an operating model that scales with case volume and complexity
  • Partner with ADO leadership to align resolution strategy with pre-admin and test day operations, closing gaps between how issues occur and how they’re resolved
  • Define the KPIs and reporting that drive process improvements and leadership visibility
  • Represent Resolve’s strategy, performance, and risks to senior leaders across Operations, Technology, and Product

Lead Digital and AI-Enabled Transformation (35%)

  • Direct the evolution of Resolve’s systems, data, and workflows to surface actionable insights into test administration anomalies
  • Own the Resolve feature backlog: define outcomes and acceptance criteria, prioritize the features that advance Resolve’s efficiency and capability with Product and Technology partners, and work with engineering teams to deliver.
  • Drive adoption of automation and AI tools that measurably improve processing speed and accuracy
  • Translate case trends and root causes into upstream fixes that prevent issues before test day

Lead and Manage the Resolve Team (25%)

  • Lead a team of 10 that is responsible for post-administration issue resolution for College Board assessments
  • Set vision and priorities for the team, guide them through transformation, track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission
  • Cultivate an inclusive and high-achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles effectively
  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work
  • Set standards for quality, speed, and consistency across Resolve’s work
  • Build team data fluency and proficiency so staff use trends and metrics to drive decisions

About You

You have

  • 10+ years of progressive experience leading teams and complex, high-stakes work, preferably in support of a digital platform, user success, or issue management work
  • Experience in product ownership, business analysis, program or project management, or a similar role translating business needs into features and outcomes
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, data science, operations, management (or other relevant field) or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to create a compelling vision and strategy for teams and functions, cultivating winning partnerships with stakeholders, and transforming long-term outcomes by adapting to changing needs and sustaining day-to-day results
  • A strategic and inclusive leadership style: you set clear priorities, build effective team structures, lead teams through change, plan for future needs, and foster a culture of belonging.
  • A proven ability to drive performance and growth: you set high expectations, deliver real-time, evidence-based feedback, and coach team members to take smart risks, stretch their skills, and achieve meaningful impact.
  • Strong command of Salesforce (or comparable CRM/case-management platform) as a system of record for case intake, tracking, and resolution workflows at volume
  • Working proficiency in JIRA (or similar) to manage and prioritize a feature backlog with Product/Technology stakeholders, and SQL proficiency to independently query and validate data for operational and scoring-anomaly investigations
  • Proven experience building or scaling a data-driven culture, using KPIs and dashboards (Tableau or equivalent) to make continuous improvement systemic
  • Comfort communicating strategy and recommendations to senior stakeholders through clear, compelling presentations
  • Experience applying automation or AI to case, customer service, or workflow processes is a plus
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $104,000–$160,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.description:
Senior Research Associate, Data Analytics – Part-Time Temporary Opportunity

Hanover Research

Remote Opportunity

The Data Analyst will primarily be responsible for working with client data to create dashboards that help higher education institutions to better understand resource allocation across their academic portfolios, including the costs, revenue, and profitability of their academic programs. We expect all employees to be intellectually curious, ambitious, and interested in assuming increasing levels of responsibility.

High-Impact Higher Education Research

  • Projects: Primarily dashboards to help clients better understand the costs, revenues, and margins of their academic programs, departments, and schools; other data analytics projects as needed, such as student success and retention analyses, determinants of progression through the enrollment funnel, financial aid optimization, non-matriculant analyses, donor analyses, and other projects.
  • Clients: Hanover works with a wide range of higher education institutions in the United States and internationally, from small community colleges to large university systems and every institution type in between.

Responsibilities

  • Efficiently process and clean datasets for analysis
  • Create dashboards in Power BI
  • Perform statistical modeling and regression analysis on education-related data
  • Form hypotheses and locate compelling support for arguments under tight deadlines
  • Write up findings and key takeaways in a clear and concise manner
  • Provide project managers with regular updates on project progress and proactively raise potential challenges and questions

Qualifications

  • Higher Education Data Fluency: Demonstrated experience working with common academic and institutional data sets, such as course section, faculty workload, student enrollment, compensation, and/or staffing data. Candidates should understand how these data are generated and used in academic operations.
  • Analytical Judgment and Data Troubleshooting: Ability to evaluate whether analytical outputs make sense in a higher education context, investigate unexpected patterns or anomalies, and recommend reasonable methodological adjustments.

Essential Skills and Attributes

  • Experience working with and preparing real-world higher education datasets for analysis, including identifying and reshaping or merging data
  • Experience with data visualization software, including Power BI
  • Intermediate-level user of statistical analysis software, particularly Stata and R

Other Important Skills and Attributes

  • Knowledge of and ability to apply econometric and statistical methods to practical research problems
  • Willingness and ability to learn new quantitative skills as necessary and apply them in new contexts
  • Demonstrable problem-solving skills
  • Willingness to tackle complex, often unfamiliar research requests
  • Ability to collaborate and strategize with senior-level research directors
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple short and long-term projects to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrable, strong work ethic
  • Ability to accept feedback and constructive critique positively
  • Strong command of the English language and demonstrated writing and editing skills, including experience writing or presenting for a business or non-technical professional audience
  • High comfort level with Microsoft Office applications, such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Experience with other programming languages such as Python, with database systems and SQL, or with spatial mapping and analysis tools such as ArcGIS is a plus.

Education Requirement

A master’s or doctoral degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Data Analytics, a Social Science or Higher Education with quantitative training, or a related quantitative discipline is preferred, though promising candidates with a bachelor’s degree in one of these disciplines with higher education industry experience may be considered.

Experience Requirement

Minimum of 2–5 years of full-time work experience (or equivalent academic work) conducting quantitative research and analysis in a higher education setting is preferred.

Location

USA Remote

Office is located in Arlington, VA

#Remote

Compensation

Hanover Research strives to create compensation that is competitive, equitable and fair. The compensation for this part-time temporary opportunity at the company is $50.00 per hour. Please note this compensation range is contingent on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Our base pay range is determined by the role and the market.


Hanover believes in supporting our team’s overall well-being now and in the future. We provide retirement benefits and 401K matching to help you plan ahead, wellness benefits to keep you healthy, medical coverage to lift you up if you or your dependents get sick, and paid time away to rejuvenate. You can learn more about our benefits on our Hanover Research Careers page or please talk to your Recruiter to learn more.

How to Apply
If you are interested in the prospect of working for a dynamic, fast-growing company, we encourage you to submit your resume and any other supporting materials. 


Hanover strives to be accessible to all users and job seekers. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and need assistance in accessing our website or completing a job application, please contact Hanover Research at 202-559-0050 or via email All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.

About Hanover Research 
Founded in 2003, Hanover Research is a global research and analytics firm that delivers market intelligence through a unique, fixed-fee model to more than 1,000 clients. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Hanover employs high-caliber market researchers, analysts, and account executives to provide a service that is revolutionary in its combination of flexibility and affordability. Hanover was named a Top 50 Market Research Firm by the American Marketing Association from 2015 to 2021. To learn more about Hanover Research, visit www.hanoverresearch.com

  • Collaborate with psychiatry providers and broader care teams
  • Maintain timely and compliant documentation in our EHR System
    • Includes 24-hour turn around for followup appointments and 48-hour turn around for initial appointments.

  • Must be able to work in California
  • Active Associate license in California (AMFT, APCC, or ACSW)
  • Master’s degree in Social Work, MFT, or Counseling (CSWE-accredited for Social Work)
  • Experience with CBT, DBT, trauma-informed care; EMDR or clinical niche preferred
  • Ability to sit with clients in emotionally intense sessions with care and clarity
  • Access to a quiet, confidential workspace with stable internet

Who You Are

  • Organized, responsive, and ethically grounded
  • Collaborative by nature but confident working independently
  • Comfortable navigating a structured schedule and a full caseload
  • Experienced with higher levels of care (psychiatric hospital care, community based services, prison setting, IOP, SUD facilities, partial hospitalization programs...)
  • Passionate about serving diverse populations (BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, neurodivergent, and more)
  • Self-motivated and dependable—you follow through without needing external reminders
  • Able to maintain focus and accountability in a remote setting, with strong time management and integrity in daily work

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive benefits, PTO, and sick time

If you're looking for meaningful work in a highly structured, supportive environment—and you're ready to grow your clinical experience while making a real impact—we’d love to meet you.

Base Salary Range: $70,304 - $80,000

Pay range is based on both your years of licensure and the number of hours you’ve accrued toward independent licensure. We also offer a 10% bilingual differential for Spanish-speaking therapists in recognition of the additional nuance required to provide therapy in one language while navigating clinical documentation, team communication, and organizational systems in another.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture
