  • Application security depth: 7+ years in security with substantial hands-on AppSec experience — you've built or significantly matured an AppSec program, run security reviews and threat modeling, owned vulnerability management (Snyk or equivalent), and worked with penetration testers. You're credible in a room with senior engineers talking about secure design, OWASP, and real-world exploitation
  • Engineering fluency: You can read code, understand modern web/API architectures, and engage with engineers on remediation without needing a translator
  • People leadership: 2+ years managing people — you've led practitioners, including ones with deeper domain expertise than you, and you know how to give direction without micromanaging
  • AI-native operator: You use AI agents daily in your own work and understand how AI-driven security tooling and AI-generated code change the shape of an AppSec program — you'll be building one, not running a 2022 playbook
  • Fast learner across domains: You can grasp a new domain quickly, ask the right questions, and speak to it broadly and credibly within months — this is how you'll ramp on IT and compliance
  • Strategic communicator: You translate security complexity into business language for leadership and customers — risk framing, not technical jargon

Nice to Have

  • IT operations exposure: Identity and access management (Okta or equivalent), endpoint management, or remote workforce IT — helpful, but your IT team brings the operational depth
  • Compliance / GRC exposure: SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR experience — helpful, but your Compliance Lead owns the program day to day
  • Security tooling stack familiarity: Snyk (vulnerability management), Wiz (cloud security posture), Cloudflare (WAF/edge), Okta — these are live in Fingerprint's environment
  • AI-native security tooling: You've run or evaluated AI-assisted code analysis, triage, auto-remediation, or autonomous testing in a real program, and have a view on how it changes what an AppSec team should look like and what it can safely be trusted to block or fix
  • Enterprise security questionnaire experience: You've answered rigorous due diligence questionnaires from financial institution InfoSec teams and know what "good" looks like on both sides of that process
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS company where security had to keep pace with rapid product and customer growth without becoming a bottleneck


The Unique Shape of This Role

This role is AppSec-first with a management scope that spans IT and compliance. That shape is deliberate. Application security is where we're investing next, and we want someone who can personally build it — not just oversee it. At the same time, IT and compliance are already run by experienced practitioners who don't need a domain expert over them; they need a leader who gives them direction, context, and prioritization.

What this means in practice: you will be hands-on in AppSec and hands-off-but-accountable in IT and compliance. We don't expect you to arrive as an expert in IT operations or GRC. We do expect you to learn those domains quickly — well enough within your first few months to evaluate your team's work, make prioritization calls across all three disciplines, and represent each of them credibly to leadership and customers. The judgment to know when to rely on your team vs. when to drive the decision yourself is what distinguishes the right candidate.

This is a role for someone who is still a strong practitioner in AppSec and has grown into leading people — not for someone who has moved entirely out of technical work, and not for a pure individual contributor who hasn't managed before.


Why This Role?

  • Shape a dedicated AppSec function from its first days, with backing: This is a sponsored, prioritized investment, and you have the mandate and the VP's support to build it your way
  • VP direct line with genuine autonomy: You own the function. You come to the VP with recommendations, not requests for direction
  • A strong team already in place: The Lead IT Engineer and Compliance Lead are capable, experienced practitioners who drive their own domains. You're not building IT or compliance from scratch — you're giving them strategic leadership
  • High customer visibility: Fingerprint serves major enterprise customers in financial services, fraud prevention, and beyond. Security posture is a real differentiator in enterprise sales, and you're the person who owns it
  • Compliance maturity to build on: SOC 2 Type 2 is already achieved. The next horizon — expanded frameworks, deeper enterprise compliance requirements — is yours to shape with your Compliance Lead
  • A function getting dedicated leadership: Security, IT, and compliance have grown up inside a larger infrastructure group. This role exists because Fingerprint is giving them focused, strategic leadership to reach the next level


Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $177k - $240k
Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

NYC: $209k - $240k

Chicago: $177k - $204k

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. Job Title: Senior Product Manager - PromoMats

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Vault PromoMats is the industry-leading platform that life sciences companies rely on to manage the full lifecycle of promotional content, from Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review and claims management to digital asset management and multichannel content distribution. We are looking for an experienced product manager to own and grow core PromoMats capabilities that make our customers' marketing, commercial, and medical affairs teams more efficient and productive.

In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for key PromoMats capabilities, such as claims management, MLR review workflows, and digital asset management. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

What You'll Do

    • AI & Product Strategy: Own the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for your area of PromoMats, including where AI capabilities fit, balancing customer demand, market trends, and the realities of design and engineering
    • Customer Discovery: Engage directly with brand, marketing operations, medical, and regulatory teams at life sciences companies to understand how they create, review, and distribute content, and translate those insights into prioritized product requirements
    • Measurement & Impact: Define and track the metrics that prove customer value, reduction in MLR review cycles, time to approval, claims auto-link rates, and feature adoption, and use them to guide the next set of investments
    • Feature Definition & Delivery: Write clear specifications and partner with Engineering, UX, and QA through design, build, and release to ship capabilities that meet the scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform
    • Compliance & Automation: Deliver capabilities that reduce manual effort across the content lifecycle, automated claims linking, reference substantiation, workflow configuration, content reuse, and AI-assisted content checks, while preserving the auditability regulated customers require
    • Cross-Product & Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with product teams across Vault to deliver connected experiences, and enable Sales, Services, and Support with the positioning, demos, and documentation needed to bring releases to market

Requirements

    • 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
    • 2+ years of hands-on focus on AI/ML applications, specifically LLMs and Generative AI
    • Technical Proficiency: Strong coding skills in Python and experience with AI Frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and APIs
    • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of data flow design, prompt engineering, and model fine-tuning for highly regulated content
    • Communication: Ability to translate complex AI concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Legal, Medical, and Regulatory departments
    • Collaboration: Proven track record of working with UX and Engineering to build intuitive tools for complex workflows
    • Marketing Acumen: Experience in Marketing or Marketing Operations, or building products for marketing teams, with a working understanding of how brand strategy, campaign planning, and content production come together
    • Marketing Process Fluency: Familiarity with the methodologies brand teams run on, creative and campaign briefs, agency and studio workflows, brand guidelines and governance, modular content and content supply chain models, omnichannel planning, and launch readiness

Nice to Have

    • Domain Expertise: Direct experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats or Vault Medical
    • Life Sciences Experience: Familiarity with MLR review processes, 2253 submissions, or Medical Information (MedInfo) workflows
    • Data Background: Experience as a data scientist, machine learning, or data engineering role
    • Brand & Launch Experience: Hands-on involvement in brand strategy, brand or product launch planning, or global campaign rollout, including the content, claims, and approval cycles that support a launch
    • Marketing Technology: Working knowledge of the martech stack brand teams use alongside PromoMats, DAM and content platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Aprimo, Sitecore), marketing work management (e.g., Adobe Workfront, Asana, Monday), marketing automation and CRM (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Veeva CRM, Vault CRM), and campaign analytics tools

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000

We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. jobs.description:
We are a team of consultants solving a familiar problem: how do you earn credibility with a client? We believe it starts with understanding the client’s industry.

Modern business has become the Tower of Babel: every industry has its own language. If you speak your client's language, you connect and find a way in. And if you don’t, you’re flying blind with a surface-level understanding. Companies spend millions on dull, slow, and unscalable solutions. The traditional go-tos – SMEs, in-house content, and live training – aren’t working.

We created a new way to learn an industry in under an hour (imagine the “I know kung fu” scene from The Matrix, but for business), using fun animated stories produced like a media product. Our primers are widely used by the world's top consulting and technology firms, with 90%+ completion rates, rave reviews, and hundreds of deals won and projects delivered.

Primerli is scaling fast, which means every process we have is up for a rethink. We are on a transformation journey to AI-native ways of working, which makes this a genuinely exciting time to join. If you're curious, resourceful, and ready to roll up your sleeves and make things happen, this role is for you.

The Role

This role works with every team in the business. You will report to the Head of Operations and support Sales, Customer Success, and Product.

Your first job is to keep the engine running: product delivery, client onboarding, data reporting, and admin processes. But there’s more to it - you’ll reinvent how we get work done alongside AI agents, and write the playbook for how Primerli operates. And when strategic problems pop up, you’ll help us crack them.

This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who enjoys moving between strategy and execution, would rather solve problems than follow a checklist, and wants to learn how an AI-native company works.

About Primerli

Primerli is a bootstrapped, early stage start-up that created the first and only engaging way to learn an industry in under an hour. We serve over 2 million professionals at global enterprises including MBB, Big Four, Google, and Microsoft. Get a feel for it yourself – check out our sample videos on YouTube:.

We are a small team with big ambitions. Many of us came from consulting backgrounds and joined Primerli because we wanted to move beyond advising to building. At a company of our size, you will get real ownership early, work closely with leadership, and help drive the direction of the business. If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact and grow alongside the company, this is the kind of role where that can happen.

What You'll Do

Mandate

Keep Primerli running smoothly and efficiently, and work cross-functionally to solve the company’s most important problems.

Responsibilities

Business Operations (50%)

Problem Solving (40%)

  • Help shape how all of Primerli uses AI: shared tools, workflows, and a company knowledge base

SpecialProjects (10%)

  • Contribute to projects that shape how Primerli operates and scales (e.g., analyze build vs. partner options for technology investments)

What We're Looking For

Values & Attitude

  • High agency and ownership: You don't wait to be told. You spot problems nobody assigned to you, grab them, and follow through without reminders.

  • Low ego, growth mindset: You ask for feedback, take it well, and act on it. The best idea wins, even when it isn't yours.

  • Strong values: You care about others, not just yourself, and you see competitiveness as complementary, not a barrier, to showing compassion, kindness, and empathy.

  • Get-stuff-done attitude: You are energized by action, and can balance priorities and timelines. You know when to be fast and scrappy and when to slow down and get things right.‍

Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM field

  • Experience building with AI tools

  • Client-facing experience (consulting club or internship counts)

What You'll Get

  • Medical and dental health coverage

  • 401k contributions and profit sharing

  • PTO and paid leave for parents

Location and Work Environment

While the company is based in California, you will work remotely with a global team. We are open to candidates based in the United States and Canada. Candidates must be comfortable working with colleagues in different time zones and traveling up to 10% of the time to co-locate with the team.

  • Experience building high-performing remote sales teams.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Proven full-cycle B2B sales leader.
  • Strong consultative selling mindset.
  • Excellent coach who develops people through structured feedback.
  • Process-oriented while remaining adaptable.
  • Comfortable balancing live coaching with asynchronous development.
  • Curious, technology-driven, and enthusiastic about AI.

  • Review pipeline health and forecast opportunities.

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

jobs.description:
Global Diagnostics Head of Imagyst Medical Platforms and Integration, Medical Affairs

Location: US Remote, NJ preferred

The Veterinary Medical Affairs Platform team under the Global Diagnostics Medical Affairs Commercial division is composed of a group of talented diagnostics medical experts, who partner with product and marketing brand managers to develop strategies for the brands they support, lead technical projects/research, participate in KOL development, and are the medical leads in reviewing educational and advertising/promotional materials for the line of existing and new marketed products/services. The team members are responsible for delivering medically driven innovation for the Vetscan Imagyst platform in addition to on-market medical messaging and support. The team members have a high level of technical and business expertise in specific diagnostic areas, and therefore are utilized strategically in the field to provide education to customers and support of the sales force. This role is highly collaborative, working in a matrixed environment with numerous internal and external stakeholders across multiple geographies with a focus on the Zoetis Diagnostics Portfolio including on-market and new indications for the Vetscan Imagyst platform and integration of medical messaging across the diagnostic portfolio as well as the therapeutic portfolio with an emphasis on key stakeholder engagement and medical conference education. This role oversees a team that conducts product launches and education and includes the management of medical leads and managers helping to develop and support the diagnostic portfolio.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Management of Imagyst Medical Platforms and Integration Team

oLead and facilitate a team of Imagyst medical platform leads responsible for:

  • Medical input for lifecycle maintenance and development of Imagyst testing platforms
  • Ensure medical affairs collaboration across all virtual lab products and services for medical education and marketing efforts.
  • On-market and in development research support and study design
  • Maintain quality and monitor clinical performance of Imagyst diagnostic indications
  • Create support materials for veterinary and sales support for new product launches
  • Provide strategic input into product management, global commercial development, research and development, and marketing teams to support technical/medical and business gaps and needs for aligned brands
  • Work with medical and marketing leadership within Global Medical Affairs team to develop tactics and strategy to foster collaboration across the diagnostic portfolio and Zoetis brands to support a continuum of care portfolio

Strategic Marketing Brand Support

oProvide diagnostic medical expertise to the marketing teams, L&D and other groups within Zoetis

oGain an understanding of the brand objectives and proactively work with the team on the strategic development and implementation of marketing plans, and product responses to competitors

oCo-lead planning and execution of marketing programs and other product focused workgroups, including key opinion leaders and internal stakeholders.

oAs a leader within the Medical Affairs Team:

  • Co-lead with the marketing brand and product managers on strategies to support future innovative product launches
  • Work with a cross-functional team to evaluate new business development opportunities
  • Proactively identify solutions to meet unmet needs to the brand team/business and lead the necessary change
  • Provide insight to the respective brand teams where conflicts and synergies exist across the Zoetis portfolio

External Customers and Field Force Support

oLead key customer activities and meetings based on brand strategy plans (e.g. lead on advisory board meetings, KOL development and engagement, customer education/training meetings on aligned products)

Collaborative Partnerships With Key Opinion Leaders (KOL)

oWork across Zoetis to collaboratively support projects which will build KOL alliances and provide additional opportunities for KOL development

oIdentify, develop and engage top KOLs and develop a plan on how to continually engage these KOLs in studies, advisory boards or speaking opportunities dependent on marketing priorities and budget

oLead efforts in organizing and executing meetings with speakers/KOLs (e.g. advisory boards, speaker bureaus), dependent on marketing budget

oLead the efforts in developing and maintaining relationships with KOLs that are strategic influencers. Collaborate with Veterinary Professional Services teams to identify new leaders as well as help support these relationships from the field level.

Imagyst Development

oOversee medical validation studies for new algorithms and product development as well as new product launches

oEstablish basic instrument requirements and lab quality benchmarks for instrument evaluation and validation studies

oAlign and collaborate with Diagnostic Innovation Team to help identify technical/medical and business gaps and needs for assigned products and suggest both enhancements to on-market and novel innovation ideas.

oEstablish liaison relationships with key animal health organizations critical to the product/diagnostic area supported and to promote and enhance the image of Zoetis

oIdentify future trends and marketplace dynamics and work across functional teams to develop a data generation/study plan [Phase IV (studies to support marketed products), Phase III studies (new claims), Outcomes Research] to address these needs

oWork with internal R&D and/or KOLs on development, submission, and execution of study proposals as well as keeping projects on track

Internal Customers: Partnerships and Training/Education

oAdvise and assist Learning and Development and medical education teams with both strategic focus and technical content of training programs and materials to assure consistency and clarity of key marketing messages and the medical appropriateness of product usage

oIdentify needs for new and enhanced technical presentations and assume a leadership role in their development

oParticipate in cross functional product teams (CFPT).

Organizational Effectiveness

oDemonstrate the ability to lead and successfully guide implementation and execution of initiatives with minimal oversight through effective understanding and ability to function within the organizational structure.

oDemonstrate ongoing and strong relationships with assigned brand teams and other key stakeholders, including but not limited to: product management, Corporate/Strategic Accounts, Outcomes Research, Commercial Development and Lifecycle Innovation, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Support, VMRD, Veterinary Professional Services.

oProficient at project management, creation of technical content, ability to act decisively, meet project deadlines, ability to manage conflict effectively.

oLead and facilitate multi-disciplinary groups; advise and influence management at all levels of Zoetis on technical issues.

oEffectively participate and demonstrate leadership in project teams, assuming the role of medical lead.

•Zoetis Values and Leader Behaviors:

oDemonstrate strong leadership behaviors within Veterinary Professional Services and Zoetis

oLead by example, actions are aligned with Zoetis mission and values

oInterface with other departments and suggest useful and effective actions to improve overall Zoetis performance

oConstantly seek ways to improve Zoetis and take leadership in identifying continuous improvement initiatives

Required Education/Experience

  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine degree or equivalent required
  • Minimum of 5 years of prior industry experience required
  • Minimum 5 years of team leadership and management experience required
  • Diplomate of College of Veterinary Clinical Pathology or other specialty and/or extensive diagnostic method validation experience or research experience strongly recommended
  • AI, Diagnostic and/or research experience strongly recommended
  • Strong foundational understanding of the veterinary industry trends required
  • MBA or prior business experience strongly encouraged

Required skills

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem solving skills, and attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with various stakeholders
  • Ability to collaborate and effectively work within cross-functional teams

•Strong relationship building skills

  • Ability to work and navigate in an environment of regulatory and legal processes
  • Excellent judgment in conflict management and influence

•Ability to think and act strategically

  • Ability to interact with and influence Senior Management, peers, and representatives from other functional groups

jobs.excerpt: Are you a current or former law enforcement professional interested in helping shape the future of AI?
jobs.description:
Are you a current or former law enforcement professional interested in helping shape the future of AI? Large-scale AI systems are increasingly used to support public safety, investigative analysis, and decision-making. High-quality training data grounded in real-world policing experience is essential to ensure these systems are accurate, responsible, and aligned with real operational needs. This project relies on your professional insight to help train and evaluate next-generation AI models.

In this project, you will apply your experience as a detective or police officer to interact with AI models on law enforcement–related scenarios. This includes reviewing and evaluating model responses involving criminal investigations, patrol operations, report writing, evidence handling, interviewing techniques, use-of-force considerations, procedural justice, and ethical decision-making. You will identify inaccuracies, gaps in reasoning, or unrealistic assumptions and document where models fail to reflect real-world law enforcement practices.

On a typical day, you may review AI-generated case scenarios, assess the realism and procedural correctness of investigative steps, validate terminology and workflows, and provide written feedback explaining what is correct, what is incorrect, and why. You may also help clarify edge cases, common misconceptions about policing, and differences between policy, law, and real-world application.

This project is well suited for individuals with professional experience in law enforcement, including patrol officers, detectives, investigators, or members of specialized units. Experience with report writing, case management systems, courtroom preparation, or interagency coordination is highly valuable. Clear written communication and the ability to explain decision-making and reasoning in plain language are essential.

No prior AI or technical background is required. Training and guidelines will be provided. What matters most is your real-world law enforcement experience, attention to detail, and willingness to thoughtfully engage with AI systems.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you will supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. You will be selling over zoom and not in person.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.

An ideal candidate has:

  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.description:
If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.

About Us 

Doma Technology LLC offers solutions for lenders, real estate professionals, title agents, and homeowners that make closings vastly simpler and more efficient, reducing cost and increasing customer satisfaction.

Our Values

  • Obsessively Entrepreneurial - We encourage calculated risk-taking, and we know that some of our best learning happens by making mistakes along the way.
  • People First - We communicate with honesty and respect to our customers, colleagues, and partners.
  • Better Together - We believe diversity, equity and inclusion creates value through the differences in our backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
  • Act with Integrity - We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards in all of our business practices.

IT Specialist

Position Summary

This is a contract 40-hour/week position paying between $25-27.50/hr.

Doma Technology is looking for an IT Specialist to provide responsive, thoughtful support to employees across our technology environment. This early-career role is primarily responsible for Tier 1 requests and incidents, with opportunities to assist with selected Tier 2 work under guidance. You will help employees stay productive from onboarding through offboarding, document what you learn, and escalate complex or high-impact issues through defined paths. This is a development-focused opportunity for someone with approximately one to two years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in IT operations. You will receive structured training and hands-on mentoring, gain exposure to Information Technology and Cybersecurity, and learn to work within an evolving support model that includes new AI-enabled automations.

Key Responsibilities

Service and Support

  • Serve as a first point of contact for IT requests and incidents through Freshservice, email, Teams, and phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Tier 1 issues involving hardware, software, Windows and macOS devices, Microsoft 365, connectivity, VPN, and access.
  • Assist with selected Tier 2 issues under the guidance of experienced team members, documenting the diagnosis and outcome.
  • Assess impact and urgency, work within service expectations, and keep employees informed through clear and timely updates.
  • Escalate unresolved, high-impact, or security-sensitive issues through defined paths to IT leadership and the appropriate Security, Engineering, or managed service resources.
  • Provide courteous, patient, and discreet support to employees at every level, including executives and other users handling sensitive information.

Employee Technology Lifecycle

  • Support onboarding by preparing devices, coordinating account creation, enrolling multifactor authentication, and confirming day-one readiness.
  • Complete assigned offboarding tasks promptly, including approved account actions, asset recovery, and license reclamation.
  • Fulfill approved identity and access requests such as password resets, MFA enrollment, mailbox permissions, and group membership changes.
  • Track equipment assignments, returns, shipments, and device reimaging in Snipe-IT or the designated asset management system.
  • Partner with Human Resources, IT leadership, and business teams to maintain accurate records and a clear audit trail for access changes.

Security Cross Training and Operational Readiness

  • Participate in structured cross-training with the Cybersecurity Team to build practical knowledge of security operations and controls.
  • Follow access governance, change control, data handling, and incident escalation procedures in every support interaction.
  • Recognize and report suspicious activity, including phishing, unusual access behavior, and potentially compromised devices, using established procedures.
  • As training and proficiency grow, provide documented coverage across IT Operations and Information Security when additional support is needed, while remaining within established responsibilities and escalation boundaries.

Documentation Automation and Improvement

  • Record troubleshooting steps, decisions, and resolutions in the ITSM so work can be understood, measured, and repeated.
  • Create and maintain knowledge articles, FAQs, and quick guides that help employees and support teammates resolve common issues.
  • Use approved AI-enabled automations across support workflows, reviewing outputs for accuracy, security, and appropriate handling before acting on them.
  • Identify repetitive work that may be suitable for self-service or automation and share practical feedback as new workflows are introduced.
  • Participate in service reviews, share recurring issue patterns, and recommend improvements that strengthen employee support and operational readiness.

Skills and Qualifications

Required

  • Approximately one to two years of experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, or comparable hands-on technical work.
  • Foundational knowledge of Windows or macOS, Microsoft 365, Teams, remote support tools, identity and access concepts, and basic network troubleshooting.
  • Ability to diagnose issues methodically, explain next steps in plain language, and confirm that the solution meets the employee's need.
  • A service-oriented approach marked by empathy, patience, professionalism, and respect for people with different levels of technical experience.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including accurate ticket notes and concise user-facing instructions.
  • Sound judgment when prioritizing work, protecting confidential information, following procedures, and deciding when to escalate.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and an interest in building skills in automation, information security, and modern IT operations.

Preferred

  • Experience with an IT service management or ticketing platform such as Freshservice, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management.
  • Familiarity with Intune, Jamf, Entra ID, or comparable endpoint and identity management tools.
  • Working knowledge of common connectivity concepts and troubleshooting for Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, and remote access.
  • Awareness of ITIL practices and foundational security concepts such as least privilege, multifactor authentication, and phishing prevention.
  • CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, an entry-level security certification (Security+), or active interest in pursuing a relevant certification.

Learning and Career Development

The IT Operations team will provide structured training, hands-on mentoring, and opportunities to pursue relevant IT certifications. You will learn alongside experienced colleagues, gain broader exposure through cross-training with Information Security and Cybersecurity, and take on more complex support work as your skills develop. Joining now also offers the chance to grow with Doma Technology's evolving support model as we introduce new processes, AI-enabled automations, and service capabilities. The role is designed to help you build confidence, sound technical judgment, and a strong foundation for continued growth in IT.

How we’ll value you and make your life a bit easier:

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits to eligible employees (FTE, non-contract): medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), generous vacation time, and paid bonding leave.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

We believe the most valuable investment we can make is to build an outstanding team of colleagues and leaders who are passionate about our mission.

We currently offer the following benefits to all Full-Time employees:

  • Work/Life Balance - We encourage taking Paid Time Off (PTO)!
  • 12 Weeks of Paid Family Bonding Leave (Maternity and Paternity)

  • Health Savings Account (HSA)

  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Supplemental Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Critical Illness, Injury and Hospital Insurance

We are looking for compassionate, collaborative clinicians who are passionate about improving behavioral health outcomes and providing exceptional patient care.

Your Role

As a Licensed Mental Health Therapist (LCSW, LMHC), you will provide individual counseling to members through our virtual behavioral health platform. You will work collaboratively with an interdisciplinary care team to deliver personalized treatment, support patient goals, and improve clinical outcomes.

This position offers the opportunity to provide meaningful behavioral healthcare in a flexible, technology-enabled environment.

  • Provide high-quality individual counseling services to patients through secure telehealth technology.
  • Develop individualized care plans, including treatment goals and outcome tracking.
  • Conduct ongoing clinical assessments and adjust treatment approaches based on patient needs.
  • Collaborate with physicians, psychiatric prescribers, and other interdisciplinary care team members.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • This role requires up to 25% travel

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Has strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Has experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$88,089.75—$118,440 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. jobs.description:
Empowering Financial Professionals to Lead Sustainable Transformation 

The BwB Fellows Programme offers an exceptional opportunity for experienced financial professionals to contribute to innovative, high-impact projects, receive mentorship from respected industry leaders, and join a driven global community that is dedicated to advancing environmental and social good.

Programme Aim

This exclusive two-year programme is designed to nurture future leaders in sustainable finance by empowering them to employ their existing skills in new ways and gain new knowledge and experience through strategic-level engagement with BwB’s innovative initiatives. The programme’s focus is on strategic input, high-level advisory work, and thought leadership, rather than operational execution. 

What to Expect from the BwB Fellows Programme  

  • Meaningful Engagement with Sustainability Projects: Fellows contribute up to 10 hours per month to support transformative projects that employ innovative strategies, instruments, and structures to mobilise capital for social and environmental impact across a diverse range of sectors and geographies. Projects may involve:

    • Structuring innovative financial mechanisms for climate resilience and biodiversity.
    • Developing investment frameworks for nature-based solutions and sustainable infrastructure.
    • Collaborating with public and private stakeholders on blended finance initiatives.
    • Supporting public finance strategies to unlock capital for underserved communities.
    • Engaging in development finance projects mobilising resources across emerging markets.
  • Mutual Mentorship and Knowledge Exchange: Fellows will receive direct mentorship from BwB’s leadership, senior ambassadors, and members of the Global Expert Group, who are recognised experts in finance, policy, and sustainability. At the same time, Fellows will be asked to provide mentorship to BwB analytical team members, drawing on their practical, market-driven experience to share expertise in areas such as: capital markets and financial structuring; sovereign and sub-sovereign debt; blended finance and impact investing; asset and risk management; and development finance institution project development and execution.
  • Access to Exclusive Networking Opportunities and Events: Fellows will have opportunities to interact with members of BwB’s Global Expert Group through events such as small group sessions and roundtable discussions. Fellows will also be invited to BwB’s annual retreat – an immersive gathering designed to foster collaboration, develop new ideas, celebrate progress, and exchange experiences and insights.

 

  • Lifelong Membership in BwB Alumni Group: Upon completing the two-year programme, Fellows transition into the BwB Alumni Group, enabling them to maintain valuable connections and draw on the collective expertise of individuals at the forefront of sustainable finance. 

Eligibility

  • Applicants must: 
    • Be currently working in investment banking (sell-side), asset management (buy-side), public finance, or a development finance institution. 
    • Have a minimum of eight years of relevant experience. 
    • Have a demonstrable passion for sustainability and financial innovation and a strong rationale for becoming a BwB Fellow.  
  • Time commitment: Up to 10 hours per month over the two-year programme, with flexibility to accommodate full-time employment. 
  • Compliance requirements: Formally commit to upholding BwB’s compliance standards, including adherence to NDAs, conflict of interest policies, and fit and proper requirements. 
  • Employer engagement: Fellows are encouraged to discuss participation with their employers to ensure alignment with internal policies. 
  • Financial contribution: A one-time fee of £10,000 (or equivalent in USD/EUR) is required upon acceptance to the programme. 

Accessibility and Scholarship Options 

At BwB, we believe that sustainable finance should be driven by a diverse and inclusive network of professionals. To ensure accessibility for individuals who may not be in a position to meet the financial commitment, a limited number of scholarship and fee-adjusted places are available. Candidates are encouraged to apply for assistance if they:

  • Can demonstrate exceptional potential to contribute to driving sustainable finance. 
  • Have a compelling rationale for participating but face financial constraints. 

Candidates should indicate their interest in a scholarship or fee adjustment during the application process by providing a brief statement outlining their situation. Scholarships will be awarded based on merit, potential impact, and commitment to BwB’s mission.

Participation Scope

As established above, the programme’s focus is on strategic input, high-level advisory work, and thought leadership, rather than operational execution. Fellows will provide insights and contribute to shaping BwB’s initiatives to help deliver high-impact outcomes, maintaining a hands-off position as regards direct implementation of project work.

Applications, Selection, and Intake

 The BwB Fellows Programme is an unparallelled opportunity for driven individuals to help shape the future of sustainable finance and make a meaningful contribution to positive change.  

 Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, with Fellows joining in spring and autumn each year. The programme is highly selective, offering limited placements annually to ensure Fellows enjoy meaningful, individualised experiences. 

 Eligible individuals who wish to be considered for this unique programme should submit the following information to begin the candidate review process:

  • A detailed statement of interest outlining their passion for sustainability. 
  • A record of relevant experience and achievements. 

Bankers without Boundaries (BwB), an innovator in global finance, is an investment banking, asset management and advisory firm focused on delivering value to our clients that benefit the environment and society. Founded in 2013, BwB is powered by former investment bankers and is a not for profit, with operations in Ireland, the United Kingdom & Singapore. BwB serves the financial needs of governments, institutional clients, corporates, high net worth individuals, cities, and foundations worldwide in meeting the most pressing social and environmental challenges.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Graduate at Samsara, you will be trained, both on-the-job and with formal training programs led by a high performing team of sales professionals, to develop into an Outbound Account Development Representative (ADR).

Typical career path for a Sales Graduate includes 6-12 months in Sales Graduate Role, 18-24 months in an ADR role, then progression to an Account Executive position.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for timely responses to inbound inquiries, expanding our list of prospects by finding new companies to target, and ultimately contributing to the generation of new business in EMEA for Samsara.

This role is remote friendly.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide a timely response to inquiries from prospective customers, and book demos of Samsara’s products
  • Receive weekly training on the Samsara way of selling, to be prepared for your next role in Sales as an outbound Account Development Representative (ADR)
  • Work directly with ADR and Account Executives (AE, Mid Market and Enterprise) to find new business opportunities
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with leads in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Competitive and driven to succeed in a high-performing team
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly Proficient in English

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 6-12 months of work experience in a sales environment but not essential
  • Experience in cold calling prospects (outbound lead generation)
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Motivated to help building a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background, race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, etc. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems. We are committed to increasing diversity across our team and ensuring that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Benefits

Full time employees receive an above market total compensation package along with employee-led remote and flexible working, health benefits, Samsara for Good charity fund, and much, much more. Take a look at our Benefits site to learn more.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we have adopted a flexible way of working, enabling teams and individuals to do their best work, regardless of where they’re based. We value in-person collaboration and know a change of scenery and quiet space to work is welcomed from time to time, but also appreciate that the world of work has changed. Our offices remain open for those who prefer to collaborate or work in-office, but we also encourage fully remote applicants. As most roles are not required to be in the office, we are able to hire remotely where Samsara has an established presence. If a role is required to be in a certain location and candidates do not have work authorization for that location, Samsara will conduct an immigration assessment. If the role is not required to be in a specific location, Samsara will move forward with the remote location that works best for the business. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company.

Please note: Samsara does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Samsara employees.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$65,450—$84,700 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Do you have a passion for higher education? Do you want to make a positive impact on the college admissions process? Our staff help to remove barriers and encourage students to forge their path to a better future. Common App is a national not-for-profit organization dedicated to the pursuit of access, equity, and integrity in the college admission process. Each year we support more than 1 million students, one-third of whom are first-generation, as they apply to our more than 1100 diverse member colleges & universities using the Common App's free online application.

If you are an experienced strategic partnerships professional and want to be part of a mission-driven non-profit that uses innovative technology to advance the college admission process, Common App may be a great match for you. Common App is currently searching for a Senior Director, State Partnerships.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting to the VP, Network Growth, the Senior Director of State Partnerships leads the organization's strategy and execution for building and expanding partnerships with state higher education systems, government agencies, and policy stakeholders through public-sector collaboration. A leader with deep relationships and understanding of the access, affordability, and attainment agendas of states, the person in this role is responsible for driving organizational growth and impact by cultivating and securing state-level agreements to implement Common App products and services. This leader will position Common App as a trusted voice and a preferred partner in state and national higher education access initiatives. The Senior Director provides leadership in setting state partnership goals, overseeing government relations work, ensuring retention of current state partnerships and aligning state partnership portfolio needs and opportunities with organizational strategy. They work cross-functionally to design and execute initiatives that advance Common App’s reach, and they represent the organization in high-level engagements with state education leaders (e.g. SHEEOs and CSSOs), elected officials, and non-profit executives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Education, non-profit management or related field; or an equivalent combination of experience and education.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead strategic evaluation and continuous improvement efforts by applying data-driven methodologies to assess program effectiveness, inform policy alignment, and drive organizational learning.
  • Skilled in convening diverse stakeholders and translating feedback into actionable strategies that enhance program design, align with strategic goals, and demonstrate measurable impact.
  • Proven experience engaging executive leaders in higher education, including Presidents, Provosts, and system heads, to build strategic partnerships and influence policy. Skilled at representing organizational priorities in public forums, including policy discussions, state convenings, and national conferences.

  • Deep knowledge of the higher education landscape, including state and system-level policy, college access trends, and technology-driven solutions shaping the future of enrollment.
  • Ability to interpret and apply enrollment data and policy research to inform strategic decision-making, shape partnerships, and influence organizational direction.
  • Deep commitment to access and equity in education, with a demonstrated ability to translate these values into scalable strategies, partnerships, and innovations that expand opportunity.
  • Proven success in developing business cases, strategic growth models, or policy alignment plans to support organizational expansion and external partnership goals.
  • Advanced relationship-building and stakeholder engagement skills, with a proven ability to influence and align diverse internal and external partners toward shared goals.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewEssen Health Care is the largest privately held, multispecialty medical group in New York, providing high-quality, compassionate care to some of the state’s most vulnerable and underserved residents.
jobs.description:
Overview

Essen Health Care is the largest privately held, multispecialty medical group in New York, providing high-quality, compassionate care to some of the state’s most vulnerable and underserved residents.

Founded in 1999, we’ve grown from a single primary care office into a network of 50+ locations offering urgent care, primary care and specialty services, from women’s health to endocrinology and psychiatry. We also provide nursing home support, care management, and in-home care through our Essen House Calls program. Guided by a Population Health model, our team of 500+ providers deliver care in-person, at home, or via telehealth, ensuring patients get the support they need when and where they need it.

We’re looking for talented, motivated individuals to join our growing team. Whether you’re a medical provider, administrator, or operations professional, there’s a career here for you. Join us in making a real difference in the health of our community.

Job Summary

Position Title: Integrated Care Coordinator

Position Summary: Essen Health Care's Care Management Division is seeking an Integrated Care Coordinator (ICC) to provide comprehensive care coordination services to patients with complex chronic conditions, including those enrolled in the New York State Health Home program.

The ICC is a core member of Essen's care management team, responsible for ensuring that high-need patients receive coordinated, whole-person care across medical, behavioral health, and social service systems. As Essen continues to expand its Care Management Division, ICCs may support additional evidence-based care management programs within the division, consistent with their qualifications and the needs of the organization.

Responsibilities

Health Home — Complex Care Management (Primary)

• Manage an active caseload of patients enrolled in the New York State Health Home program, with a focus on homebound and medically complex individuals• Conduct comprehensive assessments and develop individualized care plans that address medical, behavioral health, housing, and social determinants of health• Provide regular outreach, monitoring, and follow-up to ensure care plan implementation and patient engagement• Coordinate across primary care, specialty care, behavioral health providers, and community-based organizations to close gaps in care• Maintain timely, accurate documentation in compliance with NYSDOH Health Home program standards• Participate in care team meetings, case conferences, and quality improvement activities• Support patients in navigating insurance, benefits, and community resources

Care Management Program Support (As Assigned)

Consistent with the Care Management Division's integrated model, ICCs may also be assigned to support patients in additional care management programs offered through Essen Health Care. These assignments are made based on the coordinator's qualifications, experience, and program need, and include activities such as:

• Chronic disease monitoring and patient engagement under Medicare and Medicaid care management programs• Preventive care outreach and care gap closure for primary care patient populations• Care transition support, including scheduling coordination and documentation for patients moving between care settings• Patient enrollment and onboarding for care management program participants

Qualifications
