jobs.description:
Company Overview
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. We create modern, elegant front- and back-end tooling to enable new ways for developers and clinicians to integrate data, automate workflows, and collaborate to solve healthcare's toughest challenges. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.
Canvas is institutionally backed by some of the greatest technology investors in the world (funded notable health tech companies such as GoodRx, Oscar Health, and Hims & Hers Health).
The Role
We're hiring an Applied AI Operations Lead to join our GTM Operations team and drive successful deployment, adoption, and governance of AI agents across our customer base. This role serves as the critical bridge between our Applied AI engineering team and the healthcare organizations implementing Canvas's state-of-the-art AI capabilities to transform their clinical and operational workflows.
You'll be the hands-on expert who partners directly with customers to deploy and manage AI agents built with foundation model APIs and our server-side SDK, ensuring they deliver measurable value in real-world healthcare settings. This means working closely with clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, configure agents for optimal performance, and operate robust governance frameworks that build trust in AI-powered automation.
This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth in LLM-based systems with exceptional customer-facing skills and a passion for healthcare transformation. You'll translate complex AI capabilities into compelling value stories, guide customers through change management, and create repeatable playbooks that accelerate AI adoption across the Canvas customer base. Your work will directly impact how thousands of care teams leverage AI to deliver better patient outcomes while reducing administrative burden.
You'll collaborate with our Applied AI engineering team to inform product development based on field insights, work with customer success to ensure smooth implementations, and partner with technical marketing to showcase the transformative impact of AI agents in Canvas. As AI becomes central to healthcare delivery, you'll be at the forefront of this revolution, helping our customers realize the full potential of healthcare automation.
What You'll Do

Customer Deployment & Implementation

- Partner directly with healthcare organizations to deploy and configure AI agents for clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, communications, and workflow automation
- Conduct workflow assessments to identify high-impact automation opportunities and design agent implementations that deliver measurable ROI
- Configure and optimize agent performance using prompt engineering, context management, and tool selection based on specific customer requirements
- Create and maintain customer-specific evaluation frameworks that demonstrate agent effectiveness and build stakeholder confidence

Governance & Trust Building

- Maintain AI governance frameworks that ensure safe, reliable agent operations in production healthcare environments
- Design and implement monitoring systems for agent performance, including accuracy tracking, drift detection, and quality assurance protocols
- Partner with clinical and compliance teams to ensure deployed agents meet regulatory requirements and operational standards
- Develop and deliver training programs that enable care teams to effectively collaborate with AI agents

Technical Excellence & Innovation

- Work hands-on with foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) and the Canvas SDK to troubleshoot and optimize agent behavior
- Collaborate with Applied AI engineering to translate field insights into product improvements and new capabilitiesBuild and maintain a library of best practices, implementation templates, and governance playbooks that accelerate customer success
- Stay current with advances in LLM technology and healthcare AI applications to guide strategic customer conversations

Strategic Customer Partnership

- Serve as the trusted AI advisor for Canvas customers, helping them navigate the transformation to AI-powered healthcare operations
- Drive executive conversations about AI strategy, demonstrating how Canvas's platform capabilities enable competitive advantage
- Create compelling narratives around AI impact using customer success stories, performance metrics, and ROI analyses
- Partner with sales teams on strategic opportunities, providing technical expertise and vision for AI transformation
Qualifications

Required Experience & Background

- 5+ years in technical customer-facing roles (solutions engineering, technical consulting, customer success engineering)
- Demonstrated experience deploying and managing LLM-based applications in production environments
- Track record of driving successful enterprise technology implementations with measurable business outcomes
- Strong project management skills with ability to juggle multiple customer engagements simultaneously

AI & Technical Expertise

- Hands-on experience with products offered from foundation model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic,Google) and AI tools for low-code automation, with understanding of their capabilities and limitations
- Understanding of AI safety, alignment, and governance principles
- Experience with evaluation frameworks, A/B testing, and performance monitoring for AI systems
- Learned experience with the edges and limitations of AI products, and understanding of the iterative process required to get high quality results

Healthcare & Domain Knowledge

- Healthcare technology experience required, with ability to give workflow advice and construct automations that meet the needs of healthcare users
- Understanding of clinical workflows, EMR systems, and healthcare operations a plus
- Familiarity with HIPAA, clinical documentation standards, and healthcare compliance considerations
- Ability to quickly develop domain expertise and speak credibly with clinical stakeholders

Skills & Capabilities

- Comfort with ambiguity and ability to define structure in undefined spaces
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with ability to create compelling technical content
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with data-driven approach to decision making
- Experience creating and delivering technical training to diverse audiences

Who You Are

  • You're energized by ambiguity and thrive in fast-paced environments where you can experiment, iterate, and scale what works
  • You have 5+ years of experience implementing workflow tools and automation solutions in enterprise settings, with 2+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-based systems
  • You're deeply familiar with foundation model capabilities and have practical experience with context engineering and adversarial testing
  • You excel at translating technical complexity into business value, comfortable presenting to both technical teams and C-suite executives
  • You bring a consultative approach to customer engagement, able to diagnose problems, design solutions, and drive change management
  • You have experience in healthcare technology or a strong willingness to rapidly develop domain expertise in clinical and operational workflows
  • You combine technical depth with exceptional communication skills, able to create documentation, deliver training, and influence stakeholders

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • You've successfully deployed AI agents with at least 3 Canvas customers, demonstrating measurable improvements in efficiency and user satisfaction
  • You've made significant contributions, based on your field insights, to the best practices playbook for AI agent deployment and monitoring
  • You've created compelling case studies and ROI analyses that accelerate sales cycles and customer adoption
Location

San Francisco preferred.

We are a mostly remote, distributed team. We encourage people to do their work when and where they perform at their best. Because of this structure, strong written communication skills, time management skills, and personal accountability are very important to us.

jobs.description:
This is a fully remote opportunity for the role of Bilingual Spanish Sales / Appointment Setter. Applications that include an introduction video will be prioritized. Due to the fully remote nature of this position, candidates should be comfortable communicating through video calls.

ROLE TITLE

Bilingual Spanish Sales / Appointment Setter

ROLE SUMMARY

You are the first point of contact for prospective customers and play a critical role in converting inbound interest into qualified sales opportunities.

This is not a customer support role. Your responsibility is to engage with inbound leads, assess their needs, qualify their potential, and ensure every qualified prospect is efficiently moved into the sales pipeline.

On a daily basis, you will encounter:

  • high volumes of inbound inquiries
  • leads with varying levels of buying intent
  • incomplete customer information
  • scheduling conflicts
  • prospects requiring multiple follow-ups

Your role is to maintain momentum throughout the sales process by ensuring no qualified opportunity is overlooked and every lead receives timely, professional follow-up.

This position requires initiative, excellent communication skills in both English and Spanish, and confidence speaking with prospects. Waiting for reminders before following up or relying on constant supervision will result in missed opportunities.

Filtering Signal: This role is not suitable for individuals who are uncomfortable with voice communication, proactive follow-up, or working in a fast-paced sales environment.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES (REAL-WORLD EXECUTION)

1. Lead Qualification & Pipeline Management

  • Respond promptly to inbound leads from landing pages, social media, and other marketing channels.
  • Qualify prospects based on buying intent, budget, business profile, and readiness.
  • Categorize leads according to qualification criteria (Tier 1, Tier 2, or Tier 3).
  • Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales representative.
  • Escalate high-priority ("Hot") leads requiring immediate attention.

2. Appointment Setting & Calendar Coordination

  • Schedule discovery calls, consultations, and follow-up meetings with qualified prospects.
  • Coordinate calendars to maximize appointment availability.
  • Confirm appointments and reduce no-show rates through timely reminders.
  • Reschedule appointments when necessary while maintaining a positive customer experience.

3. CRM & Lead Tracking

  • Maintain accurate lead records throughout the sales pipeline.
  • Update lead status, notes, follow-up dates, and qualification outcomes.
  • Ensure pipeline information remains organized and current.
  • Support future CRM migration and process improvements when implemented.

4. Customer Follow-up & Sales Support

  • Conduct timely follow-ups with prospects who require additional touchpoints.
  • Re-engage inactive leads when appropriate.
  • Answer basic inquiries before scheduling appointments.
  • Ensure every interaction delivers a professional customer experience.

5. Social Media Lead Engagement

  • Publish approved marketing content across social media platforms.
  • Monitor inbound messages and engagement.
  • Respond to basic inquiries or route prospects appropriately.
  • Track inbound opportunities generated through social media.

6. Administrative & Sales Coordination

  • Maintain organized sales records and appointment schedules.
  • Communicate effectively with internal sales team members.
  • Ensure lead handoffs include complete and accurate information.
  • Assist with process improvements that increase sales efficiency.

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

  • Previous experience in Sales, Appointment Setting, Inside Sales, Business Development, or Lead Generation.
  • Fluent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Spanish.
  • Comfortable handling voice calls with prospects.
  • Strong lead qualification and objection-handling skills.
  • Experience scheduling appointments and managing calendars.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Strong follow-up discipline and organizational skills.
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Tech-savvy and able to quickly learn new software and processes.
  • Candidates who require constant direction or frequent reminders are unlikely to succeed in this role.

TOOLS

  • Asana
  • Email
  • Google Calendar (or equivalent scheduling tools)
  • CRM (current lead tracker; future CRM implementation)
  • Social Media Platforms
  • Google Workspace / Microsoft Office

WHAT WE VALUE MOST

  • You respond quickly to inbound opportunities.
  • You qualify leads accurately rather than simply booking appointments.
  • You consistently follow up until every opportunity reaches an outcome.
  • You communicate professionally in both English and Spanish.
  • You maintain organized and accurate sales records.
  • You proactively identify opportunities to improve sales processes.
  • You help move prospects smoothly through the sales funnel.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • Not a customer service-only position.
  • Not a cold calling role with high outbound quotas.
  • Not a passive administrative assistant role.
  • Not a marketing-only position focused solely on content posting.
  • Not a role where appointments are booked without proper qualification.
  • Not a position for individuals who avoid voice communication or proactive follow-up.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Remote
  • Full-time
  • Independent Contractor
  • Availability during US business hours is required.
  • Fast-paced, metrics-driven sales environment.
  • Performance is measured by lead response time, qualification accuracy, appointment conversion, and follow-up consistency.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To apply, please answer the scenario below:

Scenario:

A new inbound lead submits a request through your company's website indicating they are interested in your services. After your initial outreach, the prospect does not answer your call but responds to your email saying they are interested and would like more information before booking a meeting.

Task:

Describe your actions during the first 24 hours after receiving this response. Outline your process step by step.

We are evaluating:

  • Sales communication skills
  • Lead qualification approach
  • Follow-up strategy
  • Organization and prioritization
  • Customer experience
  • Ability to move prospects through the sales pipeline

Clear thinking, initiative, and practical sales judgment are more important than writing style.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • HMO
  • Fully Remote Work

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role  

As an IT Engineer | Operations, you will take ownership of second-line IT support and the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our IT environment across Windows, macOS, and Linux. You will work hands-on with endpoint management, Microsoft 365, identity and access management, infrastructure, and automation to ensure reliable and secure IT services across our organization. 

 

What will you do? 

  • IT Operations & Troubleshooting: Handle second-line support and escalate incidents, troubleshoot complex endpoints, operating system, application, network, and access issues, and drive problems through resolution. 
  • Endpoint & Identity Management: Manage the lifecycle of Windows and macOS devices, administer Microsoft Active Directory and Entra ID, and manage user accounts, permissions, authentication, and access. 
  • Microsoft 365 Administration: Administer Microsoft 365 services, including users, groups, licenses, permissions, and collaboration tools. 
  • Infrastructure & Connectivity: Support Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, cloud-based services, and network connectivity, working with specialist teams and vendors when needed. 
  • Server and virtualization: Windows and Linux server administration and virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V. 
  • Cloudadministration: Cloud platforms management such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.  
  • Automation & Continuous Improvement: Use PowerShell and other scripting tools to automate repetitive tasks, resolve recurring issues, and improve operational efficiency. 
  • Security & Documentation: Apply security and least-privilege principles, follow incident and change-management processes, and maintain clear technical documentation and operational procedures. 
  • Collaboration & Projects: Contribute to IT projects, system upgrades, migrations, and new technology implementations while sharing knowledge with colleagues across local and international teams. 

Who are you?

You are a hands-on IT professional with at least 3 years of practical experience in IT Operations, System Administration, or a similar technical infrastructure role. You can independently investigate technical issues, administer IT systems, and take ownership of problems from initial diagnosis through to resolution. 

You bring practical experience in the following areas: 

  • Endpoint management: Administering and troubleshooting Windows and macOS devices, including provisioning, configuration, patching, and software deployment. 
  • Identity & Microsoft 365: Working with Active Directory and/or Entra ID, user and access administration, authentication, permissions, and Microsoft 365 services. 
  • IT support & troubleshooting: Handling escalated incidents involving operating systems, applications, hardware, user access, and network connectivity. 
  • Networking fundamentals: Troubleshooting TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, LAN, and VPN connectivity issues. 
  • Scripting & automation: Using PowerShell or another scripting language to automate administrative tasks and improve IT processes. 
  • IT service management: Working with an ITSM platform, ticketing system, and structured incident, request, and change-management processes. 
     

In addition, you: 

  • Have a security-conscious mindset and understand access control, least privilege, and the importance of reliable IT operations. 
  • Can prioritize incidents and tasks, work independently, and collaborate effectively with technical teams, service desk colleagues, and external vendors. 
  • Communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, in an international working environment. 
  • Take initiative, document your work, and look for lasting solutions rather than repeatedly fixing the same issues. 
     

It would be an advantage if you also have experience with: 

  • CI/CD pipelines and collaboration with development or DevOps teams. 
  • Using AI tools responsibly to support troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and IT automation. 

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.


The benefits

  • Private health insurance
    We hope you will never need it, but nevertheless, we offer private health insurance to all our employees.
  • Education program
    We never stop learning, that’s why we offer our employees an educational program with training and certification.
  • Wellbeing program
    We all deserve to live a healthy and well-balanced life. It's not an option, it's a necessity!
  • Free beverages
    Enjoy free coffee, drinks, and snacks at work, or join one of our famous company dinners.
  • Events
    We enjoy spending time together, not only at work. Ski trips, carting, laser-tag, wine tasting, picnics, cooking classes… you name it – we’ve done it! There are plenty of cool events to join and to get to know your colleagues.
  • Competitive conditions
    Besides a competitive salary and 24 days of vacation, you will join annual company events with the whole team.
  • Challenging projects
    Ready for a challenge? We guarantee you'll find challenging projects at Valtech!
  • Cool colleagues
    What's the most important thing in a job? Cool colleagues with whom you spent most of the time during the week. We have a lot of them!
  • Honest feedback
    Honesty, openness and respect are among our core values. We encourage an open feedback culture in order to build trust and grow together.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

About Rocket Clicks

At Rocket Clicks, we help Family Law Firms grow through focused, performance-driven digital marketing.

Our team thrives on solving hard problems, improving client performance, and building trusted long-term relationships. We care about results, and we also care about how the work gets done.

Our culture is rooted in six core values:

  • Proactive – We anticipate opportunities and act before problems arise.
  • Disciplined – We remain focused and committed to excellence.
  • Candid – We communicate clearly and directly.
  • Empathetic – We understand and respect the perspectives of others.
  • Accountable – We take ownership of results, good or bad.
  • Results-Oriented – We focus on outcomes, not busyness.

If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home at Rocket Clicks!

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Account Manager at Rocket Clicks, you will own the relationship with a portfolio of family law firms at the owner and managing partner level. You will lead the strategic conversation, build and maintain the plan each firm is working from, and connect their business objectives to the work our marketing team delivers. Project managers handle delivery and specialists execute the channels, which leaves you free to stay in the conversation that matters most to the client.

We are looking for an experienced account leader with genuine commercial instincts. Someone comfortable discussing revenue, pricing, and capacity with a business owner, and confident enough to challenge a plan that does not hold up under scrutiny. Providing that perspective is the substance of this role.

The position is scoped to a single practice area for a reason. Working across a dozen family law firms at once, you will begin to recognize the same intake breakdowns, the same gaps between consultation and signed fee, and the same capacity ceilings surfacing again and again. That accumulated pattern recognition is what gives your recommendations weight in the room.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of family law firms, serving as the primary strategic contact for owners and managing partners.
  • Lead alignment calls and quarterly business reviews with decision makers, establishing clear agreement on goals, roles, timeline, and budget for the quarter ahead.

  • Track performance across the full client acquisition path, from initial lead through qualified lead, consultation, signed client, and funded agreement.
  • Extend the conversation beyond marketing into pricing, intake, operations, capacity, and hiring, where the real constraints on a firm's growth usually sit.
  • Identify growth opportunities and early signals of churn, raising both internally well before they surface with the client.

  • The ability to raise a difficult subject, whether an unrealistic goal or a number the client cannot produce, without damaging the relationship.

Role Mission

This role is the first stage of processing our new volunteer applications. This person will review new volunteer applications, screen out applications that do not meet our standards, send out scheduling links, and oversee the pipeline of applications through the interview stage.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Screening

  • M-F daily check in on new applications

  • Watches the number of applicants per role

  • Screens out applicants who do not meet our standards

Key Results Area #2 - Scheduling

Key Results Area #3 - Application Pipeline

  • Moves applicant through pipeline using software

  • Keeps pipeline organized

Needed Skills

  • Self starter - willing to dive in & figure out the various softwares

  • Detailed oriented - lots of candidates/stages to keep track of

  • Communication - not afraid to reach out/ask questions

  • Think outside the box - willing to change/improve processes

  • Organized - just plain helps

  • Love, love pups

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one dog destination in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokanes love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, freedom and God.

No NGO status here, we dont take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. Were about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We dont do drama. There are no victims here and the system isnt out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We dont bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where its normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dogs birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isnt being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

jobs.description:
About Mission Inbox

Mission Inbox is a B2B email infrastructure platform processing 80M+ emails per month for 130+ customers globally; including enterprise accounts paying us $240K+ per year. We're cash-flow positive, profitable, and growing 233% YoY with 139% NRR; early-stage growth without survival anxiety.

We operate fully remote, globally distributed, at the execution standards of a company 10x our size. Our team ships three product lines we call "Cubes": Sales & Marketing email infrastructure, and Transactional email. Our AI Shield; trained on 90M+ emails; is the defensible moat in a category where deliverability gets harder every quarter.

The Role

You'll be Mission Inbox's first dedicated Enterprise Account Executive. We've proven the model; customers already pay us $60K, $120K, and $240K+ ACVs. Your job is to find more of them.

You'll build and own a focused list of 80–100 named target accounts; Fortune 1000 marketing leaders, high-growth scale-ups with serious outbound or transactional volume, and platform companies whose email is mission-critical. You'll work both our Sales & Marketing and Transactional cubes, multi-threading across CMOs, RevOps, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Procurement.

You report directly to the CRO. You'll partner with Marketing on 1:1 and 1:few ABM plays, and with our SMB Sales team for warm pass-ups from inbound. This isn't a lone-wolf seat — it's the lead role on a coordinated hunt.

What You'll Do

  • Own a named account list of 80–100 target companies across Sales & Marketing and Transactional cubes. Build it, hunt it, defend it.
  • Land $60K+ ACV deals as your baseline, with $200K+ whale hunts as your stretch.
  • Multi-thread accounts — 5+ stakeholders per opportunity: Marketing Ops, RevOps, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Procurement, Security.
  • Become the email infrastructure expert in the room — speak credibly about deliverability, sender reputation, IP warming, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and the competitive landscape.
  • Run procurement — security reviews, MSAs, DPAs, vendor onboarding. You'll inherit playbooks from our existing $240K deals.
  • Partner with Marketing on ABM plays for your top 20 accounts.
  • Partner with SMB Sales to catch upmarket signals from inbound.
  • Shape the enterprise roadmap — you'll be closer to enterprise buyer requirements than anyone, and your input goes directly to product.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 4–7 years of B2B SaaS closing experience as a quota-carrying AE — not SDR background dressed up.
  • Proven track record closing $80K–$250K ACV deals. This is non-negotiable. Show us deal stories, not LinkedIn taglines.
  • B2B infrastructure, devtools, martech, or RevOps tech background — Twilio/SendGrid/Postmark, Outreach/Apollo/Salesloft, HubSpot/Marketo, or similar adjacent categories.
  • Technically fluent — you can hold a 30-minute conversation with a CTO about APIs, authentication, IP reputation, and infrastructure without needing a Solutions Engineer on the line.
  • Multi-thread by instinct — you've never won a real deal selling to only one champion.
  • English fluency, written and verbal. Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus.
  • Resilient and patient on enterprise cycles — you've worked deals over multiple quarters without losing edge.
  • Builder mindset — you'll co-create the enterprise playbook. No polished one exists yet.

Benefits

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $32,000 USD, paid monthly.
  • Variable Commission: $48,000 USD at 100% attainment. This is uncapped and paid out quarterly ($12k per quarter).
  • On-Target Earnings (OTE): Your total compensation at 100% quota attainment is $80,000 USD.
  • Accelerators: Hit above 100% of your quarterly quota and commissions are paid out at 1.25x the standard rate.
  • Annual Catch-up Clause: If you miss quota in one quarter but meet your $600K–$800K annual goal, we will pay you the difference owed at year-end.

Realistic upside: Closing two whale deals ($200K+ ACV each) plus a steady $60K cadence puts you at $1M+ attainment — total comp in the $140K–$180K range. That's the math. We don't hide it.

How We Measure Success

We're transparent about performance expectations. You'll get them in writing in your offer letter.

30/60/90 Day Ramp Milestones

  • By 30 Days (Setup Phase): You will select and prioritize 100 target accounts, master our product and the competitive landscape, and initiate over 200 outbound activities.
  • By 60 Days (Pipeline Building): You'll have created 6+ qualified opportunities, conducted 3+ product demos, moved at least 1 deal into technical evaluation, and established multi-threaded engagement (2+ stakeholders) on 2 or more accounts.
  • By 90 Days (Closing Readiness): You are expected to have a total of 12+ qualified opportunities, $150K+ in qualified pipeline, and at least 1 deal moving into the final, late-stage closing process.

Year 1 Quarterly Quota Structure

  • Q1 (Ramp Quarter): Your target is $30K–$50K in Closed-Won revenue. You must also maintain a $300K qualified pipeline to ensure future success.
  • Q2: Target: $100K–$150K Closed-Won, requiring 3x rolling quarterly quota coverage in your pipeline.
  • Q3: Target: $200K–$250K Closed-Won, requiring 3x rolling quarterly quota coverage.
  • Q4: Target: $250K–$350K Closed-Won, requiring 3x rolling quarterly quota coverage.
  • Year 1 Total Goal: Bring in $600K–$800K in new Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR).

We use MEDDPICC as our qualification framework, run weekly pipeline reviews with the CRO, and operate on a quarterly compensation cadence (not annual). You'll know where you stand at all times — and so will we.

What You Won't Have (Yet)

Honesty matters here, so we'll say it in the JD:

  • No dedicated Solutions Engineer yet — you'll be the SE on most calls. (Coming next, but not today.)
  • Published pricing tops out at $599/month Pro plan — enterprise SKUs are being defined now, and you'll help shape them.
  • SOC 2 is in progress, not complete.
  • We move fast and make mistakes. You'll operate inside imperfect systems.

If that excites you, you're our person. If it concerns you, you're not — and that's fine.

Why This Role

If you want a Fortune 500 logo on your resume and $400K OTE in Manhattan, this isn't the right seat. But if you want to be the founding Enterprise AE inside a profitable, growing platform that already closes $240K deals — and grow into a CRO or VP Sales role in 3–5 years as we scale — this is one of the highest-leverage seats in B2B SaaS right now.

Direct line of sight to the CRO and CEO. Real influence on what enterprise looks like at Mission Inbox. Inside a profitable company that isn't going to disappear in the next funding winter.

CRS is seeking candidates for a multi-country child development, care, and protection project. The project will improve outcomes for vulnerable children by strengthening child protection systems, supporting families and caregivers, advancing integrated early childhood health and development, and reducing reliance on residential care.

The Sr Grants and Compliance Manager, provides oversight of CRS grants and compliance systems across the global Child SAFE program, focusing on sub award management under an FAA. The role is responsible for leading the implementation, standardization, and continuous strengthening of CRS policies, procedures, and operational frameworks, ensuring consistent and compliant application across participating country programs and partners within the assigned ChildSAFE portfolio. The role ensures a coherent, high-quality, and risk-informed approach to grant management, with accountability for system performance, compliance integrity, and operational effectiveness at scale. The position drives institutional learning, system improvement, and global harmonization of practices to support rapid, accountable emergency responses.

Global Policy and Systems Leadership

  • Lead the development and implementation of CRS ChildSAFE FAA sub awards, including compliance policies, procedures, and systems.

Strategic Grants Management and Oversight

We are looking for an Embedded AI Engineer to design, optimize, and deploy machine learning models that run efficiently on resource-constrained edge devices, including mobile platforms, embedded systems, and specialized accelerators. The role requires deep expertise in model compression, quantization, and hardware-aware optimization, along with strong systems engineering skills to ship reliable AI capabilities outside the data center. The ideal candidate has shipped edge AI in production environments where compute, memory, energy, and connectivity constraints fundamentally shape the engineering trade-offs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement edge AI solutions optimized for diverse hardware including mobile SoCs, NPUs, and embedded accelerators.
  • Apply quantization, pruning, distillation, and architectural optimization to fit models within edge constraints.
  • Tune model performance for latency, energy efficiency, and memory footprint on target hardware.
  • Build cross-platform inference runtimes leveraging frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime, and Core ML.
  • Optimize models for specific accelerator backends including DSPs, NPUs, and mobile GPUs.
  • Implement on-device model update, versioning, and rollback workflows that allow safe staged rollouts to large device populations and rapid recovery if a model release behaves unexpectedly in the field.
  • Design hybrid edge-cloud architectures that gracefully degrade based on connectivity and device capability.
  • Build telemetry pipelines that respect privacy while enabling continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and product teams to align AI capabilities with device constraints.
  • Implement secure execution paths, model protection, and integrity verification on edge devices.
  • Develop benchmarking suites that characterize accuracy, latency, and energy trade-offs across devices.
  • Drive responsible AI considerations including on-device privacy and bias evaluation.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Stay current with edge AI hardware and software developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Solid understanding of mobile and embedded hardware architectures.

  • Strong performance engineering and profiling skills.
  • Familiarity with on-device privacy and security considerations.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Experience with custom NPU or DSP toolchains.
  • Familiarity with federated learning or on-device personalization.
  • Exposure to safety-critical or industrial edge deployments.

What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior International Marketing Manager to build Roo's brand and growth in every market we enter outside the US. Roo launched in Canada in September 2026, our first market outside the US, and we're growing across Canada while planning the countries that come next.

You'll lead marketing for Roo's international markets and be accountable for the outcome: bringing animal hospitals and veterinary professionals onto Roo in each new market and keeping them engaged. You'll define the marketing strategy, own the go-to-market and engagement plans, and partner closely with Roo's sales, brand, lifecycle, partnerships, and other marketing teams to bring them to life. Drawing on deep knowledge of each market, you'll guide partners with the direction and local insight they need for anything Roo launches there. Along the way, you'll build the playbook Roo uses to launch every new country.

Responsibilities

Market Strategy & Go-to-Market

  • Own the marketing strategy for Roo's international markets, setting goals for acquisition and brand presence on both sides of the marketplace.
  • Lead go-to-market and engagement planning for each new market: audience and market insight, positioning, channel mix, budget, timeline, and measurement.
  • Build Roo's international launch playbook so each new country launches faster and with less lift than the last.
  • Bring the voice of each market back to Roo, sharing what you learn from veterinary professionals, hospitals, and partners to shape product, pricing, and marketing decisions.

Positioning & Messaging

  • Define Roo's positioning and messaging for each market in partnership with the brand and product marketing teams, building on Roo's core frameworks and grounding them in how veterinary professionals and hospitals there work, hire, and think about their careers.
  • Develop the proof points, customer stories, and data that build Roo's credibility in a new market.
  • Own each market's messaging framework and set the standard for Roo's voice and narrative in market, partnering with the brand and lifecycle teams to bring it into campaigns, the website, sales materials, and the product experience.
  • Know each country's marketing, privacy, and anti-spam laws, apply them to every campaign, and educate other internal teams on these laws, ensuring compliance.

Acquisition & Growth

  • Own acquisition strategy and budget for each market across paid, organic, referral, and partner channels.
  • Partner with the sales and account management teams on hospital and veterinary professionals acquisition and growth, aligning on targets and pipeline and equipping them with the messaging, materials, and campaigns that support their outreach.
  • Partner with the lifecycle team on onboarding, activation, and engagement journeys for each market, bringing the audience insight, messaging, and goals that shape them, and reviewing performance together to turn new sign-ups into active users.
  • Shape referral and ambassador programs that help veterinary professionals and hospitals bring Roo to their peers.

Brand Presence & Community

  • Partner with the brand team to grow Roo's presence in each market, bringing local insight and ideas to campaigns, content, design, and creative so the work feels like Roo and lands locally.
  • Partner with the brand team on PR and earned media for each market, surfacing local stories, voices, and media opportunities that build Roo's credibility.
  • Bring ideas for Roo's presence at conferences, trade shows, CE events, and industry moments, and partner with the brand, events, and partnerships teams to bring them to life, from concept and experience through the follow-up that turns attendees into Roo users.
  • Build relationships with local partners, key opinion leaders, and industry associations that help Roo earn trust in a new market.

Measurement & Insights

  • Own marketing measurement for each market, setting goals and metrics before every launch and campaign and tracking performance across the funnel on both sides of the marketplace.
  • Track channel and campaign performance against budget, read signals in early data, and shift investment toward what's working.
  • Measure brand awareness and perception as Roo grows in each market, partnering with the brand team on research.
  • Share clear, regular reporting on what's working, what isn't, and what's next with international and marketing leadership.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

  • Launch in new Canadian markets on schedule.
  • Grow hospital and veterinary professional acquisition in Canada against plan and within budget.
  • Grow Roo's brand presence in Canada, so Roo shows up in the industry moments and conversations that matter to veterinary professionals and hospitals.
  • Set a clear measure for every channel and move investment toward what works.
  • Build a launch playbook that's ready for Roo's next country.
  • Prepare and lead the next country launch

Qualifications

  • You have deep experience in multi-channel marketing strategy, including launching a brand or product in a new market or country.
  • You've owned positioning and messaging for a professional audience and built the proof points that made it credible.
  • You've owned acquisition budgets and measurement, and make smart trade-offs when data is early.
  • You bring cross-functional partners together around a shared plan and move work forward through people you don't manage.
  • You're comfortable building from ambiguity and move easily between strategy and hands-on work.
  • You understand marketing and privacy regulation across countries, ideally including Canada.
  • Thoughtful about where AI and emerging tools improve how marketing teams work, and where human judgment matters most.
  • Experience in veterinary medicine, healthcare, marketplaces, labor platforms, or international expansion is a plus.

Why Roo

  • Lead marketing for Roo's first international markets and shape how Roo grows around the world.
  • Build the launch playbook Roo uses for every new country.
  • Work across strategy, messaging, acquisition, and brand, with the support of Roo's central marketing teams.

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Kaseya is seeking a proactive, highly organized, and business-minded Executive Assistant to support a senior executive. This individual will operate with a high degree of discretion, professionalism, and judgment, helping the executive maximize their time, focus, and impact across a fast-paced, high-growth organization.

The ideal candidate is more than an administrative support professional. They are proactive, anticipate needs, understand business priorities, effectively manage competing demands, and ensure the executive is prepared for critical meetings, decisions, and commitments. They are comfortable operating independently, adapting to changing priorities, and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

The successful candidate will leverage modern productivity tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to enhance executive effectiveness, streamline administrative processes, improve information management, and increase efficiency. They should be comfortable incorporating AI into daily workflows to reduce manual effort, improve the quality of deliverables, and support effective decision-making.

The Executive Assistant will work closely with senior leadership and key stakeholders and may support interactions with Kaseya's leadership team, Board members, investors, and other high-profile individuals. Experience supporting senior executives in a private equity-backed or high-growth technology organization is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive administrative and operational support to a senior executive, managing priorities, time, information, and relationships.
  • Manage a complex and dynamic executive calendar, ensuring time is aligned with business priorities and high-value activities.
  • Anticipate scheduling conflicts, preparation requirements, information gaps, and follow-up needs before they become issues.
  • Serve as a professional liaison between the executive and internal and external stakeholders, exercising sound judgment regarding priorities, access, and communication.
  • Coordinate meeting logistics, agendas, pre-reads, presentations, briefing materials, and other preparation requirements.

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, including detailed itineraries, logistics, and last-minute changes.
  • Draft, edit, and coordinate executive communications, presentations, and other business materials with professionalism and attention to detail.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to assist with meeting preparation, summarizing information, drafting communications, organizing notes, tracking action items, and streamlining administrative tasks.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve workflows, and increase productivity.
  • Stay informed about emerging AI capabilities and productivity tools relevant to executive support.
  • Use AI tools responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and following company policies regarding data security and approved technology.
  • Handle confidential, sensitive, and business-critical information with exceptional discretion and judgment.
  • Build strong working relationships across the organization and effectively coordinate with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Support special projects and business initiatives by coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, organizing information, and tracking deliverables.
  • Identify opportunities to improve executive effectiveness, team communication, and administrative processes.
  • Represent the executive with professionalism, responsiveness, and sound judgment in all interactions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative support role, preferably supporting senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting VP-level, C-suite, or other senior executives in a fast-paced organization.
  • Proven ability to anticipate executive needs, manage competing priorities, and proactively drive follow-through.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage complex calendars, multiple stakeholders, and changing priorities.
  • Experience using AI-powered tools or modern productivity technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, or enhance the quality of work.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools for meeting summaries, research, content creation, communication drafting, or administrative support.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with executives, employees, and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and make decisions without constant direction.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed and effective in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Zoom, and other executive productivity and collaboration tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a C-suite executive or senior leader in a global organization.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed organization or high-growth technology or SaaS company.
  • Experience coordinating Board meetings, Board materials, investor meetings, or other executive-level engagements.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or comparable generative AI platforms.
  • Experience identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes through automation or technology.
  • Experience supporting executives through organizational growth, transformation, or change.
  • Experience working across multiple time zones and supporting globally distributed teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.description:
About We Are Rosie

By advocating for remote work, inclusion, and flexibility, We Are Rosie has changed how big brands build their marketing teams and unlocked thousands of opportunities for marketers, especially those marginalized by how work traditionally happened.

From our start as a team of three based in Atlanta, We Are Rosie has cultivated a community of 35,000+ marketers across North America dedicated to solving real brand challenges, without the retainers, unnecessary layers, or wasted time of traditional models.

The Role

We’re looking for a Talent Community Experience Manager to lead the programs, operations, and engagement strategies that support We Are Rosie’s diverse and inclusive community of independent marketing professionals.

This is a full-time position that can work from anywhere within the United States and will report directly to the Head of Rosie Experience.

This role is focused on building and operating scalable programs that keep our talent community engaged, informed, prepared for opportunities, and connected to the value of being a Rosie. It goes beyond traditional community management, with a focus on the programs, operations, and experiences that support our talent throughout their journey with We Are Rosie.

You’ll own programs and touchpoints across the talent lifecycle — from onboarding and ongoing engagement to learning cohorts, talent readiness, re-engagement, segmentation, and platform experience. You’ll use community signals and data to understand where engagement is strong, where gaps exist, and what programs, communications, or experiences can better support both our talent and business needs.

This role operates at the intersection of talent engagement, community experience, program management, operations, and data. You’ll work closely across Product, Data, Client Experience, Business Development, and Marketing, while overseeing the Community Learning function as part of the broader talent community experience.

Responsibilities

Community Engagement & Experience

  • Own and evolve the Rosie Community experience across onboarding, communications, engagement programs, and ongoing touchpoints, creating a consistent and high-quality talent journey at scale.
  • Maintain and evolve community value proposition messaging across onboarding, communications, and engagement materials based on member feedback and business needs.
  • Build and manage scalable, tiered engagement programs designed around the needs and behaviors of different talent segments.
  • Monitor community engagement and talent segmentation to identify changes in readiness, engagement, and alignment with current opportunities.
  • Develop structured nurture journeys that move talent through defined stages of engagement and readiness.
  • Design and launch re-engagement strategies for dormant or low-engagement talent and measure their effectiveness.
  • Own day-to-day community platform operations and support platform transitions or migrations in partnership with relevant teams, maintaining continuity in communication and setting clear expectations throughout periods of change.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop and distribute audience-appropriate content and communications, providing context around talent segments and their journeys.
  • Own the existing community support model, identifying recurring themes, triaging unresolved issues, and routing persistent gaps to the appropriate teams.

Talent Readiness & Enablement

  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of Community Learning programs, including course and cohort calendars, logistics, communications, enrollment, and operations, in partnership with the Program Manager, Community Learning.
  • Manage cohort programs day to day, including milestones, enrollment, delivery logistics, communications, and outcome tracking.
  • Own credentialing and talent-signaling processes, ensuring relevant readiness indicators remain current and visible to client-facing teams.
  • Manage logistics and administrative follow-through for approved learning partnerships and provide operational input during evaluation.
  • Help ensure learning programs and positioning remain aligned with active client demand, surfacing gaps or opportunities for strategic review.

Portal Engagement & Experience

  • Serve as a key Community voice into Product, representing talent needs, experiences, and engagement insights in roadmap discussions.
  • Maintain visibility into portal data quality, workflow friction, and engagement gaps and clearly document findings for Product partners.
  • Provide operational and community insights as Product evaluates new tools, integrations, learning resources, and AI-enabled workflows designed to improve the talent experience.

Talent Intelligence

  • Serve as a bridge between data and business stakeholders, helping ensure community and talent insights are understood and actionable.
  • Translate completed analysis from Data partners into clear narratives, recommendations, and potential actions.
  • Connect talent and engagement data to opportunities for improving community programming, readiness, communications, and experience.
  • Distribute relevant talent intelligence and operational context to Client Experience, Business Development, and other key stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Surface talent supply gaps, engagement trends, and emerging community needs to key stakeholders.
  • Track and report progress against quarterly goals, identifying blockers, trends, and trade-offs that require leadership visibility or decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive program and community workflows and partner with the appropriate teams to scope and implement solutions.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to align communications with talent segmentation, priority roles, supply gaps, and community journeys.
  • Work cross-functionally across Product, Data, Client Experience, Business Development, and Marketing to ensure talent programs support broader business priorities.

Requirements

  • Passion for community-building and creating experiences that feel human.
  • 5+ years of experience in talent community programs, community operations, member experience, talent engagement, program management, or a similar role supporting a professional or workforce-based community.
  • Demonstrated experience owning scalable engagement or lifecycle programs for a professional, talent, member, or marketplace community, including segmentation, communications, re-engagement, and program measurement.
  • 2+ years of experience in cohort-based program management, learning operations, or course/bootcamp delivery, including enrollment, milestones, logistics, communications, and learning calendars end-to-end.
  • Experience managing community or member programs and supporting engagement across different audience segments.
  • Experience leading a platform migration, tool transition, or other significant change-management initiative within a community or member base.
  • Comfortable representing member or user needs to Product teams and translating feedback into clear, actionable input.
  • Comfortable taking completed data analysis from a Data partner and translating it into a clear narrative and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create community member-facing communications, stakeholder updates, and internal documentation in a brand-aligned and authentic voice.
  • Strong organizational and program-management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and a demonstrated ability to build trust and strong relationships.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment while maintaining a thoughtful, consistent, and high-quality experience.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset.
  • Alignment with We Are Rosie’s core values.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using community and collaboration platforms such as Discord.
  • Experience with learning management systems, particularly Moodle.
  • People management experience, including experience leading, managing, or coordinating employees, contractors, moderators, or other program support resources.
  • Practical experience leveraging automation, agentic workflows, or AI-enabled tools to optimize workflows and improve efficiency.

Perks & Benefits

A yearly stipend for professional and personal development; 25 PTO days + 4 Volunteer PTO days per year; medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave; remote work stipend; matching 401K; and an opportunity to join a truly incredible team at a company that is building the future of work.

OUR VALUES

Treat People Like People - Seeing the value in all people’s unique lives, experiences, and perspectives is what drives us.

Start With Why - Asking “Why” makes our team curious first so we get to better solutions. When we make a decision, we take the time to explain the “Why”’ behind our actions. Transparency is clear and it’s kind.

Speak With Actions - Trust isn’t given, it’s earned. We prove our reliability and trustworthiness to each other, our clients, and our Rosies by showing up and doing what we say we will — through small interactions and big moves.

Bring Tenacity - The path isn’t always an easy one, but our team chooses to be unwavering in our goal. We’re resilient, determined, and stubborn when necessary. That’s the fire it takes to get things done.

Make it Better - From changing old processes to disrupting the marketing industry, we know there is room to make it better. We strive to find those improvements and push them to reality.

We Are Rosie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, marital status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Accessibility Statement

We Are Rosie is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need accommodations during the application or interview stages, and we will assist you. We aim to provide an equitable experience for all candidates to showcase their skills. For questions about accessibility, please contact us at . Title: Senior Technical Product Manager

Job Function: Product Management

Employment Type: Full-time

About the position

The Principal Product Manager for Command Certificate Lifecycle Managementis responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Command Certificate Lifecycle Management product line. This role requires deep expertise in cryptographic security, machine identity management, and SaaS/on-prem hybrid solutions. The Principal Product Manager will drive Command Certificate Lifecycle Management’s evolution as the central certificate lifecycle management platform, ensuring it delivers innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions that address the needs of enterprise customers and strategic partners.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

This is a remote position.

Our client is looking for a SOC Analyst to join their IT department and oversee security operations across their endpoints, cloud systems, and identity infrastructure. They are a prominent full-service legal practice that has recently been recognized among the top employers in their region for workplace excellence and continued organizational growth. Reporting to the IT Director, this hands-on operator will serve as the central point of contact for cybersecurity, collaborating closely with a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) and internal IT personnel to validate alerts, contain threats, drive tickets to closure, and strengthen security policies and controls.

Responsibilities
  • Monitor, triage, and respond to security alerts generated by the MSSP, XDR platforms (including SentinelOne and Windows Defender), and additional security tools across endpoints, identity, and cloud systems.
  • Quickly validate security detections by distinguishing between false positives and true positives, assessing the scope of impact, and thoroughly documenting all supporting evidence.
  • Take full end-to-end ownership of security tickets by categorizing, prioritizing, escalating as needed, and driving issues to complete closure with clear timelines and detailed notes.
  • Coordinate threat containment measures with the internal IT team—such as isolating endpoints, executing account actions, and blocking malicious indicators—in alignment with established incident response procedures and severity guidelines.
  • Strengthen security configurations within Microsoft 365 and endpoint detection and response (EDR) environments.
  • Analyze trends across alerts and security incidents to recommend and implement approved policy and control adjustments that mitigate risk and reduce recurring alert noise, including tuning detection logic, tightening access controls, and updating security standards.
  • Maintain, refine, and update SOC playbooks and incident response documentation as new threat patterns emerge.
  • Prepare concise, decision-ready weekly and monthly security reports for the IT Director covering incident summaries (events, impact, and remediation), alert volumes and categories, response times, closure quality, control gaps, and recommended fixes.
  • Support ongoing continuous improvement initiatives focused on endpoint telemetry, security monitoring, and incident response workflows.

Requirements

Requirements
  • 2+ years of hands-on professional experience in a SOC analyst, security monitoring, or incident response role.
  • Demonstrated experience triaging security alerts and managing tickets from initial detection through final resolution rather than solely monitoring dashboards.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, and/or SentinelOne, alongside Microsoft 365 security administration.
  • Solid knowledge of SIEM, EDR, firewall, and network security technologies.
  • Practical understanding of endpoint detection and response (EDR) concepts and common cyberattack patterns.
  • Exceptional written documentation habits with the proven ability to construct clear, defensible incident timelines and comprehensive remediation notes.
  • Strong verbal and written English proficiency to communicate security risks in plain language to IT leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Active cybersecurity certification (or earned within the last 3 years) from at least one of the following: CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, Microsoft SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst), GIAC (entry to mid-level options), or an equivalent recognized security credential.

Qualifications
  • Direct hands-on experience with SentinelOne alert triage and incident response workflows.
  • Prior experience collaborating alongside an MSSP, managing alert escalations, and fulfilling evidence requests.
  • Background working within a law firm, financial institution, or professional services environment where strict confidentiality and chain-of-custody discipline are critical.
  • Experience drafting, reviewing, or updating cybersecurity policies and standards based on lessons learned from security incidents.
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation tools, such as PowerShell or Python, to accelerate alert triage and evidence collection.

Benefits

Benefits
  • Full-time, 100% remote position.
  • Consistent working schedule from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with approximately one hour of flexibility in either direction.
  • Opportunity for long-term stability with potential to transition to a direct hire role in the future.

Latino Legends connects exceptional Latin American talent with international companies building and scaling high-performing remote teams. We partner with companies across the US, Canada, the UK, and Australia to match skilled professionals with opportunities where they can make a meaningful impact.

About the Role

Our client is a US-based software company with an engineering team of approximately 30 people, supporting a large monolithic platform alongside a growing ecosystem of microservices. With dedicated architects for frontend and data, they are looking for a Principal Backend Architect / Engineer to take ownership of the backend architecture, the most extensive and business-critical part of their platform.

In this role, you'll shape the architecture of the backend ecosystem, including the monolith, microservices, APIs, messaging infrastructure, and integrations. You'll establish engineering standards, guide the platform's evolution toward well-defined services, and remain hands-on with implementation to ensure architectural decisions translate into reliable, scalable production systems.

You'll work closely with the Lead/Principal Architect, Principal UI Architect, and Data Architect to drive technical direction across the platform.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role, ideal for an experienced engineer who combines architectural ownership with strong technical execution. There are no direct reports, and hands-on development remains a core part of the position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own backend architecture across the platform and lead the incremental decomposition of a large monolith into well-defined, maintainable services.

  • Establish backend engineering standards, best practices, and tooling, including shared libraries, service templates, and cross-cutting platform capabilities.

  • Lead API and contract design, ensuring effective versioning, backward compatibility, and reliable communication between internal services, frontend applications, and external integrations.

  • Own event-driven architecture using Azure Service Bus, including message delivery guarantees, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.

  • Define scalable patterns for customer and partner integrations, ensuring failures are observable, traceable, and recoverable.

  • Collaborate with the Data Architect on data ownership, transactional boundaries, access patterns, and query performance.

  • Improve platform reliability, security, observability, and cloud cost efficiency.

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering practices and help expand the team's capabilities through practical adoption of AI tools and workflows.

  • Mentor engineers, review critical pull requests, facilitate technical office hours, and document architectural decisions through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

  • Contribute to incident response, technical interviews, quarterly planning, and occasional customer-facing technical discussions.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of backend engineering experience, including several years in architecture or technical leadership roles at the principal level.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in C# and .NET, with a proven track record of designing and delivering secure, scalable, and resilient commercial backend systems.

  • Practical experience with Azure services, particularly Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Data Factory.

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, Snowflake, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.

  • Demonstrated success incrementally decomposing large monolithic systems, prioritizing safe, reversible changes over disruptive rewrites.

  • Strong understanding of event-driven and asynchronous architectures, including message ordering, idempotency, poison messages, retries, and dead-letter queues.

  • Extensive experience with API design, service contracts, versioning, and backward compatibility.

  • Strong data-access fundamentals, including query optimization, zero-downtime migrations, and handling inconsistent or complex customer data.

  • Proven production ownership, including observability, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.

  • Required: Daily, hands-on use of AI development tools such as Claude, Claude Code, or comparable agentic engineering tools, along with practical experience building AI-powered solutions involving agents, reusable skills, MCP servers, or evaluations.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What We're Looking For

This opportunity is specifically for a true Principal-level engineer, not simply a strong Senior Engineer.

The ideal candidate has personally owned significant architectural decisions in production environments, influenced engineering practices across multiple teams, and successfully guided complex technical transformations without relying on formal management authority.

Candidates must be able to provide concrete examples of architectural decisions they personally made, the trade-offs involved, and the measurable outcomes. Experience leading the incremental decomposition of a large monolith is particularly valuable.

High-level architectural knowledge alone will not be sufficient. The client is highly selective and is looking for someone who can demonstrate both deep technical expertise and a clear record of architectural ownership while continuing to write production code.

Why Join?

  • Real architectural ownership: Shape the backend architecture of a business-critical software platform.

  • Technical influence: Help define engineering standards and guide technical decisions across multiple teams.

  • Hands-on impact: Stay close to the code while leading complex architectural initiatives.

  • AI-forward engineering: Help shape how a growing engineering organization integrates AI into its everyday development practices.

  • Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced architects and engineers who value thoughtful technical decisions and continuous improvement.

Engagement Details

  • Full-time, remote independent contractor engagement.

  • Compensation of $45–$50 USD per hour, depending on experience and fit.

  • Timesheet submission is required.

  • Days off, sick days, and local holidays are not billable. Working on local holidays may be possible by prior arrangement.

  • Company hardware will be shipped to the selected candidate. The anticipated start date is approximately four weeks after the offer is signed.

Application Process

Our recruitment team will carefully evaluate candidates' technical depth, architectural ownership, hands-on engineering experience, and practical use of AI development tools.

Please highlight specific production examples of architectural decisions you've owned, large-scale backend transformations you've led, and how you've influenced engineering teams without formal authority.

Only candidates who meet the principal-level requirements and can demonstrate the required experience will be presented to the client.

About the role

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to help CES build customer relationships and win new work across battery storage, solar and data center services.

You will work with CES business development leadership, operations and technical teams to identify opportunities, understand customer needs and develop proposals. Position summary

The Business Development Manager helps move opportunities from the first conversation with the potential customer through proposal, award and handoff to operations. You will develop new contacts, stay close to existing customers and keep opportunities moving with consistent outreach and follow-up. Critically, you will also pursue new customers for CES through various channels, and will have the support of the existing business development team in doing so.

You will work with business development leadership on account strategy and commercial discussions, operations on scope and staffing, technical teams on service requirements, and estimating and legal on pricing and agreements.

This is a hands-on business development role with support from experienced leadership and significant interaction with customers. You should be comfortable starting conversations, asking questions and bringing the right CES people into a discussion when needed.

Key responsibilities

Customer relationships and outreach

  • Build relationships with asset owners (including utilities and independent power producers), developers, data center owners and operators, EPC contractors and equipment manufacturers.
  • Reach out to prospective customers, introduce CES and arrange meetings.
  • Assist the business development team in “closing deals” with prospective customers to generate revenue for CES.
  • Stay in regular contact with existing accounts to understand upcoming work and additional service needs.
  • Prepare for customer meetings and document priorities, commitments and next steps.

Opportunity development
