  • Prepare proposals using CES templates and established approval processes.
  • Track RFP requirements, submission deadlines and customer clarification requests.
  • Follow up on proposals and help address customer questions.
  • Support commercial discussions and contract negotiations with guidance from CES leadership.

Pipeline and reporting

  • Keep CRM records current with customer activity, opportunity value, stage, timing and next steps.
  • Provide regular updates on active opportunities, expected awards and items requiring support.
  • Help maintain realistic forecasts based on customer conversations and project schedules.
  • Share customer feedback and market observations with the CES team.

Internal coordination and handoff

  • Confirm proposed services and customer commitments with the teams responsible for delivering them.
  • Bring operational or commercial concerns forward early.
  • Keep the CRM current with accurate account information, opportunity status, customer interactions, and next steps to support reporting, pipeline tracking, and internal handoffs.
  • Help hand awarded work over to operations with clear scope, pricing, schedule and customer expectations.
  • Stay engaged with customers after award to support the relationship and identify future needs.

Industry engagement

  • Represent CES at conferences, networking events, customer meetings and site visits.
  • Build familiarity with BESS, solar and data center technologies, service requirements and market activity.
  • Work with leadership and marketing to keep customer presentations and capabilities materials relevant.

What we are looking for

  • Strong communication skills and an ability to build relationships with different types of people.
  • Initiative and comfort reaching out to new contacts.
  • Someone who will grow into the role of owning the entire sales life cycle, from securing the initial meeting with the customer to finalizing a customer contract and sales win with the customer.
  • Organized person with strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Willingness to learn CES’s services, ask questions and take guidance.

  • Comfortable working with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, and learning CRM tools.

  • Experience with BESS, solar or data center infrastructure, along with existing industry contacts is preferred but not required.

What success looks like

What employees can expect from CES

  • Investment in employees who want long-term careers with CES, with clear paths for advancement.

Location and travel

Remote, with travel for customer meetings, site visits, industry conferences and CES team meetings. Travel will vary based on customer needs and business activity. Being located in Houston is a plus.

This is a remote position.

On behalf of our Client, a global consulting company which is expanding its SAP unit in Poland, we are looking for a Program Manager for the Retail & Consumer Products industry, who will shape and lead the definition and adoption of the integrated business transformation delivery methodology for S/4HANA-based digital transformations of retail, wholesale and consumer products (CPG) companies, from discovery and business case through delivery to stabilisation, based on SAP Activate.

jobs.title: Manager, Learner Services & Experiences
jobs.excerpt: The Organization: Meritus CollegeMeritus College is a new kind of not-for-profit online college, built from the ground up to meet the needs of working adults and career-changers who’ve been overlooked by traditional higher education.
jobs.description:
The Organization: Meritus College

Meritus College is a new kind of not-for-profit online college, built from the ground up to meet the needs of working adults and career-changers who’ve been overlooked by traditional higher education.

The problem is clear: only 33% of Pell grant recipients complete their degrees at two-year colleges within six years. College has become too rigid, too expensive, and too disconnected from both student realities and career outcomes. Meritus College is different. Our online, asynchronous programs and "workplace as laboratory" approach allow students to learn and apply new skills directly to their jobs, while receiving personalized support from dedicated coaches every step of the way. We focus on real-world skills and stackable credentials in high-demand fields, ensuring graduates are prepared for today's jobs and tomorrow's opportunities. Founded in 2025 with an inaugural Associate of Applied Science in Technology and Innovation degree, Meritus College is building a mainstream pathway to economic mobility—one designed not for the privileged few, but for the talented many who’ve too often been left behind.

Role Overview

At Meritus College, learner support is not a collection of disconnected services - it is a coordinated system designed to remove barriers, accelerate progress, and ensure every learner has access to the resources they need to succeed.

The Manager, Learner Services & Experiences, is responsible for ensuring that this system functions seamlessly. This role oversees the full ecosystem of learner support services, including academic advising, tutoring, wellness, accessibility, and library services. These services are delivered through a combination of AI-powered tools and external partners. This role ensures that services are available, accessible, high-quality, and effectively integrated into the learner experience. As Meritus College continues to build, you will own the learner services system end to end, setting the standards for how services are delivered and holding providers, tools, and processes to them.

The Manager, Learner Services & Experiences, serves as the central coordination point across services and as the primary escalation point for complex learner needs. They work closely with Learner Success Partners (coaches), instructors, instructor and program design team, and external providers to ensure learners are connected to the right support at the right time. This role reports to the Director of Instruction and Learner Experience.

This is a high-ownership, systems-oriented role designed for scale. It is a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of learner services with program management for the work: translating priorities into plans, coordinating providers and dependencies, tracking work, and building the service standards, policies, and workflows that do not yet exist. The Learner Success Partners (LSPs) report to this role. Because Meritus College is a small, collaborative team, you will lead as a working member of it: handling complex learner situations alongside LSPs, building shared coaching practices with them, and supporting their day-to-day work and growth.

You will be the connective point between how learner services are designed and how learners experience them. Working with the Manager, Instruction and Program Design, you will use what LSPs and service providers see in live delivery to improve services, policies, and courses rather than waiting for a formal review cycle.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:

Program and Project Management (15%):

  • Own the learner services portion of the instruction and learner support workplan, in coordination with the Manager, Instruction and Program Design, maintaining projects, milestones, owners, timelines, and statuses
  • Coordinate the learner services operating rhythm: facilitate team meetings and internal reviews, set agendas, document decisions and next steps, and ensure follow-through
  • Represent learner services in Functional Lead syncs within Meritus College, raising progress, asks, dependencies, decisions needed, and wins
  • Define and report learner services metrics (e.g., service use, time to resolution, learner satisfaction, persistence) to College leadership
  • Make staffing, capacity, and budget recommendations as enrollment grows, including LSP caseload ratios and vendor capacity

Learner Services Operations (20%):

  • Ensure all learner support services are operational, accessible, and aligned with learner needs
  • Create and maintain clear pathways for learners to access services such as academic advising, tutoring, wellness, and accessibility support
  • Monitor service usage and identify trends in learner needs and barriers to access
  • Continuously improve processes to create a seamless and intuitive learner experience
  • Translate College model into a coordinated set of services spanning advising, academic support, wellness, career, coaching, and financial and child care resources
  • Own the accommodations process end to end, from intake and documentation through approval, faculty notification, and record-keeping, in partnership with the Operations and Compliance team
  • Create and maintain service standards, response-time expectations, and learner-facing guides so services are consistent, accessible, and usable at scale

Service Coordination & Escalation (15%):

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex learner issues that require coordination across multiple services
  • Partner with Learner Success Partners (coaches) to ensure learners are connected to the appropriate resources
  • Ensure timely resolution of learner issues, maintain accurate documentation, and communicate with coaches and instructors
  • Establish protocols for learner crises, wellness concerns, and other urgent situations, including when and how to involve College leadership and outside resources
  • Manage the learner complaint and grievance process in partnership with the Compliance team, so complaints are documented, resolved, and tracked as accreditors and state regulators require

LSP Team Leadership & Support (15%):

  • Serve as the day-to-day lead for the Learner Success Partners (LSPs): hold regular check-ins, help prioritize their work, and be their first call when a learner situation gets complicated
  • Work with LSPs to build shared coaching practices (outreach, check-ins, referrals, and documentation), using case consultations and peer feedback to keep support consistent across learners
  • Coordinate LSP caseloads with the team, balancing assignments as enrollment grows and learner needs shift
  • Help onboard and train new LSPs on the learner services ecosystem, referral and escalation protocols, and FERPA and data privacy requirements
  • Use shared team measures (e.g., learner contact rates, referral follow-through, persistence) to spot where learners need more support and where the team needs more capacity

Vendor & Tool Management (10%):

  • Act as the primary liaison for external service providers including library and tutoring services, and AI-supported tools
  • Monitor service performance and learner experience across vendors and tools
  • Provide feedback and insights to improve service quality and effectiveness
  • Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to enhance or expand services over time
  • Manage vendor relationships end to end, including scoping, selection, contract terms and service-level expectations, performance reviews, and renewal recommendations
  • Evaluate AI-enabled support tools before and after adoption, with safeguards for learner privacy and accuracy and clear handoffs to a person when a learner needs one

Process Design & Continuous Improvement (15%):

  • Build and refine workflows for service access, triage, and escalation
  • Identify gaps in the learner services ecosystem and build practical solutions
  • Use learner feedback and data to inform improvements to services and processes
  • Contribute to the long-term design of a scalable, high-impact learner support model
  • Maintain learner services documentation (policies, procedures, service records, and outcome data) to a standard that holds up under accreditation review, in partnership with the Operations and Compliance team

Cross-Functional Collaboration (10%):

  • Partner with the instruction team so learners get coordinated, consistent support.
  • Provide guidance and clarity on how and when to utilize learner services
  • Share insights and trends to inform learner experience improvements
  • Partner with the Manager, Instruction and Program Design to turn what LSPs and service providers see in live delivery into course revisions, and to build learner services into courses where learners need them
  • Partner with recruitment and enrollment on the handoff from admission to onboarding so new learners are connected to services and an LSP from day one

Skills and Competencies

We recognize that some individuals from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet 100% of the listed qualifications. Please don’t let that discourage you from applying! We value the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each applicant brings, and we encourage you to apply if you believe your background demonstrates the required skills and competencies:

Must Haves for all roles at Meritus College:

  • Committed to Merit America’s mission to pave pathways to family-sustaining careers, break the poverty cycle, and create upward mobility for low-wage workers
  • Demonstrated history of embodying our values, which inform our work and drive our organization's culture
  • Shared sense of responsibility and ownership for our collective work in making a positive impact on the community we support, true to our value of Win & Lose Together
  • Committed to continuous learning and growth in advancing inclusive excellence and closing gaps across lines of difference
  • Passionate about fostering a workplace culture that embraces and values individual differences, aligned with our core value of inclusivity

Must Haves for this role:

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in higher education, counseling, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • 5+ years in student services, academic advising, coaching, or learner support, including designing or running support services for online, adult, or non-traditional learners

Systems Thinking & Operations

  • Ability to manage and improve complex systems involving multiple stakeholders, tools, and processes
  • Strong organizational and project management skills in fast-moving environments
  • Experience building or refining processes to improve user experience
  • Comfortable in a start-up environment, creating service standards, policies, and processes where none exist, and moving the work forward while building the system around it

Team Leadership

  • Experience leading a team, formally or informally, ideally coaches, advisors, or other frontline support staff
  • A collaborative leadership style: you build shared practices with colleagues, give and ask for direct feedback, and work through difficult learner situations alongside your team

Learner Support & Problem Solving

  • Experience supporting learners, students, or participants in education, workforce, or customer-facing environments
  • Familiarity with accessibility, accommodations, or wellness support frameworks
  • Working knowledge of student data privacy laws and disability accommodation requirements (ADA/Section 504) in higher education, or the ability to get up to speed quickly
  • Strong critical thinking skills to diagnose and resolve complex or ambiguous challenges
  • Ability to navigate sensitive situations with empathy and sound judgment

Coordination & Communication

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills
  • Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders, including external partners
  • Clear, concise communication with both learners and internal teams

Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Comfort using data and feedback to identify trends and inform decisions
  • Ability to translate insights into actionable improvements
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through
  • Understands and can apply data privacy and data security framework to all sensitive learner data.

Nice to Haves for this role:

  • Experience in higher education, student services, workforce development, or customer experience operations
  • Experience working with external vendors or managing partnerships
  • Experience working with or alongside AI-enabled tools or digital support systems

Other Logistics

  • This position is full-time
  • Location:Remote
  • Salary: $105,000

We take care of our employees by providing the following perks and benefits (please note that some of the benefits do not apply to temporary employees):

  • Medical, Dental and Vision insurance (100% Paid Employee Only Coverage)
  • Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account
  • Dependent care Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Reimbursement Account fully funded by Merit
  • Education & personal development reimbursement
  • Catalog of courses for professional learning and development
  • Short and long-term disability
  • Flexible PTO (after a 90-day introductory period)
  • Paid Parental Leave and Adoption benefits (after 1 year of employment)
  • 11 federally recognized holidays
  • 2 week holiday office closure in December/January
  • 401(k) retirement plan with automatic Merit contribution
  • Wellness Benefits/Wellness Resources
  • Discount perks at work program
  • Phone/technology stipend
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Affinity groups and community building via virtual, in-person, and/or regional meetups

*Eligibility for some benefits may vary based on employment status, full-time or part-time. Eligibility will be outlined during the hiring process.

Remote Work & Sponsorship

Candidates must reside within the 50 states or District of Columbia and have full authorization to work in the 50 U.S. states & the District of Columbia (international work abroad, including the U.S. territories (Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, and other islands are excluded). In addition, Merit America doesn't offer employment visa sponsorship.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Building an inclusive, high-performing team that is diverse across lines of personal identity is integral to our success and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

This means we do not discriminate against any job applicant or employee because of their race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We actively strive and evolve to develop and maintain workspaces that are fully inclusive. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply.

Still excited about our work? You can learn more about our work inthis video we made with our founding partner, Google.

jobs.excerpt: Vill du vara med och förändra vården? Då vill vi prata med dig!
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och förändra vården?

Då vill vi prata med dig!

Om den digitala tjänsten

Hej! Jag heter Maria Lundqvist och är verksamhetschef på Kry Digital. Jag tror på en enkel sak: vården blir bättre när vi vågar göra den annorlunda. I vår digitala tjänst jobbar vi nära varandra med hjälp av våra digitala verktyg. Det är lika självklart att be om hjälp som att komma med en ny idé. Vi är ett team på 140 medarbetare som delar samma övertygelse – att hög tillgänglighet, ny teknik och ett genuint fokus på kvalitet och patientnöjdhet inte är motsatser. Det bevisar vi varje dag.

Varför Kry?
Vi har förändrat hur vård bedrivs i Sverige i över tio år. Gjort den digital, tillgänglig och mer jämlik. Men vi är inte klara och det är poängen.På Kry tror vi att det modigaste du kan göra i vårdbranschen är att vara snäll. Och att de som kan vården ska styra den. Hos oss får du mandat att göra det - ta det, be inte om det.

Vad du faktiskt gör

Du genomför digitala konsultationer via vår plattform och du gör det på ett sätt som får patienter att känna sig sedda. Du kommer även arbeta direkt avlastande mot våra vårdcentraler och du kommer att arbeta i lokala journalsystem. Arbetet är brett. Du utreder, bedömer och behandlar patienter i alla åldrar: akuta bedömningar, långsiktig uppföljning, digitalt och fysiskt. Du samarbetar nära vårdcentralerna och övriga vårdflöden. Vi tror inte att digital och fysisk vård är varandras motpoler. De är varandras förutsättningar. Dina erfarenheter är med och formar hur vi arbetar, idag och framåt. Det kallar vi Kry-modellen.Läs mer om den här.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig

  • Du är allmänspecialist eller ST inom allmänmedicin med minst 2 års erfarenhet från vårdcentral.

  • Du tar ansvar och får saker gjorda.

  • Du trivs i förändring och ser det som kul.

  • Du levererar vård med hög kvalitet och sätter patienten först.

  • Du är flytande i både svenska och engelska.

  • Meriterande med kunskap inom Cosmic, Take Care eller PMO.

Praktiskt

Start: Höst/vinter 2026

Ersättning:Timlön eller konsultarvode

Arbetstid:Vardagar dagtid, kvällar efter 19 samt helg

Är du redo?

Skicka din ansökan senast 30/11 2026. Vid eventuella frågor, vänligen ämnesraden "Rekrytering läkare".

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Ta hand om dig ❤

jobs.description:
Farma Sales Manager (Business Leader)

Republic M Group BeNeLux

We zijn op zoek naar een Business Leader (BL) binnen onze BeNeLux markt.

Republic M

De farmaceutische industrie ontwikkelt nieuwe medicijnen die de levens van miljoenen patiënten verbeteren of zelfs redden. Zij werken met overheden, verzekeraars en medisch professionals om patiënten toegang te verschaffen tot nieuwe behandelingen. Republic M (RM) helpt farmaceuten om hun innovaties om te zetten in de klinische praktijk zodat meer patiënten ervan kunnen profiteren.

RM doet dit door namens farmaceuten via digitale kanalen te communiceren met medisch professionals om hun klinisch handelen te vernieuwen. De belangrijkste kanalen zijn 1 op 1 videogesprekken, online events en online platforms.

Bekijk voor meer informatie de website:

Functiebeschrijving

De Business Leaders (BLs) rapporteren aan de Executive Director van de BeNeLux en zijn verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van verschillende account management teams die namens de farmaceutische industrie videogesprekken doen met medisch professionals. Het doel van de gesprekken is het verbeteren van de diagnose en behandeling van bepaalde patiëntgroepen. Naast het aansturen van de verschillende sales teams is de BL projectleider van verschillende projecten die deze sales teams uitvoeren. De BL is tevens het primaire aanspreekpunt voor de verschillende opdrachtgevers (farmaceuten).

De BL werkt 100% online vanuit huis met behulp van de webcam en andere digitale tools. Dit hoeft niet vanuit een locatie binnen de BeNeLux te zijn. De BL is vrij om te werken van waaruit hij/zij wil, zolang de internetverbinding maar goed is.

Alle projecten hebben doelstellingen om het klinische gedrag van de medisch professionals te vernieuwen en/of te verbeteren. Hier profiteren zowel de patiënten als de farmaceuten van. De belangrijke verantwoordelijkheden van de BL zijn:

Leidinggeven aan de Virtual Key Account Managers en Medical Connection Agents in de verschillende projectteams voor de verschillende farmaceuten

Analyses en management rapportages maken voor de opdrachtgevers zodat zij weten wat de impact is en wij met elkaar de grootst mogelijke klantwaarde klantwaarde kunnen genereren

Klantbeheer en stakeholder management op project niveau

Interne samenwerking met de enabling teams (Business Excellence, HR, Finance en IT) en de collega BLs

Functievereisten

De ideale kandidaat is een volwassen en verantwoordelijk persoon met erkende HBO/academische kwalificaties en een bewezen staat van dienst in de farmaceutische industrie inclusief sales managementervaring (het aansturen van een field sales team). Hij/zij:

Is een ervaren manager/coach, met farma sales managementervaring

Heeft uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden

Heeft ervaring met het analyseren van gegevens, het doen van aanbevelingen en het opstellen van rapportages.

Kan zich op geloofwaardige wijze kunnen presenteren aan senior managers in de farmaceutische industrie (bijvoorbeeld Business Unit Directors) om bestaande projecten te managen en interventies te doen indien nodig

Is in staat zijn om meerdere projecten bij meerdere doelgroepen voor meerdere brands bij meerdere farmaceuten tegelijk uit te voeren

Vaardig zijn in het gebruik van AI (ChatGPT, Claude of Co-pilot), MS 365 inclusief Teams en andere algemene kantoorsoftware.

Competenties en waarden

De ideale kandidaat laat een houding en gedrag zien die verbonden is met de vier kernwaarden van RM:

VERANTWOORDELIJKHEID

  • Neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor prestaties en onderneemt actie
  • Vertoont positief en constructief gedrag
  • Neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling
  • Houdt zich aan verwachtingen en vraagt verantwoording van zichzelf en anderen
  • Ondersteunt collega’s (luisteren, een handje helpen / aanbod doen, zich vrijwillig inzetten)

INNOVATIEF

  • Nieuwsgierig en opmerkzaam
  • Toegewijd aan voortdurende verbetering

INTEGRITEIT

  • Doet altijd het juiste
  • Eerlijk, heeft een gevoel voor goed en kwaad, geeft fouten toe en geeft anderen de eer die ze toekomt
  • Communiceert duidelijk en direct

  • Respecteert meningen en bestaande kennis

PASSIE

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryWith over 50 years of serving the creative community, Adorama has grown from a beloved New York City camera store into the world’s only full-service destination for photo, video, and electronics.
jobs.description:
Our StoryWith over 50 years of serving the creative community, Adorama has grown from a beloved New York City camera store into the world’s only full-service destination for photo, video, and electronics. We’re more than a retailer—we’re a creative partner for professionals, hobbyists, and tech enthusiasts alike.

From iconic brands like Sony, Canon, and Nikon to the latest in drones, smart home tech, musical instruments, and pro audio gear, Adorama provides creators with the gear and services they need to bring their visions to life. Our passion for education, innovation and commitment to customer experience make us a dedicated and trusted resource.

At Adorama, we don’t just support creativity—we live it. Join a team that’s shaping the future of how the world captures, creates and connects.

Our Leadership Principles

  • Growth Mindset: We set high standards, embrace failure, and are open to change.
  • Be Customer-Centered: We focus on the end-to-end customer experience.
  • Take Ownership & Dig Deeper: We are proactive, use data, and avoid shortcuts.
  • Think Like a Start-Up: We move fast, stay flexible, and celebrate every win.
  • Be Humble & Respectful: We assume positive intent, listen actively, and support one another.

About Adorama Used/Trade & Role

Adorama's Used/Trade department is seeking a Freelance Consumer Researcher to better understand what drives customers to buy, sell, and trade pre-owned gear, and translate those insights into more effective advertising, landing pages, and offers.

Our Used/Trade department specializes in buying, evaluating, and reselling pre-owned equipment, as well as managing our trade-in program. Unlike customers purchasing new gear, Used/Trade customers are often more price-conscious, focused on product condition, and looking for reassurance and trust throughout the buying or selling process.

While we have extensive transaction data, we're looking to gain a deeper understanding of our customers' motivations, concerns, and decision-making behaviors.

In this role, you'll independently manage research initiatives from start to finish, including conducting customer interviews, testing ads and landing pages, analyzing customer behavior, and developing surveys. You'll report to the Paid Media team and collaborate closely with our marketing teams to turn research findings into actionable insights that improve the customer experience and drive business results.

Employment Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Location: Remote

Schedule: Approximately 20 hours per week, with flexibility based on interview and survey schedules

Duration: Initial 3-month engagement, with the possibility of extension based on business needs

Application Requirements:

When applying, please submit your resume along with 1–2 samples of previous research work, such as a redacted readout, report, or case study, demonstrating how you translated research findings into actionable recommendations.

What Will Help You Thrive

  • Moderated customer interviews. Recruit, schedule and conduct one-on-one interviews with real Used/Trade customers (buyers, sellers and trade-in customers). Write the discussion guides, run the sessions and synthesize what you learn so it enriches our internal customer data: motivations, objections, trust signals, and how people describe their own gear and buying decisions.
  • Unmoderated research on ads and landing pages. Design and run unmoderated tests that show where our paid ads and landing pages confuse, mislead or fail to persuade. This may include evaluating and recommending the right user research tool for our needs (platform fit, participant panel quality, cost, and ability to screen for used-gear shoppers) before running studies in it.
  • Heatmap and click analysis. Set up and analyze heatmaps, scroll maps and click data on our landing pages. Identify where visitors stall, what they ignore and what they click that is not clickable, and translate the patterns into specific page recommendations.
  • Hypothesis-driven surveys. Work with our paid media and email teams to turn their questions into testable consumer hypotheses, then plan, field and analyze surveys designed to prove or disprove them. Own questionnaire design, sample definition and the readout of results, including what the data does not tell us.

Deliverables
Each study ends with something the team can act on, not a raw data dump.

  • A short research plan before each study: question, method, sample and timeline
  • Interview recordings, transcripts and a synthesized readout with direct customer quotes
  • If relevant, a written recommendation on the user research tool, with the options compared
  • Annotated heatmap and click-analysis findings with prioritized page changes
  • Survey instruments, raw results and a plain-language readout that states whether each hypothesis held
  • A running log of insights the paid media, email and Used/Trade teams can reference

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of consumer or UX research experience
  • A track record of running moderated interviews and turning them into clear, usable insights
  • Hands-on experience with unmoderated testing platforms (such as UserTesting, Maze, Lyssna or similar) and the judgment to compare them
  • Experience analyzing heatmaps, scroll maps and click data (such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity or Crazy Egg)
  • Survey design skills: writing unbiased questions, defining samples and reading results with appropriate caution
  • Comfort working with paid media and email marketers and translating their questions into testable hypotheses
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including concise readouts for non-researchers
  • Able to work independently and manage your own schedule and participant recruiting

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the photography, video or consumer electronics market, or with resale and trade-in marketplaces

$80—$80 USD

Role Overview

The person in this role will own both the technical infrastructure and the client experience for a portfolio of customer accounts, many of whom are technologically sophisticated, cutting-edge software startups and security-conscious VC firms. This role is also the senior technical authority that clients rely on, and they need to be someone a non-technical founder trusts as much as a technical CTO respects.

If you are the type who can diagnose a security incident, explain what happened to an operations manager in plain language, and leave that person feeling confident, not confused, then YOU belong here.

This Role IS:

  • The face of our company to technologically sophisticated, security-conscious clients — you own relationships, not just tickets
  • Equal parts technical problem-solving and warm, clear client communication
  • A Mac-first, Google Workspace-first, SaaS-security environment

  • A backend NOC or infrastructure role where you work silently behind the scenes
  • A pure engineering role — if you prefer zero client contact, this is not the right fit
  • A Windows Server / Active Directory / on-prem data center environment
  • A role with heavy supervision and rigid escalation paths

Responsibilities:

Technical Delivery

  • Own the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of our security tool stack (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cynomi, KnowBe4, etc.) across client environments.
  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for escalated issues across Mac workstations, networks, Google Workspace, and SaaS platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents independently with clear, client-readable documentation.
  • Lead technical projects: migrations, security tool rollouts, network upgrades, compliance implementations.
  • Develop process automation to reduce repetitive manual work (not infrastructure-as-code; think workflow efficiency).
  • Own recurring technical issues and implement long-term root-cause fixes.
  • Support monitoring, patching (including CVE remediation alerting), and incident response workflows.
  • Evaluate new platforms to determine their suitability as part of our tool stack.
  • Perform system updates, backups, and security audits.

Client Experience

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned client accounts. You own the relationship, not just the ticket queue.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, confident language for non-technical stakeholders (startup founders, ops managers, office managers).
  • Lead client-facing project presentations: scoping, status updates, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Collaborate with Tier 1 and Tier 2 team members to share knowledge and elevate the team's client communication standards.
  • Bridge the gap between subject matter experts and end-users – ensure that SOPs, documentation, and client-facing instructions are user-friendly and accessible.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and proactively communicate them to clients and internal leadership.
  • Contribute to and improve knowledge base documentation with a client-readability lens.

Required Qualifications

Technical Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, and security project implementation.
  • Strong Mac/macOS support experience. Candidates without extensive Apple experience must obtain Apple Desktop Support certification within 90 days.
  • Experience administering Google Workspace environments for distributed/remote teams.
  • Strong cybersecurity literacy: hands-on experience with zero-trust SaaS security platforms (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cisco Umbrella, KnowBe4, or equivalent).
  • Solid networking fundamentals (VPNs, firewalls, routing), ideally supporting Cisco Meraki environments.
  • Experience with endpoint management / MDM tools (Jamf, Intune, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience leading SaaS security implementation projects end-to-end: from scoping and proposal through deployment and client sign-off.

Client-Facing Skills(Equally Weighted)

  • Demonstrated experience as the primary point of contact for client accounts – not just an escalation resource, but the person the client calls first.
  • Proven ability to explain technical issues to non-technical audiences in plain language and leave them feeling confident, not overwhelmed.
  • Experience leading or co-leading client meetings, project kickoffs, and status reviews.
  • High customer satisfaction scores or equivalent evidence of strong client relationships (references, testimonials, NPS).
  • Comfort with ambiguity: startup clients often don't know what they need, and you help them figure it out.

Soft Skills

  • Ownership mindset – if it's your account, it's your problem until it's solved.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision across multiple time zones.
  • Continuous improvement orientation: you don't just fix the ticket, you fix the system that created the ticket.
  • Strong written communication – client-facing emails and documentation should be clear, professional, and warm.

Threat Research

Network and Infrastructure Analysis

Collaboration

  • Proven track record of leading complex analytical projects or investigations, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent work streams

Additional Skills

  • Well-developed analytical, deductive reasoning, and critical thinking skills; comfortable forming assessments from incomplete or ambiguous data
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a distributed, remote team environment, including willingness to conduct peer review and share tradecraft knowledge
  • Experience tracking APT, nation-state, or cybercriminal actors, with the ability to contextualize their activity within the broader geopolitical or strategic landscape
  • Outstanding network infrastructure and traffic analysis skills: PCAP, NetFlow, PDNS, open ports, certificates
  • Deep working knowledge of IP networking and internet services: DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, VPNs, and routing protocols (BGP)
  • Demonstrated knowledge of operating system concepts, including experience developing and contextualizing indicators of compromise and understanding their deployment in host and network-level detection architectures
  • Working proficiency in SQL and querying and analyzing large disparate datasets
  • Strong familiarity with common OSINT platforms and research techniques

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Confident and skilled public speaker with experience presenting technical research to large audiences at industry conferences or similar forums

  • Exposure to malware reverse engineering, including static and dynamic analysis techniques and common tooling (e.g. Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg)
  • Familiarity with the operational structures of hosting providers, ISPs, and internet exchanges, including how infrastructure is provisioned, attributed, and abused by threat actors

Travel

Occasional travel locally and internationally for customer workshops, industry events, and team meetings is required

At Team Cymru, we provide unmatched global threat intelligence that empowers organizations to proactively disrupt adversaries. You'll be at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, helping customers harness the full power of our threat intelligence to achieve critical business and security outcomes.

We offer a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your expertise and impact will directly contribute to improving global security.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply now and help shape the financial future of a company protecting millions worldwide.

This job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve as needed. Team Cymru is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. This is a remote position.

jobs.description:
About Manhead LLC

Manhead is a worldwide, full service, merchandise and experiential company creating the global intersection of music, fashion and culture through branded experiences that strengthen the bond between artists and fans. For over thirteen years, Manhead has succeeded as one of the leading, independently owned music/entertainment merchandise companies, specializing in touring, e-commerce, creative, retail, licensing, collaborations, and pop-up shops.

About the role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and motivated Junior Graphic Designer to join our growing creative team at Manhead.

The Junior Graphic Designer will be responsible for executing and preparing merchandise artwork across Tour, E-commerce, Retail, and Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) platforms for our extensive roster of artists and brands.

Working closely with our Graphic Design, Apparel Design, and Production teams, this role will focus on executing established creative direction, preparing artwork for production, creating product mockups, building presentations, and ensuring all artwork meets Manhead's standards for quality, accuracy, and consistency.

A significant part of this role involves supporting production workflows, managing time-sensitive artwork setups, reviewing print proofs, and maintaining an accurate, organized artwork catalog across our artist roster.

Attention to detail, organization, collaboration, and flawless execution are at the core of this position. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, can confidently manage multiple priorities, and understands the importance of delivering accurate work within tight deadlines.

A strong foundation in apparel graphic design and production processes is essential, along with a working knowledge of garment decoration techniques and the technical requirements needed to take artwork from approved design to finished product.

What you'll do

Artwork Execution & Design Support

  • Execute artwork based on established creative direction, approved designs, and artist brand guidelines.
  • Create accurate product mockups for apparel, accessories, and merchandise across Tour, E-commerce, Retail, and D2C channels.
  • Build polished presentation decks and visual layouts for internal and client reviews.
  • Make artwork revisions, adjustments, and updates based on feedback from the creative and account management teams.
  • Resize, reformat, and adapt existing artwork for various products, garment styles, and production requirements.
  • Ensure all artwork maintains brand consistency, accuracy, and the highest level of attention to detail.

Production Coordination & Artwork Preparation

  • Work closely with the Production team to prepare and deliver time-sensitive artwork setups, ensuring all files meet production specifications and deadlines.
  • Prepare accurate, production-ready artwork for screen printing, embroidery, specialty inks, and other garment decoration methods.
  • Review print proofs for accuracy, including artwork placement, sizing, color, spelling, and overall execution, ensuring all details align with approved designs.
  • Coordinate with Production to address artwork revisions, resolve technical challenges, and maintain efficient communication throughout the production process.
  • Prioritize urgent artwork requests and proof approvals to support tight production schedules and avoid unnecessary delays.
  • Ensure final artwork files are properly formatted, organized, and ready for production.

Artwork Catalog Management

  • Maintain and regularly update Manhead's artwork catalog across our extensive artist roster.
  • Ensure all artwork, revisions, approvals, and final production files are accurately organized, labeled, and easily accessible.
  • Maintain consistency in file naming, version control, and artwork documentation.
  • Ensure approved designs and final production artwork are properly archived for future reference, reorders, and ongoing merchandise programs.
  • Work with internal teams to ensure the artwork catalog remains current, accurate, and complete.

Collaboration & Project Management

  • Collaborate closely with the Graphic Design, Apparel Design, Production, and Account Management teams to ensure artwork and production needs are met.
  • Serve as a reliable resource for cross-functional teams, responding efficiently to artwork requests and production-related needs.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, organization, and established deadlines.
  • Communicate proactively regarding project status, outstanding artwork needs, potential challenges, and timelines.
  • Maintain a positive, collaborative attitude and contribute to an efficient, solutions-oriented team environment.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with graphics specifically for apparel and merchandise.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Strong understanding of typography, composition, color accuracy, and graphic layout.
  • Working knowledge of apparel production processes, including screen printing, embroidery, and various decoration techniques.
  • Experience preparing production-ready artwork and reviewing print proofs.
  • Experience creating apparel mockups and presentation layouts.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality control.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain detailed artwork libraries, file structures, and version control.
  • Ability to follow established creative direction and execute revisions accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset.
  • A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn and grow.
  • An interest in music, fashion, and the merchandise industry.
  • A portfolio demonstrating apparel graphics, production knowledge, and technical execution.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-driven, dependable, and takes genuine pride in their work.

Someone who understands that even the smallest details matter, whether it's preparing a time-sensitive print file, catching an error on a proof, building an accurate product mockup, or keeping our artwork catalog organized and current.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working within established creative direction, takes feedback well, and knows how to balance quality with efficiency.

Above all, we're looking for a team player who is proactive, adaptable, and eager to support the creative and production teams in delivering exceptional merchandise.

At Manhead, great design starts with a strong vision, but exceptional execution is what brings it to life.

Guiding Salesforce customers through complex organizational transformations, leading and overseeing holistic change strategies, and playing a leadership role in advancing the Human-Centered Change (HCC) practice itself. You are also responsible for the successful delivery of HCC engagements, providing guidance and oversight to other team members who are part of the change management workstreams, and/or leading the execution of key change management activities.

  • Proactive, self-sufficient and professional, with strong organizational, time management and communication skills
  • Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP or other enterprise software

jobs.excerpt: WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast.
jobs.description:
WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast. Ohne diese Erfahrung ist eine Bewerbung leider nicht sinnvoll.

Du hast Freude daran, Facebook- und Instagram-Werbeanzeigen anzulegen und zu kontrollieren, und suchst eine Aufgabe für rund 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, die du zu 100% aus dem Homeoffice erledigen kannst?

Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, durch digitales Recruiting die besten Mitarbeiter zu finden. Dafür läuft bei uns ein eingespielter Prozess: Wir wissen, welche Werbeanzeigen funktionieren, wie die Texte aufgebaut sind und wie eine Kampagne aussehen muss und welche Handgriffe es in Meta für eine erfolgreiche Kampagne braucht.

Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

Wir wachsen weiter und suchen deshalb Unterstützung bei der Durchführung unserer Projekte.

Deine Aufgaben

Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

Du legst unsere Kunden in BVS an und erstellst die Verknüpfungen, so dass die Bewerber auch an den Kunden weitergeleitet werden.

Betreuen unserer Recruiting-Kampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Projektleiterin, nach unserem bestehenden System

Als Urlaubsvertretung übernimmst du die Gestaltung von Kampagnen in Canva und erstellst die passenden Texte für neue Kampagnen. Du arbeitest mit unseren Vorlagen und setzt daraus ansprechende Anzeigen und Grafiken um.

Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

Das bieten wir

Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

Interessiert? Melde dich bei uns und lass uns sprechen (Lebenslauf und deine Kontaktdaten reichen aus - kein Motivationsschreiben).

jobs.description:
AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations. Our expertise spans IT infrastructure management, custom software development, seamless system integrations, and optimization of low-code business automation, empowering clients to maximize their existing technology investments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title

Manager, Software Engineering

Position Location

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Reports To

Director, Software Engineering

Job Summary

AI2IO is seeking a Manager, Software Engineering to lead the people, capability, and operating environment behind a growing AI platform and agent ecosystem serving architecture, engineering, construction, commissioning, design, proposal, and related business workflows. The team is building governed AI agents, semantic and knowledge-graph capabilities, retrieval and data pipelines, and shared platform services informed by data available within the QCS Ecosystem.

This is a formal people-management role for all engineers and AI Engineer Technical Leads on the AI Tools team. Candidates must bring demonstrated professional experience leading, managing, architecting, or delivering production AI or LLM platforms or applications, with broad credibility and demonstrated depth across several relevant AI disciplines. The role develops people, builds workforce capability, improves team clarity, and helps translate strategy and architecture into context the team and broader organization can understand without replacing Technical Lead, architecture, product, analysis, or delivery authority.

Essential Functions

This role grows from complete ownership of people leadership and the AI Tools delivery environment toward broader workforce strategy, specialized capability development, management-system improvement, and organizational leadership across a maturing AI engineering function. As the organization grows, expand impact through multi-team capability planning, development of technical and people leaders, management-system improvement, workforce strategy, and resolution of organizational challenges beyond the assigned specialty.

Lead and Develop Engineers

  • Serve as the formal people manager for all engineers and Technical Leads assigned to the specialty team through regular one-on-ones, clear expectations, timely feedback, performance reviews, professional-development planning, and credible support for every direct report.
  • Provide recognition and development feedback throughout the year and address sustained performance concerns through clear expectations, documented support, follow-through, and appropriate organizational processes.
  • Connect individual goals to meaningful assignments, coaching, learning, mentoring, and increasing ownership without promising advancement before readiness is demonstrated.
  • Partner with Technical Leads to understand technical contribution and development needs while retaining accountability for career evaluation, formal performance decisions, employee relations, and team health.

Build Team Capability and Leadership Depth

  • Maintain a current view of capacity, critical skills, experience distribution, key-person dependencies, succession risk, and staffing needs.
  • Identify capability gaps and coordinate learning, pairing, assignments, mentoring, hiring, and onboarding plans.
  • Develop future Technical Leads and management candidates through scoped assignments, calibrated feedback, explicit readiness criteria, and partnership with current leaders.
  • Reduce leadership and knowledge-continuity risk through distributed ownership, documentation, coverage, and succession options.

Own the Sustainable Delivery Environment

  • Ensure teams have sufficient staffing, capability, role clarity, decision pathways, tools, and organizational support to deliver sustainably.
  • Partner with Technical Leads and Project Managers on delivery health, risk, dependencies, capacity, and recovery without replacing technical or project-management ownership.
  • Ensure material delivery problems receive appropriate management intervention, including staffing changes, escalation, cross-team negotiation, or leadership decisions.
  • Review recurring delays, incidents, rework, quality concerns, support burdens, and workload imbalance to identify organizational or capability improvements.
  • Protect teams from sustained overload and commitments incompatible with available capacity.

Translate AI Strategy Into Clear Team Context

  • Partner with Director, AI Strategy and Enablement, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Project Managers, architecture contributors, and AI Engineer Technical Leads to translate strategic and architectural direction into objectives, decision context, capability needs, dependencies, risks, and intake-ready work.
  • Participate regularly in developer discussions and intake so AI specialists, mainstream software engineers, delivery partners, and leadership share a common understanding of goals, constraints, outcomes, and unresolved decisions.
  • Help Business Analysts and Product Owners clarify requirements and stories without taking over product ownership, analysis, acceptance criteria, or backlog priority.
  • Help technical leaders explain architectural and implementation direction to non-AI engineers and leadership.
  • Improve tactical documentation, communication rhythms, and decision records when high-level strategy is not yet expressed clearly enough for execution, while leaving architecture approval and technical decomposition with the appropriate leaders.

Build AI Platform and Data Capability

  • Own workforce capability, staffing, development, and training plans spanning AI application engineering, agents, semantic engineering, ontology and taxonomy, data science, knowledge graphs, retrieval, data pipelines, evaluation, responsible AI, data governance, platform operations, and supporting software engineering.
  • Ensure the team has the mix of engineering, data, semantic, governance, quality, and operational skills required to build and support a governed AI platform and domain-specific agents.
  • Develop engineers across specialized AI concerns and the surrounding C#/.NET, Azure, API, identity, security, testing, CI/CD, observability, and production-support environment.
  • Reduce single-person dependencies in platform architecture, knowledge-graph pipelines, semantic models, agent workflows, data governance, and operations.

Support Responsible AI, Data Governance, and Platform Maturity

  • Champion early adoption of responsible AI, data governance, access control, evaluation, observability, model-risk, knowledge-quality, and operational practices as dedicated capabilities mature.
  • Ensure staffing, training, ownership, and escalation paths exist for model and retrieval quality, sensitive-data handling, lineage, ontology changes, agent behavior, tool permissions, telemetry, incident learning, and support.
  • Partner with technical leaders and Director, AI Strategy and Enablement to identify governance and platform risks requiring clearer ownership, specialist support, or investment.
  • Balance research and experimentation with documentation, production readiness, supportability, security, quality, cost awareness, and sustainable delivery.
  • As architecture and governance functions mature, help evolve ownership boundaries while remaining accountable for staffing, training, participation, and organizational support.

Build Healthy, Candid Team Practices

  • Establish practices that support candid discussion of risks, uncertainty, mistakes, technical disagreements, workload concerns, and alternative viewpoints without individual blame.
  • Address observable patterns such as unresolved conflict, sustained overload, escalation failures, knowledge bottlenecks, or reluctance to surface delivery problems.
  • Maintain reliable communication rhythms so engineers understand priorities, decisions, role boundaries, and available support.
  • Address performance, conduct, and employee-relations concerns through appropriate management processes rather than transferring formal accountability to Technical Leads.

Lead Hiring, Selection, and Onboarding

  • Partner with the Director on workforce planning, role requirements, interview plans, evaluation criteria, and hiring priorities.
  • Lead structured and equitable selection processes, calibrate interviewers, document evidence, and make clear candidate recommendations.
  • Own consistent onboarding expectations, including role clarity, access, relationships, learning objectives, 30/60/90-day plans, and ramp check-ins.
  • Evaluate onboarding effectiveness through independence, role understanding, contribution, and feedback and improve the process based on evidence.
  • Identify retention risks early and coordinate appropriate responses.

Maintain Clear Leadership Boundaries

  • Partner with Technical Leads, who own technical feasibility, estimates, dependencies, execution health, engineering standards, implementation direction, and team-level technical decisions.
  • Partner with Architects, who own cross-team architecture, technical standards, governance, and long-term technical direction.
  • Partner with Project Managers, who own the integrated schedule, formal stakeholder communication, scope coordination, project governance, and overall delivery process.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Business Analysts while preserving their authority for product value, priority, requirements, workflow analysis, and backlog readiness.
  • Use technical and domain fluency to understand risk, ask informed questions, clarify context, develop people, and improve the environment without becoming the default Technical Lead, Architect, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Project Manager.

Improve Management Systems and Organizational Effectiveness

  • Lead improvements to performance management, career development, hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, team operating practices, and leadership continuity.
  • Identify patterns spanning teams and coordinate improvements with peer Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, Project Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and the Director.
  • Contribute to department-level capability planning, organizational design, role definition, career frameworks, cross-team staffing, leadership development, and organizational change.
  • Evaluate whether adopted practices improve clarity, fairness, staffing effectiveness, internal growth, management consistency, and sustainability.
  • Represent capacity, capability, succession, and organizational risk in department planning with concise evidence and decision-ready recommendations.
  • Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

What Success Looks Like

  • Direct reports understand expectations, receive timely feedback, and have credible development plans aligned with software-engineering and specialized AI capability needs.
  • The team has sufficient staffing, role clarity, technical leadership, training, and organizational support to deliver and operate the AI platform sustainably.
  • Strategic and architectural direction becomes understandable objectives, context, risks, dependencies, and intake-ready work without displacing Product Owner, Business Analyst, AI Engineer Technical Lead, architecture, or Project Manager authority.
  • AI Engineer Technical Leads retain technical authority and receive effective management partnership rather than tactical micromanagement.

Sobi is hiring for 3 Sr MSL, Lymphoma (Lacutamab) openings. Candidates can work remotely anywhere in the continental U.S., with a strong preference that they're located within 30-40 minutes of a major airport.

As the Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Lymphoma (Lacutamab), you will serve as a field-based scientific expert on cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) and lacutamab, a humanized monoclonal antibody immunotherapy targeting KIR3DL2. You will build trusted scientific relationships, exchange balanced medical information, and generate actionable insights that inform US Medical Affairs strategy and launch readiness.

You will support Sobi's rare disease portfolio in the hematology franchise and serve as a trusted scientific resource across the hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology communities. You will collaborate with academic, community, and multidisciplinary care teams, always in accordance with regulatory, legal, and compliance requirements.

This is a field execution role within Hematology Medical Affairs. You will contribute insights and a field perspective to the CTCL medical strategy, which is led by Medical Affairs leadership.

What You Will Do

Scientific Engagement and External Relationships

  • Serve as a primary field-based scientific point of contact for Sobi Medical Affairs within your assigned geography.
  • Develop and maintain meaningful, two-way relationships with opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, medical organizations, investigators, and other stakeholders involved in CTCL care.
  • Exchange accurate, fair, balanced, and scientifically rigorous information on CTCL, lacutamab, relevant clinical data, disease biology, treatment approaches, and the evolving care landscape.
  • Engage across academic, community, and multidisciplinary settings, including hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology practices.
  • Respond appropriately to unsolicited scientific inquiries and connect stakeholders with Sobi resources in line with applicable policies and procedures.

Medical Insights and Strategy Execution

  • Identify, document, and share high-quality field insights on unmet needs, clinical practice, patient pathways, evidence gaps, stakeholder perspectives, competitive developments, and the treatment landscape.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs leadership and cross-functional colleagues to interpret insights and inform adjustments to medical strategy, tactics, educational priorities, and engagement plans.
  • Execute territory-level medical plans aligned with the US CTCL and lacutamab medical strategy, adapting engagement to local and regional stakeholder needs.
  • Support key institution and stakeholder engagement planning, helping establish Sobi as a trusted scientific partner in CTCL.

Launch Readiness, Education, and Congress Support

  • Contribute to lacutamab launch preparedness through disease-state education, articulation of unmet need, scientific exchange, stakeholder mapping, and field execution of approved medical tactics.
  • Provide internal and external scientific training on CTCL disease biology, preclinical science, clinical data, evidence gaps, and relevant outcomes.
  • Participate in or support advisory boards, medical roundtables, webinars, symposia, and other educational activities at local, regional, and national levels.
  • Represent Sobi Medical Affairs at scientific and medical congresses, and synthesize and communicate key updates and implications to internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate to identify and develop field resources and scientific materials specific to CTCL and lacutamab.

Evidence Generation and Clinical Development Support

  • Provide field-based support to Clinical Development and Clinical Operations, including site identification and recommendations, investigator engagement, communication facilitation, site initiation support, and patient accrual support.
  • Identify evidence gaps and potential research opportunities, and communicate them to appropriate internal partners.
  • Contribute scientific and field perspectives to evidence generation activities, real-world evidence initiatives, publications, and medical education programs, as appropriate.
  • Support investigator-sponsored research and other research collaborations in accordance with company processes and governance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Territory Leadership

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is marked by:

  • Scientific credibility and curiosity
  • Strategic territory leadership
  • Insight generation and synthesis
  • Trusted stakeholder partnership
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Clear, balanced communication
  • Agility and a solution-oriented approach
  • Operational excellence
  • A patient-centered mindset

  • Experience: At least 5 years of MSL experience in hematology/oncology, heme-onc, or a closely related therapeutic area is required.
    • Further experience in the following is highly valued:
      • Clinical practice, Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL), Peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL), lymphoma, dermatology, dermato-oncology.
      • Rare disease and/or product launch.
  • Scientific acumen: Strong ability to understand, critically evaluate, and clearly communicate complex scientific and clinical information.
    • Clinical hematology-oncology background is highly preferred.
    • Knowledge of CTCL and/or PTCL and the multidisciplinary care environment is an advantage.
  • Patient focus: Strong commitment to patient needs and advancing scientific understanding within the CTCL community.

  • Ability to attend local, regional, and national meetings, including occasional evening or weekend programs, as business needs require.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

  • Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.

  • Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $215,000 - $230,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. You will run ads for a product that shows people their own problem in under 90 seconds.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

You will run ads for a product that shows people their own problem in under 90 seconds. If you love watching a click turn into a customer, keep reading.

Start here: what makes this marketing different

Most paid ads ask a stranger to trust a claim. This company’s ads don’t have to.

Every ad from this company points to one action: run the free scan. A business owner enters their website address, and in under 90 seconds, the company’s scanner shows what their own site is doing right now: trackers firing before anyone has consented, AI running without disclosure, and missing legal pages. They get the report. Then they decide what to do about it.

That is a clean funnel with a real hook: ad, scan, report, plan. Your job is to fill the top of it, make every step convert better than last month, and prove it with numbers.

Who they are:

They find the hidden risks on websites, fixes them, and keeps the proof. Businesses hire them to check their site against the rules that now apply to tracking and AI, fix what is broken, and show the proof with a live trust badge that their customers, partners and insurance carrier can check. If the site stops passing, the badge shows it. That last part is why people believe it.

They are a small, remote team spread across the US, Latin America, and Europe, with roughly half a dozen people. Engineering, client experience, marketing, and sales are all one message away from each other and the founder. Decisions get made in hours, not quarters.

The founder has built and sold three companies, has been a licensed attorney since 1999, and has written four books, with a fifth on the way. You will work with him directly, not through three layers.

What you would be marketing:

  • The free scan. Ten checks on any website, free to the public. It is the front door for almost every customer we have.

  • They earned plans. Tiered subscriptions with a monthly re-scan, the fixes that follow, and a live trust badge that stays honest.

  • They Consent. Their own consent platform. It controls which scripts run before a visitor agrees and keeps the records that prove consent was given.

  • Their partner program. Agencies and affiliates who send their clients to us and earn commission. They want finished, ready-to-send material, and you will help keep it that way.

One more thing worth saying up front: they sell consent and tracking done right. Their own pixels, tags and audiences have to be clean too. If you have only ever run tracking the loose way, you will learn the right way here, and it will make you better at this job anywhere.

The role:

Paid ads are the core of this job, roughly two-thirds of your week. The rest is the marketing those ads depend on: content, organic, brand and partner support. On a lean team, the person who is good at ads is directly involved in all of it.

  • Run paid acquisition.Plan, build, launch and manage campaigns in Meta and/or Google. You own the budgets, audiences, bidding and testing calendar.

  • Own the ad accounts.Manage our Meta Business account and/or Google Ads account: users, pixels, conversion events, domains, billing and policy issues.

  • Make the ads.Write the copy and build the creative: static, carousel and short video. You will use AI tools and their brand design system to produce more variations, faster.

  • Own the numbers. Cost per scan, cost per signup, customer acquisition cost and return on ad spend. Report them weekly in plain words, cut losers fast and scale winners.

  • Improve the funnel.Work with engineering on landing and offer pages, and with sales on follow-up sequences in GoHighLevel, so more scans turn into customers.

  • Support organic and partners. Help with LinkedIn, blog and email content, and keep partner materials current. Their brand voice and approved words matter, and you will learn them.

  • Use AI every day. Research, drafts, ad variations, analysis. They build with AI on purpose, and we expect you to bring new ways to use it.

  • Show up to the 10:00 AM ET standup. Fifteen minutes, whole team, what moved and what is stuck.


Requirements

Who this fits:

  • You have personally built and managed paid campaigns in Meta Ads Manager and/or Google Ads for at least 3 years, working with real budgets, and you can walk us through a campaign’s performance from the first click to the sale.
  • You have managed a Meta Business account and/or a Google Ads account yourself, not just had access to one.
  • You love conversions. You read a results dashboard because you want to, not because someone asked.
  • You are not afraid of technology. Pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs, GA4, landing page builders and CRM automations do not scare you, and when something breaks you dig in.
  • You already use AI tools in your work and want to use them more.
  • You are a self-starter. They run a macro-management shop: they agree on the goal and the number, and you decide how to hit it.
  • You are fluent in English at a C1 to C2 level, especially written. You will be writing copy that business owners read. Accents are awesome; strong writing is the requirement.
  • You care how a brand looks and sounds, and you notice when something is off.

Who this does not fit:

  • Anyone who needs a manager to sign off on every ad before it goes live.

  • Anyone who only wants to manage spend and hand the creative to someone else.

  • Anyone who sees AI as a threat rather than a tool.

Nice to have, not required:

  • Experience in both Meta and Google, not just one.

  • Hands-on CRM Experience, GoHighLevel experience preferred but NOT required. Our stack may change.

  • LinkedIn Ads, Google Tag Manager or server-side conversion tracking.

  • Short-form video editing. Great news is their tech tools do almost all of this work now!!

  • Marketed B2B services, SaaS, or to professional services firms, agencies or healthcare.

  • Worked with an affiliate or partner program.

  • Worked on a US and Latin America remote team before.

Room to grow:

This is a new company in its start-up phase, and the market is moving fast. The person in this seat will see the whole business up close, shape how they go to market, and have real room to grow with the company as the team does. Your results will be visible to everyone, including the founder, every week.


Benefits

  • $2300 - $3500 USD/monthly
  • 100% remote from anywhere in Latin America
