The Project Manager drives approved Product initiatives through the Product Development Lifecycle by making plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, owners, readiness, and decisions visible. The role organizes execution across functions so contributors can focus on their work and Product leaders can focus on Product decisions.
The Project Manager is a systems-minded delivery leader, not a meeting scheduler or task chaser. The role is accountable for momentum, clarity, and escalation while leaving product, technical, academic, design, creative, AI-quality, and business decisions with the appropriate owners.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Planning

  • Turn approved scope and readiness criteria into an integrated plan with functional estimates and commitments. Coordinate discovery contributors and dependencies when assigned.
  • Identify critical path, decision points, cross-functional handoffs, resource assumptions, and risks before they become blockers.
  • Maintain original and current forecasts, record approved changes and coordinate accepted handoff, remaining obligations and project closure.

2. Execution & Coordination

  • Facilitate the minimum operating cadence needed to keep work aligned and moving.
  • Track dependencies, risks, blockers, decisions, actions, and readiness in the shared system of record rather than shadow trackers.
  • Ensure owners understand commitments and escalate when work cannot proceed within agreed parameters.

3. Scope Change & Readiness

  • Make proposed scope changes visible with impact to schedule, dependencies, capacity, quality, and readiness.
  • Route Product tradeoffs to PM/Product leadership and functional decisions to the appropriate leader.
  • Coordinate completion and visibility of Product, enablement, implementation, support, design, academic, AI-quality where applicable, QA, and technical readiness inputs without becoming the owner of those approvals.

4. Risk, Decisions & Escalation

  • Surface unresolved blockers and decisions early with clear owner, impact, options, and required timing.
  • Distinguish delivery risk from product, technical, academic, AI-quality, or operating-system issues and route each to the correct owner.
  • Use the Director of Product Operations and Delivery for coaching or escalation when complexity, cross-project dependency, or consequence exceeds the PjM's delegated scope.

5. Continuous Improvement & Leverage

  • Capture recurring delivery friction and recommend system improvements to Director of Product Operations and Delivery and Product Operations.
  • Use shared templates, automation, and status conventions to minimize administrative overhead.
  • Contribute lessons learned and reusable project patterns back into the delivery practice.

Definition of Success

Projects have credible plans, timely decisions, complete readiness and accepted handoffs. Product and functional owners retain decisions; PjMs independently coordinate delivery and surface risks before commitments fail.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required

  • 4+ years of project or program-management experience in cross-functional product, software, content, or digital delivery, or equivalent demonstrated capability.

  • Translate approved scope and readiness into plans while preserving Product and functional decisions.
  • Experience with Jira or comparable delivery tooling and disciplined system-of-record practices.
  • Manage concurrent workstreams, surface risks early and communicate concise delivery evidence.
  • Use verified AI-assisted planning, synthesis, documentation and automation.

Preferred

  • Experience coordinating Product releases across Engineering, QA, Design, Academic, Creative and customer teams, including AI readiness where applicable.

jobs.description:
Remote Position: This is a remote role, with preference given to candidates who reside in Idaho, Utah, or Wyoming, where our dental practices are located.

About Accelerate Dental

Accelerate Dental is a growing dental partnership organization with more than 40 offices across Utah, Idaho, and Wyoming. We partner with dentists to help them grow successful practices while preserving their independence, ownership, and unique identities.

Through financial, operational, recruiting, HR, marketing, and other administrative support, we help our partner doctors focus on what they do best: caring for patients and building thriving practices.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a hands-on, entrepreneurial finance leader who can help build the financial foundation for our next stage of growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Finance & Accounting who is equally comfortable leading a team, shaping financial strategy, and rolling up their sleeves to get the work done.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who enjoys building, improving, and solving problems in a fast-growing, multi-location organization. You'll lead our finance team, strengthen our financial systems and processes, and work closely with our executive team and partner doctors to drive performance, profitability, and long-term growth.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, moves with urgency, and isn't afraid to dig into the details. You'll need the strategic mindset to see the big picture and the willingness to jump into the day-to-day when something needs attention. We value leaders who build alongside their teams, take initiative without waiting to be asked, and find ways to make things better.

This role will require looking into the future and strategizing the best platform/technology/team combination to deliver results in a consistent and timely manner.

Just as important, culture and relationships matter. You'll work closely with our partner doctors, practice leadership teams, and internal departments. The right person will be a strong financial leader who can build trust, communicate clearly, collaborate with different personalities, and help others understand the financial side of their businesses.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact, help shape a growing organization, and participate in the long-term value you're helping create.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop the Finance Team

  • Lead, mentor, and develop our finance and accounting team, building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear expectations, establish priorities, and ensure the team has the tools and support needed to succeed.
  • Lead by example, remaining hands-on and willing to jump in when the team needs support or a problem needs to be solved.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team structure, workflows, and overall performance as the organization grows.

Own Financial Operations

  • Oversee accounting, financial reporting, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management across a multi-site organization.
  • Maintain accurate, timely financial reporting and ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Take ownership of the month-end close, financial accuracy, and reporting processes, working directly in the details when needed.
  • Oversee banking relationships, liquidity planning, and capital allocation.
  • Maintain and optimize our financial systems, with a strong emphasis on Sage Intacct.

Drive Strategy and Growth

  • Partner with the executive team to develop and execute financial strategies that support continued growth, acquisitions, and market expansion.
  • Build financial models, forecasts, and reporting tools that help leadership make informed business decisions.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across our partner practices to identify opportunities, improve profitability, and drive results.
  • Help evaluate acquisitions, support financial due diligence, and lead financial onboarding and integration for new practices.
  • Build scalable systems, processes, and infrastructure that can support a growing organization without sacrificing accuracy or efficiency.

Partner With Our Doctors and Practices

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with partner doctors and practice leadership teams.
  • Serve as a financial resource and strategic advisor, helping doctors understand their numbers, evaluate opportunities, and make sound business decisions.
  • Provide financial guidance on practice performance, growth opportunities, profitability, and tax-related planning in coordination with appropriate tax professionals.
  • Participate in practice board discussions and help translate financial results into actionable recommendations.
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to solve problems and support the success of our partner practices.

Build for What's Next

  • Identify gaps, challenge the status quo, and take initiative to improve how we operate.
  • Create financial processes and reporting structures that can scale with future acquisitions and organizational growth.
  • Manage relationships with external partners, including auditors, banking partners, and other financial advisors.
  • Contribute to broader business initiatives as a member of the leadership team.

What We're Looking For

Experience and Expertise

  • 10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Experience leading, developing, and managing a finance or accounting team, ideally with 5–10+ team members.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Sage Intacct is required. Netsuite and other platforms valuable as well.
  • Proven experience in a high-growth, multi-location or multi-entity business environment.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and FP&A.
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field required; CPA or MBA preferred.
  • Experience with acquisitions, integrations, or a multi-site growth strategy is a plus.
  • Familiarity with banking relationships, cash flow management, and capital planning.

Leadership Style and Mindset

  • Entrepreneurial and action-oriented. You see opportunities, take initiative, and don't wait for someone else to tell you what needs to be done.
  • A hands-on leader. You're comfortable moving between high-level strategy and the day-to-day details. You lead from the front and never consider a task beneath you.
  • A builder. You enjoy creating structure, improving systems, and developing processes that help a growing organization succeed.
  • Driven and accountable. You take ownership of outcomes, follow through on commitments, and bring a sense of urgency to your work.
  • A strong people leader. You know how to set expectations, develop talent, navigate challenges, and bring a team together around shared goals.
  • Collaborative and relationship-focused. You can work effectively with doctors, operators, and colleagues with different backgrounds and perspectives.
  • A clear communicator. You can turn complex financial information into practical insights and recommendations that make sense to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Grounded in integrity. You handle sensitive information with discretion and approach financial decisions with sound judgment.

Dental industry experience is not required. We're more interested in finding someone with the right combination of financial expertise, leadership ability, entrepreneurial thinking, and a genuine interest in helping a business grow.

Location and Travel

This position is based in Utah, and local candidates are preferred. Occasional travel throughout Utah, Idaho, and Wyoming will be required, generally involving monthly day trips to visit our partner practices and work directly with our teams.

Compensation and Opportunity

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to attract an exceptional leader, including:

  • Base salary commensurate with experience.
  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • Profit interests or equity participation.
  • The opportunity to buy into ownership and participate in long-term distributions.

This is more than an opportunity to lead a finance department. It's a chance to help shape the financial future of a growing organization, build a strong team, develop meaningful partnerships with our doctors, and share in the long-term success of the business.

Since 1998, we've been on a mission to reshape how players interact with their favorite games, growing into a global team of over 12,000 professionals spread across 70+ studios in 26 countries.

We are always there to lend a hand to video games developers and publishers by offering a wide range of solutions: from art and audio to testing, localization and finally - Player Engagement - which is one of the fastest-growing Service Lines at Keywords Studios. Player Engagement provides technical support, community management, and trust & safety services for a wide range of AAA and Indie studios in the gaming industry.

Join us in our mission to build engaging player communities and offer outstanding experiences! 🎮🔥

Role overview

We’re looking for a Game Capture Artist who can start immediately and join our award-winning team. You'll stage, shoot and scrutinise in-engine shots across specialised development builds to create the best content possible for our clients.

Our client list and fast growth come from a culture of no-waffle and a strong creative focus. The successful applicant will need to live those values and hit the ground running without heavy hand holding.

What are we looking for? Our Project Manager has a knack for the following skills:

  • A passionate gamer with a broad appreciation of mobile, PC and console titles
  • A willingness to learn each game and its project setup inside out, and to stay hands-on with it every day
  • Someone who can adapt to game development builds and Unity projects that are always changing, including version updates, new scenes and shifting assets
  • An understanding of game trends and how games are marketed across the gaming landscape
  • Creative problem solving: finding ways around bugs, broken scenes and build issues to get the shot
  • A keen eye for composition, camera movement, lighting and framing
  • An eagerness to develop in-engine cinematography techniques and creative storytelling skills
  • A collaborator who can work efficiently with creative, editorial and client-side development teams
  • Strong proficiency in Unity (essential), including Cinemachine, Timeline, the Unity Recorder and working across URP/HDRP render pipelines
  • Working knowledge of Unreal Engine, including Sequencer, Movie Render Queue and cine cameras (highly desirable)
  • Previous experience in a game capture, in-engine cinematics or trailer production role (essential)
  • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro
  • PC proficient, with experience capturing from both PC and mobile builds (Android/iOS)

Your duties:

  • Create high-quality in-engine capture using game development builds and Unity projects. This means setting up cameras, staging scenes and characters, and rendering high-resolution, high-frame-rate footage through the Unity Recorder and, where needed, Unreal's Movie Render Queue
  • Meet capture deadlines, which can sometimes be very tight, and manage your own time efficiently
  • Keep a sharp eye on quality, pushing lighting, post-processing, resolution and detail levels to get the best possible image from each build
  • Select and stage shots that meet the brief, telling a story through capture and showing off each game and its features in the best possible light
  • Fully understand the latest build and project version of each game, and be the main point of contact for all game and engine updates
  • Edit captured footage in After Effects and Premiere Pro, using editing techniques to make it as exciting as possible
  • Build and maintain reusable capture setups, such as camera rigs, Timeline sequences and lighting presets, to speed up future work
  • Gather high-quality assets (characters, environments, UI, renders) and export them from the engine when needed

Requirements

You'd be a great fit for this role if you have:

  • Previous experience in a Game Capture Artist role.
  • A passionate gamer, especially one who enjoys mobile games.
  • Willing to learn the games inside out and play them frequently.
  • Able to adapt to ever-changing game development builds.
  • Understanding of game trends across the gaming landscape.
  • Creative problem-solving skills to find ways around bugs and issues in builds.
  • A keen eye for composition.
  • Eager to develop game capture techniques and creative storytelling skills.
  • Collaborative and able to work efficiently with multiple departments.
  • Competence with OBS Studio (not essential).
  • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects CC.
  • Proficient with both Mac and PC, with a focus on PC.
  • Able to use iOS devices.

If you don't meet all the qualifications but believe you have the skills and experience to excel in this role, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits

What do we offer?

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

Benefits:

  • Non-taxable Allowances
  • HMO and Life Insurance

  • If you pass the TA interview, your profile and portfolio will be shared to the hiring managers for further review. We'll invite you for an interview with them if they thing you meet the basic qualifications. A second interview with the project hiring managers might happen depending on business requirements.
  • At the end of our journey - hopefully you will receive an offer and become our new Keywordian!

Our recruitment process is fully online and remote. We value each application and review every candidate individually. Our recruitment team will get back to you as soon as they can to inform you about the status of your candidacy. If you're interested in joining our team, we highly encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast. Ohne diese Erfahrung ist eine Bewerbung leider nicht sinnvoll.

Du bist auf Facebook und Instagram zu Hause, arbeitest gerne sorgfältig und verlässlich und suchst eine Aufgabe für rund 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, die du zu 100% aus dem Homeoffice erledigen kannst?

Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, durch digitales Recruiting die besten Mitarbeiter zu finden. Dafür läuft bei uns ein eingespielter Prozess: Wir wissen, welche Werbeanzeigen funktionieren, wie die Texte aufgebaut sind und wie eine Kampagne aussehen muss und welche Handgriffe es in Meta für eine erfolgreiche Kampagne braucht.

Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

Wir wachsen weiter und suchen deshalb Unterstützung bei der Durchführung unserer Projekte.

Deine Aufgaben

Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

Du legst unsere Kunden in BVS an und erstellst die Verknüpfungen, so dass die Bewerber auch an den Kunden weitergeleitet werden.

Betreuen unserer Recruiting-Kampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Projektleiterin, nach unserem bestehenden System

Als Urlaubsvertretung übernimmst du die Gestaltung von Kampagnen in Canva und erstellst die passenden Texte für neue Kampagnen. Du arbeitest mit unseren Vorlagen und setzt daraus ansprechende Anzeigen und Grafiken um.

Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

Das bieten wir

Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

Interessiert? Melde dich bei uns und lass uns sprechen (Lebenslauf und deine Kontaktdaten reichen aus - kein Motivationsschreiben).

QA Automation Engineer (Playwright, TypeScript, E2E Testing & CI/CD) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Preferred Locations: LATAM, Eastern Europe, Pakistan, South Africa

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a fast-growing, product-focused technology company — is hiring a senior-level QA Automation Engineer to strengthen its test automation infrastructure and improve software quality at scale.

This is not a manual QA role.

You’ll take hands-on ownership of:

  • Playwright automation
  • TypeScript-based testing
  • E2E test frameworks
  • Regression coverage
  • Test stability and flaky-test reduction
  • CI/CD integration
  • AI-assisted testing workflows

You’ll work directly with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable, scalable automation that increases release confidence and catches problems before they reach production.

If you think like an engineer, enjoy solving difficult automation problems, and care about building maintainable test infrastructure, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Build and maintain end-to-end (E2E) automated tests using:
    • Playwright
    • TypeScript
  • Expand automation coverage across critical:
    • User journeys
    • Product workflows
    • Regression scenarios
  • Build reusable:
    • Test utilities
    • Fixtures
    • Testing patterns
    • Automation components
  • Improve framework:
    • Maintainability
    • Scalability
    • Reliability
    • Execution speed
  • Maintain clean and sustainable automation architecture

Test Stability & Flaky-Test Reduction

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and eliminate flaky tests
  • Diagnose failures involving:
    • DOM interactions
    • Network requests
    • Asynchronous behavior
    • Timing and synchronization
    • Test environments
  • Reduce false positives and inconsistent failures
  • Improve regression suite reliability
  • Develop reliable test-data strategies
  • Help maintain stable testing environments

CI/CD & Release Automation

  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Ensure automated test suites run reliably during deployment workflows
  • Review CI/CD test results and troubleshoot failures
  • Improve execution speed and feedback cycles
  • Support release validation and regression prevention
  • Increase engineering confidence in production deployments

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers during feature development
  • Collaborate on:
    • Testability
    • Regression prevention
    • Release readiness
    • Automation architecture
  • Participate in engineering and testing discussions
  • Identify quality risks before releases
  • Provide clear technical feedback when defects or automation issues are identified

AI-Assisted Testing & Quality Innovation

  • Use AI-assisted tools to improve:
    • Exploratory testing
    • Edge-case identification
    • Test development
    • Debugging
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and testing efficiency
  • Experiment with modern QA and automation workflows
  • Help evolve testing practices as AI-assisted engineering tools improve

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright
    • Strong Cypress experience with willingness to transition to Playwright may also be considered
  • Proven experience building and maintaining E2E automation frameworks
  • Strong understanding of:
    • DOM interaction
    • Network requests
    • Asynchronous application behavior
    • Test synchronization
    • Flaky-test diagnosis
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting abilities
  • Experience improving automation reliability and regression coverage
  • Ability to work directly with software engineers in a modern product environment
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience building automation infrastructure from scratch
  • Experience with test-data management and environment strategies
  • B2B SaaS testing experience
  • Experience testing:
    • Multi-tenant applications
    • Role-based permissions
    • Complex user workflows
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools and workflows
  • Experience in Agile or product-led engineering environments
  • Strong understanding of modern software development and release practices

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think like an engineer first and tester second
  • You prefer automation over repetitive manual testing
  • You enjoy diagnosing why tests are unstable rather than simply rerunning them
  • You take ownership of framework quality and long-term maintainability
  • You understand how modern web applications behave across the DOM, network, and asynchronous workflows
  • You care about clean, reusable automation code
  • You work effectively with minimal management
  • You communicate clearly with frontend and backend engineers

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing CI/CD test results and investigating a flaky Playwright test affecting the regression suite.

From there, you could build automated coverage for a newly released workflow, improve shared TypeScript fixtures, troubleshoot asynchronous behavior, or collaborate with an engineer on making a feature easier to test reliably.

You’ll also continuously improve test performance, framework stability, and automation coverage while experimenting with AI-assisted approaches to exploratory testing and edge-case detection.

In short: you build the automation infrastructure that keeps software releases fast, reliable, and production-ready.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Increased E2E automation coverage
  • Reduction in flaky and unreliable tests
  • Stable CI/CD test execution
  • Faster automated test execution
  • Improved regression detection
  • Increased release confidence
  • Reduction in production issues
  • Maintainable and reusable automation architecture
  • Strong collaboration with engineering teams

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct collaboration with frontend and backend engineering teams
  • Opportunity to improve CI/CD and release quality

jobs.excerpt: PRIMEis a leader in continuing medical education and research.
jobs.description:
PRIMEis a leader in continuing medical education and research. We provide accurate, quality-driven, unbiased CME education to our customers. Our mission is to advance the science of learning and behavior change among providers, patients, payers, and health ecosystems in order to improve competency, performance, and quality health outcomes. The scalable and sustainable research and education that PRIME delivers has measurably improved patient care for over 28 years.

The Opportunity

Prime Education, a property of Everyday Health Group, is looking for an Associate Director, Scientific Affairs. The Associate Director is a professional in the Scientific Affairs team with a high level of independence, who utilizes their combined skills as a scientific medical writer, educational design innovator, and grant development specialist to conduct a turnkey process that includes educational grant development followed by content development for awarded grants. You will engage in investigative and analytical skills and cultivate relationships with expert faculty to identify and establish ongoing opportunities for grant development to achieve the company’s goals. The Associate Director is responsible to complete quality scientific and medical writing as assigned by the Executive Director, Scientific Affairs and maintain oversight of project deliverables. You will conduct literature reviews of clinical trials, peer-reviewed articles, clinical guidelines and other medical/scientific data sources to develop needs assessments and grant proposals, accurate content, and identify compelling educational designs, including program titles, learning objectives, agendas, and formats. You will also contribute to identification of publishing opportunities, develop abstracts for scientific posters and podium presentations at leading medical meetings, and journal articles for peer-reviewed publications to showcase the results of the company’s educational and research initiatives. The Associate Director, Scientific Affairs is a self-starter with extensive experience in independently designing and developing continuing education activities and research-informed initiatives for the interprofessional healthcare team and relies on their extensive experience and judgment to accomplish goals. The Associate Director will act as an adult learning expert to assist PRIME® in fulfilling its responsibilities in grant development, program design, development, and evaluation. In this role, the Associate Director collaborates with other colleagues, departments and stakeholders as part of PRIME®’s commitment to flawless execution of its educational products and services. The Associate Director reports directly to the Executive Director, Scientific Affairs and is responsible to liaise with the department members in a team environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop high-caliber medical and scientific content with the highest standards of editorial excellence adhering to standards of adult learning principles and interprofessional education
  • Contribute to grant planning and development, encompassing educational designs, formats, and execution plans, to meet department goals and address unmet educational and research needs to assist in strategic planning for future activities
  • Establish and maintain relationships among key leaders in health care, among various practice settings, in order to collect expert opinion and insights into educational program needs and grant development opportunities
  • Contribute to the outcomes measurement of high-impact educational programs, including measurement planning, survey instrument development, program analyses, and communication of outcomes findings with external stakeholders
  • Develop and contribute to scientific articles, abstracts, and outcomes-based presentations and publications to exemplify the services and products of the company
  • Communicate effectively to ensure workflow is smooth and carry out opportunities, needs, ideas, and timelines to meet the company’s and department’s goals for continued growth and success
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues pertaining to instructional design components in the development of content, with recommendations provided to the Executive Director, Scientific Affairs in a timely manner
  • Review content developed by other medical writers and freelancers, and provide guidance and/or revisions to ensure clinical relevance and accuracy
  • Participate in decisions pertaining to PRIME®’s model of learning and implementation procedures to execute the model of learning
  • Participate in regularly scheduled meetings of the Scientific Affairs Department, including grant and content planning meetings
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Job Qualifications:

  • Minimal Master’s degree (PhD degree preferred) in a scientific and communications or related field commensurate with the scope of work identified in this job description and current knowledge of the healthcare industry
  • Prefer minimum of 4 years of experience in designing and developing continuing medical education (CME/CE) activities for healthcare professionals
  • Prefer experience in developing CME/CE activities supported by pharmaceutical companies and government contracts or grants
  • Prefer experience in training, project management and/or staff supervision in a team-based office environment
  • Excellent ability to work independently and autonomously, and multi-task multiple high-level responsibilities and projects with accuracy and efficiency
  • Ability to independently research, design, and develop high-quality scientific grant and medical writing commensurate with the desired “Position Duties”
  • Ability to independently complete literature review and review/analyze scientific/medical research in order to apply accurate concepts to product development
  • Analytical and didactic ability to independently complete medical writing in accordance with AMA criteria and grant development procedures
  • Ability to organize and convey educational designs and deliverables efficiently, fluently, and accurately
  • Proficiency in analytical thinking and an ability to convey complex data results in a clear and concise manner
  • Ability to gather data from verifiable sources for grant development
  • Possess creative and visionary skills to identify and execute innovative educational program designs and formats
  • Current knowledge of the healthcare industry, pharmaceutical pipelines, health care industry/policies, and CE industry
  • Experience in developing content in any of the following disease areas: oncology, diabetes,
  • endocrinology, neurology, rheumatology, cardiology, ophthalmology, dermatology, respiratory, pain management, mental health, women’s health, gastroenterology, hepatology, infectious diseases, or immune mediated inflammatory diseases
  • Excellent English language skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Endnote or any other reference manager applications

Our Culture and Values

We created our values together to guide our collective purpose and pursuits. We are collaborators and problem solvers. We empower one another to make informed decisions and to be enabled towards action. We embrace success. We recognize that innovation can spark and be born from any of us no matter our individual role or background. We encourage open mindedness and sensitivity to each other and our environment. Our personal and professional passions get ignited, nurtured and supported. We value that doing is greater than talking as the most measurable means of impact. Our collective purpose to deliver enlightened audience experiences with trusted brands is what drives the success of our business and our professional satisfaction.

Life at Everyday Health

At Everyday Health Group, a division of Ziff Davis, we work in a culture of collaboration and welcome those who desire to join our growing global community. We believe in careers versus jobs and people versus employees. We seek enthusiastic individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit looking for an environment that rewards your best work.

About Ziff Davis

Description

Executive Assistant to the Owner

Fully Remote | Full-Time | Dedicated Support

Plumbing Solutions LLC

Monday–Friday | 7:30 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

Remote — Candidates must live outside South Carolina and Georgia

Plumbing Solutions LLC is looking for a highly organized, dependable, and discreet Executive Assistant to work directly with the owner of our growing businesses.

The owner oversees two South Carolina-based companies — a residential plumbing contractor operating across multiple markets and a luxury bath showroom. With a busy schedule, a constant flow of calls, texts, emails, appointments, deadlines, and projects, we are looking for someone who can bring organization, follow-through, and calm to the day-to-day. This is more than a calendar-management position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, think ahead and protect the owner's time.

﻿

What You'll Do

You'll become the owner's go-to person for managing the details that keep his professional and personal schedule moving.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing and organizing incoming email, phone calls, texts, and other communications
  • Determining what needs the owner's attention and what can be handled or routed without interrupting him
  • Managing the calendar, appointments, travel, reservations, and commitments
  • Tracking deadlines and following up until things are actually completed
  • Preparing a concise daily summary of items that require the owner's attention
  • Making approved purchases and coordinating returns, renewals, and other administrative tasks
  • Coordinating with vendors and outsourced service providers
  • Handling personal and household logistics when requested
  • Organizing information and records using Google Workspace, Notion, Smartsheet, and other tools
  • Researching questions and providing concise, decision-ready information
  • Helping manage projects from start to finish
  • Creating simple procedures and documentation as you learn recurring responsibilities
  • Using AI and technology to make recurring work more efficient

The goal isn't simply to keep up with messages. The goal is to make sure the right things get handled, the important things don't get missed, and the owner can stay focused on the things that only he can do.

What We're Looking For

The right person for this role is someone who naturally thinks: "I'll take care of it."

You are organized without being reminded. You follow up without being asked twice. You notice details. You can work independently and are comfortable making reasonable decisions within established guidelines.

We'd love to hear from you if you have experience as an:

  • Executive Assistant
  • Personal Assistant
  • Legal Assistant or Paralegal
  • Office Manager
  • Operations Coordinator
  • Administrative Coordinator
  • Executive Support professional
  • Similar role supporting an owner, executive, attorney, or other busy professional

Experience supporting an owner or senior executive is strongly preferred.

You will be trained on the owner's preferences, systems, and processes.

The expectations are that you are:

  • A quick learner
  • Comfortable with technology
  • Curious about AI and how it can improve your work
  • A strong writer and communicator
  • Comfortable documenting what you learn
  • Able to handle confidential information with maturity and discretion
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Someone who takes pride in following through

Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, Smartsheet, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools is a plus. Most importantly, we want someone who can demonstrate that they have used technology to solve real problems — not simply someone who can list software on a resume.

This Is a Different Kind of Remote Role

This position works directly for the owner and is intentionally separate from the company's day-to-day organizational structure.

You won't be expected to sit in company meetings, manage employees, or become involved in office politics.

Your job is to support the owner.

You'll have clear guidelines for what you can handle yourself, what should be brought to his attention, and what should be routed to the appropriate person.

That means you won't have to constantly wonder, "Does he want me to handle this or bother him about it?"

The systems and expectations will be clearly defined.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote

Location Requirement: Candidates must reside outside South Carolina and Georgia.

There is no office requirement, travel requirement, or site-visit requirement for this position.

This is a dedicated single-principal position, meaning your primary responsibility will be supporting one owner rather than working for multiple clients or through an agency.

Confidentiality Matters

This position involves access to sensitive business and personal information.

We are looking for someone who understands that trust is earned through consistency, discretion, and good judgment.

You should be comfortable handling confidential information without sharing details unnecessarily — including during the interview process.

A confidentiality agreement will be required as part of employment.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Full benefits
  • Weekly pay
  • Monday–Friday schedule
  • Fully remote work
  • Direct support to the owner
  • Dedicated single-principal position

Our Interview Process

We want to get to know you, but we also want to see how you actually work.

Our process will generally include:

  1. Application
  2. Initial phone conversation
  3. A one way recorded interview (link will be emailed)
  4. A short, approximately 30-minute working exercise
  5. Second Interview (link will be emailed)
  6. Hiring decison

The working exercise will give you a sample set of messages or requests and allow us to see how you decide what to handle, what to hold, what to follow up on, and what actually needs the owner's attention. It's less about having the "perfect" answer and more about seeing how you think.

Interested?

If you're the kind of person who enjoys bringing order to a busy day, catching details before they become problems, and taking things off someone's plate without needing to be asked twice, we'd love to hear from you.

**When you apply, please include a short note answering this question:

**Tell us about a time you kept something off your boss's plate because you recognized that it didn't require their attention — and you were right to do so.**

We'd also love to hear briefly about a time you used AI or technology to make a real work process easier or more efficient.

If you're looking for a traditional administrative job where you simply complete a list of assigned tasks, this may not be the right fit.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

•3+ years supporting an owner or senior executive with demonstrated communication-triage ownership, not calendar-only support

•Evidence of using AI tools to run real workflows, with examples and results

•Proficiency in Google Workspace and at least one of Notion or Smartsheet

•Verifiable references on confidentiality and follow-through

Role-Specific Competencies

• Judgment at the edges of rules: applies the matrix to messy real inputs and logs the call

• AI fluency at the workflow level: prompting, structured data, automation, not tool name-dropping

• Documentation as default behavior: builds the Playbook without being told

• High discretion, low drama, comfortable being invisible

• Remote self-management: produces daily visible output without supervision

Success Measures

• Escalations reaching the CEO per day, trending down with zero material misses

• Protected morning compliance percentage

• CEO last work-send timestamp moving into business hours

• Open loops closed on time; SLA met on CEO-behalf responses

The 90-day test is not "were assigned tasks completed." It is: does the CEO day actually run differently.

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Senior Training Instructor will be responsible for preparing and delivering technical, skill-based training across MEI Rigging & Crating’s workforce, including new hires, apprenticeship program participants, and incumbent employees. This role supports organization-wide initiatives by coordinating the MEI Apprenticeship Training Program and managing related activities such as team member mentorship, field coaching, on-the-job training (OJT), Best Known Methods (BKMs), and candidate evaluations. The Training Instructor will collaborate with the Training and Development Director, Talent Development Managers, Training Specialists, and other organizational leaders to design and implement effective training solutions. They will play a pivotal role in identifying and addressing company-wide training requirements and development opportunities.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead Apprenticeship Program Curriculum Development/Revision via needs assessments, curriculum design, instructional material development, assessment/evaluations, program revisions, and delivery optimization
  • Lead Apprenticeship Program Course Delivery and Presentation via public speaking, logistics/scheduling, collaboration, reliability, continuous improvement, supporting KPIs, and alignment with MEI’s values of safety, integrity, and excellence.
  • Drive Organizational Training Projects: Oversee and manage training initiatives that address company-wide needs and monitor their effectiveness, making adjustments as necessary.
  • Support Skill Development: Manage skill development initiatives for employees at all levels, including evaluating candidates’ qualifications and commitment to participating in programs such as Entry-Level Driver Training.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Training and Development, Talent Development Managers, Training Specialists, Regional Office Training Instructors, and other organizational leaders to design and implement effective training solutions.
  • Conduct Gap Analyses: Perform skill and knowledge assessments to identify development opportunities and align employees with appropriate training pathways.
  • Develop and Deliver Training Materials: Obtain or create training resources and presentations, including technical content. Facilitate training sessions for individuals or groups across multiple locations.
  • Track and Maintain Training Records: Maintain a centralized system of training records for the organization, ensuring compliance with audit and regulatory standards.
  • Evaluate Training Effectiveness: Monitor and report on participant progress, milestones, and successes, and assess overall program effectiveness in meeting organizational goals.
  • Stay Current as an SME: Attend industry trade shows, seminars, and continuing education opportunities to maintain subject matter expertise relevant to the organization’s operations.
  • Support Recruitment Efforts: Evaluate and interview new hires to assess their potential for success in training programs and alignment with organizational needs.
  • Position reports to Director of Training and Development and will require travel to regional offices, anticipate up to 50%.

Minimum Qualifications (Experience, Skills, and Education):

  • High school diploma or equivalent necessary. Higher degree (Bachelor) in Education, Training, Human Resources, Industrial Education, or related field helpful.
  • Ten (10) years of experience as an advanced level Rigger, Machinery Mover, Construction Rigger, or similar role.
  • Be knowledgeable in or have experience with DOT regulations and CDL training programs and requirements.
  • Experience managing training programs and curriculums, including short-duration and long- duration learning. Maintain current and relative materials, topics, and records for training.
  • Proficient with MS Office, including PowerPoint, Outlook, and Excel, and use of a Windows- based operating system.
  • Strong organization and planning skills; possess adaptability and flexibility considerations; and a customer-focused mindset.
  • Ability to convey complex or technical information and concepts across all levels of staff and understanding; interpret and explain information meaning and uses to others.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills; comfortable with in-person instruction delivered to groups or crowds of various size.
  • Possess a good understanding of the English language, including the meaning and spelling of words. Keep accurate and legible records, in English.
  • Demonstrates active listening skills and critical thinking skills. Interacts with others professionally and positively; can follow direction and is receptive to constructive feedback.
  • Must be self-directed and self-motivated; able to manage own time efficiently and encourages this with others.
  • Ability to analyze information, make determinations, problem-solve, and positively influence others.
  • Bilingual in English / Spanish helpful but not necessary.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license, be insurable, and is willing and able to travel locally between regional offices on a frequent basis.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

Most work is in a normal indoor, climate-controlled environment. The Senior Training Instructor will stand frequently (at times for long durations), sit frequently, utilize senses involving sight, touch, and audio; will use speech and verbal communication skills. Will work with mouse, keyboard, and general office equipment. Occasional work in a non-climate-controlled environment, outdoors, or on uneven terrain. May lift and/or move items weighing 20+ pounds.

Additional Requirements:

Work with a Top-of-Mind Awareness for the safety of yourself and everyone at the job site. Must be able to work in a high functioning team environment. Display the highest levels of honesty, integrity, and professionalism. Take pride in your work and in the company. Communicate openly and strive for peak performance in daily tasks. Know and deliver the quality service MEI’s customers have come to expect. About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. The AI Build team is a new, industry-focused team dedicated to building with the world’s leading and fastest-scaling AI companies. We work alongside Stripe’s AI Solutions Architecture and GTM teams, and across Stripe’s product suite to help customers adopt emerging products, close interoperability and 0→1 solution gaps, and bring field learning directly into Stripe’s product roadmap. The team owns strategic proof-of-concept engagements across the pre- and post-sales lifecycle, complementing Stripe’s AI account teams and the product depth of Stripe’s specialist teams.

As a Solutions Engineer on the AI Build team, you’ll work directly with frontier AI companies on the payments, billing, and monetization infrastructure underlying their core businesses. You’ll own complex proof-of-concept engagements on Stripe’s frontier products, from initial scoping through activation and handoff, combining customer discovery, solution design, rapid prototyping, and cross-functional leadership. You won’t simply implement a finished product: you’ll build with customers, identify where Stripe’s products or integrations need to evolve, and help customers feel as though they are inside our product roadmap.

  • Own strategic POCs end to end: Sell, scope, and lead proof-of-concept engagements from initial customer commitment through activation.
  • Build with customers: Work deeply with users’ engineers and technical leaders to understand their workflows, rapidly prototype solutions, and establish credible paths to production.
  • Design across Stripe: Create solutions that span multiple Stripe products and determine whether blockers require configuration, integration work, custom development, or a core product change.
  • Close 0→1 gaps: Navigate incomplete products, evolving requirements, and interoperability gaps while balancing immediate customer outcomes with reusable solutions.
  • Influence the roadmap: Translate customer needs and deployment friction into clear product requirements, and partner with product and engineering teams to shape how Stripe’s frontier products are built.
  • Lead cross-functionally: Coordinate AI account teams, AI and specialist Solutions Architects, product and engineering teams, Professional Services, and post-sales technical resources across the engagement lifecycle of new builds and deployments.
  • Create repeatable patterns: Turn successful customer-specific work into reusable prototypes, reference architectures, implementation playbooks, and solution components.
  • Stay close to the AI frontier: Operate at the pace and in the working style of AI-native companies, and remain current on emerging companies, products, business models, and technical developments across the industry.

Who you are

You are a customer-oriented technical builder who thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. You build trusted relationships with engineers, technical leaders, and senior stakeholders, and you are equally comfortable discovering an unclear problem, designing an architecture, prototyping a solution, and coordinating teams through activation. You use code pragmatically to accelerate your work. You communicate clearly, lead through influence, and look for patterns that can turn one customer engagement into a better product or repeatable approach for many customers.

  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customer engineers, technical leaders, founders, and other senior stakeholders
  • Ability to lead through influence across sales, product, engineering, implementation, and post-sales teams while maintaining clear ownership of the customer outcome
  • Experience operating at startup speed and in Slack-first, rapidly changing environments, along with active engagement in the broader AI industry

This role offers a unique opportunity to partner directly with leading AI companies and work on the financial infrastructure that powers their businesses. As an early member of Stripe’s AI industry team, you’ll help shape how Stripe partners with frontier companies, brings emerging products to market, and translates customer insights into product direction.

As organizations increasingly rely on cloud services, digital identities, connected devices and AI-powered tools, security teams often have to manage multiple, disconnected solutions. This fragmentation creates gaps in visibility and makes cyber threats harder to identify and stop.

HarfangLab brings these protections together in a single platform. Powered by lightweight software and AI designed specifically for cybersecurity, our technology helps organizations detect suspicious activity, investigate incidents and respond to threats across computers, servers, identities, email, cloud environments, internet-facing systems and AI tools.

Organizations can deploy our platform in the cloud or within their own infrastructure, allowing them to retain control over their technology and data. Our EDR was the first to be certified and qualified by ANSSI, France’s national cybersecurity agency, and the first EDR to receive certification from the BSI, Germany’s Federal Office for Information Security.

Today, HarfangLab’s technology protects more than 1,000 customers across a wide range of sectors, from major corporations and public institutions to SMEs, hospitals and local authorities. Harfanglab continuously strives to create new features to provide the most professional cybersecurity application for its clients. A Quick Note Before You Apply

We are looking for a hands-on public relations professional who has actually pitched reporters, developed media relationships, and helped secure meaningful earned coverage. This is an execution-focused, multi-client role with the opportunity to help shape a growing earned-media and digital PR practice. You should be able to take an approved campaign direction and independently move it from research and messaging through outreach, follow-up, and reporting.

About RR Digital

RR Digital is a digital marketing agency helping law firms grow through data-driven strategy, paid media, SEO, content, web development, and marketing technology. We are expanding how traditional public relations and digital PR work alongside those capabilities to strengthen client visibility, credibility, and authority.

About the Role

The PR Specialist will support a growing portfolio of legal, litigation, and advocacy clients, including case announcements, attorney thought leadership, public affairs, and sensitive advocacy campaigns. You will execute day-to-day earned-media work across multiple accounts while partnering with PR leadership on positioning, client priorities, and high-value opportunities.

As RR Digital develops a broader digital PR offering, you will also help plan and execute campaigns built around original research, data, relevant news, expert commentary, podcasts, newsletters, and digital publishers. You will collaborate with SEO, link-building, content, and social teams, while keeping clear distinctions between independently earned coverage, paid placements, and press release syndication.

What You'll Do

  • Own execution of assigned campaigns: organize briefs, draft materials, build targeted outlet lists, conduct outreach, follow up, manage responses, and report results.
  • Pitch journalists, editors, podcast producers, newsletter writers, and other relevant publishers with individualized, newsworthy angles; maintain and grow authentic media relationships.
  • Draft and edit press releases, story pitches, attorney commentary, statements, interview briefs, thought-leadership materials, and client updates.
  • Identify proactive opportunities from breaking news, litigation developments, public records, client milestones, and timely trends.
  • Support digital PR campaigns promoting credible original research, surveys, useful resources, and data-driven stories; coordinate outreach sequencing, exclusives, and embargoes when appropriate.
  • Collaborate with SEO and link-building colleagues to connect editorial opportunities with relevant content and audience goals, without compromising journalistic standards or pitching solely for links.
  • Coordinate attorneys and clients for interviews, approvals, and time-sensitive journalist requests; maintain accurate calendars, status updates, and campaign records.
  • Monitor and clearly distinguish independent earned coverage, wire syndication, editorial mentions and links, referral activity, and other campaign outcomes.
  • Help refine repeatable processes, reporting templates, campaign intake, and cross-team workflows as the earned-media practice grows.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive legal and survivor-advocacy matters with care, accuracy, sound judgment, and discretion.

Who You Are

  • A resourceful publicist who enjoys finding a real story and persuading the right journalist to care about it.
  • Comfortable owning the details of an account or campaign while knowing when to escalate sensitive strategic or legal questions.
  • Curious, collaborative, precise, and able to work in an evolving department without waiting for perfect processes.
  • Motivated by quality of placements and relationships, not just email volume, syndication counts, or vanity metrics.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned client campaigns advance from approved strategy to timely, accurate materials and sustained outreach with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Journalists and digital publishers receive relevant pitches; reporter engagement and substantive earned opportunities increase over time.
  • Cross-functional digital PR pilots are coordinated efficiently, with clearly owned contacts, messaging, approvals, and results.
  • Clients and internal teams receive dependable updates and reporting that distinguishes types of coverage and their actual value.
  • PR leadership gains capacity for high-level strategy, relationships, service development, and growth because campaign execution is in reliable hands.

Position Details

Full-time, remote (United States). Candidates must be based in the United States and authorized to work without sponsorship. RR Digital is open to strong candidates from agency, in-house, legal, and adjacent earned-media backgrounds.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on PR/media relations experience, preferably in an agency or other fast-moving, multi-account environment; candidates with equivalent experience are welcome.
  • Demonstrated experience independently pitching media, following up appropriately, managing inquiries, and contributing to genuine earned coverage (not only drafting releases or distributing them).
  • Excellent writing, editing, and news judgment, including the ability to translate technical or sensitive material into accurate, compelling stories.
  • Strong organization and accountability: able to move several live campaigns forward, manage approvals and deadlines, and communicate progress without constant supervision.
  • Confidence working with clients, subject-matter experts, journalists, and colleagues across different functions.
  • Understanding of editorial independence and the distinctions among earned media, sponsored content, and press release distribution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in legal or litigation PR, public affairs, corporate communications, advocacy, consumer issues, or other high-stakes/regulated fields.
  • Experience with digital PR, data-led outreach, surveys, original research, online editorial publishers, newsletters, or podcasts.
  • Familiarity with Muck Rack, Cision, PR Newswire, media monitoring platforms, and media contact databases.
  • Working understanding of how editorial mentions, relevant links, referral traffic, SEO, and brand visibility intersect; prior link-building production experience is not required.
  • Experience creating concise, client-ready coverage reports and identifying actionable lessons from campaign results.

Benefits

  • 401(k): Match 100% of employee contributions up to 4%
  • Unlimited Manager-Approved Paid Time Off
  • Health Insurance: Aetna PPO & EPO options (Subsidized $300 per month)
  • Dental & Vision Insurance: Guardian
  • Company-provided MacBook
  • Fully Remote

That is where you come in. As our GTM Engineer, you will build the AI and automation layer behind our go-to-market organization. You will design, build, and ship the agents, workflows, and integrations that take manual work off the plates of our sales, marketing, customer success, and GTM Operations teams, and you will put practical AI tools in the hands of everyone who sells and supports our products. Every hour you give back is an hour our people can spend with the students and educators we serve, and a way to reach K-12 districts, schools, and clinical professionals with more precision without growing headcount at the same rate. That is our double bottom line at work: capacity that powers both revenue and mission.

Selling into education has its own rhythm: fiscal-year budget cycles, federal and state funding streams, RFP-driven procurement, buying committees that span superintendents, assessment directors, and school psychologists, and strict expectations for protecting student data. You will build systems tuned to that reality, so our teams show up at the right district, with the right message, at the right point in the buying cycle.

You will be GTM Operations' builder. You will partner with our Revenue Analytics, Systems & RevTech, Deal Operations, and Global Operations owners to find the highest-leverage opportunities, ship in short sprints, measure the hours and revenue impact of every build, and teach the team to use and extend what you create. About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Vice President of Customer Support to lead a global Level 1 support organization for a finance technology company delivering SaaS solutions to financial services customers. This leader will manage approximately 50 support professionals across application support, account support, data management support, implementation support, and configuration support.
The VP of Customer Support will be accountable for delivering a premium, responsive, and scalable customer support experience for tier 1 financial services organizations. The role requires strong operational discipline, deep understanding of support KPIs and SLAs, proven experience defining support contracts, and the ability to optimize Zendesk and AI-enabled workflows across a follow-the-sun global support model.

Responsibilities
Global Support Leadership
  • Lead and develop a global Level 1 customer support organization of approximately 50 people across application support, account support, data management support, implementation support, and configuration support.
  • Operate and continuously improve a follow-the-sun support model spanning the United States, Europe, APAC and South Africa
  • Build a high-performance support culture focused on ownership, responsiveness, customer empathy, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure clear roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, and handoffs across support teams and adjacent functions.

Support Operations, KPIs, and SLAs
  • Define, manage, and report on core support KPIs, including first response time, time to resolution, SLA adherence, ticket backlog, customer satisfaction, escalation rates, and quality metrics.
  • Own the design and operational management of support SLAs across customer tiers, support packages, and internal support groups.
  • Establish clear operating rhythms, dashboards, quality assurance processes, and management reviews to improve support performance and customer outcomes.
  • Use data-driven insights to identify operational bottlenecks, improve workflows, reduce repeat issues, and increase first-contact or first-team resolution.

Support Contracts and Premium Support
  • Define, refine, and operationalize customer support contracts, including standard and premium support offerings.
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure support commitments are commercially sound, operationally achievable, and clearly measurable.
  • Develop tiered support models that align service levels, response commitments, escalation paths, and customer value.
  • Support executive-level customer conversations regarding support models, service commitments, escalations, and continuous improvement plans.

Zendesk Optimization and AI-Enabled Support
  • Own the optimization of Zendesk as the central support platform, including ticket intake, forms, routing, queues, automations, triggers, reporting, knowledge base, and customer portal experience.
  • Design workflows that ensure customer issues are routed quickly to the right team with the right context and are tracked through to resolution.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI tooling to improve support efficiency, including intelligent ticket classification, customer self-service, knowledge recommendations, quality review, customer sentiment analysis, and agent productivity.
  • Ensure AI-enabled workflows are governed, measurable, secure, and aligned with the expectations of enterprise financial services customers.

Customer Engagement and Enterprise Support
  • Ensure the support organization can confidently engage with and support tier 1 financial services organizations, including investment banks, asset managers, regulators, and other premium enterprise customers.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for high-value customers and critical support issues.
  • Develop customer-facing support practices that demonstrate professionalism, accountability, urgency, and deep understanding of enterprise financial services expectations.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Account Management to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and confidence in the support experience.

People Development and Training
  • Build a structured training and enablement program that equips support personnel to deliver superior service across product, process, communication, and customer engagement skills.
  • Define career paths, skills matrices, progression plans, and coaching routines for support professionals and team leaders.
  • Develop future leaders and technical specialists within the support organization.
  • Ensure teams have the knowledge, tools, and confidence to troubleshoot complex SaaS application, account, data, implementation, and configuration issues.

Product and Engineering Collaboration
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure customer support insights are converted into actionable product improvements.
  • Establish clear defect escalation, prioritization, communication, and resolution processes across Support, Product, and Engineering.
  • Provide structured feedback on product usability, recurring customer pain points, configuration complexity, data issues, and supportability concerns.
  • Ensure swift resolution of defects and transparent communication to customers and internal stakeholders.

Experience and Skills
  • 10+ years of customer support, technical support, customer operations, or service delivery leadership experience, preferably in B2B SaaS or financial technology.
  • 5+ years leading managers and geographically distributed support teams across multiple regions.
  • Proven experience managing Level 1 support organizations supporting complex SaaS products for enterprise customers.
  • Experience supporting financial services customers, ideally including tier 1 banks, investment banks, asset managers, regulators, or other highly regulated enterprise clients.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with premium enterprise customers and senior internal stakeholders.

Leadership Attributes
  • Customer obsessed, commercially aware, and operationally disciplined.
  • Comfortable leading transformation while maintaining high standards of day-to-day service delivery.
  • Strong people leader who can coach managers, develop talent, and build clear career paths.
  • Data-driven decision maker with the ability to convert metrics into practical operational improvements.
  • Confident working in a high-expectation enterprise environment where responsiveness, trust, and communication are critical.
  • Collaborative, transparent, and able to influence across functions without creating unnecessary complexity.

Measures of Success
  • Improved first response time, time to resolution, SLA adherence, backlog management, and customer satisfaction.
  • Clear support contract definitions and operating models for standard and premium support.
  • Optimized Zendesk workflows, reporting, routing, customer portal experience, and AI-enabled support processes.
  • Consistent follow-the-sun support execution across the United States, Europe, and India.
  • Improved support quality, staff capability, career progression, and management effectiveness.
  • Stronger collaboration between Support, Product Management, and Engineering, resulting in faster defect resolution and better product feedback loops.
  • Greater confidence from premium financial services customers in the quality, reliability, and professionalism of the support organization.

About MCO (MyComplianceOffice)
MCO is a global leader dedicated to empowering Financial Services firms to manage compliance programs with ease and efficiency. Our mission is to foster a fair, transparent, and trusted financial environment worldwide by helping organizations meet their regulatory obligations to society.

At the heart of MCO’s offering is our unique, unified platform, which seamlessly integrates compliance monitoring and data into a single, comprehensive view. This holistic approach enables firms to maintain compliance across all internal systems, structures, and processes—ensuring peace of mind in an ever-evolving regulatory landscape.

Headquartered in Dublin, MCO has an international footprint, with offices in London, Singapore, Hyderabad, New York, Chicago, Fort Worth, Switzerland, South Africa, Slovenia, and the UAE. Since our founding in 2008, we have evolved from a specialist provider of “best of breed” employee compliance solutions to a pioneer in integrated compliance technology.

Today, our team of over 400 professionals supports more than 1.5 million users in 128 countries. Our diverse customer base includes small businesses, large enterprises, four of the world’s top ten asset managers, twenty of the top seventy-five global banks, and three of the top five investment banks for global M&A transactions.
