jobs.title: Senior Director, Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Writing Services
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position.  Position SummaryCriterion Edge is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead its Pharmaceutical Writing Services group, with substantial hands-on pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory medical writing expertise and the ability to independently author and lead complex medical device clinical evaluations as needed.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.
Position Summary

Criterion Edge is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead its Pharmaceutical Writing Services group, with substantial hands-on pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory medical writing expertise and the ability to independently author and lead complex medical device clinical evaluations as needed.
The Senior Director will provide scientific, technical, and operational leadership for pharmaceutical writing engagements, including oversight of complex clinical submission programs, client relationships, writer development, resourcing, and quality. The successful candidate must also be capable of independently leading end-to-end Clinical Evaluation Report (CER) projects under the EU MDR, including responses to Notified Body questions.
This is a hands-on writing leadership role, not solely a people-management, regulatory affairs, or review position. The Senior Director must be able to personally author and critically review complex pharmaceutical and medical device documents and serve as a technical authority for writers, project teams, and clients.

Required Pharmaceutical Writing Experience

Candidates must have:
  1. At least 8 years of direct pharmaceutical and/or biologic regulatory medical writing experience, with substantial recent hands-on authorship of complex clinical and regulatory submission documents.
  2. Demonstrated end-to-end leadership of pharmaceutical writing programs or major submission workstreams, including planning, authoring, review coordination, issue resolution, and delivery of submission-ready documents, rather than experience limited to discrete sections, editing, quality control, or project management.
  3. Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate pharmaceutical and biologic clinical regulatory writing strategies, coordinating across clinical, regulatory, biostatistics, safety, and other functions.
  4. Demonstrated ability to advise clients on pharmaceutical regulatory guidance, submission expectations, and implications for clinical and regulatory documents.
Relevant pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory writing experience may include:
  1. Regulatory submissions: INDs, NDAs, BLAs, and global regulatory dossiers.
  2. CTD clinical documentation: Clinical Overviews, Clinical Summaries, Integrated Summaries of Safety (ISS), and Integrated Summaries of Efficacy (ISE).
  3. Clinical development documents: Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), clinical study protocols, and Investigator's Brochures (IBs).
  4. Regulatory authority interactions: Regulatory briefing documents and responses to regulatory authority questions.
  5. Safety and benefit-risk documentation: Integrated safety evaluations, benefit-risk assessments, and related regulatory documentation.
  6. Regulatory strategy and advisory services: Development of regulatory writing strategies and advising clients on evolving regulatory requirements and submission expectations.
Experience planning and coordinating clinical submission documents across eCTD Modules 2 through 5, including integrated clinical summaries and major marketing application workstreams, is strongly preferred.
Candidates must demonstrate the ability to lead pharmaceutical writing engagements independently, including development of the writing strategy, coordination of cross-functional reviews, resolution of conflicting reviewer comments, and direct communication with sponsors and regulatory stakeholders.

Required Medical Device Experience

Candidates must have:
  1. At least 5 years of direct medical device regulatory or clinical writing experience, with substantial end-to-end EU MDR CER leadership experience.
  2. Demonstrated ability to independently scope, author, lead, and finalize regulator-ready CERs, including resolving complex clinical evidence issues and addressing Notified Body questions without day-to-day supervision. Experience limited to editing, quality control, review, project management, or authorship of individual CER sections is insufficient.
  3. Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate regulatory strategies for medical device programs.
  4. Demonstrated ability to guide clients on regulatory updates, changing requirements, and the potential impact of those changes on clinical and regulatory documentation.
Independent CER leadership must include the ability to direct and perform the following activities, as applicable:
  1. Clinical evaluation planning and strategy: Clinical Evaluation Plan (CEP) development, project scoping, and clinical evaluation strategy.
  2. Literature review and clinical evidence assessment: State-of-the-art development, systematic literature review strategy, literature screening, clinical data appraisal, and evidence synthesis.
  3. Clinical evaluation and benefit-risk assessment: Evaluation of device safety, performance, clinical benefits, equivalence (where applicable), and benefit-risk conclusions.
  4. PMS and PMCF integration: Evaluation and integration of post-market surveillance (PMS) and post-market clinical follow-up (PMCF) data into clinical evaluations.
  5. CER development and regulatory support: Authoring and finalization of regulator-ready CERs, lifecycle updates, and responses to Notified Body questions and deficiencies.
  6. Regulatory strategy and client advisory: Interpretation of evolving EU MDR, MEDDEV, MDCG, and related regulatory requirements and advising clients on their implications for clinical evaluation.
Candidates must demonstrate current working knowledge of EU MDR clinical evaluation requirements, MEDDEV 2.7/1 Rev. 4, and applicable MDCG guidance.

Preferred U.S. Medical Device Submission Experience

Candidates should also have experience authoring, leading, or substantially contributing to U.S. medical device regulatory documentation; direct 510(k) authorship is preferred.
Relevant experience may include:
  1. FDA regulatory submissions: 510(k), De Novo, and Premarket Approval (PMA) submissions.
  2. Regulatory and scientific documentation: Predicate device comparisons, substantial equivalence assessments, clinical and performance evidence summaries, and supporting technical documentation.
  3. FDA interactions: Preparation of responses to FDA questions, requests for additional information, and regulatory deficiencies.
  4. Regulatory strategy and client advisory: Development of U.S. market access strategies and advising clients on evolving FDA requirements and submission expectations.
Leadership Responsibilities
The Senior Director will:
  1. Lead Criterion Edge’s Pharmaceutical Writing Services group, with accountability for technical quality, delivery, staff development, and the successful execution of pharmaceutical and biologic regulatory writing engagements.
  2. Establish consistent pharmaceutical writing processes, quality expectations, and technical review standards while maintaining direct authorship capacity for priority or high-complexity deliverables.
  3. Serve as the senior pharmaceutical regulatory medical writing expert for complex clinical submission programs, while providing independent technical leadership for CER projects when needed.
  4. Lead pharmaceutical client scoping discussions, proposal input, kickoffs, and ongoing senior-level client communications.
  5. Develop and communicate regulatory and medical writing strategies appropriate to each project.
  6. Guide clients on regulatory updates, changing requirements, emerging guidance, and their potential impact on regulatory strategy and documentation.
  7. Plan pharmaceutical writing deliverables, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and cross-functional review cycles; oversee execution and address delivery risks.
  8. Independently author or lead pharmaceutical regulatory documents and major submission workstreams, and lead complex EU MDR CER projects from planning through finalization, including Notified Body deficiency responses.
  9. Review complex scientific and regulatory documents for scientific accuracy, regulatory compliance, consistency, and overall quality.
  10. Lead, mentor, and provide substantive scientific and regulatory oversight to Principal and Senior Medical Writers; assign work appropriate to writer expertise and provide actionable feedback.
  11. Provide technical direction when project teams encounter complex scientific, regulatory, or writing issues.
  12. Serve as an escalation point for high-risk or technically complex projects.
  13. Work directly with client regulatory, clinical, biostatistics, safety, quality, and medical teams.
  14. Lead client discussions involving regulatory strategy, document development, review resolution, regulatory updates, and submission readiness.
  15. Translate regulatory changes into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal project teams.
  16. Support development and improvement of writing procedures, templates, training materials, and quality standards.
  17. Support business development activities by providing technical expertise during proposals, capability discussions, and prospective client meetings.
  18. Own or actively support writer allocation, capacity planning, project estimates, and identification of appropriate resources for pharmaceutical and medical device engagements.
  19. Maintain awareness of evolving medical device and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements and communicate relevant changes to clients and internal teams.

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:
  1. Bachelor's degree or higher in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline.
  2. 5+ years of medical device regulatory or clinical writing experience, including substantive CER authorship.
  3. 5+ years independently leading end-to-end CER projects, including substantial EU MDR CER work from 2019 to the present and direct experience resolving Notified Body questions.
  4. 8+ years of pharmaceutical or biologic regulatory medical writing experience, including substantial hands-on authorship and leadership of complex submission documents.
  5. Demonstrated end-to-end leadership of a significant pharmaceutical submission program or major clinical submission workstream, with personal authorship of major regulatory documents.
  6. Demonstrated experience working with eCTD-based pharmaceutical submissions.
  7. Experience substantially contributing to U.S. medical device regulatory submissions; direct 510(k) authorship is strongly preferred.
  8. Demonstrated experience developing regulatory strategies for medical device and/or pharmaceutical programs.
  9. Demonstrated ability to interpret regulatory updates and provide clear guidance to clients regarding resulting actions or documentation requirements.
  10. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex pharmaceutical medical writing projects and manage multidisciplinary review teams.
  11. Experience interacting directly with clients and senior stakeholders.
  12. Demonstrated ability to review and provide substantive scientific and regulatory feedback on the work of other senior medical writers.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 12+ years of total pharmaceutical, biologic, and medical device regulatory medical writing experience.
  2. Previous Director, Associate Director, Senior Manager, Principal Medical Writer, Regulatory Writing Lead, or comparable senior-level experience.
  3. Advanced scientific degree such as MS, PharmD, PhD, MD, or equivalent.
  4. Experience across both U.S. and EU regulatory environments.
  5. Experience with EU MDR remediation or transition projects.
  6. Experience responding directly to Notified Body questions.
  7. Experience leading NDA/BLA submission programs and integrated clinical submission workstreams.
  8. Experience with eCTD Modules 2 through 5.
  9. Experience leading multidisciplinary submission teams.
  10. Experience advising clients on evolving FDA, EU MDR, MDCG, ICH, or other regulatory requirements.
  11. Leadership experience in a medical writing consultancy or CRO supporting multiple external pharmaceutical clients.

jobs.description:
Liberia Country Coordinator Job Description

October 29, 2024

About SHE-CAN

SHE-CAN (an acronym for Supporting Her Education Changes A Nation) is a global non-profit organization located in San Francisco, California USA, that builds female global leadership in post-conflict countries – Rwanda, Cambodia, Liberia and Guatemala. We help passionate young leaders win scholarships to U.S. colleges and universities, provide leadership training, and pair them with U.S. mentor teams who help them thrive in college and launch change-agent careers at home. To date, we have helped 119 young women from Rwanda, Cambodia, Liberia, and Guatemala win $37M+ in full scholarships at top U.S. colleges.

We have operated in Liberia since 2018 and have supported 26 Liberian women in winning U.S. college scholarships. We are officially partnered with the Angie Brooks International Centre and work closely with SMART Liberia, among other organizations.

Overview of the Role

We are seeking a Country Coordinator for our Liberia program. We are interested in either an organization or an individual. This organization or individual will be designated as SHE-CAN’s representative in Liberia and will act as our liaison on-the-ground in Liberia with our scholars, our Liberian partners, and in growing our connections in Liberia.

Main Responsibilities

  1. Support Scholars: Act as our local liaison to our 3-7 SHE-CAN scholars living in Liberia who are preparing to come to the U.S. by delivering cash, organizing small events and helping them with issues as they arise.

  2. Support Scholar Application Outreach: Support outreach for recruiting new SHE-CAN candidates and working with our U.S. staff when we are visiting Liberia in January of each year to interview new scholar candidates.

  3. Grow Our Network: Help us grow our network of leaders, ministries, organizations and companies that are interested in hiring our graduates.

Qualifications

  • Well-networked in Monrovia to leaders, companies, ministries and organizations

  • Has experience successfully implementing and organizing programs

  • College degree and at least 5 years of work experience for the individual or organization’s key representative

  • If candidate represents an organization, they will ideally have a staff that can be a back-up for the key representative and provide more support when needed

  • We will prioritize organizations and candidates passionate about, and with experience in, building women leaders in Liberia

Specifications of the Position

The SHE-CAN Liberian Coordinator role is a part-time position that requires approximately 10 hours a month. This position can be handled by an individual on weekends and evenings while working in another full-time position. Or the role can be integrated into the on-going work of an established and reputable organization. Yearly salary range is between $2K and $3K depending on experience and resources. The position requires a computer and solid internet connection.

How to Apply

To apply both individuals and organizations should send a resume and cover letter of the applicant or key leader to Apply Here. Organizations should also provide an on-line link to background on the organization.

jobs.excerpt: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage.
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role

As our first EMEA Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent, you will create, deploy and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers. This highly cross-functional and customer-facing role blends product thinking, a nose for value, and project leadership with senior customer executives. At the end of the day, you own each AI Agent and the outcomes they drive for our customers, and you take that personally. You are a creative, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, rolls up your sleeves to build, and excels at turning ambiguity into execution.

In this role, you’ll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will support the build, integrations and optimization to make each AI Agent successful. You’ll also work closely with product and engineering, providing a tight feedback loop and custom tooling that will shape the future of our platform. As the first hire in EMEA, you’ll also play a key role in setting the standards for the role in the EMEA region and helping to grow the team as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own AI Agent outcomes for our customers — defining and delivering on the metrics that move the needle. This includes finding additional automation opportunities that can provide even more value! To do this, you’ll…
  • Own the deployment lifecycle for AI Agents — from scoping and kickoff to launch and post-go-live optimization
  • Design, build, test and iterate on AI agents in partnership with FDEs using Cresta’s internal tools and the latest technologies to deliver the highest customer ROI
  • Serve as the AI Agent SME for the EMEA Sales cycle, partnering on demos, solutioning, and deal reviews to ensure technical feasibility, value articulation, and successful handoff to deployment.
  • Lead customer relationships and act as the primary point of contact for AI Agent. Help customers move faster to ensure we can deliver quickly and effectively.
  • Facilitate workshops and design sessions with customer stakeholders to align on agent use cases, workflows, and success criteria
  • Work closely with FDEs to ensure smooth implementation, build new capabilities as needed and provide feedback and improvements to our broader platform
  • Improve our playbooks for agent development and customer deployment
  • Build our forward deployed practice for EMEA, setting the standards for future growth

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Technology Consulting, Implementations, Product, or Customer Success roles, ideally working closely with AI or LLM first products
  • Hands-on work style – curiosity with a bias for action. You anticipate needs and bottlenecks and deliver with urgency and care.
  • Experience leading complex deployments, owning customer relationships (including senior customer stakeholders), and working cross-functionally
  • Strong technical understanding, systems thinking and exposure to building Agents (not necessarily conversational, personal projects count!)
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and learning quickly in a dynamic startup environment
  • Passion for AI, automation, and shaping the future of customer experience

Bonus Points

  • Background in product management, conversation design or forward deployed engineering roles
  • Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Familiarity with customer support and contact center operations

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • 20 days of vacation time

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

jobs.title: Senior Associate – Digital Marketing & Communications
jobs.excerpt: About Us:Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit that advances access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit that advances access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers. We believe a truly good job is more than wages — it creates conditions for workers to thrive. Yet too few workers have access to sustained wage growth, supportive workplaces, and real opportunities for advancement. GBL works to change this by expanding pathways into better-fit, higher-opportunity work and improving job quality within large employers. We study worker needs, partner with workers and employers to co-design interventions that serve both individual and business goals, and evaluate impact through causal methods. Across manufacturing, retail, and food service, our work shows that improving job quality also improves firm performance. Globally, we have directly improved outcomes for over 500,000 workers, with indirect reach across an ecosystem impacting nearly 2 million more.

The founders of the GBL are Ach Adhvaryu – Professor of Economics, Director of 21st Century India Center, School of Global Policy and Strategy at UC San Diego, Anant Ahuja – Director of ESG and Sustainability at Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd. (India’s largest Ready Made Garment firm), and Anant Nyshadham – Associate Professor of Business Economics and Public Policy at the University of Michigan.

About the role

The Senior Associate – Digital Marketing & Communications will be the primary operational owner of GBL’s website and digital marketing systems. The role will ensure that GBL’s research, solutions, insights, and organisational story are presented through accurate, accessible, engaging, and measurable digital experiences. You will combine hands-on website management with SEO, analytics, digital campaigns, technical support for events, vendor coordination, and cross-functional project management. You will work closely with colleagues across Marketing & Communications, Growth, Research, Programmes, and Design to convert organisational priorities into effective digital journeys and audience-facing outputs. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of content, technology, design, and strategy and is equally comfortable making website updates, interpreting performance data, and coordinating specialists for more complex work.

We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to historically underrepresented and marginalized communities. If comfortable, please share your social location in your application. This information will be limited to the hiring team and will not have any detrimental impact on your candidature.

Location: Delhi/Bangalore/Remote

Compensation: 10-12 LPA

Type of Engagement: Full Time

Roles and Responsibilities:

Website ownership and digital experience

  • Own day-to-day management of GBL’s website and related digital properties.
  • Maintain a website roadmap covering content updates, technical fixes, feature improvements, and strategic development.
  • Manage CMS and no-code updates for blogs, case studies, reports, team profiles, landing pages, forms, and other institutional content.
  • Build and maintain reusable page templates and components using Framer or comparable platforms.
  • Conduct regular quality checks across desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences, including links, forms, responsiveness, interactions, and page consistency.
  • Identify and prioritise bugs or technical debt; resolve issues directly where possible and coordinate developers or vendors where specialist support is required.

SEO, analytics, and digital performance

  • Lead on-page SEO, including metadata, internal linking, page structure, sitemaps, indexing hygiene, and content optimisation.
  • Monitor traffic, acquisition, engagement, conversions, and priority-page performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity, Looker Studio, or comparable tools.
  • Develop recurring performance reports with clear insights, recommendations, and experiments.
  • Maintain UTM, attribution, and conversion-tracking practices across social media, email, paid campaigns, and partner links.
  • Use performance data and user feedback to recommend improvements to content, website architecture, and digital campaigns.

Digital campaigns and content operations

  • Support integrated digital campaigns across the website, social media, email, and paid channels.
  • Work with content and design colleagues to adapt research, reports, and organisational updates into effective digital formats.
  • Support the execution of the editorial calendar and coordinate copy, design, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing workflows for digital marketing channels.
  • Build reusable campaign templates, checklists, content banks, and workflows that improve consistency and reduce last-minute production.
  • Support paid-media activity on platforms such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Business Manager, including setup, tracking, budget monitoring, and reporting.

Digital and technical support for events

  • Build and maintain event landing pages or microsites, registration and waitlist forms, confirmation flows, and related website components.
  • Set up tracking, integrations, and analytics for event registrations and digital campaigns.
  • Coordinate with vendors or internal teams to troubleshoot forms, embeds, links, livestreams, and other technical requirements.
  • Conduct pre-launch quality assurance and post-event updates or archiving for digital event assets.

Project, vendor, and systems management

  • Convert broad objectives into project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, review points, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate trackers and communicate timelines, blockers, risks, and trade-offs early.
  • Brief and coordinate website, design, development, analytics, or other specialist partners as required.
  • Translate internal requirements into clear scopes, acceptance criteria, and consolidated feedback; conduct final quality assurance before sign-off.
  • Maintain SOPs, templates, checklists, screen-recorded walkthroughs, and onboarding resources for recurring digital tasks.
  • Keep an updated register of digital tools, owners, access routes, use cases, renewal needs, and costs.

Who are you?

Required technical skills and experience

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, website management, integrated communications, growth marketing, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience managing a CMS or no-code website platform; experience with Framer, Webflow, WordPress, or comparable tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, UTMs, conversion tracking, and digital-performance reporting.
  • Experience supporting digital campaigns across website, social media, email, and/or paid media.
  • Ability to diagnose common website issues, manage responsive QA, and coordinate specialist technical support when required.

Required behavioural skills

  • Strong project-management and organisational skills, including managing dependencies and competing deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex information into practical briefs and audience-facing content.
  • Strong ownership, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams, manage external partners, communicate risks early, and work independently in a remote or hybrid environment.
  • Interest in GBL’s mission and commitment to communicating research and social impact responsibly.

We understand that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. So please avoid the confidence gap, if this role excites you, and go ahead and apply. You don’t have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

Additional Requirements: (If Any)

Good to have, but not essential:

  • Experience in a non-profit, research, social-impact, consulting, or project-based organisation.
  • Familiarity with paid-media, email-marketing, design, or collaboration tools such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Business Manager, Mailchimp, Figma, Miro, or Canva.
  • Basic understanding of domains, hosting, DNS, integrations, and website troubleshooting.
  • Experience with information architecture, digital publications, or data-led storytelling.

Recent projects and blog posts:

To acclimatize yourself with some of our work, you can explore our website where you’ll find project insights, podcasts and reports. You can also read our blog posts on Medium, and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter (X), and Instagram to learn more about our work.

Deadline to Apply: (If any/On rolling basis)

The process:

We are glad you’re interested in applying for this role! We deeply value your time and effort.

Our interview process for this role includes the following steps:

  1. Introductory Conversation
  2. Assignment
  3. First Round of Interview
  4. Second Round of Interview

Depending on the candidate pool, we may add any additional interviews to make a well thought through decision.

The hiring team will review your application after each round and share a timely update on your application status and keep you updated on your progression through the following stages.

Our commitment to diversity:

GBL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a young and growing company making us the ideal ground for team members to experiment, take on dynamic roles, and grow with us. We focus on happiness, output, and quality of work.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

Background Verification:

Employment with GBL is contingent upon satisfactory background verification. GBL reserves the right to withdraw the offer in the event of any adverse or unsatisfactory findings.

Salary: INR 10-12 LPA

jobs.description:
WSP is seeking EHV EPC Project Manager (Power Delivery)- Remote for our Power & Energy Program Management Office in Portland, OR. The following locations will also be considered: Los Angeles, CA, San Francisco, CA, San Diego, CA, Seattle, WA, Boise, ID, Helena, MT and Phoenix, AZ. In this position, you will be responsible for cradle-to-grave execution of high-voltage transmission EPC projects, from project development and design through construction, energization, and final closeout.

This Opportunity

This position provides high level technical project leadership, and guidance with managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of EHV Transmission and Substation project(s) or portfolio of projects in accordance with WSP’s core values, and the level of project services agreed upon in the contract by WSP and the client(s).

Responsible for the overall performance of assigned project(s) that are moderate and larger size/complexity and regional in scope, and includes oversight for financial, technical, client satisfaction, quality, safety, and schedule.

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, project startup and planning, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are adhered to, delivered, and audited with a level of quality that meets or exceeds acceptable corporate standards for safety, execution, profitability, and operational purpose.

Your Impact

  • Coordinate and communicate with all levels of management and disciplines throughout the project life cycle to support project cost and schedule objectives, both internally and within the client’s systems.
  • Lead the development of project proposals, cost estimates, scope, schedules, and resource plans
  • Oversee management of budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, cost and change management and control.
  • Provide regular project reporting and updates to clients, technical leads, and business leaders, identifying any emergent issues with scope, risk, and/or budget and mitigation strategies.
  • Be the face of WSP for the client. Develop and nurture strong, long-term relationships with client by understanding their needs, providing tailored solutions, and ensuring consistent communication to drive satisfaction and retention.
  • Adherence to proven processes and ability to develop new processes to standardize procedures.
  • Adhere to safety regulations and enforce project safety standards
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, Project Management or Construction Management), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C firm, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
  • 10+ years of relevant post education experience in a project management role within our industry.
  • 3+ years of EHV transmission level voltage project experience (115kV up to 500kV)
  • Cradle to grave EPC project management experience for transmission level voltage
  • Highly proficient understanding of project delivery process and strong background and experience in project management. Experience managing projects through a variety of delivery models (DBB, EPC, PDB).
  • Advanced proficiency with analytical and organizational skills, with business acumen to bridge the business and project management.
  • Advanced proficiency with interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and adjusting readily to the changing prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.
  • Works independently and provides guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
  • Advanced proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
  • Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including senior management, subcontractors, consultants, and company-wide staff, including those with whom no formal hierarchical relationship exits.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
  • Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet project-specific needs.
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Salary (all locations): $120,000 - $210,000

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

Vill du vara med och förändra vården?

Då vill vi prata med dig!

Om den digitala tjänsten

Hej! Jag heter Maria Lundqvist och är verksamhetschef på Kry Digital. Jag tror på en enkel sak: vården blir bättre när vi vågar göra den annorlunda. I vår digitala tjänst jobbar vi nära varandra med hjälp av våra digitala verktyg. Det är lika självklart att be om hjälp som att komma med en ny idé. Vi är ett team på 140 medarbetare som delar samma övertygelse – att hög tillgänglighet, ny teknik och ett genuint fokus på kvalitet och patientnöjdhet inte är motsatser. Det bevisar vi varje dag.

Varför Kry?
Vi har förändrat hur vård bedrivs i Sverige i över tio år. Gjort den digital, tillgänglig och mer jämlik. Men vi är inte klara och det är poängen.På Kry tror vi att det modigaste du kan göra i vårdbranschen är att vara snäll. Och att de som kan vården ska styra den. Hos oss får du mandat att göra det - ta det, be inte om det.

Vad du faktiskt gör

Du genomför digitala konsultationer via vår plattform och du gör det på ett sätt som får barnpatienter att känna sig sedda. Du kan även komma att avlasta våra vårdcentraler digitalt och journalföra i regionala system. Arbetet är brett. Du utreder, bedömer och behandlar barn upp till 18 år: akuta bedömningar, långsiktig uppföljning, digitalt och fysiskt. Du samarbetar nära vårdcentralerna och övriga vårdflöden. Vi tror inte att digital och fysisk vård är varandras motpoler. De är varandras förutsättningar. Dina erfarenheter är med och formar hur vi arbetar, idag och framåt. Det kallar vi Kry-modellen.Läs mer om den här.

Goodwall

Goodwall ( is a TIME100 award-winning social education app, empowering over 4 million youth with skills in AI, climate, and entrepreneurship through impactful experiential learning.

We deliver meaningful, authentic brand value to our partners by serving as the trusted bridge connecting Gen Z & Alpha with Fortune 500 companies, governments, and international organisations, including Microsoft, Accenture, HP and UNICEF. Goodwall co-builds engaging experiential learning campaigns for the next generation to help young people across the globe gain the confidence, skills, and networks to achieve better livelihoods.

Backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognised as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes.

About the Role

We are looking for a Strategic Partnerships Director to help take Goodwall into its next stage of growth. This is a big role in a small team: you’ll be responsible for winning new partnerships, growing relationships with major organisations, and turning ambitious ideas into high-value programs that deliver real impact for young people.

You’ll have a multi-million-dollar revenue target across multiple 6-7 figure partnerships, and will be expected to build a significant part of your own pipeline. You’ll work with senior leaders across global companies, Fortune 500 corporates, foundations and public sector organisations - opening doors, building trust, shaping opportunities and getting contracts over the line.

But this isn’t a role where you’ll be selling a fixed product from a playbook. Goodwall is evolving quickly, and our best partnerships are built around what our partners are trying to achieve. You’ll listen, spot the opportunity, bring the right people together and work with the team to create something bespoke that works for everyone.

You’ll have a lot of autonomy. We’re a lean team, so you’ll have real influence over how we sell, who we build relationships with and where we focus. If you see a better way of doing something, we expect you to run with it. This is not a typical 9-5 role, and we trust you to manage your time around your partnerships.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and close big opportunities: Own a multi-million-dollar target, create your own pipeline and turn conversations into significant new partnerships.

  • Open doors: Use your network, our existing relationships and smart outreach to build relationships with the people who can make things happen.

  • Build great partnerships: Understand what organisations care about and find the intersection between their goals and what Goodwall can deliver.

  • Grow what’s working: Develop existing partnerships, find new opportunities within them and build relationships that last.

  • Bring ideas to life: Work closely with our programs, product and leadership teams to shape compelling proposals and partnerships.

  • Own the full journey: From the first conversation through to proposal, negotiation and close, you’ll take ownership and keep things moving.

  • Help shape how we grow: We’re still building our approach to partnerships. You’ll have a voice in where we focus, how we sell and how we build a high-performing partnerships team.

Why Goodwall?

  • Above-market compensation package that rewards performance

  • The chance to work on strategic 6-7 figure partnerships with some of the world’s biggest organisations

  • A genuinely global role, meeting and working across markets and with a global youth community

  • A small, ambitious team where you can shape the strategy, not just execute it

  • Real ownership, autonomy and room to grow

  • Flexibility on working environment

  • And most importantly, a mission you can be proud of - helping millions of young people build skills, access opportunity and shape their futures

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 10+ years experience in enterprise sales, partnerships or business development, ideally selling into corporate CSR, sustainability, HR/talent or foundation budgets, in youth, skills, workforce development, edtech or social impact. Strong sellers from adjacent spaces (fintech, HR-tech, digital health) who have sold "soft" outcomes to hard enterprise buyers are also a fit.

  • You’re naturally commercial, but you’re also curious and creative — you know that the best opportunities often start with a conversation rather than a pitch.

  • You’re confidentbuildingrelationships with senior decision-makers and equally comfortable getting into the details with the people who will actually make things happen.

  • You can take an idea from “this could be interesting” to a signed contract — including shaping the proposal, numbers and business case.

  • You’re highly self-directed. You don’t need a big team or lots of processes around you to get things done.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity, move quickly and enjoy figuring things out as you go.

  • Most importantly, you want ownership.

Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership

About Ascend

Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.

We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.

Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.

As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

  • Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,
  • Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders
  • Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception
  • Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations

  • Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities
  • Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client
  • Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need
  • Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences

  • Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up
  • Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment
  • Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations
  • Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence

  • Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team
  • Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively
  • Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation
  • Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend

  • Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale
  • Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations
  • Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset
  • 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines
  • Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work
  • A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership
  • Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

  • Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs
  • Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms
  • A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs
  • Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones
  • Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.

What Makes You Stand Out

We are especially interested in candidates who:

  • Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove
  • Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them
  • Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client
  • Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium
  • Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path

The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain

We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

  • We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers
  • Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback
  • A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you
  • A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance

  • Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance
  • Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late
  • A global team with talented colleagues across continents
  • Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead

  • Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry
  • How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations
  • Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.

Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

  • Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win
  • Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours
  • Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust
  • Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it
  • Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?

If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:

  • Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?
  • Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?
  • Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?
  • Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role

This is perfect for someone who:

  • Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders
  • Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership
  • Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow
  • Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices
  • Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, and Benefits

Ascend is a remote-first, global team. This role is structured as a direct independent contractor engagement, with compensation being stated in USD and be paid in your local currency

As this is an independent contractor engagement, the compensation will not follow a traditional local payroll structure or salary breakup. This means statutory deductions or components or other local payroll-linked benefits are not applicable unless specifically required under the terms of engagement or communicated in writing by Ascend. Contractors are responsible for managing any applicable taxes, filings, and compliance requirements in their own location.

This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends, or public holidays depending on business and team scheduling needs. jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
jobs.excerpt: Company Overviewhermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

As a Quantitative Researcher at hermeneutic research, you will develop and improve systematic trading strategies across digital asset markets.

You will work across the full research lifecycle: identifying market inefficiencies, developing hypotheses, analyzing large-scale market data, building predictive signals and trading models, designing robust backtests, and helping to monetise successful research and improve firm-wide execution quality.

This role will be grounded in real market behavior and production trading data. You will work extensively with tick market data, order book and trade data, execution data, and portfolio-level performance to identify market inefficiencies, test hypotheses, and determine whether observed patterns are robust and tradable.

You will join a team with high-frequency/systematic trading and market making background, whose strategies that naturally enable improvement of firm-wide execution quality. You will collaborate closely with traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers while retaining significant ownership of your own research. Successful researchers are expected not only to develop sophisticated models, but also to identify the questions that matter, design rigorous experiments, challenge assumptions, and translate findings into economically meaningful improvements to live trading.

This is an opportunity for a strong quantitative researcher to work in a highly collaborative environment with access to substantial data, technology and trading infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, develop and optimize systematic trading strategies and signals across digital asset markets.
  • Analyze high-frequency market data, including trades, order books, derivatives data, and cross-venue market activity, to identify exploitable market structure and behavioral patterns.
  • Formulate research hypotheses and design statistically rigorous experiments to evaluate them.
  • Build robust backtesting and simulation frameworks while carefully accounting for transaction costs, market impact, latency, liquidity, and other real-world trading constraints.
  • Research market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, price formation, execution behavior, and short-horizon alpha.
  • Develop quantitative models for signal generation, execution, portfolio construction, and risk management.
  • Evaluate existing strategies and identify opportunities to improve alpha, execution quality and robustness.
  • Work closely with engineers to translate successful research into reliable production trading systems.
  • Monitor live strategy performance and investigate discrepancies between research, simulation, and production results.
  • Continuously improve research methodologies, datasets, tooling, and experimental standards across the quantitative research process.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • A degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Finance, or another highly quantitative field.
  • Strong quantitative and statistical reasoning, with the ability to translate ambiguous market questions into testable hypotheses.
  • Strong programming ability, particularly in Python, with experience analyzing large datasets and building quantitative research pipelines.
  • Experience conducting empirical research using financial, market, or similarly noisy real-world datasets.
  • Strong understanding of probability, statistics, time-series analysis, and quantitative modeling.
  • Ability to distinguish statistically interesting results from economically meaningful and tradable opportunities.
  • Strong attention to research methodology, including robustness testing, avoiding look-ahead bias and overfitting, and correctly evaluating out-of-sample performance.
  • Intellectual curiosity and the ability to independently investigate complex problems while collaborating effectively with others.
  • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to clearly explain research methodology, results, limitations, and implications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in quantitative trading, systematic investing, market making, or high-frequency trading.
  • Experience researching market microstructure, execution, order books, transaction costs, or short-horizon price dynamics.
  • Experience working with tick-level or high-frequency financial data.
  • Familiarity with digital asset markets, derivatives, perpetual futures, and fragmented multi-venue market structure.
  • Experience developing signals or strategies that have been deployed into live trading.
  • Experience with machine learning methods applied to financial markets.

Interview Process

  1. CV and Research Experience Screening – We will review your academic background, quantitative experience, and evidence of strong empirical research ability.
  2. HR Interview – If further clarification is needed, a brief call may be scheduled to better understand your background and motivations.
  3. Quantitative Research Interview – A discussion focused on probability, statistics, markets, research methodology, and how you approach open-ended quantitative problems.
  4. Research Case Study / Technical Interview – A practical exercise designed to assess your ability to analyze data, formulate hypotheses, evaluate evidence, and communicate conclusions.
  5. Final Interview – A concluding discussion to assess your research judgment, intellectual curiosity, strategic thinking, and cultural fit.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company's goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn't just what they know—it's how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $45–$160 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if your clinical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand complex medical information, evaluate healthcare scenarios, and deliver more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we’re connecting experienced healthcare professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We’re seeking physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants who can apply their clinical knowledge, independent judgment, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This isn’t a traditional healthcare position. You won’t be providing direct patient care or managing a caseload. Instead, you’ll assess complex medical scenarios, challenge inaccurate conclusions, identify gaps in reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your clinical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Healthcare SME, you’ll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized healthcare functions.

You’ll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established medical standards, clinical guidelines, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex healthcare challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

1. General Practice

Physicians experienced in primary care, diagnostic assessment, preventive medicine, management of common medical conditions, and evidence-based clinical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Physicians with expertise in comprehensive primary care, acute and chronic disease management, differential diagnosis, and patient care across different age groups.

3. Internal Medicine

Physicians experienced in adult medicine, complex medical conditions, diagnostic interpretation, multisystem disease management, and evidence-based treatment decisions.

4. Nurse Practitioners (NPs)

Advanced-practice nursing professionals with experience in clinical assessment, diagnostic reasoning, treatment planning, patient management, and healthcare quality standards within their professional scope.

5. Physician Assistants / Physician Associates (PAs)

Qualified clinical professionals with experience in patient assessment, diagnostic evaluation, treatment planning, and interpretation of medical findings within their professional scope.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated medical content: Assess responses for clinical accuracy, completeness, relevance, and consistency with accepted medical standards.
  • Analyze clinical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment recommendations are supported by appropriate clinical evidence.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate medical information, unsupported conclusions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns.
  • Validate medical information: Reference authoritative medical literature, established clinical guidelines, and evidence-based healthcare practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend clinically appropriate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply established evaluation guidelines, scoring criteria, and project-specific quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Clinical Expertise in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and professional judgment you've developed throughout your career to contribute to advanced AI technology without providing direct patient care.

Help Improve AI Accuracy and Reliability

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more accurate, clinically informed AI systems.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project-based assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads determined by project needs.

Explore the Future of Healthcare Technology

Gain experience contributing to advanced AI model evaluation while applying the professional expertise you already possess.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for strong clinical professionals who can recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify mistakes, and explain their assessments using sound professional judgment.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on clinical specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements. See rates per expertise:

General Practice Physician: $75–$130

Family Medicine Physician: $85–$145

Internal Medicine Physician: $95–$160

Nurse Practitioner: $45–$85

Physician Assistant: $45–$85

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States
  • Additional Markets: United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete a skills-based clinical evaluation assessment before selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Medical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced healthcare professional who enjoys analyzing complex medical information, applying evidence-based clinical judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We’re seeking experienced healthcare professionals who bring more than familiarity with clinical practice. You should be comfortable analyzing complex medical information, exercising independent clinical judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of three years of relevant professional clinical experience in an applicable specialty.
  • Recognized medical degree, advanced-practice qualification, or equivalent professional credential appropriate to the specialty and country.
  • Demonstrated experience applying clinical judgment, diagnostic reasoning, or evidence-based medical practices.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, clinical guidelines, and healthcare standards relevant to the candidate's specialization.
  • Ability to critically evaluate complex medical information and distinguish accurate clinical reasoning from unsupported conclusions.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written English communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain clinical findings and professional assessments.
  • Comfort using digital platforms, web-based applications, and online research tools.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet established quality standards.
  • Must be comfortable and understand this is a task-based role.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Current or previous professional licensure or registration relevant to the candidate's specialty.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical research, medical guidelines, or healthcare quality assessments.
  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare standards or clinical practices in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand.
  • Experience evaluating clinical documentation, medical literature, or complex healthcare cases.
  • Previous exposure to AI model evaluation, medical content review, clinical research, or healthcare technology.

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

jobs.description:
Business Operations & AI Transformation Lead

Own the changes that make a growing healthcare business run better—from identifying workflow bottlenecks to implementing AI-enabled solutions and helping teams adopt them.

Join a rapidly growing healthcare technology company transforming how health plans engage members and deliver essential healthcare services. In this role, you’ll work across operations, clinical services, scheduling, provider management, finance, and customer success to understand how work gets done, uncover inefficiencies, and implement smarter ways of operating.

This is not a traditional project management or strategy role. You’ll be expected to ask sharp questions, map real workflows, identify what is slowing teams down, and take ownership of practical improvements using data, automation, AI tools, and strong business judgment.

Role Details

  • Location: Remote, United States
  • Compensation: $110,000–$150,000 yearly, with flexibility for the right candidate
  • Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience
  • English proficiency: C1-level English required

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with department leaders and frontline teams to understand existing workflows, operational challenges, and business priorities.
  • Map how work actually gets done, identify bottlenecks, and redesign processes to improve productivity, accuracy, speed, and outcomes.
  • Identify practical opportunities to use AI, automation, low-code tools, workflow software, and modern productivity platforms across business operations.
  • Prototype lightweight solutions independently using AI-assisted development tools, low-code platforms, spreadsheets, dashboards, and workflow automation software.
  • Partner with engineering, data, and technology teams on more sophisticated solutions when needed.
  • Analyze operational data to uncover performance gaps, define KPIs, and quantify the impact of process improvements.
  • Build practical dashboards, reporting tools, performance scorecards, lightweight documentation, operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Own improvement initiatives from discovery through implementation, adoption, measurement, and ongoing optimization.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in business operations, management consulting, business analytics, operational excellence, or technology-driven process improvement.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Experience analyzing, redesigning, and optimizing business processes.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies.
  • Comfort with spreadsheets, data analysis, dashboards, and modern productivity and automation tools.
  • Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar business processes and identify meaningful improvement opportunities.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with department leaders and frontline employees.
  • High ownership, resourcefulness, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward execution.

Preferred, But Not Required

  • Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, or operationally intensive service businesses.
  • Background in management consulting, high-growth startups, or business transformation.
  • Familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Zapier, Make, n8n, Claude Code, or similar tools.
  • Experience building lightweight internal tools or implementing workflow automation.

Examples of Projects You Might Own

  • Redesign appointment scheduling workflows to improve member engagement and visit completion rates.
  • Improve call center productivity through AI-assisted workflows and automation.
  • Analyze provider utilization and build processes that increase completed visits per clinician.
  • Automate manual reporting, reconciliation, or administrative processes.
  • Build operational dashboards that surface bottlenecks and help managers make faster decisions.
  • Streamline customer onboarding, internal handoffs, and cross-departmental workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a strong understanding of several core business functions, identified and prioritized a pipeline of high-impact improvement opportunities, independently implemented measurable process improvements, collaborated with technical teams on at least one meaningful AI-enabled or automated workflow, and established clear metrics showing improvements in efficiency, accuracy, speed, or cost.

Success is measured by real-world business impact — not the number of analyses, presentations, or recommendations produced.

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.
