jobs.excerpt: Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel LeadershipAbout AscendAscend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site.
jobs.description:
Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership

About Ascend

Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.

We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.

Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.

As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

  • Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,
  • Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders
  • Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception
  • Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations

  • Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities
  • Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client
  • Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need
  • Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences

  • Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up
  • Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment
  • Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations
  • Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence

  • Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team
  • Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively
  • Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation
  • Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend

  • Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale
  • Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations
  • Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset
  • 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines
  • Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work
  • A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership
  • Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

  • Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs
  • Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms
  • A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs
  • Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones
  • Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.

What Makes You Stand Out

We are especially interested in candidates who:

  • Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove
  • Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them
  • Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client
  • Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium
  • Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path

The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain

We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

  • We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers
  • Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback
  • A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you
  • A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance

  • Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance
  • Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late
  • A global team with talented colleagues across continents
  • Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead

  • Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry
  • How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations
  • Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.

Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

  • Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win
  • Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours
  • Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust
  • Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it
  • Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?

If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:

  • Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?
  • Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?
  • Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?

Overview

The Executive Medical Science Liaison will prioritize contacts with key opinion leaders (KOLs), healthcare providers, and clinical investigators within an assigned U.S. region, providing advanced scientific exchange and generating actionable insights.

This role serves as a field-based extension of the Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation (MA&EG) organization, requiring a highly experienced professional who operates with independence, accountability, and execution focus in a fast-paced, performance-driven biotech environment.

The Associate Director is expected to deliver complex, data-driven scientific discussions, synthesize meaningful insights from the field, and navigate real-world clinical dynamics while maintaining a strong focus on regional ownership and high-impact engagement.

Enhancing knowledge / scientific exchange:

Handles challenging or skeptical stakeholders with strong scientific rationale. Establishes credibility as a trusted scientific expert and resource internally and externally. Identifies trends in clinical practice, perceptions of data, and practical considerations influencing treatment decisions. Regional ownership / execution:

  • Operates with a high level of accountability in a lean, fast-paced environment. Maintains a consistent field presence with disciplined execution and adaptability to changing priorities.

Cross-functional engagement

  • Establishes and maintains strong working relationships with home-office stakeholders across MA&EG, including HEOR, PRO, and other functional partners.
  • Ensures appropriate involvement of internal stakeholders in KOL and external engagement activities, facilitating alignment between field insights and organizational priorities.
  • Supports the field-based needs of Commercial (Marketing, Field Sales) and Market Access teams through compliant, science-based engagement.

Data generation/R&D SupportActs as a key scientific liaison between the organization and clinical investigators and study sites, supporting site identification, engagement, and scientific exchange.

  • Scientific engagement support:Provides scientific support for congresses, advisory boards, and other relevant external engagements. Maintains awareness of scientific literature, emerging research, and competitive landscape.

Workstream leadership:

Experience elevation / team contribution:

  • Demonstrates senior field leadership by modeling best practices in scientific engagement, insight generation, and stakeholder management.
  • Provides onboarding, coaching, and informal mentorship to new and developing MSLs. Serves as a resource for complex or escalated field situations and contributes to overall team effectiveness.

Broader stakeholder engagement (as applicable):

  • Demonstrates awareness of factors influencing treatment decisions, including practice-level dynamics, access considerations, and healthcare delivery models.
  • May contribute to discussions where clinical evidence informs broader decision-making environments (e.g., payer-influenced or decision-support settings), while maintaining a primary focus on evidence-based scientific exchange and remaining within appropriate compliance boundaries.

Qualifications

  • Requires strong customer-facing, listening, and probing skills

jobs.excerpt: About RivetRivet is an AI-native accounting firm.
jobs.description:
About Rivet

Rivet is an AI-native accounting firm. In less than 3 years, we've built a T500 firm in the US, combining corporate and personal income tax, sales tax, R&D credits, and bookkeeping into a single, all-inclusive experience that eliminates the worst parts of tax season for real businesses and the people who run them.

Our platform is designed to feel invisible: it guides clients through their tax to-dos, automates the drudgery for preparers, and gets out of the way when it's not needed. We measure success in time saved and returns completed, not vanity usage metrics. We run Rivet (the firm) on Rivet (the platform) because owning the stack makes it possible to deeply embed AI into every step of our workflows, far more than our competition will ever be able to relying on third-party/off-the-shelf tooling.

Our team of 50 supports more than 1,300 clients, including some of the most innovative companies in the US — Cursor, Cognition, and ModRetro — and their executives, investors, and employees.

And while we may have just gotten started a little over two years ago, this isn't our first rodeo:

  • Nick Abouzeid (cofounder & CEO) comes from Ramp, where he ran three of their Growth teams from $100M → $600M in ARR

  • Kyle Christenson (cofounder & Head of Tax) comes from the IRS, where he spent six years as an auditor before leaving to start his own firm over a decade ago

We're well-funded, growing quickly, and sustainable. We've raised over $7M to date, from investors like XYZ Ventures, Susa Ventures, Haystack Ventures, and 40+ executives from Ramp, Anduril, Physical Intelligence, & more.

Why this role is different

We don't run an internship program. There's no cohort, no intern project graveyard, no summer showcase. We open this role when we meet someone we're excited to work with, and the work is the same work everyone else is doing.

That means a few things you should take literally:

  • You'll ship to production. Not a sandbox, not a prototype someone archives in September. Real users, real returns, real consequences.

  • Ownership from first commit to production. You design, build, ship, and maintain your work — with someone experienced sitting close, not reviewing from a distance.

  • Decisions happen at the edge. Engineers talk to clients and tax preparers directly. You will too.

  • Clear is kind. You'll get direct feedback early and often. We're kind by being honest, not by being vague.

  • We're hiring you for slope, not credentials. What you've built on your own matters more than where you're enrolled.

Our stack

Six engineers today, five languages. You'd work across the first two:

  • Platform: Go, as a modular monolith — Connect RPC over protobuf, Go Fx for wiring, sqlc and goose against Postgres, River Pro for background jobs, Watermill for pub-sub over RabbitMQ.

  • Frontend: React and TanStack, deployed to Cloudflare Workers.

  • AI and eval: Python, in their own repos — ModelBridge (a gRPC service for AI building blocks) and TaxBench, our internal eval suite.

  • Legacy integration: a C# Windows agent that drives Drake, one of the tax platforms our industry never built APIs for.

  • Infrastructure: AWS — ECS Fargate, Amazon MQ, AMP, Loki, Tempo — provisioned by Pulumi, itself written in Go.

  • Around the edges: Buildkite for CI, OpenTelemetry throughout, Doppler for secrets, Linear for tracking.

What you'll do

  • Own a scoped feature end to end — Postgres schema, Go service, protobuf contract, React screen. Scoped so you can finish it, not so it doesn't matter.

  • Pair with the engineer who owns that module. You'll have a named mentor from day one and a standing weekly with them.

  • Work on the automation problems. Our industry never built APIs. Parsing filings that arrive as scanned paper and reconciling ledgers that disagree with each other is most of the interesting work here, and plenty of it is well-scoped.

  • Talk to accountants every day. They're on Slack, they'll tell you exactly what's broken, and they're the reason the thing you build matters.

  • Ask questions in public. We'd rather you ask in a channel than spend two days stuck.

We're fully distributed.

What makes you a fit

  • You've built things outside of coursework — side projects, open source, a company, something you shipped because you wanted it to exist

  • Working knowledge of at least one of Go or React, and real interest in the other

  • You can read unfamiliar code and make progress without a tutorial

  • You write clearly. Remote and asynchronous means most of the job is writing

  • You want feedback and do something with it

  • Enrolled in or recently out of a degree program, or self-taught and at an equivalent point

Nice to haves

  • Postgres beyond an ORM

  • Any exposure to protobuf, gRPC, or typed API clients

  • You've used LLMs to build something real, and have opinions about where they fail

  • Curiosity about tax, accounting, or other domains where a wrong number has consequences

What we offer

  • Paid

  • A named mentor, a real project, and a direct line to the CEO

  • A fully remote team, plus twice-yearly company offsites

  • A well-funded, fast-moving environment with minimal layers of management

  • An honest conversation about a full-time offer at the end, in either direction - we've brought on our first two interns full-time (even while they wrapped up school) in the last 2.5 years

We open this role rarely and only for people we're excited to mentor. If that sounds like a reason not to apply, apply anyway.

jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.

Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams. In partnership with Deel’s recruitment platform, we are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant based in LATAM for a remote Contractor of Record (COR) or Employer of Record (EOR) engagement. Candidates must be available to work during EST or CST business hours.

Position Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

  • Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.
  • Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.
  • Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.
  • Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide advanced functional support for core Dynamics GP modules, including Financial Management, Distribution, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales Order Processing, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and Field Service.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, transactional, and configuration issues.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, posting errors, reconciliation issues, workflow challenges, and integration-related concerns.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes.
  • Coordinate with technical consultants and developers as needed to identify and resolve system issues.

Business Process Optimization

  • Evaluate existing client processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Configure Dynamics GP to support evolving business requirements.
  • Support workflow automation, approval processes, and operational efficiencies.
  • Help clients improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and system adoption.
  • Assist with documenting business processes and future-state recommendations.

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

  • Support and troubleshoot third-party applications commonly integrated with Dynamics GP, including SalesPad and other ISV solutions.
  • Assist with integration troubleshooting between Dynamics GP and external business systems.
  • Advise clients on configuration options, process impacts, and best practices when utilizing integrated applications.
  • Coordinate with software vendors and client stakeholders as needed to resolve issues and implement agreed enhancements.

Training, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions for clients.
  • Create and maintain functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document solutions, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Provide functional guidance and knowledge sharing with other consultants as appropriate.
  • Identify recurrent issues and recommend long-term corrective measures.

Required Skills

  • Deep functional knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics GP.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and data integrity.
  • Ability to understand and improve business processes through technology solutions.
  • Excellent client relationship management and consulting skills.
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements simultaneously.
  • Experience working within a managed services, consulting, or support environment.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Desired Skills

  • Bilingual in English and French.
  • Experience with SmartConnect and Dynamics GP integrations.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server and Dynamics GP reporting tools.
  • Previous experience in a Microsoft partner or consulting environment.

About Us

Endeavour Solutions is a top Microsoft Partner for ERP, CRM, and AI Cloud Business Applications, providing SMB, mid-market, and corporate clients with advisory services, implementation and training, and ongoing support for their Microsoft Business Applications. Key focus areas include Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Business Central, and Dynamics GP, supporting clients across the United States and Canada.

With offices coast-to-coast across Canada and the United States, Endeavour Solutions works with over 1,100 active clients spanning each of the major time zones across North America. Founded in 1989, Endeavour operates several key brands, including Endeavour Solutions, GP Support North, and Purely CRM.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $4,000–$4,200 USD per month, depending on years of comparable experience, skill set, and the unique value you bring.
  • Candidates must reside in a LATAM country and be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.

Accessibility & Inclusion

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Lending Operations Quality Control team plays a critical role in protecting customers, strengthening operational processes, and supporting regulatory compliance across our lending lifecycle. As a first-line-of-defense function, the team evaluates frontline activities across Onboarding, Servicing, Complaints, and Collections to identify risks, improve quality, and support bank readiness.

As the Senior Operations Manager, Quality Control at Upstart, you will lead a team of five quality control professionals and help build and execute a scalable, risk-based quality control program. You’ll combine hands-on program development with people leadership, partnering across Operations, Compliance, and Risk to strengthen testing methodologies, address control gaps, and explore opportunities to improve oversight through automation and AI.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of quality control professionals, establishing clear performance expectations, consistent calibration practices, and effective testing execution.
  • Build and enhance the quality control program, including risk-based testing plans, standardized review criteria, statistically sound sampling methodologies, and documentation that supports regulatory and audit readiness.
  • Oversee frontline quality reviews, including call monitoring, agent interactions, and adherence to operational procedures, to identify regulatory risks, process defects, and potential customer impact.
  • Partner with operational leaders, Compliance, and Risk to communicate findings, identify root causes, recommend process improvements, and monitor remediation through resolution.
  • Establish reporting and performance metrics that highlight quality trends, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and customer outcomes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to evaluate AI-enabled testing and automation capabilities, improving review coverage and efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and controls.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in consumer lending operations, quality control, compliance testing, or operational risk within a regulated financial services environment.
  • Experience directly managing quality control, quality assurance, or compliance testing teams within a regulated environment.
  • Experience developing, implementing, or managing frontline operational quality control programs, including call monitoring, agent interaction reviews, or evaluations of agent adherence to established procedures.
  • Experience designing or executing sampling methodologies, standardized testing criteria, and documented quality assessments.
  • Experience managing quality findings, root-cause analysis, corrective action tracking, or remediation monitoring within a regulated environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of consumer financial protection regulations, including UDAAP, TILA, ECOA, FCRA, FDCPA, and GLBA, and their application to lending operations.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-enabled quality assurance tools, speech analytics, or automated compliance monitoring solutions.
  • Experience supporting bank partner oversight, regulatory examinations, or internal and external audits.
  • Ability to collaborate across Operations, Compliance, Risk, and technical teams to translate quality findings into sustainable process improvements.
  • Experience working in a fintech or evolving financial services environment, with the ability to balance regulatory expectations, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time zone requirements The team operates on the East coast time zones.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$104,800—$145,000 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)

  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements

  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – Dashboard

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

The Caliza dashboard is where our customers see and control money moving across rails, currencies and countries. When a payment is in flight, a balance changes, or a compliance check is pending, the dashboard has to show it accurately and immediately, even across thousands of transactions.

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on the dashboard, you'll own features end to end, including transaction and settlement views, balances across currencies, search and filtering, exports and reporting, and the permissions that control who sees and does what. You'll work closely with design, product, back-end and compliance.

Location: Remote, open to candidates based in Latin America. Professional English required.

In your first six months, you'll

  • Design and build the real-time dashboard experience, so customers see payment and balance changes as they happen.

  • Make large transaction tables fast and usable, with solid filtering, search and export.

  • Improve how we show payment and settlement state, so users always know where money is and what happens next.

  • Strengthen our shared component library and set front-end conventions for testing, performance and accessibility.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain the dashboard in TypeScript and React.

  • Design data-dense interfaces: tables, detail views, charts and reports.

  • Integrate with back-end APIs, handling the loading, error and edge-case states that matter when money is involved.

  • Contribute to our back-end services in Kotlin and Spring Boot when a feature needs it, such as adding or changing the APIs the dashboard depends on.

  • Implement role-based access so each user sees exactly what they should.

  • Own performance, from rendering large data sets to efficient data fetching.

  • Write meaningful automated tests and review your teammates' code.

  • Work with product and design from early concept through launch.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

  • Deep expertise in TypeScript and React.

  • Experience with data fetching, caching and state management tools such as Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query.

  • Experience building real-time interfaces (websockets, live updates).

  • Comfort working across the stack: you're happy to make back-end changes when a feature needs them.

  • Experience building data-heavy applications such as dashboards, admin tools or analytics products.

  • Strong product sense: you care about building rich, highly usable interfaces, not just shipping tickets.

  • A strong grasp of front-end security: handling sensitive data, XSS/CSRF protection, and secure authentication flows.

  • Real experience writing automated tests and caring about test quality.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development in your daily work, with the judgment to review and question what the tools produce.

  • Solid understanding of performance and accessibility (WCAG).

  • Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

  • Clear written communication. Most of our collaboration is async.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking or crypto products.

  • Back-end experience with Kotlin or Java and Spring Boot.

  • Experience building or maintaining a design system.

  • Experience with multiple currencies, languages, and number and date formats.

How we work

We use AI coding tools every day and expect you to as well. They make us faster at the routine parts of the work. But you own every line you ship: you understand it, test it, and can defend it in review. Because we handle financial data, we follow clear rules about what code and data can go into which tools.

Named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers and a Deloitte Technology Fast 500 company, we're building a culture where innovation thrives, collaboration is the norm, and every team member contributes to reshaping how the world understands location.

NICE TO HAVES:

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to work more efficiently—whether professionally or personally—and a curiosity for finding new ways to apply them.

Assistenz der Geschäftsführung (m/w/d) – Teilzeit oder Vollzeit

Über Cryptory

Die Cryptory GmbH mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main ist eine moderne Bildungsplattform rund um den Handel und die strategische Geldanlage in digitalen Währungen, Edelmetallen und weiteren Anlageklassen.

Unser Qualitätsmanagement ist TÜV-zertifiziert nach ISO 9001. Aktuell begleiten wir parallel zwischen 500 und 1.000 Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, sich fundiertes Wissen aufzubauen und die Finanzmärkte besser zu verstehen.

Damit unsere neuen Mitglieder von Anfang an einen klaren Überblick haben und sich bei uns gut aufgehoben fühlen, suchen wir Unterstützung im Kunden-Onboarding.

Als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine vielseitige Position mit Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Du unterstützt unsere Geschäftsführung im Tagesgeschäft, übernimmst organisatorische und administrative Aufgaben und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Team zusammen und betreust eigenständig Projekte.

Die Stelle ist in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit (30–40 Stunden pro Woche) möglich.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben bei uns:

  • Geschäftsführung unterstützen: Du unterstützt im operativen und strategischen Tagesgeschäft und hilfst bei der Koordination interner Projekte.

  • Buchhaltung unterstützen: Du organisierst Belege und Rechnungen und unterstützt bei der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung.

  • Kunden-Onboardings begleiten: Du koordinierst und begleitest Onboardings und sorgst für einen professionellen Start unserer Neukunden.

  • Geschäftsreisen organisieren: Du planst Reisen unserer Geschäftsführer und kümmerst dich um Flüge, Hotels und Buchungen.

  • Events planen: Du organisierst unsere Veranstaltungen, koordinierst Locations und Dienstleister und begleitest die Umsetzung.

  • Vertragsmanagement unterstützen: Du verwaltest Vertragsunterlagen, überwachst Fristen und Laufzeiten und sorgst für eine strukturierte Ablage.

  • Termine und Meetings koordinieren: Du organisierst Besprechungen und unterstützt bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung.

  • Präsentationen und Unterlagen erstellen: Du bereitest Präsentationen, Berichte und Entscheidungsvorlagen vor.

  • Kommunikation übernehmen: Du bearbeitest Korrespondenzen und kommunizierst mit Mitarbeitern, Kunden und Geschäftspartnern.

Qualifikation

  • Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte Organisations- und Kommunikationsstärke und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.

  • Du bist zuverlässig, diskret und verantwortungsbewusst.

  • Du bringst eine hohe Eigenmotivation, Einsatzbereitschaft und Eigeninitiative mit.

  • Du bist ein echter Teamplayer und arbeitest gerne mit anderen Menschen zusammen.

  • Du beherrschst die gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen und bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du hast eine ruhige Arbeitsumgebung und eine stabile Internetverbindung.

Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder erste Erfahrungen in der Assistenz, Verwaltung oder Organisation sind von Vorteil. Kenntnisse in Google Workspace und ChatGPT sind ebenfalls hilfreich. Entscheidend sind für uns deine Motivation, Zuverlässigkeit und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du arbeitest 30–40 Stunden pro Woche und kannst deine Arbeitszeit in Abstimmung mit unserem Team flexibel gestalten.

  • Remote-Arbeit: Du arbeitest von zu Hause und bist eng in unser Team eingebunden.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Du erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst eigene Projekte, bringst Ideen ein und gestaltest interne Abläufe aktiv mit.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Wir machen dich mit unseren Produkten, Prozessen und Tools vertraut.

  • Persönlicher Mentor: Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner für Fragen, Feedback und deine Weiterentwicklung.

  • Regelmäßige Weiterbildungen: Du entwickelst deine fachlichen und persönlichen Fähigkeiten gezielt weiter.

  • Mitarbeiterbenefits wie Wellpass: Profitiere von vielfältigen Sport- und Fitnessangeboten.

  • Ein engagiertes Team: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, geben ehrliches Feedback und arbeiten gemeinsam an unseren Zielen.

Job Title: Senior Director, Global Medical Affairs

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions.Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.

Description of Role

The Senior Director, Global Medical Affairs, will serve as the Global Medical Affairs Lead for Centessa's lead orexin receptor 2 agonist program. This strategic leadership role is responsible for developing and executing the global medical strategy across the product lifecycle, with a primary focus on launch readiness, scientific leadership, evidence generation, external engagement, and cross-functional partnership.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience leading global medical affairs activities for one or more successful product launches and possess a strong track record of partnering with commercial, market access, HEOR, clinical development, regulatory affairs, patient advocacy and regional medical teams to deliver integrated launch strategies. The individual will serve as the medical voice of the asset, ensuring that scientific evidence, stakeholder insights, and patient needs are incorporated into key business decisions.

This role reports to the Head of Medical Affairs and will partner closely with senior leadership across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Global Medical Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead the global medical affairs strategy and tactical execution plan for cleminorexton
  • Serve as the Global Medical Affairs Lead and core member of the cross-functional asset team
  • Ensure alignment of medical strategy with corporate objectives, clinical development milestones, and commercialization plans
  • Establish long-range medical affairs planning to support regulatory approvals, launch readiness, and lifecycle management
  • Identify emerging scientific opportunities, evidence gaps, and stakeholder needs to inform future development

Global Launch Excellence

  • Lead medical launch preparedness activities across major global markets
  • Partner with commercial, market access, HEOR, regulatory affairs, and regional medical teams to develop integrated launch strategies
  • Collaborate with medical affairs colleagues to ensure deliverables are aligned with strategy and launch timelines, including scientific platforms, training content, medical information resources, publications, congress activities, and insights generation
  • Support pre-launch and launch planning activities, including collaborating with HEOR and market access for global payer engagement strategies and value communication

External Scientific Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with global key opinion leaders, investigators, professional societies, and patient advocacy organizations.
  • Lead scientific advisory boards, expert consultations, and other insight-gathering initiatives.
  • Represent Centessa at major scientific congresses and industry meetings.
  • Serve as a credible scientific ambassador and subject matter expert for orexin biology and sleep-wake disorders.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as a strategic partner to commercial, market access, HEOR, regulatory, clinical development, patient advocacy, and corporate affairs
  • Contribute medical expertise to brand strategy, payer engagement, disease-state education, and scientific communication initiatives
  • Strategic partner for development of scientific platforms, publication strategies, educational programs, and medical training
  • Provide medical review and guidance for externally facing scientific materials in compliance with applicable regulations and company policies

Qualifications

Required

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD)
  • Minimum 10 years of Medical Affairs leadership experience with 5 years global experience preferred
  • Experience in neuroscience, sleep medicine, neurology, psychiatry, or rare disease
  • Demonstrated experience leading at least one successful global product launch (North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific markets highly preferred)
  • Experience serving as a global medical lead for late-stage development or commercial products
  • Strong understanding of global medical affairs, evidence generation, payer evidence requirements, and commercialization readiness
  • Proven ability to drive strategy in a matrix environment
  • Proven track record of collaborating closely with commercial, market access, HEOR, regulatory affairs, and clinical development organizations
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Work Location

The Sr. Director, Global Medical Affairs role is remote, based in the US, with occasional travel (20%).

jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help us architecting, implementing and operating the complete data infrastructure pipeline for our Research and Trading operations. This role will be crucial in building a scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient system for handling vast amounts of market trading data, real-time news feeds and a variety of internal and external data sources. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on professional who understands the entire data lifecycle and can drive innovation while collaborating across research and engineering teams to meet their needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and integrating large-volume datasets (market data, news feeds and various unstructured data sources).
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and real-time monitoring using tools like DBT, 3rd party libraries that can facilitate data validation processes.
  • Develop processes to normalize and organize our data warehouse for use across different departments.
  • Apply advanced data management practices to ensure the scalability, availability, and efficiency of data storage.
  • Ensure the infrastructure supports trading and research needs while maintaining data integrity, security, and performance at scale.
  • Collaborate with research and analytics teams to understand their data needs and build frameworks that empower data exploration, analysis, and model development. Create tools for overlaying data from multiple sources.
  • Ensure that data storage, processing, and management are done in a cost-effective manner, optimizing both hardware and software resources. Implement solutions that balance high performance with cost control.
  • Stay ahead of the curve by continuously evaluating and adopting the most suitable technologies for the organization’s data engineering needs. Ensure that company’s systems align with the latest best practices in data management.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Clear communication skills for cross-functional collaboration
  • Proficiency in building robust data quality checks for ingested data
  • Experience identifying anomalies in ingested data.
  • Strong proficiency in writing complex SQL (and similar) queries and optimize performance.
  • Proficiency in Python or Java/Scala.
  • Experience building and maintaining complex ETL pipelines with tools like Apache Airflow, dbt, or custom scripts.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, normalization/denormalization principles, etc.
  • Proven experience with platforms like Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Synapse, etc.
  • Expert knowledge of Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data security and privacy standards

Preferred Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their data services (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, S3, Dataflow, etc.), proven by certifications (e.g., Google Professional Data Engineer, AWS Big Data Specialty or Snowflake’s SnowPro Data Engineer )
  • Experience with data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Deequ or others)
  • Experience with Git/GitHub or similar for code versioning.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Exposure to containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with data governance, data lineage, and catalog tools (e.g., Apache Atlas, Amundsen).
  • Hands-on with observability and monitoring tools for data pipelines (e.g., Monte Carlo, Datadog).
  • Knowledge of machine learning pipelines.
  • Prior experience in a trading or financial services environment.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. HR Interview – To understand your experience, overall skill set, and cultural fit.
  3. Technical Interview – Interviews with multiple stakeholder teams to assess your skill set and cross-functional collaboration.
  4. CTO Interview – Interview with the CTO to discuss your experience, technical expertise, problem-solving approach, and overall fit for the role.
  5. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Business Financial Group

Business Financial Group (BFG) is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, and financial advisory organization serving businesses and individuals throughout the United States.

Our services include business and individual tax preparation, tax planning, IRS and state tax resolution, accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, accounts payable, and financial advisory services.

Our India-based operations team works closely with U.S.-based professionals to deliver accurate, timely, and consistent client services.

We are building a strong team of accounting and tax professionals and are seeking a practical, organized, and motivated Tax Team Manager to help lead our tax operations.

Position Summary

We are seeking a **hands-on Tax Team Manager** to oversee the daily operations, workflow, productivity, and performance of our U.S. tax preparation team.

The primary responsibility is to **ensure that tax projects are assigned appropriately, completed accurately, reviewed, and delivered on time.**

This role is ideal for an experienced U.S. Tax Senior, Tax Team Lead, Tax Supervisor, or Assistant Tax Manager who enjoys managing people, solving operational challenges, and improving team performance.

The successful candidate should have a good understanding of U.S. tax preparation and practical experience supervising or coordinating tax professionals.

**This is a team management and tax operations position, not a senior technical tax specialist or Tax Director role.**

Complex tax matters, advanced planning, and IRS representation will be escalated to BFG's designated senior tax professionals and CPA Advisors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Team Leadership and Supervision

  • Supervise assigned tax preparers and tax associates.
  • Allocate work based on employee experience, workload, and project complexity.
  • Establish clear expectations for daily and weekly deliverables.
  • Monitor employee productivity and work quality.
  • Conduct regular team meetings and individual follow-ups.
  • Identify training needs and coordinate employee development.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support performance improvement.
  • Escalate significant employee or operational concerns to the Delivery & Operations Manager.

2. Tax Project and Workflow Management

  • Manage daily tax project workflows from assignment through preparation, review, e-filing, and completion.
  • Monitor internal and statutory deadlines.
  • Ensure tax projects are updated accurately in BFG's project management system.
  • Track missing client information and coordinate follow-ups.
  • Identify overdue projects and potential delivery delays.
  • Prioritize projects based on deadlines, complexity, and client requirements.
  • Coordinate with tax reviewers and other departments to resolve pending matters.
  • Provide regular project status reports to management.

3. U.S. Tax Preparation and Review Coordination

  • Oversee tax preparation activities involving:

- Form 1040 – Individual Tax Returns

- Form 1065 – Partnership Tax Returns

- Form 1120S – S Corporation Tax Returns

- Form 1120 – C Corporation Tax Returns

  • Perform basic or first-level tax return reviews within demonstrated competency.
  • Ensure preparers follow established tax preparation procedures.
  • Verify that required supporting documents and workpapers are available.
  • Coordinate second-level or technical reviews with qualified reviewers.
  • Monitor extensions, estimated tax payments, e-filing requirements, and unresolved tax return issues.

- Escalate complex tax matters promptly.

Extensive expertise in every business tax form is not required, provided the candidate has a strong foundation in U.S. taxation and can effectively coordinate qualified reviewers.

4. Quality Control and Compliance

  • Ensure team members follow BFG's preparation and review checklists.
  • Monitor review comments and pending corrections.

- Identify repeated preparation errors.

- Coordinate corrective training.

  • Verify completion of required documentation before final review.
  • Help reduce rework, missed deadlines, and preventable errors.
  • Maintain consistent quality-control practices across assigned projects.

5. Tax Planning and Resolution Coordination

  • Coordinate documentation and project assignments for tax planning engagements.
  • Track IRS notices, client correspondence, outstanding documents, and due dates.
  • Maintain organized project records and follow-up schedules.
  • Coordinate technical questions with senior tax professionals.
  • Ensure client requests receive appropriate internal attention.

Advanced tax planning and independent IRS representation experience are not required for this position.

6. Process Improvement and Reporting

  • Implement existing SOPs and tax workflow procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify project management.
  • Assist with developing checklists and employee training materials.
  • Track employee workload, pending reviews, overdue projects, and delivery performance.
  • Support the use of automation and AI tools to improve efficiency.
  • Provide weekly updates to the Delivery & Operations Manager.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • **3–6 years of relevant U.S. tax preparation or tax operations experience.**
  • At least **1 year of experience as a Team Lead, Senior Tax Associate with supervisory responsibilities, Tax Supervisor, or Assistant Manager**, or equivalent demonstrated leadership experience.
  • Experience working with U.S. CPA firms, EA practices, offshore tax outsourcing companies, or similar organizations.
  • Practical experience preparing or reviewing Form 1040.
  • Working knowledge of Forms 1065 and 1120S.
  • Experience assigning or monitoring work across multiple tax projects.
  • Familiarity with tax software and preparation/review procedures.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Commerce, Finance, or a related field.

Professional Credentials — Preferred, Not Required

- Enrolled Agent (EA)

- CA / CA Inter

- CPA candidate

  • Relevant U.S. tax training or certifications

Candidates with strong practical experience and demonstrated management ability are encouraged to apply even without professional credentials.

Required Skills

- Team supervision and work allocation

- U.S. individual tax preparation

  • Working knowledge of U.S. business taxation

- Tax preparation and review workflows

- Project and deadline management

- Quality control

- Staff training and coaching

- Problem-solving and escalation

- Professional English communication

- Microsoft Excel

- U.S. tax preparation software

  • Workflow and project management systems

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with any of the following is an advantage:

- Drake Tax

- CCH Axcess

- UltraTax

- Lacerte

- ProConnect

- QuickBooks Online

- Xero

  • Zoho Projects or similar workflow systems

Candidates are not required to know every software platform listed.

Remote Work Requirements

Candidates must have:

- A dedicated, quiet workspace

  • A laptop or computer capable of supporting dual monitors
  • High-speed internet with a minimum of 150 Mbps download and 9 Mbps upload

- Backup internet connectivity

- Reliable power supply with backup

- Noise-cancelling headset

  • Ability to attend virtual team meetings

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

  • Keep assigned tax projects organized and on schedule.
  • Ensure team members understand their responsibilities.
  • Minimize avoidable delays and missed deadlines.
  • Maintain consistent preparation and review standards.
  • Identify and escalate technical problems promptly.
  • Improve team productivity through coaching and coordination.
  • Maintain accurate workflow information.
  • Help create a reliable, accountable, and collaborative tax operations team.

Career Development

BFG offers opportunities for professional growth, including:

  • Exposure to U.S. individual and business tax engagements.
  • Collaboration with experienced U.S. tax and accounting professionals.
  • Opportunities to develop tax review and management skills.
  • Experience with workflow automation and AI-assisted operations.
  • Potential advancement to more senior tax management positions based on demonstrated performance and business requirements.

Compensation

**Annual Compensation: ₹9,00,000–₹12,00,000**

Final compensation will be based on demonstrated U.S. tax experience, team leadership capability, technical knowledge, and interview performance.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their updated resumes highlighting:

- U.S. tax preparation experience

- Tax software knowledge

  • Team leadership or supervisory experience
  • Experience managing deadlines and multiple engagements
  • Current and expected annual compensation

- Notice period and availability

**Join BFG and help build a high-performing U.S. tax operations team.**

German Speaking Travel Consultants

Closing Date: 30th October

Location

Whether you will work remotely in the UK, at our bright, modern campus in Kent or Munich, as long as you can deliver a great service for customers, we are flexible for this role.

About Us

At Holiday Extras, we’re creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, build their careers and reach their limitless potential. As a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025, we’re proud to offer a world of benefits designed to enhance your lifestyle and well-being. By joining our team, you’ll feel supported and rewarded every day.

We sell everything but the holiday. Using innovative technology, we provide great value travel extras in the UK and Europe as well as UK Breaks, with an unrivalled experience to over 8 million travellers a year. With over 40 years' experience, there's nothing our team of travel experts doesn’t know about taking the hassle out of organising a holiday at home or abroad. Our Contact Centre is at the heart of delivering Extra Care, creating experiences that connect with our customers, build confidence and make every interaction feel effortless.

We’re looking for customer-focused people to join our team and become experts at helping our German customers find the best products and services that make travelling easy, simple and fun. We’re searching for diverse perspectives and big ideas from people who are curious and keen to learn!

By joining our team you'll:

  • Speak and write German and English fluently to be the voice of Holiday Extras, talking to our customers over the phone. Strong, adaptable and empathetic communication skills therefore are a must.
  • Use your excellent rapport-building and listening skills to quickly connect customers with products and services that enhance their holiday experience.
  • Become a product expert and brand ambassador, developing in-depth knowledge of our range of products and services.
  • Receive full training and support from our dedicated Contact Centre Trainers. Starting with an induction programme, designed to give you the knowledge and confidence you need to be successful in the role. Followed by weekly 1-to-1 coaching and mentoring to support your continual development.
  • Learn and use cutting-edge tech, including your own Apple Macbook from day 1, as well as access to the Google Workspace suite and other apps. If you’ve never used these before - we’ll show you how.
  • Be part of a supportive, thriving, ‘be one team’ environment where our values are embedded - we celebrate success together with our Group Profit Share Bonus Scheme, as well as enjoying our famous culture with seasonal events such as parties and BBQs. Learn more about our unique culture.
  • Enjoy a world of benefits including 25 days holiday, your birthday off, enhanced parental leave, pension, life assurance, discounts for cinema tickets and high street retailers, cycle to work scheme.
  • You will have access to our wellbeing benefits - we offer a free employee assistance programme - enhanced after 4 years to private medical insurance and health screening, discounted gym membership, holiday buy scheme. Plus, our in-house network of trained mental health first aiders who are on hand should you need support.

What you can bring to our team:

  • You are an effective communicator with a warm, friendly, inviting and engaging tone of voice, with the ability to adapt and tailor your approach to each customer.
  • A flexible approach with the ability to adapt to different products, customers and scenarios.
  • Reliability and a self-reliant way of working
  • Experience of working in a sales and service-oriented environment, as well as excellent collaboration and communication skills.

If you choose to work remotely, you must have cabled broadband at home and a suitable private working space. So that we can provide the best service to our customers, 4G mobile routers are not suitable for this role.

Prior contact centre experience is not necessary although we’re ideally looking for people who:

  • have previously worked in a customer-facing role
  • have excellent writen and spoken German language skills
  • thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • have a great attention to detail
  • care about providing an effortless experience to our customers
  • have no trouble multitasking

Hours

On a full-time basis, you would work 37.5 hours per week, with shifts scheduled across our opening hours of Monday to Friday, 8am–6pm, plus Saturdays from 7:30am–1pm.

Our aim is to be as inclusive as possible, and we welcome both full-time and part-time candidates who can work shifts to meet the needs of our customers. This will include some Saturday working.

As part of a typical 12-week rota, you can expect to work approximately 3 Saturdays. The exact pattern may vary depending on business and customer needs.

You will need to be able to attend a 2-week full-time induction. This is super important as it has been purpose-built and designed to give you the knowledge and confidence you need to be successful in the role.

Rotas are given out 8 weeks in advance so you have plenty of time to plan ahead and enjoy your free time.

How we hire for this role

If we believe you might be a match, you'll enter our hiring process as follows:

  • Initial telephone call with a member of our recruitment team so we can get to know you a little better.
  • You will then be invited to an interview with the manager of our German Contact Centre team. This normally takes around an hour and will be held online. It's a great opportunity to find out about the role and for us to learn more about your skills and experience and what you can expect working with us.

​

Cultivating a diverse and inclusive culture is paramount for us.

As part of this, we have designed our hiring process so you can be comfortable to confidently convey your strengths and who you are.

Recognising we are all different, if for whatever reason you need us to adapt the process, please get in touch via

Benefits

Why choose Holiday Extras?

We believe that holidays are the most precious time of all, so we create products, tech and services that make travel and holidays memorable and fun. We’re on a mission to be the only place to go for your holiday extras, offering unparalleled choice, value and service, turning our customers’ ordinary trips into extraordinarily good times.

At Holiday Extras, we’re creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, build their careers and reach their limitless potential. As a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025, we’re proud to offer a world of benefits designed to enhance your lifestyle and well-being. By joining our team, you’ll feel supported and rewarded every day. Learn more about our culture and benefits.

  • Time is precious: 25 days annual leave (+BH’s), extra holidays through Holiday Buy, Birthday Day Off, and Sabbaticals at each milestone.
  • Parental Leave: Enhanced parental leave - Up to 1 year off, including 13 weeks at 100% pay, 13 weeks at 50% pay
  • Road to well-being: Access to Gym Discounts, Private Dental Insurance and Private Medical Insurance (after 4 years)
  • Celebrate success together: Enjoy a Profit Share Bonus and a pension scheme with Aviva.
  • Good for the soul: Join our Social Club for 25% off any ticket or event in the UK, Discounts on the latest tech, or give back to your community with our Volunteering Scheme.

Intertek, a leading provider of quality and safety solutions to many of the world’s top-recognized brands and companies, is actively seeking a Senior UX Designer to join our People Assurance team in Remote. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in Design.

Intertek's People Assurance teams empower your workforce to identify and close operational gaps and mitigate risk by assuring smart actions across your organization. Intertek Alchemy provides frontline worker training solutions for processors, manufacturers, packagers, and distributors of all sizes. Intertek Catalyst inspires and engages workforces with highly creative, custom-branded, asset protection communication programs tailor-made strategic solutions designed to leverage our clients' company brand, values, and objectives to optimize the culture of their people. Intertek Wisetail provides a custom branded training and communication platform built to engage today’s workforce with a complete learning management system, giving customers the tools to grow their passionate workforce. Intertek is continually innovating and evolving to reduce risk for consumers, brands and organizations in every sector and industry around the world.We go beyond Testing, Inspection and Certification of products: we are a Total Quality Assurance Provider to industries worldwide.Our Purpose: Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life.

What are we looking for?

The Senior UX Designer will own UX for agreed Wisetail product areas and partner closely with the Lead Product Designer on Convergence. Your UX expertise will help shape the new platform through flows, wireframes, prototypes and informed design decisions. Working with Product, Engineering and the existing designers, you will contribute to both products as they evolve. The Head of Design will set priorities and balance your workload across Wisetail and Convergence.

Shift/Schedule: Monday- Friday; business hours

Salary & Benefits Information

The base wage or salary range for this position is $145,000. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate including skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

In addition to competitive compensation packages, when working with Intertek you can expect benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k) with company match, generous vacation / sick time (PTO), tuition reimbursement and more.

What you’ll do:

  • Work with Product and Engineering to understand customer problems, requirements and existing workflow maps. Identify missing information, challenge assumptions and compare approaches before committing to a solution.

  • Map user journeys, task flows, information architecture and navigation. Make relationships between users, roles, permissions, learning content and administration tools clear and consistent.

  • Create detailed wireframes and clickable prototypes that show how an experience works. Annotate interactions, decision points, dependencies and relevant loading, empty, error and recovery states so partners can understand and implement the intended behavior.

  • Plan and conduct appropriate usability testing with research partners. Build on existing customer research, observe where people struggle and use findings to improve flows and interaction decisions.

  • Carry agreed workflows through to clear, accessible interfaces using shared design components. Apply sound visual hierarchy, layout and responsive behavior, partnering with other designers on more demanding visual work.

  • Lead UX for agreed Wisetail product areas and coordinate with the existing designers across web and mobile. Maintain clear ownership and dependable support for priority Wisetail work alongside your Convergence contributions.

  • Work with engineers throughout implementation. Maintain useful design specifications, resolve questions and review the built experience against intended behavior, accessibility and interface quality.

  • Partner with the Lead Product Designer on Convergence journeys, navigation, wireframes and usability decisions. Bring Wisetail and Alchemy customer insights into this work, share reusable patterns and agree priorities across both products with the Head of Design.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience independently designing complex digital products, with ownership of substantial workflows from problem framing through implementation and iteration.

  • Deep UX skills in task analysis, information architecture, navigation and interaction design. You can untangle requirements, identify gaps and explain complex behavior through clear flows and annotated wireframes.

  • Strong Figma and interactive prototyping skills, with the ability to choose the right level of detail for exploration, testing and implementation.

  • Experience planning or conducting usability testing, synthesizing research and product evidence, and changing designs based on what you learn.

  • Solid interface design skills, including visual hierarchy, layout, accessibility and responsive behavior. You can deliver clear, consistent UI within a design system and collaborate on its improvement.

  • Experience working with engineers on feasibility, data, permissions and implementation tradeoffs. You can document interactions precisely and stay involved as the experience is built.

  • Clear communication, sound judgment and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and other designers. You can explain decisions and prioritize with your partners.

Intertek: Total Quality. Assured.

Intertek is a world leader in the Quality Assurance market, with a proven, high-quality business model and a global network of customer-focused operations and highly engaged subject matter experts. With passion, pace, and precision we work to exceed our customers’ expectations, while engaging with our employees to be 10X in their performance and professional growth.

Intertek is a drug-free workplace. As a condition of employment, certain positions may be required to pass a pre-employment drug test based on the type of work that will be performed.

We Value Diversity

We take affirmative action to ensure all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.
