jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

This is a UK Based remote role, you must have the right to work in the UK.
Kyckr is a fast-scaling SaaS and data company transforming how financial crime teams verify businesses. We give regulated institutions, including banks, fintechs, law firms and payment providers, access to legally authoritative company data from 300+ corporate registries across 120 countries. Our customers use Kyckr to power their Know Your Business (KYB) and AML workflows, helping them onboard customers, assess risk and maintain ongoing compliance with confidence.
We've been a trusted name in the market for 20 years, but we operate like a scale-up. Our team is small, decisions are made quickly, and we're always improving what we build.

After a year of record growth, we are investing in our engineering team to accelerate delivery of our next-generation Registry Hub architecture. We are a small, focused engineering team distributed across Australia, the UK, and the Philippines. We operate on Azure, run a large .NET monorepo alongside a newer microservices architecture, and are actively adopting AI-assisted development tooling — including Claude Code and GitHub Copilot — as a core part of how we build software.

We are looking for a Development Team Lead to lead a small team of four developers while remaining a hands-on senior engineer. This is a player-coach role: we anticipate roughly an 80/20 split between writing code and leading the team. You will spend the majority of your time building software, and the rest growing your engineers, unblocking delivery, and raising the technical bar.

You will be one of our most senior technical contributors — setting the standard for code quality, design, and AI-assisted ways of working — at the same time as owning the line management and career development of your team. You will report directly to the CTO and work closely with them on technical direction, delivery, and team growth.

Two areas matter especially for this role. First, agentic AI for coding: we are not experimenting at the edges — Claude Code and agentic development and QA workflows are central to how we build, and we want a leader who can drive that adoption from the front. Second, product integrations: a large part of our value is connecting reliably to corporate registries and third-party data sources worldwide, and to our customers’ systems, so deep, practical integration experience is important.

The right person is an excellent engineer who genuinely enjoys developing people, communicates clearly in a distributed team, and is energised by working in a domain where data quality has real regulatory consequences.

What You’ll Be Doing

Hands-On Engineering (the majority of your time)

Spend most of your time writing clean, testable, production code in .NET (C#) and SQL Server across our monorepo and newer Registry Hub services — leading by example, not from the sidelines.

Take on the most complex and ambiguous technical work, and set the standard for design, code quality, and testing across the team.

Own significant features and services end-to-end, from design through delivery and operation.

Lead architecture and design discussions, making pragmatic, well-reasoned decisions and clearly communicating the trade-offs.

Agentic AI for Coding

Drive the team’s use of Claude Code and agentic development and QA workflows — for code generation, refactoring, test writing, code review, automated regression checking, and code analysis.

Define and continuously improve the prompt engineering practices, agent configurations, and guardrails that let the team build faster without compromising quality.

Evaluate and introduce new AI tooling as the landscape evolves, and help the wider engineering organisation adopt what works.

Establish how we measure the impact of AI-assisted development on velocity and quality, and use that to guide adoption.

Product Integrations

Lead the design and delivery of integrations with third-party registry APIs and data sources, handling the complexity of varied data formats and reliability characteristics across 120 countries.

Own the patterns for resilient, observable, and maintainable integrations — retries, error handling, rate limiting, and monitoring.

Work with product and customer-facing teams to deliver integrations into customers’ systems and workflows that solve real compliance problems.

Team Leadership & People Management

Line-manage a team of four developers, including regular one-to-ones, performance management, and active career development and growth planning.

Mentor and coach engineers, giving and receiving constructive feedback through code review and day-to-day collaboration.

Own your team’s delivery — planning, prioritisation, and removing blockers — in partnership with product and the CTO.

Foster a pragmatic, high-trust, high-ownership engineering culture and help recruit and onboard new engineers as the team grows.

Delivery, Quality & Collaboration

Champion strong engineering practices: meaningful tests, safe and repeatable deployments through our Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and continuous improvement.

Work asynchronously with a distributed team across three time zones, using Microsoft Teams, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and Jira.

Document technical decisions, architecture, and runbooks clearly — good written communication matters in a remote team.

Collaborate with product, compliance, and customer success to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet real-world needs

Requirements

We are looking for 7–10 years of hands-on software development experience, including time spent leading or mentoring other engineers. The ideal candidate will have held a formal “Team Lead” title before. You should be ready to combine deep, current technical contribution with real responsibility for a team. You don’t need to have worked in FinTech or RegTech specifically, but you should be comfortable building production services where reliability and security matter.

Essential

7–10 years of professional software development experience, with strong, current hands-on skills in .NET / C#.

Solid experience with SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, and relational data modelling.

Proven experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party systems and data sources.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Functions, App Services, Service Bus, Blob Storage, Key Vault, APIM).

Demonstrable experience leading, mentoring, or line-managing engineers — and a genuine interest in developing people and their careers.

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar), and enthusiasm for making it central to how a team works.

Strong system design and architecture judgement, with the ability to make and clearly explain pragmatic trade-offs.

Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills across a distributed system.

Strong written and verbal communication for a remote, distributed team.

Comfortable balancing hands-on delivery with leadership responsibilities (an 80/20 coding-to-leadership split).

Nice to Have

Experience configuring or operating agentic AI workflows for development or QA at a team level.

Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps, YAML pipelines, automated deployments).

Experience with message-driven and event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, queues).

Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and Kubernetes.

Front-end experience with React or other modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

Experience working in a regulated industry (FinTech, HealthTech, GovTech, or similar).


Benefits

Remote-first with periodic in person collaboration days
Annual leave + UK bank holidays (25 days + 8 bank holidays)
Private Medical Insurance
Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
Supportive family & sick leave policies
Best-in-class pension contributions
Annual training budget
Laptop + home office equipment provided as required
Work from Anywhere: up to 20 days/year (policy conditions apply)
Wellbeing programme + quarterly socials

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Automation Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence.
jobs.description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).

The Role in Context

Fingerprint's device intelligence platform processes billions of identification events for companies that need to know who — or what — is on the other end of a request. Increasingly, the answer is not a person. AI agents, AI assistants, crawlers, headless browsers, and malicious automation now make up a large and fast-growing share of internet traffic, and telling them apart from humans — and from each other — is becoming one of the most important problems our customers ask us to solve.

We are standing up a dedicated Automation Intelligence engineering team to own that problem end to end: detection in the browser, detection at the edge, the classification taxonomy that tells customers what kind of automation they're seeing and how confident we are, and the API that customers and their agents call.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team. You'll inherit a small, senior group (three engineers to start, growing to four or five) and a clear mandate. You report directly to the VP of Engineering.


Your Mission

  • Ship the product — Take the automation intelligence product through Beta to GA, and then to a standalone commercial launch. You own engineering readiness: scope, estimates, service reliability, operating limits, API and MCP coverage, and the evidence that it's ready
  • Make detection accurate and keep it that way — Build the team's quality loop: a test corpus of known bots, agents, and automation frameworks; continuous false-positive and false-negative testing; a regression test for every confirmed gap; and coverage benchmarked against the best in the industry. Detection quality is the product
  • Build a team that runs itself — Set the team up so adding a detection, shipping a change, or running a staged rollout doesn't depend on another team's calendar. Grow the engineers, hire the next seats, and create an environment where senior people do their best work
  • Lead the AI-native engineering model — AI agents write the code by default and engineers decide what gets built and whether it's right. You'll operate that model, measure it honestly, and produce the playbook the rest of engineering adopts


What You'll Do

Delivery & Product Readiness

  • Own the engineering plan for Beta → GA → standalone launch: PRD partnership with the product manager, estimates, sequencing, and the readiness evidence that gates each stage
  • Define and prove the service's operating envelope — throughput, latency tails, rate limiting, availability SLOs — before customers depend on it
  • Run staged rollouts for detection changes that affect customer bot rates, with feature flags, rollback, and clear go/no-go evidence for customer-facing teams
  • Turn design-partner feedback and customer-reported false positives into prioritized, owned engineering work

Detection Quality & Coverage

  • Stand up and run a weekly detection quality loop: prioritized test corpus, automated FP/FN testing across browser and edge detection, regression coverage, and drift monitoring
  • Drive coverage of the automation that matters most to customers — AI agents and assistants first — benchmarked against industry leaders, and prioritized by customer exposure rather than catalogue size
  • Guide the hard problems: self-hosted agents, stealth and anti-detect browser automation, and fingerprinting agent infrastructure across browser, network, and runtime evidence
  • Evolve the classification contract from "automation detected" to rich agent context — automation type, verified vs. inferred identity, confidence, and reason codes — and keep detection and attribution measured separately

Team Leadership

  • Manage, coach, and grow a team of senior engineers; run hiring for the next seats, starting with a detection research and quality engineer
  • Set the team's goals against its charter and bring them to leadership for alignment, not approval; communicate decisions as intent with reasoning before acting
  • Establish healthy engineering practice from day one: written ownership lines, review tiers per repository, specs before epics, and baselines for cycle time, throughput, predictability, change failure rate, and recovery time
  • Negotiate clean working agreements with the sibling team the codebase is shared with today, and drive gradual decoupling prioritized by what blocks independent deploys

AI-Native Engineering

  • Operate the agent-first development model: spec → coding agent → review agent → security review → human merge, with low-risk changes merging on agent approval and mandatory human review on critical paths
  • Treat the agent harness — repository instructions, skills, review personas — as infrastructure maintained like code, and publish it so other teams start ahead
  • Measure the model against the team's own baseline, run 30- and 60-day reviews, and write up what worked and what didn't for the rest of engineering

Contract-First APIs

  • Ensure every surface the team ships is contract-first: OpenAPI in the repo, breaking-change detection in CI, generated docs and SDKs, and the API kept readable by both developers and AI agents
  • Own the team's observability: logs, metrics, traces, and SLOs for the detection service


What We're Looking For

Required

  • Engineering management experience: 3+ years managing software engineers, ideally including senior and staff-level ICs, with a track record of shipping products — not just features — through launch
  • Strong technical foundation: 8+ years in software engineering before or alongside management. You can read a design doc and a PR critically, engage senior engineers on architecture, and make technical calls when the team is split
  • Relevant domain depth in at least one of: bot detection or bot management, fraud or abuse prevention, web security, browser or client-side engineering, or high-volume API services. You understand that this is an adversarial problem where the other side adapts
  • Quality-driven mindset: Experience building or running measurement-driven engineering — test corpora, precision/recall or FP/FN tracking, regression suites, SLOs — and using that data to prioritize
  • Hands-on with AI coding tools: You use AI coding agents in your own work, have opinions about where they help and where they don't, and are excited to lead a team where they are the default
  • Cross-functional operator: You've worked closely with product managers, researchers, and customer-facing teams, and you're comfortable making dependencies and trade-offs explicit rather than absorbing them
  • Clear communicator: You write well, make decisions visible with your reasoning, and can explain detection quality and launch readiness to executives and customers alike

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with bot detection, bot management, or anti-automation products (e.g. at a CDN, WAF, fraud, or security vendor)
  • Familiarity with AI agent ecosystems: agent frameworks, verified-agent protocols, and how agents interact with websites and APIs
  • Experience with browser internals or headless/automation frameworks and the techniques used to detect or evade them
  • Experience running API-first products with public OpenAPI specs, SDKs, and MCP or similar agent-facing surfaces
  • Experience forming a new team out of an existing one — separating codebases, setting ownership lines, and keeping the sibling relationship healthy
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS company with enterprise customers


The Shape of This Role

This is a hands-on-adjacent engineering manager role for a small, senior, high-leverage team. You are not expected to write the production code — your engineers and their agents do that — but you are expected to be close enough to it to set direction, evaluate the work, and hold the quality bar.

The team has unusual autonomy and unusual visibility. It owns a product that leadership considers strategically critical, it is the first team operating Fingerprint's AI-native engineering model, and its results — good and bad — will be used as evidence for how the rest of engineering works. That means two things: you'll have real room to decide how the team operates, and you'll need to be honest about what the data shows.

In the first 90 days you will likely: finalize the roster and ownership lines with the sibling team, get the quality loop and engineering baselines running, deliver the engineering evidence for the Beta gate, and run the first review of the AI-native operating model.


Why This Role?

  • A problem that is getting harder and more important every quarter: The internet is filling with agents. Customers need to tell useful automation from abuse, and the answer isn't "block everything." The team that solves this well defines a category
  • A product with a clear path to market: Beta to GA to standalone launch, with product, go-to-market, and executive support already lined up
  • A senior team and a dedicated PM from day one: You're not starting from zero. The engineers already know the problem; your job is to focus them and remove what's in their way
  • Lead how engineering will work next: AI-native development, contract-first APIs, and a self-directed team model — piloted here first, with your findings shaping the whole organization
  • VP direct line: You report to the VP of Engineering, set your own goals against a clear charter, and bring recommendations rather than requests for direction


Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $159k - $215k

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

NYC: $187k - $215k

Chicago: $159k - $183k

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer

As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment.
Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance.

What to expect

  • Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward.

  • Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs.

  • Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security.

  • Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

  • Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

  • SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

  • Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

  • Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

What you bring

  • Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

  • Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

  • Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

  • Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

  • A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

  • Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

  • Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

  • Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

  • Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

Bonus points

  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools.

  • Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company.

  • Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

  • Professional proficiency in French.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. What we offer

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

  • Foster strong cross-functional relationships across Nulogy and its partner ecosystem, proactively identifying and resolving organizational barriers that impact integration delivery and customer success.

EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Enjoy fast paced environments with competing deadlines
  • Friendly, empathetic, patient, and personable even under stressful circumstances
  • Organized and hardworking

  • Demonstrate a strong ability to solve problems creatively, and systematically

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.

Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.

By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact.

OUR VALUES
1. We put people first
We lead with genuine care, build strong relationships, and create space for people to grow.
2. We rewrite the playbook
We don’t wait for perfect conditions. We move, deliver, and refine, solving problems creatively as we go.
3. We learn up
We stay curious, learn from the people and experiences around us, and keep looking ahead.
4. We take the hot potato!
When something goes wrong, we don’t pass the problem along. We take ownership and work together to solve it.
5. We ring the bell together
We celebrate success as a team and recognize the people who helped make it happen.

jobs.description:
Mission Summary:

The Safety-Layer Team is responsible for ensuring the Motional Autonomous Vehicle executes appropriate dynamic trajectories in both nominal and safety-critical scenarios. This team focuses on refining upstream motion plans to guarantee compliance with safety-driven requirements, executing highly dynamic evasive maneuvers at the AV’s physical limits, and implementing system-wide safety overrides. The team pursues these goals through a process of rigorous algorithmic design, implementation, validation, analysis in simulation, and comprehensive closed-course and public road evaluation.

As the team's responsibilities are growing to support more complex scenarios and the scaling of Motional’s deployment area, we are looking for a Senior Motion Planning - Safety-Layer to help build a robust motion planning safety-layer. You will work on enabling cutting-edge capabilities for Motional’s AV, including algorithm design and documentation, software development, metrics definition, simulation implementation and evaluation, and in-vehicle testing. As part of this role, you will maintain cross-functional relationships across the organization to help understand and communicate the impacts of their work on overall AV performance.

What you will work on:

  • Design, implement, and test algorithms for synthesizing trajectories and selecting trajectories across asynchronous generation sources to ensure AV behaviors adhere to safety-critical requirement specifications.
  • Develop evasive maneuver planning algorithms in conjunction with low-level control systems to safely use the full actuation capacity of Motional’s AV for collision avoidance.
  • Evaluate the role of multiple perception sensor modalities in refining the safety-layer’s identification of safety-critical scenarios.
  • Construct test/analysis tooling for isolated and system-level evaluation of safety-layer components and processes, select test parameters, and analyze test results.
  • Utilize, validate, and improve dynamic simulation environments to accelerate the design and analysis of safety-critical motion planning algorithms, including validating simulation models against real-world data.
  • Define and implement performance, comfort, and safety metrics for motion planning and safety systems, and perform quantitative analysis of fleet-wide vehicle data to validate design improvements and identify key areas of improvement.
  • Build a system-wide understanding of Motional’s autonomy stack components by supporting root-cause analysis of simulation, closed-course, and public road events from a motion planning and safety perspective.
  • Travel for in-person vehicle testing at Motional’s and our partner's deployment and test track locations, typically once every 4 to 6 months.

Desired Background:

  • MS, PhD preferred, in one of Control Theory / Robotics / Computer Science / Applied Math or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience developing motion planning and collision avoidance related algorithms and components in an industrial setting, preferably the AV industry
  • Strong background in modern C++ programming (C++17, C++20), with an emphasis on developing high-performance and reliable systems
  • Experienced with concepts from motion planning including trajectory generation through numerical optimization and sampling-based approaches, cost and heuristic-based methods for trajectory selection, multi-modal prediction models, geometric and physics-based collision detection, time-series data processing, and data visualization
  • Familiarity with dynamic collision modeling, convex set processing, state machine logic, and multi-rate decision-making processes
  • Familiarity with agentic-based development tooling
  • Familiarity with Linux-based operating systems

Bonus Points:

  • General familiarity with machine learning, including supervised learning, reinforcement learning, training/test validation, etc.
  • Familiarity with vehicle dynamics modeling, including standard longitudinal/lateral vehicle dynamics models
  • Publications in Robotics/Controls or Autonomous Driving conferences/journals (IROS, ICRA, CoRL, RAL, TRO, CDC, ACC, TAC, CSL, Automatica, IV, ITSC, T-ITS)
  • Familiarity with SQL-based queries
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Familiarity with Gitlab, Bazel, VSCode / CLion
  • Familiarity with AV industry simulation tooling

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

Leading & scaling recommendation and search systems

Driving AI design generation & vision pipelines

  • Oversee image generation pipelines that combine LLMs/multimodal models with deep learning architectures (e.g., diffusion models, UNets, Vision Transformers) to generate high-converting designs for merchants.

  • Deepen our classical computer vision capabilities (OpenCV) alongside deep learning vision models (e.g., ResNet, CNNs, YOLO/segmentation networks) for delayering, automated background separation, print-area quality analysis, and asset validation.

Driving end-to-end product innovation (maker focus)

  • Define and refine online/offline evaluation frameworks (NDCG, MRR, visual quality metrics, merchant conversion uplift) and oversee our continuous A/B testing strategy.

  • Product maker mindset: a proven track record of taking full technical ownership of end-to-end features. You treat ML systems as products and are comfortable making architectural decisions across the whole stack, from model selection down to frontend API integration.

Sign on bonus may apply up to $15,000

Position Summary:
Manages the daily operations and delivery of physician office and professional fee coding services with adherence to established coding guidelines; responsible for managing the coordination of accurate and compliant Professional Services coding of pertinent medical information; ensures accurate assignment of codes and compliance with regulatory requirements. Assists in determining strategic priorities and planning for unit operations and participates in the audit projects and provides education to the Professional Services coding team based on the audit findings.

Job Requirement

Education/Experience:
Equivalent to a Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management or related field and five (5) years of coding/auditing experience in an acute care setting, three (3) years of which were in a supervisory/management role.

Licensing/Certification Requirements:
Certified Professional Coder (CPC); or, multiple specialty-specific coding certifications from the American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); or, Certified Coding Specialist, Physician-based (CCS-P); or, Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT); or, Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) issued from the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Physical Requirements

Knowledge of:
Federal, state and county laws and regulations governing coding; modern theories, principles and practices of effective supervision; coding principles and guidelines including, but not limited to ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/E&M, and HCPCS; coding documentation and billing regulations related to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance; revenue cycle workflows including, but not limited to charges/charge master, code edits, auditing, denials management, and documentation improvement; budget principles and practices; principles of information management including principles of confidentiality and other patient rights; data collection and analysis techniques; personal computers and associate software applications; department and hospital safety practice and procedures; patient rights; age specific patient care practices; infection control policies and practices; handling, storage, use and disposal of hazardous materials; department and hospital emergency response policies and procedures.

Skill in:
Effectively managing assigned staff; facilitating resolution of conflicts among staff; applying budget principles and practices; compiling, interpreting and evaluating statistical and medical data; identifying and implementing performance standards; problem solving; using electronic health record systems; 3M 360 or similar integrated encoder/computer-assisted coding system; utilizing personal computers for data management and information dissemination; communicating effectively with a wide variety of people from diverse socio-economic and ethnic backgrounds; establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with all personnel contacted in the course of duties; efficient, effective and safe use of equipment.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:
Mobility to work in a typical of ice setting and use standard of ice equipment, stamina to remain seated and maintain concentration for extended periods of time; vision to read printed materials and a computer screen, and hearing and speech to communicate effectively in-person and over the telephone. Strength and agility to exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. This role will be part of Stand’s Climate Finance team, and the contractor’s work will build on an existing national and international campaign to halt the expansion of oil and gas infrastructure through financial interventions.

Are you ready to hit the ground running? We are looking for someone passionate about elevating an existing campaign to maximize its impact against a newly invigorated fossil fuel industry.

We encourage applicants to apply by September 1, 2026. This position is open until filled.

About Stand.earth

Stand.earth is a nonprofit environmental organization working to create a world where respect for people and the environment comes first. Our campaigns challenge destructive corporate and governmental practices, demand accountability, and create solutions that support all of us — and the environment and climate upon which we depend. Stand’s strategic approach and fierce determination have yielded extraordinary results: Since 2000, we’ve secured the protection of millions of acres of wilderness, shifted billions of dollars of corporate purchasing and investing toward responsible options, and transformed the environmental practices of more than 100 major corporations. Stand.earth operates in the United States and Canada.

Stand recognizes and respects the sovereignty of First Nations, and the rights of Indigenous Peoples and frontline communities. These communities are often first and most directly impacted by environmental pollution and climate change, and they provide critical leadership in developing solutions.

Pollution, climate change, and corporations’ bad behavior disproportionately hurts the most marginalized people in society — including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women and LGBTQ+ people. To develop transformative solutions, these communities must be centered in the work we do. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other historically marginalized communities. If you require assistance applying to this opportunity, please contact .

Scope of Work:

Key Responsibilities

  • With support from the rest of the Climate Finance Team, increase the impact of an existing campaign to slow and stop final investment decisions for new LNG projects in Canada.
  • Work with our Communications and Engagement team to develop digital and communications strategies and products to support this campaign.
  • Act as a spokesperson for this campaign as directed.
  • Act as a representative for the campaign in Canadian and international coalition spaces, and coordinate our efforts with partners and allies.
  • Work with frontline communities, including First Nations, that are impacted by proposed LNG projects.

Qualifications and Skills

  • At least five years of experience campaigning on political, environmental or social justice campaigns
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing effective public campaign strategies and tactics
  • Able to anticipate and identify key related external public discourse moments to strategically insert our messaging.

  • Committed to equity, racial justice, authentic communications, standing up for impacted communities, and continual learning

  • Strong preference for a candidate with climate and other community networks and knowledge of the political and cultural landscape in Canada
  • Preference for experience with digital campaigning and communications
Projected Contract Hours & Rate:

This is a full-time contract position for the term of nine months with strong potential for extension. The hourly rate offered will be $50 CAD per hour for up to 32 hours per week. Stand.earth operates under a four-day work week with offices closed on Fridays.

The location for this contract position is fully remote in Canada with the option to be in our office space in Vancouver. The candidate must be willing and able to do occasional travel within Canada.

jobs.description:
Principal Drainage Engineer / Hydrologist | Remote, UK

Naturally Compliant is a forward-thinking environmental and construction consultancy delivering integrated ecological, environmental, and engineering services across the UK.

As we grow our multidisciplinary offer, we are looking for an experienced Principal Drainage Engineer or Hydrologist to lead and develop our water and drainage service line.

This is a high-impact, senior role with genuine autonomy and the opportunity to shape a service, build a team, and deliver technically excellent work across a diverse and growing project portfolio.

The Role

As technical lead for water and drainage, you will take ownership of service delivery across permanent and temporary drainage design, construction phase pollution control, and sustainable water management.

Working closely with our ecology and environmental teams, you will play a key role in integrating drainage and hydrological expertise into multidisciplinary project delivery.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading the technical delivery of drainage and hydrology commissions, from feasibility and concept through to detailed design and construction support
  • Designing permanent and temporary drainage systems for a range of development and infrastructure projects
  • Developing and implementing construction phase pollution prevention and treatment solutions
  • Providing sustainable water management advice, including SuDS design, runoff attenuation, and water quality assessment
  • Acting as technical reviewer and quality assurer across the water and drainage service
  • Managing project programmes, budgets, and deliverables across multiple concurrent commissions
  • Coordinating internally with ecology, environmental, and project management colleagues to support integrated service delivery
  • Engaging with clients, local authorities, the Environment Agency, and other statutory consultees throughout the project lifecycle
  • Leading on business development activity - identifying opportunities, nurturing client relationships, preparing fee proposals and tenders
  • Developing and growing the water and drainage service line, including contributing to resourcing and capability planning

About You

Essential:

  • Significant experience in drainage engineering or hydrology, ideally within a consultancy environment, operating at Senior or Principal level
  • Proven track record in designing drainage systems, SuDS schemes, or construction phase water treatment or pollution control solutions
  • Solid project management skills — comfortable coordinating timelines, budgets, and deliverables across multiple projects simultaneously
  • Experience engaging with statutory consultees and managing stakeholder relationships throughout the planning and consenting process
  • Business development experience, including client relationship management and bid preparation
  • Full driving licence and access to your own vehicle
  • CSCS card held or willingness to obtain

Desirable:

  • On-site construction phase experience
  • Familiarity with ecological and environmental constraints and how drainage design interfaces with protected species, habitats, and biodiversity net gain
  • Experience working within or alongside multidisciplinary environmental consultancies
  • Chartership with CIWEM, ICE, or equivalent professional body

You will also bring:

You are a technically confident engineer with the interpersonal skills to match — equally comfortable negotiating with a statutory body, or guiding a junior colleague through a complex design problem.

You are proactive, commercially aware, and motivated by the opportunity to build something: a service line, a client base, and a reputation for technical excellence in a business that genuinely cares about environmental outcomes.

What's on Offer

  • Salary: £50,000 – £60,000+ depending on experience
  • 7% employer pension contribution
  • 25 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
  • Health, Wellbeing, and Volunteer days
  • Private health insurance
  • EV Salary Sacrifice Scheme
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Performance-related profit share scheme

APPLY NOW or reach out to Jim Merryfield at CleanTech Talent for more information.

Naturally Compliant is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

jobs.excerpt: Jeder redet über Geldanlage.  Kaum jemand zeigt, wie Profis es wirklich machen: ihr Setup, ihre Psyche, ihre schlimmsten Verluste und was sie danach anders gemacht haben.
jobs.description:
Jeder redet über Geldanlage. Kaum jemand zeigt, wie Profis es wirklich machen: ihr Setup, ihre Psyche, ihre schlimmsten Verluste und was sie danach anders gemacht haben. Banken verkaufen Produkte, Finfluencer verkaufen Hypes, ETF-Kanäle halten aktives Handeln für Unsinn. Das echte Handwerk bleibt dabei auf der Strecke.

Bei [Bulle & Mensch] spreche ich mit Trading-Weltmeistern und Millionären zwei Stunden lang über alles, auch über das, was wehtut. Ich frage als Lernender, nicht als Lehrer. Deshalb reden meine Gäste offen - und du siehst, was sie anders machen als du und ich.

Wenn wir das nicht bauen, baut es im deutschsprachigen Raum niemand. Du würdest unser Wachstum von Grund auf mit aufbauen, mit KI als Werkzeug und viel Freiheit.

Wenn du es ernst meinst - melde dich. Viel Erfolg beim Ziehen deines persönlichen Alphas.

Aufgaben

1. Longform-Schnitt in Riverside (Kern der Aufgabe)

  • Du bearbeitest das gesamte Gespräch in Riverside - von der Rohaufnahme bis zur fertigen Podcast-Folge - bestmöglich automatisiert und KI gestützt/mit MCP.

  • Audio-Cleanup, Layout (Split-Screen / Speaker-View), Farbkorrektur und Branding direkt in Riverside.

2. Trailer (Opener) für jede Folge

  • Du baust aus dem Gespräch einen packenden Trailer (ca. 60 bis 90 Sekunden) als Einstieg in die Folge. Das Drehbuch dazu ist fertig - du fokussierst dich auf die Bearbeitung.

  • Die Auswahl der stärksten Aussagen triffst du nach dem Gefälle-Prinzip: Der Zuschauer merkt, dass es um sein eigenes Depot geht.

  • Tool ist frei wählbar (Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Riverside etc.).

3. Shorts (optional, kein Muss)

  • Wenn du Lust und Können hast: vertikale Clips (Shorts / Reels) aus den besten Stellen des Gesprächs.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Videoschnitt - Praktikum, eigene Projekte oder Kanal reichen. Du musst kein Profi sein, aber sauber arbeiten.

  • Du kennst Riverside oder bist bereit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten (wir zeigen dir alles).

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit KI und nutzt KI-Funktionen in deinen Tools aktiv (z.B. Riverside Magic Audio, KI-Schnitt, Transkript-Suche).

  • Gutes Gespür für Rhythmus, Spannung und Story in langen Gesprächen.

  • Zuverlässig: Sonntag 6 Uhr ist fix. Die Folge muss davor fertig sein.

  • Deutsch fließend.

Benefits

  • Feste Verantwortung: Du bekommst einen klaren Bereich, der von Anfang bis Ende deiner ist.

  • Klarer Prozess: Alle Abläufe sind dokumentiert. Du weißt immer, was zu tun ist.

  • Remote und flexibel: Du arbeitest, wann und wo du willst, solange die Deadline steht.

  • Feedback direkt vom Host. Kurze Wege, keine Agentur dazwischen.

  • Wachstum: Wer gut liefert, übernimmt mehr.

  • Mitarbeiterangebote (Rabatte bei 1500+ Unternehmen)

Schick uns:

  • Den Bereich, in dem du mitmachen willst

  • 2 bis 3 Beispiele deiner Arbeit (Links reichen)

  • 3 Sätze zu dir: Warum du, warum [Bulle & Mensch]?

  • Deine Verfügbarkeit pro Woche und deine Preisvorstellung

Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

The Director of Quality Assurance is responsible for defining and leading the global quality strategy across the company’s product portfolio. This role provides horizontal/dotted-line leadership to approximately 150 QA and Automation QA engineers across 10 global product teams. The position drives consistent quality practices, modernization of QA capabilities, AI-enabled testing, and a culture of efficiency and innovation. This leader plays a critical role in driving business growth, competitive advantage, and customer retention by ensuring reliable, scalable, and high-performing product experiences. The Senior Director will also prepare and deliver executive-level quality reports, insights, and recommendations to C-level stakeholders.

Security Clearance Requirement: Candidates must hold a valid and active security clearance appropriate to the requirements of the role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Quality Strategy, Governance & Innovation

  • Develop and maintain a unified quality strategy aligned with organizational and product goals.
  • Define QA standards, processes, tools, and governance mechanisms across all product lines.
  • Lead quality improvement initiatives, audits, and transformation programs.
  • Drive the adoption of AI/ML-based quality, testing, and risk assessment tools.
  • Champion a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Define, track, and report key quality metrics including defect rates, release stability, automation effectiveness, and customer-reported issues.
  • Prepare clear, concise executive-level reports and dashboards for C-level leadership.

Global QA Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide dotted-line leadership to ~150 QA/AQA professionals across 10 distributed product teams.
  • Mentor QA managers, leads, and senior engineers, fostering talent development and capability growth.
  • Build and maintain a competency framework emphasizing automation (UI, backend, e2e), quality engineering, AI literacy, and modern testing disciplines.
  • Promote collaboration, consistency, and best-practice adoption across globally distributed teams.
  • Instill an efficiency-first mindset and passion for quality, innovation, and customer value.

Quality Engineering, Automation & AI Enablement

  • Oversee functional, regression, integration, performance, security, and automated testing practices.
  • Advance automation strategies and frameworks to support CI/CD pipelines and modern engineering delivery models.
  • Support risk-based test planning and strategic testing for complex, multi-product environments.
  • Lead integration of AI-assisted testing, generative AI tools, intelligent automation, and predictive quality insights.
  • Introduce tools and technologies that improve test effectiveness, coverage, and speed.
  • Ensure continuous learning and adaptation to emerging QA technologies, tools, and industry trends.

Release Quality, Delivery Readiness & Risk Management

  • Ensure alignment on release criteria, quality gates, and readiness standards across product teams.
  • Partner with Engineering and Product to improve release stability, predictability, and performance.
  • Oversee defect detection mechanisms and provide visibility into quality risks throughout the SDLC.
  • Participate in critical release reviews, escalations, and post-release evaluations.
  • Utilize AI tools and analytics to enhance release risk assessment and decision-making.
  • Ensure timely communication of risks, priorities, and release readiness to senior leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Impact

  • Work with Product Management to ensure requirements are testable and quality expectations are defined.
  • Collaborate with Customer Support and Customer Success to resolve customer-found issues efficiently and sustainably.
  • Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Services teams during escalations or customer-critical engagements.
  • Communicate quality risks, priorities, and metrics to stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Identify cross-functional opportunities for automation, AI-enabled improvements, and operational efficiency.
  • Strengthen customer retention and competitive positioning through improved product quality and reliability.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of QA, Quality Engineering, or Software Testing experience.
  • 7+ years in QA leadership roles with responsibility across multiple products and global teams.
  • Experience with automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and modern SDLC practices.
  • Proven ability to lead in a matrixed/dotted-line environment.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted testing or ML-driven quality tools.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business functions.
  • Passion for quality, innovation, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience preparing and presenting reports and insights to C-level executives.

Preferred:

  • Experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise software.
  • Knowledge of generative AI, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation technologies.
  • Experience in large-scale QA modernization and organizational change initiatives.

*Please submit your resume and application in English

Security Clearance Requirement: Candidates must hold a valid and active security clearance appropriate to the requirements of the role.


WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

This opportunity is a good fit for US-based physicians open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified with the issuing medical board);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);

This opportunity is not fit to medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

jobs.description:
PAXAFE is a GxP cold chain decision intelligence platform that eliminates silos, ensures compliance, and empowers teams with contextual intelligence to drive towards zero waste.

​

Acting as the cold chain operating system for every time, temperature and value sensitive shipment in the universe, PAXAFE works with cold chain manufactures and service providers to enhance supply chain planning and intelligence, enable logistics execution, and streamline end-to-end product disposition and batch traceability as system of record.

PAXAFE is backed by venture investors (Framework Venture Partners, Ubiquity Ventures, Venture53, RoseCliff Ventures, etc.) and corporate ventures (Microsoft M12, Northwestern Mutual, Greenlight Re)

The Role

This role bridges and orchestrates the handoff between what was sold and what gets built. As Senior Solution Engineer you facilitate both sides of it.

Before the contract, you are the technical and process authority in the room. You run discovery with quality, logistics and IT stakeholders, demo the platform against the customer's real cold chain problem rather than a generic script, and shape the initial solution design that underpins the commercial proposal. After signature, you stay on. You translate that design into a delivery plan, then support where needed alongside Delivery, Product and Engineering to make it real.

That continuity is the point. You scope what you will be accountable for delivering, which means the solution design that reaches the customer is the one that survives implementation. You are the single technical thread from first discovery call through to a customer operating in production.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role in PAXAFE's Commercial Organization, working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Discovery. Run technical and process discovery with customers across supply chain, quality, logistics, and IT, uncovering current-state workflows, data sources, systems and constraints.
  • Pre-sales. Deliver tailored demonstrations mapped to the customer's own lanes, products and release process, not a standard script. Handle technical objections in the room.
  • Solutioning. Own the initial solution design and solution map: which modules apply, what data is required, which integrations are in play, what is phased and what is out of scope.
  • Scoping. Translate the solution design into scoped, sequenced statements of work and implementation plans. Size effort honestly, surface long-lead items and dependencies before they become commitments.
  • Commercial support. Partner with Sales and the CCO on proposals and order forms, ensuring what is committed commercially is technically deliverable. Flag anything that is not.
  • Delivery. Carry your own design into delivery. Lead solution workshops, guide configuration of Lane Qualification, Command Center and Automated Product Release against customer stability budgets and product profiles, and stay accountable through go-live.
  • Cross-functional. Coordinate with Product, Data and Engineering to sequence deliverables, manage technical handoffs, and feed real customer patterns back into the roadmap.
  • Repeatability. Build the reusable assets: reference solution designs, discovery question banks, scoping templates, and integration patterns that make the next deal faster.
  • Tooling. Track work in Linear; understand customer issues in Pylon, map solutions in Figma / FigJam. Document decisions so they survive handoff.

Who We're Looking For

Experience

Required

  • 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles across the software sales cycle and delivery: Solution Engineer, Solution Architect, Presales Consultant, Implementation Lead, or management/technology consulting with hands-on SaaS delivery.
  • Demonstrable experience on both sides of contract signature. You have scoped work in a sales cycle and then been accountable for delivering it.
  • Strong supply chain and process background: an ability to map a customer's current-state process, find where it breaks, and design a workable future state rather than describing features.
  • Cold chain domain knowledge: temperature-controlled logistics, lanes and lane qualification, temperature excursions, stability budgets, passive and active monitoring, product release decisions.
  • Consulting-grade communication. Comfortable with a quality director, a logistics operator, an enterprise architect and a CFO, and able to write a scope document that holds up under procurement and legal review.
  • Practical technical fluency: APIs, data mapping and transformation, integration patterns. You need to be credible with engineers without being one.
  • Track record running multiple concurrent customer engagements with real deadlines.

Bonus Qualifications

Preferred

  • Life sciences exposure: Pharma, biotech, CDMO, or medical devices, and familiarity with GxP-regulated and compliance-driven environments / validation expectations.
  • Familiarity with the systems this role meets in the field: SAP, Oracle, TMS platforms, QMS such as Veeva Vault or TrackWise, visibility platforms, packaging providers, 4PLs and carriers, and logger ecosystems (Elpro, Sensitech, Tive, TempMate, etc.).
  • Experience selling or delivering into enterprise Pharma procurement and quality organizations.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, Python, Postman, Prismatic, PostgreSQL / Supabase, and JSON-based data workflows.
  • Additional languages; comfort working across US and European time zones and traveling up to 25%

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • High-impact mission: every project supports the safe, on-time delivery of the world's most important products, including vaccines and life-saving therapies.
  • A genuinely unique remit: most companies split pre-sales and delivery and then absorb the cost of the handoff. Here you own the whole arc.
  • You'll work with the world's leading life sciences companies (pharma, CDMOs, medical devices, biotech) on some of the most advanced therapies in the world.
  • PAXAFE has entered an exciting growth phase, which provides for, and requires, real autonomy and leadership at every level.
  • Direct visibility to the executive team, and influence over how the Commercial Organization scales.
  • Cutting-edge tech: LLMs and Agentic AI | Azure | Python | Prismatic | Supabase | PostgreSQL | LavinMQ | Inngest | IoT | Linear | Figma.
  • Remote-first flexibility. [CONFIRM: preferred region for this role]
  • Comprehensive benefits: competitive base salary, equity participation, five weeks PTO, and full healthcare coverage.

Our Core Values

  • Create Magic: Deliver products that exceed customer expectations and solve real problems elegantly
  • Own With Pride: Take ownership of outcomes and deliver with excellence
  • Navigate With Intent: Make strategic decisions with clarity and purpose
  • Think Deep, Act Fast: Balance thorough analysis with rapid execution
  • Enjoy the Journey: Celebrate wins and maintain perspective
  • X-hibit Teamwork: Collaborate across functions and support each other's success
  • Tackle With Empathy: Understand customer and team needs deeply before proposing solutions

Ready to build the future of AI-powered pharmaceutical supply chain intelligence?

If you're ready to join the leader in cold chain decision intelligence — creating cutting edge agentic solutions that serve a direct impact on patient health — then we want to hear from you! Apply today and let's build this together.

Please include:

  • Your resume highlighting product management experience with AI/ML products or data-intensive B2B/SaaS platforms
  • A brief description of an AI-powered feature or product you've shipped and its measurable impact
  • Any experience with pharmaceutical, cold chain, life sciences, or logistics domains
  • Your vision for how LLMs and agentic AI can transform enterprise supply chain operations

Position Highlights

Location: This position is remote with occasional travel required to Oregon. Oregon-based candidates are preferred. The successful candidate will be hired by the CDC Foundation and will be organizationally located with Oregon Health Authority (OHA).

Salary Range: $90,000-$120,000 plus benefits. Individual salary offers will be based on experience and qualifications unique to each candidate.

Position Type: Grant funded, limited-term opportunity

Position End Date: October 30, 2028, with extension possible

Overview

The CDC Foundation is seeking a Project Manager to lead project management efforts for the Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) Operations team at the Oregon Health Authority, ensuring cohesive planning, implementation and oversight of RHTP Operations workstreams. This position serves as a senior operational strategist responsible for building and maintaining the project schedule for operations workstreams, monitoring daily task progression, coordinating operational responsibilities across the central RHTP team, elevating emerging operational risks and ensuring operational excellence in alignment with CMS requirements. They will provide collaborative partnership to the Senior Operations Policy Lead, both of whom work with the Deputy Director of Operations to lead the team ensuring strategic alignment and efficient operations.

The position ensures integration across operational systems by managing internal team communications, coordinating cross-functional workflows, maintaining operations-led implementation schedules and supporting the development and refinement of tracking systems that uphold compliance and performance. The Operations Project Manager plays a critical role in building and improving the operational infrastructure needed to manage multi-year deliverables and funding pathways, ensuring RHTP operations run efficiently, consistently, and transparently. This includes applying advanced project management methodologies; supporting streamlined processes for grant execution and procurement; and supporting system improvements that strengthen internal operations across the five-year grant period.

The position works closely with the Policy & Programs Project Manager, the Program Affairs & Communications Project Manager, the RHTP Program Manager and RHTP leadership to ensure that operational activities are strategically aligned, on schedule, well-documented and progressing in accordance with CMS guidelines, timelines and priorities—supporting overall program and CMS coherence, impact and operational excellence.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Translate CMS cooperative agreement requirements into actionable operational plans, schedules and process workflows.
  • Build and maintain detailed project plans using advanced tools such as Smartsheet to monitor daily operational tasks, key deadlines, dependencies and milestones.

  • Manage operational components of RHTP grantmaking, including supporting development of Smartsheet dashboards and workflows used to track grant execution, agreement routing and compliance processes.
  • Coordinate operational partnerships with the Office of Contracts and Procurement (OC&P) and HPA Contracts to ensure timely signing, countersigning and processing of RHTP grant agreements.
