  • Designs and executes operational meeting structures, agendas, materials and follow‑up tracking to support consistent cross‑team alignment and execution.
  • Synthesizes operational updates into executive‑level summaries and reporting for program leadership, highlighting risks, accomplishments, and required decisions.
  • Leads development, implementation, and continuous improvement of operational systems, procedures, tools, and templates that increase efficiency, reduce administrative burden, and support consistent workflows across the five year program.
  • Creates standardized Smartsheet platforms, operational SOPs, intake workflows, and documentation systems to support operations staff, grant coordinators, procurement partners, and contractors.
  • Evaluates internal operational systems for inefficiencies, gaps, or performance challenges; designs and implements corrective strategies that strengthen operational reliability and scalability.

  • Models operational technology improvements such as AdobeSign workflows, routing processes, or automation of multi‑step operational tasks.
  • Coordinates operational components of competitive RHTP grantmaking, including Smartsheet tracking systems, workflow automation, document management and agreement routing.
  • Partners with OC&P and HPA Contracts to ensure timely preparation, routing, review, signing, countersigning and filing of RHTP grant agreements and related procurement documents.
  • Ensures operational activities adhere to CMS requirements, cooperative agreement conditions, state procurement policies and agency‑wide operational guidelines.
  • Tracks and monitors operational compliance across RHTP systems, escalating concerns or deviations to leadership when needed.
  • Identifies, monitors, and evaluates operational risks including constrained timelines, staffing capacity challenges, system bottlenecks and shifting annual funding requirements.
  • Maintains and governs operational risk logs, ensuring risks are documented, actionable, monitored and used to inform decision‑making.
  • Designs and oversees mitigation strategies to prevent operational issues from escalating or impacting program‑wide deliverables.
  • Advises leadership on implications of operational delays, resource needs, scope changes and system readiness issues, recommending operational adjustments to maintain alignment with CMS expectations.
  • Performs other duties related to Rural Health Transformation Program operations as assigned.

Qualifications and Necessary Skills:

  • Experience applying regulatory knowledge and sound judgment to ensure compliance with laws, standards and organizational policies.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Special Notes

The CDC Foundation is an independent nonprofit authorized by Congress to mobilize philanthropic partners to support the public health system, including the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in preventing and responding to threats to health. Job Title: Project Manager

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Project Manager to own and drive our core operational pipelines: new product development (NPD), go-to-market product launches, and our ongoing packaging/rebrand rollout across our product portfolio.

In this role, you will act as the central POC transitioning products from initial concept through development, print production, listing creation, and launch. You will coordinate cross-functionally across internal teams (marketing, creative, compliance, supply chain) and external partners (printers, packaging vendors, marketplace partners) to keep every product and SKU moving smoothly on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Product Development & Pipeline Management

  • Own and maintain the master product development pipeline and launch calendar.
  • Coordinate cross-functional milestones across formulation/product development, packaging design, regulatory compliance, and supply chain setup.
  • Establish critical project milestones, track dependencies, identify operational risks, and proactively eliminate bottlenecks.
  • Ensure every active SKU development project has clear ownership, timelines, checklists, and status visibility.

2. Go-to-Market Launch Execution & Marketplace Readiness

  • Drive launch execution from pre-launch planning through live market availability across Amazon, DTC, and marketplace channels.
  • Coordinate marketplace listing setup and asset readiness, including titles, bullet points, images, A+ content, backend keywords, pricing, and compliance documentation.
  • Align inventory availability, warehouse/FBA readiness, and marketing activation dates for smooth go-live execution.
  • Track post-launch performance metrics (sales, listing health, traffic, conversion) and conduct post-launch reviews to continually refine our launch playbook.

3. Packaging Rollout & Version Control Management

  • Manage artwork version control, dielines, and print production tracking across existing and updated SKUs.
  • Coordinate directly with packaging vendors and print manufacturers on specifications, proof approvals, and lead times.
  • Sequence packaging updates and rebrand rollouts against existing inventory depletion to prevent stockouts or scrapped inventory.
  • Route packaging artwork through design and regulatory compliance sign-off.
  • Maintain clean status tracking for all SKU packaging updates rolled out in planned, batched waves.

4. Process Ownership & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Build, document, and continuously refine standard operating procedures (SOPs), launch templates, and project tracking dashboards.
  • Serve as the single point of contact for status updates across product development, launches, and rebrand updates.
  • Drive cross-functional accountability without needing direct authority over every contributor.

Required

  • 3+ years of project management experience in CPG, ecommerce, consumer health/supplements, or physical consumer products.
  • Familiarity with ecommerce platforms and marketplace operations (e.g., Amazon Seller Central, FBA setup, or DTC platforms).
  • High proficiency with modern project management software (e.g., Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com) and spreadsheet tracking dashboards.
  • Exceptional organization, task management, and cross-functional communication
    skills.

Preferred

  • Proven track record or translatable experience in managing physical product launches and cross-functional development pipelines from concept through market launch.
  • Experience with packaging workflows, print production tracking, dielines, and artwork version control.
  • Experience in regulated consumer products (dietary supplements, food & beverage, personal care) and compliance review workflows.
  • Experience with Amazon listing structures, variation setups, and launch readiness.
  • Strong background building SOPs and operational workflows for high-velocity product teams.

Benefits & Work Setup

About Doit

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor de verdere ontwikkeling en professionalisering van een modern cloudgebaseerd dataplatform zoeken we een ervaren data engineer die schaalbare en betrouwbare data-oplossingen ontwerpt, realiseert en beheert.

Je werkt aan een dataplatform met een moderne data-architectuur, waarbij Microsoft Fabric centraal staat, samen met Power BI, Python en grootschalige datapipelines. Je zet rapporterings- en databehoeften om in performante datamodellen, efficiënte pipelines en herbruikbare data-assets, zodat eindgebruikers kunnen rekenen op consistente en bruikbare inzichten.

Daarnaast lever je inhoudelijke input rond architectuur, data governance, datakwaliteit, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid. Je stemt geregeld af met analisten, rapporteringsspecialisten, architecten, eindgebruikers en andere betrokkenen.

  • Je ontwerpt, bouwt, optimaliseert en onderhoudt schaalbare datapipelines binnen een moderne cloud data-omgeving.
  • Je realiseert data-integraties vanuit diverse bronsystemen, zoals relationele databanken, API's, bestanden en applicaties.
  • Je werkt lakehouse-, warehouse- en medaillonarchitecturen uit en beheert die, met aandacht voor herbruikbaarheid, performantie en datakwaliteit.
  • Je vertaalt rapporterings- en analysebehoeften naar heldere datamodellen en betrouwbare datasets.
  • Je ontwerpt en implementeert ETL-processen voor de verwerking van datastromen op schaal.
  • Je ondersteunt rapporterings- en analyticsomgevingen met kwalitatieve en consistente data-oplossingen.
  • Je monitort, documenteert en verbetert bestaande dataflows, pipelines en dataprocessen doorlopend.
  • Je neemt dataprojecten zelfstandig op, van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie en oplevering.
  • Je overlegt met business stakeholders, data-analisten, architecten en technische teams over vereisten, oplossingen en opleveringen.
  • Je draagt bij aan standaarden, best practices, CI/CD, versiebeheer en de deployment van data-oplossingen.
  • Je helpt de maturiteit van het datalandschap verder te verhogen en stimuleert kennisdeling binnen de omgeving.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als senior data engineer.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met cloudgebaseerde data-architecturen en met lakehouse- of warehouseconcepten binnen Azure.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Microsoft Fabric, in het bijzonder met pipelines, dataflows en notebooks.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met data-integratie vanuit meerdere bronsystemen.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python, Java of Scala voor de ontwikkeling van datastromen en ETL-processen.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Python binnen data engineering. Ervaring op mediorniveau in deze context is vereist.
  • Je beschikt over aantoonbare kennis van SQL en query-optimalisatie.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met databanken en met Spark of Spark-gebaseerde verwerking.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met CI/CD, versiebeheer en deployment van data-oplossingen.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Power BI en met het ondersteunen van rapporterings- en analyticsomgevingen.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met medaillonarchitectuur, bijvoorbeeld met bronze-, silver- en gold-lagen.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van data governance, data quality management en lineage.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van datamodellering volgens de Kimball-methodologie.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis van lakehouse-, datamesh- of domein-georiënteerde data-architecturen.
  • Ervaring binnen een publieke, stedelijke of complexe enterprise-omgeving is belangrijk.
  • Je drukt je uitstekend uit in het Nederlands. Taalniveau C2 is vereist.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.title: Norsktalende teknisk kundeservicemedarbeider for Samsung
jobs.excerpt: General Information Location Work at Home Job ID 14038 Job Category Customer Service Representative (CSR) Description & requirements Description Vi ser etter en svært motivert og teknisk person til å bli med i vårt tekniske supportteam for Samsung.
jobs.description:
General Information

Location
Work at Home
Job ID
14038
Job Category
Customer Service Representative (CSR)

Description & requirements

Description

Vi ser etter en svært motivert og teknisk person til å bli med i vårt tekniske supportteam for Samsung. Som representant for teknisk support og brukerstøtte vil du ha den unike muligheten til å spille en viktig rolle i å gi førsteklasses assistanse til Samsungs kunder, feilsøke tekniske problemer og gjøre det mulig for dem å maksimere bruken av sine høyteknologiske produkter.

Transcom er et globalt fellesskap av kundeserviceeksperter. Alle er smarte, nysgjerrige, målorienterte, ivrige etter å lære og engasjerte i verdens beste og mest elskede merkevarer. Vi ser etter en norsktalende teknologiekspert som elsker å hjelpe andre, brenner for å tilby utmerket kundeservice og har en ekte lidenskap for teknologiens og AI-verdenen – og vi ønsker at du skal være en del av oss. Dette er den perfekte muligheten for en teknologinerd.

Hva får du ut av det?

Hos Transcom fremmer vi et internasjonalt og inkluderende miljø som får deg til å føle deg støttet, oppmuntret og velkommen fra dag én. Vi er forpliktet til din vekst og suksess.

  • Tjenesten er fulltid på distans- du kan jobbe hjemmefra om du bor i Sverige

  • En hybridløsning om du bor i Stockholms område, der du kan kombinere å jobbe både hjemme og på kontoret

  • Byggefrontteknologi – Hold deg i forkant av teknologien og jobb med de nyeste tekniske produktene og innovasjonene.

  • Karriereutvikling – Vi tilbyr robuste faglige utviklingsprogrammer, veiledning og muligheter for avansement innenfor vårt mangfoldige kundeopplevelsesteam. Dette er din sjanse til å vokse og utvikle deg i en dynamisk og fartsfylt bransje.

  • Gjør en reell forskjell – Forbedre brukernes liv direkte ved å løse deres tekniske utfordringer og veilede dem til å maksimere verdien av enhetene sine. Din rolle er avgjørende for å sikre at brukerne våre får mest mulig ut av teknologien sin og gjør en reell forskjell i livene sine.

  • Fast heltidskontrakt.

  • Helse og velvære: Omfattende forsikrings- og pensjonsordning, samt tilgang til et kostnadsfritt treningsstudio på arbeidsplassen og rabatterte måltider gjennom Edenred-programmet.

Bli med i teamet vårt som teknisk supportekspert og brukerstøtteekspert!

Samsung er i forkant av markedet når det gjelder fremtidens teknologi. I denne rollen fungerer du som en brukerstøtter. Du lytter til og forstår brukernes spørsmål og sørger for at de forstår hvordan de best kan gå videre. Ditt oppdrag vil inkludere å løse problemer, men det stopper ikke der; du vil sørge for at brukeren får mest mulig ut av sitt teknologiprodukt, samtidig som du bruker de beste banebrytende teknologiverktøyene for å hjelpe deg i ditt daglige arbeid. Dine primære oppgaver er å bruke din dyptgående kunnskap om teknologiproduktene til å diagnostisere og løse komplekse problemer, og være en forkjemper for kundene våre, ivareta deres behov og tilby eksepsjonell service.

Hva vi ser etter:

  • Morsmålstalende eller flytende norsk

  • Fremragende engelskkunnskaper (B2+) Skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Sterk interesse for feilsøking av maskinvare og programvare på ulike elektroniske enheter.

  • En lidenskap for å lære og forstå mobile operativsystemer (Android og IOS) og generell programvare.

  • Entusiasme for problemløsning og en naturlig tilnærming til diagnostisering og feilsøking av tekniske problemer.

  • En positiv holdning og en sterk evne til å håndtere stress effektivt.

  • Utmerkede lytteferdigheter og en genuin interesse for å bygge sterke kunderelasjoner.

  • En kreativ tankegang og ressurssterkhet for å finne innovative løsninger og alternative alternativer.

  • Startdato = 16.11.2026

Hvordan er livet hos Transcom?

Vi har over 30 000 spesialister på kundeopplevelse i 29 land med 90 lokasjoner, og leverer tjenester på 33 språk til internasjonale merkevarer på tvers av bransjer. På grunn av vår nylige suksess utvider vi våre prisbelønte team og investerer i våre ansatte.

Hos Transcom er vi dypt dedikert forpliktet. Til våre kunder og til hverandre. Hver dag starter noen sin reise med Transcom. Å ta potensialet de har i dag og gjøre det om til ferdigheter for fremtiden. Å bli anerkjent for å jobbe hardt, være en lagspiller og støtte andre. Å kjempe for positiv, varig endring i sine team og lokalsamfunn. Det er bare slik vi er hos Transcom. Her bryr vi oss om og heier på hverandre. Du er inkludert, akkurat som du er, fra dag én. Og med riktig tankesett er det ingen grenser for hvor langt vi kan nå sammen. Vi er forpliktet til din vekst og suksess.

Hvis profilen din samsvarer med det vi ser etter, vil vi invitere deg til et av våre digitale intervjuer. Der vil vi gi deg mer informasjon om stillingen og bli bedre kjent med deg. Intervjuer pågår, så send inn søknaden din så snart som mulig.

Vi er en arbeidsgiver som tilbyr like muligheter, og alle kvalifiserte søkere vil bli vurdert for ansettelse uten hensyn til rase, hudfarge, religion, kjønn, nasjonal opprinnelse, funksjonsnedsettelse, status som vernet veteran eller andre egenskaper som er beskyttet av loven.

jobs.excerpt: The ProblemSevere mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States.
jobs.description:
The Problem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

The Problem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

Who We Are

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation that delivers specialty outpatient care for people living with severe mental illness, including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar I disorder, and treatment-resistant depression. We design and operate high-acuity, in-person clinics across the United States.

Our model integrates psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community health workers under one roof to deliver coordinated, longitudinal care for a population that has historically been fragmented across systems.

Leading health systems collaborate with Amae to bring this model to their communities, including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit Health. Our investors include health systems such as Cedars-Sinai and CommonSpirit Health, organizations that evaluated our model clinically and chose to back it.

Why We Are Different

Many clinicians who join Amae have worked in PHPs, IOPs, inpatient psychiatry, or community mental health. They understand the limitations of the traditional system. Amae was built to change that—for patients and for clinicians.

Integrated care, not a referral network. Psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers work side-by-side and share responsibility for the same patients.

Practice at the top of your license. Manageable caseloads, meaningful clinical depth, and purpose-built tools designed for this population.

Continuous learning. Through our partnership with Mass General Brigham, clinicians receive ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care.

Advancing the field. Our clinicians contribute to new outcomes frameworks and research shaping the future of severe mental illness care.

A model built for sustainability. Team-based care, thoughtful caseloads, and strong infrastructure make this work meaningful—and sustainable over time.

The Opportunity:

We are hiring a part-time (24 hours/week) Virtual Intake Therapist to serve as the clinical front door for prospective members across our California clinics. This is a fully virtual, licensed clinical role responsible for conducting comprehensive intake assessments and determining the right course of care for individuals living with serious mental illness (SMI).

Every person who reaches out to Amae for the first time will go through you. You'll conduct the clinical intake assessment — biopsychosocial history, mental status exam, risk assessment, diagnostic impression and level of care determination — and make the call: is this person a fit for Amae's integrated SMI care model, and if so, which clinic and care team should take them on? If not, you'll provide an appropriate referral rather than force a fit that isn't right.

This role centralizes and standardizes the intake function that today lives with individual Clinic Directors, giving prospective members a faster, more consistent front door across every California clinic.

What You'll Do:

  • Comprehensive Virtual Intake Assessment - Conduct virtual biopsychosocial assessments, mental status exams, and risk assessments for individuals inquiring about Amae's services.
  • Level of Care & Fit Determination - Determine whether Amae's integrated SMI care model is clinically appropriate for the prospective member, and determine their qualification to join our PHP or IOP programs. If they are not a fit, provide referrals to a more appropriate level or type of care.
  • Diagnostic Impressions - Develop diagnostic impressions and preliminary treatment recommendations to hand off to the receiving clinic's care team.
  • Clinic Coordination - Interface with Clinic Directors and care teams across California regarding patient appropriateness and readiness for programming, ensuring a smooth warm hand-off.
  • Family & Referrer Communication - Answer questions from prospective members, their families, and referring providers about Amae's programs, and screen inbound referrals for appropriateness.
  • Represent Amae’s Program - Engage potential members and their caregivers on what Amae Health’s program entails, what differentiates our outcomes, and how members might benefit from our program. Communicate our program effectively while ensuring the patient’s needs are met
  • Documentation & Utilization Review - Maintain accurate, timely intake documentation, and coordinate with the utilization review/insurance authorization process.
  • Overflow Clinical Coverage (as needed) - Provide occasional individual or group therapy coverage across California clinics during lower-intake-volume periods.

About You:

You've done real clinical intake work before and you're comfortable being the person who makes the call on fit and level of care. You ask good questions, listen for what's underneath the presenting complaint, and you're not afraid to say no to a referral that isn't right for Amae's model. You're organized enough to manage a full day of assessments without losing the thread on any one person, and you communicate clearly and quickly with our enrollment team and Clinic Directors so hand-offs don't drop. You're comfortable doing all of this over video, with the same rigor you'd bring in person.

What We're Looking For

  • An active license to practice as a therapist in California (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or Licensed Psychologist), in good standing is required. Supervision hours are not available for this role.
  • Master's or Doctoral degree in social work, psychology, counseling, or a related clinical field
  • Prior experience conducting clinical intake assessments, diagnostic evaluations, and/or level-of-care determinations, ideally in a PHP/IOP, community mental health, or hospital-adjacent setting
  • Direct experience working with serious mental illness (SMI) populations, including psychotic spectrum and mood disorders
  • Strong working knowledge of risk assessment and crisis safety planning
  • Excellent, fast, clear written and verbal communication — you'll be coordinating hand-offs with clinic teams throughout the day
  • Comfortable and effective delivering clinical assessments over video/telehealth
  • Highly organized, able to manage a full daily schedule of assessments without losing continuity
  • Technologically savvy, with the ability to learn and navigate new tools quickly

What We’re Building

As a clinician at Amae, you are not adjacent to this work. You are essential to it.

  • A national care delivery model for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
  • Precision medicine for SMI. Individualized treatment informed by multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data.
  • A clinical operating system that puts longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer for care teams.
  • Frontier science and measurement: defining and validating the outcomes frameworks that this field has never had. Hospitalizations avoided, days stable, functional improvement, and more.
  • A partnership model with the country’s leading health systems that proves coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

What We Value

We center care in all we do. Empathy is not a brand value. It’s how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.

We challenge convention. The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.

We take the work seriously, not ourselves. High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.

Your job isn’t done until the job is done. We close gaps, we follow through, and we don’t hide behind titles or org charts.

We win together and fail together. We own outcomes as a team. We learn fast. We don’t do blame.

We hustle with humility. Speed matters. So does integrity. We assume best intent and stay grounded in the mission.

Compensation & Benefits

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range for this role is $58-$68 per hour and will be adjusted to market cost. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Parental leave and programs built around well-being. We’ll share specifics during the interview process.

If you want to practice at the top of your license, learn from the best in academic medicine, contribute to research that is defining a new field, and do it all inside a team that was actually built for this work, we’d like to talk.

jobs.description:
Stand.earth is seeking a creative and experienced community organizer for a part-time (20-32 hours per week) contract position starting as soon as possible for a 12-month term with possible extension. Reporting to the Senior Campaigner, this fully remote position will be responsible for coordinating and expanding Stand.earth’s engagement with local campaigns and organizers focused on local opposition to data center developments in key regions around the USA. This role will be part of Stand’s Big Tech team, and the contractor’s work will build on an existing national and international campaign to increase local and national pressure on Microsoft to deliver on key climate and energy commitments, including supporting local community partners engaged in existing data center site fights.

Are you already active on local data center campaigns? Are you experienced at local organizing, community level engagement, facilitation, and corporate campaigning? Are you ready to hit the ground running? Our ideal candidate will have a background in building networked community campaigns with experience in data center and AI related issues in the US, and experience in working with diverse groups and organizers, collaborating on strategy development and building consensus to implement campaign strategies.

We encourage applicants to apply by September 20, 2026. This position is open until filled.

About Stand.earth

Stand.earth is a nonprofit environmental organization working to create a world where respect for people and the environment comes first. Our campaigns challenge destructive corporate and governmental practices, demand accountability, and create solutions that support all of us — and the environment and climate upon which we depend. Stand’s strategic approach and fierce determination have yielded extraordinary results: Since 2000, we’ve secured the protection of millions of acres of wilderness, shifted billions of dollars of corporate purchasing and investing toward responsible options, and transformed the environmental practices of more than 100 major corporations. Stand.earth operates in the United States and Canada.

Stand recognizes and respects the sovereignty of First Nations, and the rights of Indigenous Peoples and frontline communities. These communities are often first and most directly impacted by environmental pollution and climate change, and they provide critical leadership in developing solutions.

Pollution, climate change, and corporations’ bad behavior disproportionately hurts the most marginalized people in society — including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women, and LGBTQ+ people. To develop transformative solutions, these communities must be centered in the work we do. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other historically marginalized communities. If you require assistance applying to this opportunity, please contact .

We are looking for someone ready to help build a national movement to network individual data center battlegrounds into a wider story about community power and corporate harm. The role will be part of Stand.earth’s Big Tech team, supporting the campaign team by working with a network of community organizers and groups to build local power to hold Microsoft to account for the impact of its data center build-out.

This is a part-time fixed-term position until the end of September 2027. Salary is commensurate with experience and adjusted based on location, but will likely be within the range of $27.64 - $40.87 USD per hour [$57,000 USD - $85,000 USD annually prorated]. Stand.earth offers a medical insurance stipend in lieu of extended health benefits and 4-weeks vacation, prorated. We also encourage employees to make use of our mindfulness sessions and professional development training opportunities that we offer. All staff can expect to travel periodically for in-person team meetings, retreats, and work events.

This role is fully remote in the USA. Candidates who are based in or near Bellingham, Washington, will have the option of working out of our Bellingham office.

Please apply with a cover letter and resume after seeing the full scope of work below.

Responsibilities
  • With support from the Senior Campaigner, maintain and grow Stand.earth’s relationships with local campaign groups and organizers in key data center locations
  • Identifying and leading outreach to communities where established relationships do not exist in alignment with campaign priorities
  • Working with communities to understand and develop the best opportunities for Stand.earth’s support and involvement, and identify alignment with Stand.earth’s wider campaign goals
  • Working with communities and the campaign team to identify and support the delivery of key campaign tactics, including through strategy, planning, logistics, sharing resources, messaging and communications
  • Regularly representing Stand.earth at meetings with local allies and scheduling additional check-ins with local organizers as necessary. This will likely require some engagement during evenings and weekends
  • Budgeting and then facilitating payment and reimbursement for individual tactics in support of local allies
  • Support the delivery of key Stand.earth campaign activities through logistical support, community engagement, partner outreach, volunteer support and organizing, and other needs as identified by campaign leads
  • Managing 1-2 dedicated part-time local organizers
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • Three to five years’ experience (including volunteer experience) in community, local, or regional organizing with preference given to experience with social justice or environmental campaigns
  • Experience developing and implementing effective public campaign strategies and tactics, ideally targeting corporations
  • Able to anticipate and identify key related external public discourse moments to strategically insert our messaging
  • Strong track record of working with different communities to build relationships, work across differences, and develop shared approaches
  • Committed to equity, racial justice, authentic communications, standing up for impacted communities, and continual learning
  • Excellent written communication skills in English
  • Access to a car and willingness to travel to communities where we’re organizing; willingness to communicate and attend meetings outside of regular working hours
  • Passion for building community power to stand up to hyperscale developers
  • Direct connection or experience organizing in data center impacted communities highly desirable
  • Experience with digital campaigning and communications is an asset

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Venn Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces.
jobs.description:
About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As the Revenue Operations Engineer at Venn, you'll make our go-to-market systems work as one. Our revenue stack spans HubSpot, Vitally, Nooks, Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora.You will own how those tools connect, how data flows between them, and how the business gets trustworthy reporting out of them. You'll sit in Finance and work daily with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, so that lead generation, pipeline, and customer data tie cleanly together from first touch through renewal. This is a hands-on, builder-minded role: you'll design integrations and automations, fix the data problems behind the numbers, and give leadership a single, reliable view of revenue.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrations and data flows between our GTM systems, including HubSpot (CRM), Vitally (customer success), Nooks (AI phone dialer), Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora so that data moves accurately and automatically between them
  • Build and maintain automations and workflows that reduce manual work for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams
  • Serve as the technical owner of HubSpot, including objects, properties, workflows, lead routing, lifecycle stages, and data hygiene
  • Design and maintain reporting and dashboards for pipeline generation, conversion, sales activity, forecasting, and customer health, working with Finance on revenue reporting
  • Define and document metrics and data definitions so Sales, Marketing, CS, and Finance all work from the same numbers
  • Partner with Marketing on lead flow, attribution, and campaign reporting from first touch through closed-won
  • Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline visibility, forecast inputs, and rep productivity reporting
  • Partner with Customer Success on connecting customer health, usage, and renewal data to the CRM
  • Audit data quality across systems, find and fix sync errors, duplicates, and gaps, and put safeguards in place to prevent them
  • Evaluate new GTM tools and AI-driven workflows, and manage vendor setup, permissions, and integrations
  • Document systems, processes, and integrations so the revenue stack is easy to maintain and scale
  • Support Finance with revenue, bookings, and pipeline data for board reporting, planning, and audits

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in revenue operations, GTM operations, marketing operations, sales operations, or a similar technical GTM role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep, hands-on experience with HubSpot, including workflows, custom properties and objects, reporting, and integrations
  • You know the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You can connect AI tools to business systems with MCP connectors (for example, HubSpot, Zuora, and Google Drive)
  • Experience connecting systems and building integrations through native connectors, APIs, webhooks, and iPaaS tools (e.g., Zapier, Workato, Make, n8n, or similar)
  • Strong reporting and analytics skills, with experience building dashboards and translating messy data into clear answers for leadership
  • Familiarity with the types of tools in our stack, such as customer success platforms, sales dialers and engagement tools, and conversation intelligence platforms (Vitally, Nooks, and Gong experience is a plus)
  • Comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical teammates
  • A detail-oriented, systems-thinking approach, with a habit of documenting what you build
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to prioritize competing requests from multiple stakeholders
  • Comfort in a startup or scale-up environment, with a bias toward action and a willingness to build process as you go

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of SQL, JavaScript or Python, or scripting for data transformation and API work
  • Experience with BI or data tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Google Sheets or BigQuery modeling)
  • Experience supporting finance reporting, such as bookings, ARR, and revenue recognition inputs
  • Experience with AI-driven GTM tools and automation
  • HubSpot certifications

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
  • Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

jobs.title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
jobs.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application and a short asynchronous interview. One take, no re-records.
  2. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  3. A short video introduction.
  4. A verification step where we check what you have told us.
  5. A short paid screen of a few days, then a paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

  1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
  2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
  3. Strong written English.
  4. Based in South Africa.
  5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1000 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus (13th month pay in the Philippines and South Africa, THR in Indonesia).
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

For more information, visit . Come join us.

Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against—ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.

About the Role:As a Sector Specialist on our Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing the quality and efficiency of our proprietary research content within the Healthcare sector.   • Alternatively, you bring comparable experience in the healthcare industry, such as biopharma or medtech strategy, competitive intelligence, business development, or healthcare consulting.
  • You bring deep domain expertise in Healthcare, with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends.
  • You have a proven ability to lead projects, manage deadlines, and hit business targets.
  • You possess original and independent thought with strong analytical, organizational, and critical-thinking skills.
  • You have excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • You are adept at working cross-functionally and can work more broadly within an organization where information-sharing is critical.
  • You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

jobs.description:
This is a remote role; however, we only operate in the following states: AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX and WI.

ABOUT SULLIVANCOTTER

SullivanCotter partners with health care and other not-for-profit organizations to enhance performance and improve outcomes by developing and implementing integrated workforce strategies. Using our time-tested methodologies and industry-leading research and information, we provide data-driven insights, expertise, and solutions to help organizations align business strategy and performance objectives – enabling our clients to deliver on their mission, vision and values.

ABOUT THE EXECUTIVE WORKFORCE SERVICES PRACTICE

Our Executive Workforce Services consultants provide comprehensive advisory services spanning executive compensation, governance, and leadership strategy. We help organizations define and implement effective executive compensation programs that align with market benchmarks, organizational strategies, and regulatory requirements. Our expertise includes governance support for boards and committees, performance evaluations for executives, and design of competitive total compensation. We also advise on executive benefits and pay-for-performance strategies. Additionally, we provide insights on emerging trends, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, and employment agreements to ensure a holistic and compliant approach to executive talent management.

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Provide comprehensive executive compensation consulting services and develop, implement, and/or administer executive compensation programs
  • Provide subject matter expertise and serve as a market expert regarding specific client market compensation issues
  • Conduct executive job evaluations; analyze job responsibilities, activities, duties, requirements, and organizational structure and recommend internal job placement in the appropriate level and title
  • Conduct market pricing, peer group selection, survey analyses, interpreting compensation data, financial modeling, and special research projects
  • Analyze data to determine the appropriate compensation level and job title for existing and proposed executive positions, including more complex positions involving responsibilities within multiple focus areas
  • Identify complex job matching and data issues and proactively consult with clients and key associates to determine the appropriate course of action, acting quickly to remove obstacles impeding project steps
  • Effectively keep the project manager apprised of project status, including delays or potential problems, holding self and team members accountable for client deadlines and deliverables
  • Assist with more complex report and proposal writing related to describing and summarizing project objectives, methodologies, analysis and results, and proof for accuracy
  • Serve as a peer reviewer and mentor of technical knowledge to effectively guide more junior associates in complex research, data collection, and analytics
  • Participate in appropriate client delivery team meetings to understand team and client initiatives
  • Establish client relationships and act as a key point of contact for client inquiries, as appropriate
  • Shadow project and client relationship managers at client meetings or teleconferences, as requested

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in a business-related field, ideally with an emphasis in finance, economics, statistics, mathematics, accounting, or health care administration
  • One to five years of progressive experience directly consulting with clients
  • Three to five years of related analytical experience required involving data analysis, financial modeling, and presentation design
  • Compensation consulting experience preferred

jobs.description:
Signal Advisors is on a mission to solve the retirement crisis. 69% of Americans do not work with a financial advisor today, and only a quarter have a financial plan. Our team is reimagining a 60-year-old industry—bringing new technologies, comprehensive services, and an inspired vision to financial advisors. Supported by our incredible investors, we’ve grown from a small Detroit-based team in 2020 to over 130+ team members dispersed across the country.

We are: Empowering Leaders. Client Advocates. Entrepreneurial Champions.

Our team is a blend of industry experts and technologists building a better business, together. We’re in it for the long haul. Are you looking to be part of a dedicated, dispersed team where you can architect your impact and shape the company’s vision? Join us at Signal!

THE JOB

Signal Advisors is seeking a Planning Specialist to elevate the technical planning acumen of our advisor community. In this role, you’ll help advisors translate client goals and data into clear, actionable planning strategies—integrating protection, income, and accumulation concepts into cohesive recommendations.

Your work sits at the intersection of financial analysis and advisor enablement. You’ll take the messy, incomplete, real-world inputs that sales-oriented advisors bring to us and turn them into structured, modular planning insights they can confidently deliver to clients. You’ll also provide technical guidance on where annuities, life insurance, and investment considerations fit within a broader, well-constructed financial plan.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being the technical backbone behind strong advisors—someone who can see the strategy behind the products, connect the dots quickly, and bring clarity to complex client scenarios.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO

  • Translate advisor-submitted client data into structured planning proposals that address a wide range of client objectives, from common retirement income, longevity and risk management concerns to advanced tax and estate planning needs.
  • Design clear, modular planning recommendations that advisors can present directly to clients, connecting how asset management, annuities and life insurance each support the broader plan.
  • Evaluate advisor goals and client constraints to identify suitable product strategies—using product knowledge as a tool within a planning framework, not the end goal.
  • Guide advisors through technical questions related to planning logic, case design, suitability considerations, and the strategic role of individual solutions.
  • Support field underwriting diligence by helping advisors understand risk factors and set appropriate expectations with applicants.
  • Create and refine planning deliverables (summaries, scenario comparisons, plan modules) that elevate advisor professionalism and deepen client trust.
  • Provide thoughtful, planning-first support via platform messaging, live phone support and case consultations—bringing clarity and direction to sales-oriented advisors who rely on deep technical expertise.
  • Collaborate with the Planning team to evolve our tools, templates, workflows, and internal knowledge base as our offering grows.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR IN TEAM MEMBERS

  • 💪 Executer: We’re currently building out many new initiatives and programs. You’ll need to quickly ramp up and start executing. We talk a lot about strategy and high-level ideas, and you should be able to independently translate ideas into action, dig into the details, and make progress toward our team’s goals.
  • 💁 Customer Centric: You’re obsessed with creating an unparalleled customer experience. You lead with compassion, anticipate customer needs and wants, and bring ease and calm to all interactions—knowing every customer interaction is an opportunity to amaze.
  • 🤔 Problem Solver: Working at a startup is rife with challenges. These challenges invigorate you! When you come up against friction or roadblocks, you demonstrate excellent problem solving skills—exploring creative solutions and taking ownership to keep moving forward.

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • A deep knowledge of insurance products, especially annuities.
  • 1-2 years of experience in financial planning or paraplanning.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a keen attention to detail.

WHAT WE VALUE @ SIGNAL

These are the values that drive how we operate and make decisions.

🌔 We’re obsessed with finding a better way. Never settle for less.
🏃 We act with a sense of urgency. We use our best judgment to act urgently on the right things at the right time.
👀 We raise our level of awareness. Everything starts with awareness. We’re curious and alert to what is happening around us.
🏈 We find inches everywhere around us. There are thousands of opportunities to make an impact. We take those opportunities and act.
🧭 We do the right thing. Sticking to the highest standard of integrity is not optional.
💪 We have strong opinions, loosely held. It’s not about WHO is right, it’s about WHAT is right.
❓ Simplicity is Genius. Simplicity doesn’t just clarify; it makes things better for everyone. It’s that simple.
🙏 Ideas are valued, execution is worshiped. Great ideas get you to the 50-yard line; outstanding execution gets you into the end zone.

🪞 We are the "they". There is no "they". We are empowered to fix things, to be proactive, to find a solution.

🚀 We launch big ideas and then obsess over feedback to learn how we can make it even better.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, and alignment with market data.

Partnership

EQL Tech is partnering with Future of Cancer Care Today to appoint its next Chief Executive Officer.

About FCCT

Future of Cancer Care Today is an initiative incubated by the Sijbrandij Foundation, grown out of Sid Sijbrandij’s own cancer journey and the experience of the many patients and families the Foundation has worked with since.

There is more science available to cancer patients than any one care team can keep up with. New diagnostics, treatments, trials and suppliers keep emerging, and when standard of care runs out, patients are usually left to work out what else might be possible on their own.

FCCT helps cancer patients and their families connect the dots. A PhD-led team surfaces diagnostic and treatment options relevant to a patient’s case, including those beyond standard of care, and identifies vetted suppliers and providers who work beyond standard protocols. FCCT is not a medical provider: it does not diagnose, prescribe or direct treatment. It creates playbooks, curates resources and provides a non-clinical decision-support layer so families can walk into the next conversation with a fuller picture. Everything FCCT does is free to patients.

The role

FCCT is looking for a Chief Executive Officer to lead the initiative into its next phase. This is a builder’s job, not a caretaker’s. FCCT has proven that the model helps patients. The task now is to turn a small, high-touch service into something that reaches many more families without losing the rigour and compassion that make it work. The CEO will own FCCT’s strategy, team, standards and growth, reporting to the CEO of the Sijbrandij Foundation.

What you will do

  • Set and own the strategy. Decide what FCCT should be in three years, and what it should not be.
  • Lead and grow the team: a Director of Patient Connections and a growing Patient Navigation function, expected to grow materially over the next 12 months.
  • Protect the quality of the work. Own the standards for how cases are researched, how resources are vetted and how materials are reviewed before they reach a patient.
  • Hold the line on what FCCT is not. FCCT sits deliberately outside the clinical relationship, and you are the final judge of where that boundary falls.
  • Scale beyond one-to-one. Extend the playbooks, resource directory and self-serve tools so families FCCT never speaks to directly still benefit.
  • Build the external network across clinicians, researchers, diagnostics and therapeutics companies, patient advocacy organisations and peer foundations.
  • Work in partnership with the Sijbrandij Foundation’s CEO on budget, impact, risk and need.

Requirements

What we are looking for

Essential:

  • An advanced degree in a relevant scientific, medical or health discipline.
  • The ability to read, interrogate and summarise primary oncology literature, and hold your own with practising oncologists and researchers.
  • Demonstrated leadership of a team, with a track record of hiring well.
  • Experience building something from an early stage into something larger.
  • Judgement under ambiguity, where stakes are high and evidence incomplete.
  • Exceptional communication, including translating complex science into language a frightened family can act on.
  • Deep personal commitment to patients.

Strongly preferred:

  • Direct experience in oncology, precision medicine, clinical research or patient navigation.
  • Familiarity with the landscape beyond standard of care, including expanded access, Right to Try and trial pathways.
  • Experience operating within or alongside a philanthropic funder.
  • An existing network across oncology, research or patient advocacy.

First twelve months

  • An agreed three-year strategy, signed off with the Foundation.
  • The team fully staffed, with the open Patient Connections Manager and Associate roles closed and performing.
  • Documented standards for case research, resource vetting and material review.
  • A measurable increase in patients and families reached, with an agreed way of measuring whether FCCT changed their options.
  • At least two substantive external partnerships that widen what FCCT can offer.

Benefits

Compensation and benefits

  • Salary: $190,000–$220,000 base per year, plus equity, depending on experience (USD).
  • Benefits include:
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Health insurance
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Other standard benefits for a full-time, US-based role

About EQL Tech

EQL Tech hires mission-critical leaders and individual contributors for tech companies and philanthropic ventures. We run searches the way an operator would: we start from what the hire has to make happen in their first 90 days, then find the people who have already done it.

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.title: Incident Response Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Security Incident Response Engineer to join our Incident Response team. You will help redefine how incidents are handled at scale, pairing autonomous AI agents with human judgment so that we can detect, investigate, and contain threats faster across a rapidly growing cloud and AI footprint.

AS A SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Join a high-impact team of security experts to scale security at one of the fastest-growing software companies ever

  • Spearhead an agentic approach to Incident Response by deploying, guiding, and refining autonomous AI agents that execute initial triage, context gathering, and rapid investigation alongside human Incident Commanders

  • Handle escalations, lead security investigations, and act as Incident Commander for critical incidents

  • Build scripts, automation pipelines, and agentic workflows that continuously enhance Snowflake's incident response capabilities

  • Partner closely with our Threat Detection, Automation, Product Security, Legal, HR, Cloud, and Data teams

  • Create and improve detections, threat signatures, and guardrails for both traditional and AI-driven attack vectors

  • Participate in a periodic on-call rotation, which may involve non-traditional working hours

OUR IDEAL SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in incident response or security operations preferred

  • Strong experience in incident response, security investigations, and running incidents as the Incident Commander

  • Advanced experience using security stack capabilities (EDR, SIEM, SOAR, DLP) across endpoints, identity providers, SaaS, and cloud workloads

  • Deep familiarity with AI/LLM tooling, security copilots, and AI-driven telemetry to accelerate investigations, threat triage, and post-incident reporting

  • Knowledge of securing frontier AI infrastructure, including model training and serving pipelines and AI agent permissions

  • Proven ability to detect and respond to modern AI-driven attacks

  • Proficiency in Python to build automated orchestration pipelines, reduce manual incident response toil, and programmatically enrich security alerts

  • Expert-level understanding of cloud security architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container runtime isolation (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Ability to translate incident findings and root-cause analysis into short-term tactical fixes and long-term security engineering objectives

  • Ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis using sandbox environments and modern AI-assisted reverse engineering tools

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with threat hunting or building detection-as-code programs

  • Experience running sensitive investigations alongside Legal and HR, such as insider risk cases

  • Familiarity with large-scale data platforms and using them to analyze security telemetry

  • Contributions to open-source security tooling, detection rules, or the broader security community

  • Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, or GREM

WHY JOIN OUR INCIDENT RESPONSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is an opportunity to shape what incident response looks like in the agentic era. You will work on the front line of defending one of the world's most important data platforms, building the AI-driven workflows that let a team of experts respond with the speed and precision that modern threats demand.

You will work across Detection, Product Security, Cloud, Legal, and HR, see incidents end to end, and turn what you learn into lasting improvements to how Snowflake protects its customers and its people.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
