jobs.description:
Provider Claims Customer Service Representative - Remote

Job Type: Full-time - 100% Remote Position

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 11am - 7:30pm EST

Pay: $16.00 - $17.00 per hour

We are seeking a Provider Claims Customer Service Representative to support inbound calls from healthcare provider representatives requesting claim status information. This role is responsible for researching claims within client systems and providing clear, accurate, and timely information to callers.

The ideal candidate is reliable, customer-focused, efficient, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven contact center environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer inbound calls from healthcare provider representatives regarding claim status.
  • Research claims and claim status information using client systems and platforms.
  • Clearly and accurately communicate available claim information to provider representatives.
  • Verify appropriate information before discussing claim details.
  • Navigate multiple applications while actively assisting callers.
  • Document calls and actions accurately in accordance with established procedures.
  • Identify inquiries requiring additional assistance and follow established escalation procedures.
  • Maintain professional and effective communication throughout provider interactions.
  • Consistently achieve established productivity, quality, attendance, and service expectations.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and ongoing professional development activities.
  • Follow established privacy, security, client, and organizational requirements.

Role Expectations

This position supports a fast-paced healthcare provider contact center and requires representatives to efficiently research and communicate claim status information throughout the workday.

Successful candidates must be comfortable:

  • Managing a consistent volume of inbound provider calls.
  • Researching claim information swiftly and accurately.
  • Navigating multiple systems while actively speaking with callers.
  • Communicating clearly and professionally with healthcare provider representatives.
  • Following established processes and escalating inquiries appropriately when additional assistance is required.
  • Working independently in a fully remote environment.
  • Receiving feedback and coaching in support of continuous improvement.
  • Adapting to changing procedures, client requirements, and business needs.

This is primarily an inbound provider-facing contact center role focused on claim status inquiries and does not involve claims adjudication.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of previous customer service or contact center experience.
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Ability to communicate information clearly, accurately, and professionally over the phone.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems while actively handling calls.
  • Ability to manage workload effectively and meet productivity and quality expectations.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote team environment.
  • Reliable attendance and ability to maintain an established work schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare providers, provider offices, or medical billing organizations.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, healthcare claims and claims terminology.
  • Experience researching medical claim status within payer, health plan, TPA, or managed care systems.
  • Familiarity with common claim statuses, including paid, denied, pending, and in-process claims.
  • Experience working within established contact center metrics, including average handle time, quality, productivity, and schedule adherence.
  • Experience navigating multiple systems simultaneously while assisting callers.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Provider Claims Customer Service Representatives consistently:

  • Provide accurate and professional claim status information to provider representatives.
  • Navigate client systems efficiently and effectively.
  • Balance call efficiency with accuracy and service quality.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with callers.
  • Demonstrate accountability and ownership of their work.
  • Maintain strong attendance and schedule adherence.
  • Follow established processes and escalate appropriately when needed.
  • Meet established productivity and quality expectations.
  • Receive and apply coaching in support of continuous improvement.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us:

  • 🏠 Work Remotely
  • 💰 Competitive Pay
  • 🩺Comprehensive Benefit Structure
  • 💻 Equipment Provided – Everything you need to succeed
  • 🚀 Career Growth – Be part of a dynamic and supportive team that values your expertise

WORK FROM HOME REQUIREMENTS

  • High Speed Internet of 25MBPS download and 5MBPS upload. You will be required to provide a speed test.
  • Ability to directly hardwire to your modem
  • Required to have a quiet dedicated work area.

About Imagenet

Imagenet is a technology-forward healthcare operations partner with more than 25 years of experience helping healthcare payers manage critical administrative and operational processes. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, Imagenet supports 150+ health plans through its payer clients.

Our teams help improve efficiency, accuracy, visibility, and service across complex healthcare operations, including digital mailroom, claims adjudication, contact center, member communications, and related administrative functions. By combining experienced operational teams, proven processes, and purpose-built workflow technology, Imagenet helps payers keep essential processes moving for the members, providers, and communities they serve.

Imagenet operates 10 secure facilities across the U.S. and one secure facility in Manila, Philippines.

Joining Imagenet means contributing to work that supports the healthcare operations members and providers rely on every day.

Salary: $16.00 - $17.00 per hour

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkhedenJe werkt mee aan de stapsgewijze vernieuwing van een bestaande bodemtoepassing die wordt gebruikt voor het beheer van bodemdossiers en het afleveren van bodemattesten.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Je werkt mee aan de stapsgewijze vernieuwing van een bestaande bodemtoepassing die wordt gebruikt voor het beheer van bodemdossiers en het afleveren van bodemattesten. De opdracht kadert in de modernisering van een toepassing die functioneel en technisch niet langer volstaat voor de actuele doelstellingen.

De focus ligt op de gefaseerde vervanging van bestaande onderdelen door nieuwe ontwikkeling, met aandacht voor extra functionaliteiten, een vlotter dossierbeheer, de verwerking van een stijgend volume aan dossiers, een betere ondersteuning van kadastermutaties en een meer geografische manier van werken.

Je ontwikkelt in Java binnen een service-oriented omgeving en werkt mee aan REST-services en API-implementaties. Daarnaast bouw je single page webapplicaties met React en werk je met Spring Boot, Hibernate, DB2, Postgres, Maven, Nexus, containerconcepten zoals Docker of Kubernetes en Atlassian Tools zoals Bitbucket, Bamboo, Confluence en Jira. Je functioneert binnen een agile ontwikkelaanpak.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je hebt een hogere opleiding op bachelor- of masterniveau met een technische of engineeringachtergrond, of je bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring.

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met de gevraagde technologie of met een vergelijkbare technologie.

  • Ervaring met Java-ontwikkeling in een service-oriented omgeving is vereist.
  • Je hebt kennis van Spring Boot, Hibernate, REST-services en de implementatie van API's.
  • Je hebt ervaring met de ontwikkeling van single page webapplicaties in React.
  • Je werkt vlot met DB2 en Postgres.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met Maven, Nexus en Atlassian Tools zoals Bitbucket, Bamboo, Confluence en Jira.
  • Je hebt kennis van containerconcepten, bijvoorbeeld Docker of Kubernetes.
  • Ervaring met agile ontwikkeling is noodzakelijk.
  • Kennis van de publieke sector, de Vlaamse Overheid en de afvalverwerkende sector is vereist.
  • Je beheerst het Nederlands op CEFR-niveau C2.

📌 Over de opdracht

Deze rol ondersteunt de verdere uitbouw van een bodemtoepassing binnen een maatschappelijke context rond materialen, afvalbeheer en bodemkwaliteit. De toepassing moet de opvolging van historische bodemverontreinigingen en een actievere aanpak van risicogronden beter ondersteunen. Daarom wordt gekozen voor een gradueel vernieuwingstraject in plaats van een volledige vervanging in één keer.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Dayton
jobs.excerpt: Big Ass who? We didn’t set out to start a fan company.
jobs.description:
Big Ass who?

We didn’t set out to start a fan company. We set out to solve a problem—workplace discomfort. (Sorry, HR, not your kind.) Facilities become furnaces during the summer, but businesses still expect peak performance and productivity. Without providing the basic human right of comfort, that’s just asinine. Seeing how overhead fans cooled California dairy cows begged a massive question for our founder. “Can a fan be made to revolutionize comfort for people?” he uttered. That’s when the HVLS Fan Company was born—with the first-ever patented high-volume, low-speed fan. But that name? BOR-ing. And customers knew it. We kept getting calls asking, “Are you the guys who make those big ass fans?” Hell yeah we are. And Big Ass Fans was born, complete with our own cheeky donkey mascot, Fanny. Today, we don’t just move air, we transform experiences. Big Ass Fans deliver comfort where it counts. We build every product like lives depend on it. Because, turns out, they do.
Our success is a result of the Big Ass Fans team’s innovation. Are you seeking an opportunity to work with extraordinary people with an entrepreneurial spirit? Do you have something that sets you apart from the rest? With a bias for action, we want you to #livelifebigass and bring the next great BAF product to market. From our customers to our employees, we are passionate about what we can accomplish together. The successful candidate will bring passion, energy, and a “get it done” mentality to BAF and the industrial business and contribute in a meaningful way to realize the company’s full potential in the market.

Opportunity

The Outside Sales Representative (OSR) plays a crucial role in making the world safer, healthier and more productive by ensuring our customers receive the best possible solutions tailored to their needs. Their in-person presence and dedication to customer satisfaction help build trust and long-lasting partnerships, driving the company’s success and growth. Picture this; you arrive at a customer’s facility, sporting BAF’s top swag, and get to provide a solution that provides comfort to their employees, increases their productivity, and their overall health - You are changing the quality of customers' lives! With a passion for making the world safer, healthier, and more productive, this role often requires extensive travel, averaging three days and two nights per week in hotels during busy periods. If you bring an energetic, positive attitude with a technical mindset who likes solving problems and developing lasting relationships, we want to hear from you! Applications are now being accepted for the position expected to begin on November 2, 2026.

Compensation Range

$70,000-$73,000 Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions

Anticipated Start Date:

November 2nd, 2026

What you'll do

  • Serve as the professional face of Big Ass Fans for all current and prospective customers.
  • Perform facility surveys and make customized product recommendations for each customer.
  • Submit all facility information and log all customer interactions in the CRM.
  • Maintain constant communication with customers, the inside sales team, and field services/installers, and management.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction through frequent post-purchase follow-ups and account nurturing.
  • Generate meetings and new opportunities with existing customers and leads.
  • Respond to inside sales requests for visits promptly.
  • Maintain a positive company image.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent training and experience
  • Proven outside sales experience (industrial sales is a bonus)
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships, internally and externally
  • Experience using a CRM (Salesforce preferred) - must be diligent in adding your notes from each visit
  • Experience using CAD is a plus but not required; Familiarity with engineering blueprints and building plans is a plus
  • Effective and efficient time management is a must; Demonstrate a strong follow-through and ability to self-manage multiple projects at once
  • Must be flexible and self-motivated with a strong work ethic
  • Maintain a professional appearance and positive attitude
  • Clean driving record
  • Willing to drive and maintain a BAF-branded company vehicle which may be a sedan, SUV or pickup truck
  • Job is remote and requires a lot of drive time; must be able to be in the car for 3-5+ hours at a time and often 20 hours in a week
  • Must be able to walk and stand continuously for up to 6 hours during large campus site visits, with periodic kneeling required for tasks such as floor-to-ceiling measurements
  • Willingness to make overnight trips frequently
  • Must reside in the designated sales territory

Think you have what it takes, but your background doesn’t perfectly align with this role? No sweat! If this position gets your fan spinning, we encourage you to apply and tell us how you’ll succeed with your unique skills in your application.

First 90 Days

Every Big Ass Fans employee works towards the company’s growth goals, and no goal is successful without a plan. When you kickstart your BAF journey with a strong 90-day plan, you’ll be set up for a great first day, week, month, quarter and beyond! Here’s a snapshot of the first 90 days as a BAF Outside Sales Representative:

Big Ass Fans will be hiring a cohort of new Outside Sales Representatives, expected to start on November 2nd, 2026, who will be onboarded together before they begin independent customer meetings to create and present custom fan solutions in January of 2027.

Days 1-30:

  • Meet your peers and stakeholders you’ll be working with on a daily basis.
  • Ensure a complete understanding of BAF’s products, software, and processes to perform your daily tasks.
  • Ride-alongs: Join Outside Sales professionals in what will be your local territory, and also travel to other teammates' territories to join their visits.
  • Continuous learning on topics such as fan science, fan solution design concepts, fan model details, installation scope of work, electrical panel identification, and control systems.
  • Ensure a complete understanding of BAF's products, software, and processes to perform your daily tasks.

Days 31-60:

  • Additional ride-along trips on the first and third weeks of December.
  • Join BAF's Sales Conference, located at our Headquarters in Lexington, KY from December 7th through 11th.
  • Holiday shutdown from December 24th through January 3rd.

Days 61-90+:

  • Begin conducting independent sales meetings.
  • continue learning BAF technical details relating to products, installation, and design principles.
  • Be able to create high-quality Speclab airflow models for any facility.
  • Primary metrics: Overall Sales & Proactively Generated Opportunities.
  • Provide accurate recommendations while minimizing installation change orders.

The Interview Process

  1. Video Screen:Show us yourcoolskills! This will be a one-way video screen that goes through several questionsfor you to answer, leaving you a certain amount of time to respond. First time doing one of these? Be yourself!Some say it helps to settle your nerves by picturing the camera in its underwear.
  2. First Conversation:You’ll be speaking with a BAF Recruiter! Here, you’ll discuss the opportunity more in-depth,and talk through any questions you have, as well as cover any details that didn’t come out in the video screen.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview:This will be a virtual interview with the Outside Sales Supervisor and Director of Outside Sales (you get to see theirface and they will even talk back to you this time!) In this conversation, you’ll go through all of the in-depthdetails of the position, going over the day-to-day operations, and learn about the role’s KPIs.
  4. Assessment:You'll complete an online assessment to help us better understand your sales strengths and potential.
  5. In-Person interview:If you are in an area where one of our Outside Sales Reps or Supervisors are nearby, wemay be able to set up an in-person meeting with you for a more casual conversation and iron out any details orlingering questions you have of the position.

How do you live life Big Ass?

Wonder what it’s like to walk through our Headquarters, or what benefits and perks BAFers have? Click here to learn more!

Be a part of something BIG

You’re not just a member of the Big Ass Fans team; it’s BIGGER than us. We are a Madison Industries company, one of the world's leading publicly held industrial organizations. Madison Industries has fostered and built exceptional companies that are essential to our collective health and well-being. Come join our mission to make the world healthier, safer, and more productive to build something truly remarkable!

Why haven’t you applied yet?

Overview

We are seeking a UK-qualified Commercial Transactions Attorney to join the legal team of a mature but still fast-growing SaaS business. This role will drive revenue and manage risk by owning the drafting, negotiation, and risk assessment of customer partners, and vendor agreements across the company's commercial lifecycle. The successful candidate will act as a trusted, business-embedded Legal partner to our Go-to-Market (GTM) Sales, Deal and Revenue Operations, Procurement, Security, Partner, and Product teams, balancing commercial pragmatism with disciplined risk management in a subscription SaaS business model.

Who you are:

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or equivalent UK jurisdiction), currently in good standing with the SRA (or relevant regulator).
  • PQE appropriate to the level being hired (typically 3+ years for Commercial Counsel; 7+ years for Senior Commercial Counsel), with substantial in-house or law firm experience in technology/commercial transactions.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating SaaS/technology commercial agreements, including MSAs, order forms, and DPAs, and vendor contracts.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR, and international data protection frameworks as applied to commercial contracting. Experience negotiating customer information security requirements, AI terms, data use rights, audit rights, and vendor risk/security exhibits in a multi-tenant SaaS environment.
  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to independently assess and communicate risk to non-lawyer business stakeholders.
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to manage a high-volume deal pipeline under time pressure.
  • Experience being a key member of cross functional process improvement initiatives as well as legal department specific projects.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in a high-growth or publicly traded SaaS company, particularly one selling into regulated or enterprise customer bases, including financial services.
  • Familiarity with export control, sanctions screening, and anti-bribery/anti-corruption considerations in commercial contracting.
  • Exposure to procurement/vendor management processes and subcontractor flow-down frameworks.
  • Prior experience supporting M&A due diligence or corporate transactions from a commercial contract’s perspective.
  • Additional practical experience in or familiarity with EU data protection law, U.S. privacy law (e.g., CCPA), or other multi-jurisdictional privacy regimes.

Key Competencies

  • Pragmatic, business-forward approach to risk — able to distinguish material risk from immaterial friction.
  • A results focused attitude and team first working style.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership; comfortable operating with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Process-minded: interested in improving templates, playbooks, and workflow efficiency, not just individual deals.
  • Resilient and responsive under deadline pressure typical of quarter-end/enterprise sales cycles.

What you'll be doing:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a high volume of commercial agreements, including SaaS subscription agreements, master services agreements (MSAs), order forms, data processing agreements (DPAs), reseller/channel partner agreements, and vendor/procurement contracts with EMEA based prospects and customers.
  • Negotiate customer-initiated security exhibits, AI terms IT security policies, and audit/right-to-audit clauses against the company's standard security posture, certifications (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II), and Trust Center positions.
  • Advise on UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, and cross-border data transfer mechanisms (e.g., UK IDTA, EU SCCs) as they apply to customer and vendor contracts.
  • Partner with Sales and Deal Ops to structure and close enterprise deals, including pricing, liability caps, indemnities, service levels, and termination terms, within approved playbooks and escalation thresholds.
  • Manage subcontractor and vendor flow-down obligations, ensuring consistency between customer commitments and the company's vendor risk management program.
  • Work with Legal team to help maintain and continuously improve contract templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and internal negotiation guidance to increase deal velocity and consistency.
  • Support cross-functional stakeholders (GTM, Customer Success, DealOps, InfoSec Finance, and Product) on contract interpretation, compliance questions, and dispute avoidance.
  • Track and report on contracting trends, common redline patterns, and recurring points of friction to inform template and policy updates.
  • Assist with legal aspects of procurement, including SaaS and cloud vendor agreements, software licensing, and IT services contracts.
  • Collaborate with team members on departmental process improvements and general projects.

jobs.description:
[We show compassion to heal minds.]

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $35–$40 USD/hour, based on relevant experience and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Government

What if your years of experience navigating government regulations, evaluating complex cases, or interpreting public-sector policies could help make artificial intelligence more accurate, reliable, and effective?

At Volga Partners, we're bringing experienced government professionals into the next generation of AI development.

We're seeking Government Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who can apply their professional knowledge, analytical judgment, and industry experience to evaluate and improve advanced AI models.

This isn't a traditional government position, and you won't be processing applications or managing government caseloads. Instead, you'll use your expertise to assess how well AI systems interpret information, apply regulations, reason through complex scenarios, and produce accurate, defensible conclusions.

Your expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

The Opportunity

As a Government SME, you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized government functions.

You'll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established regulations, policies, and professional standards.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex public-sector challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

1. Government Policy, Public Records & Regulatory Compliance

  • Interpreting federal, state, or local government regulations and policies
  • Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), public records, and disclosure requirements
  • Privacy compliance, sensitive information protection, and regulatory auditing
  • Evaluating complex compliance scenarios and identifying regulatory risks

2. Government Programs, Eligibility & Administrative Decision-Making

  • Interpreting government program requirements and eligibility regulations
  • Evaluating complex cases, supporting documentation, and administrative determinations
  • Identifying inconsistencies, compliance issues, or unsupported decisions
  • Applying professional judgment to regulatory and program-specific scenarios

3. Government Procurement, Contracts & Vendor Evaluation

  • Federal, state, or local government procurement processes
  • Request for Proposal (RFP) analysis and evaluation
  • Contracting standards, vendor selection, and procurement compliance
  • Developing or applying evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and defensible recommendations

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated responses: Review complex government-related scenarios for accuracy, completeness, reasoning, and regulatory alignment.
  • Apply expert judgment: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are appropriate, defensible, and supported by relevant policies or regulations.
  • Identify errors and gaps: Recognize inaccurate interpretations, flawed assumptions, missing information, and potential compliance concerns.
  • Validate against authoritative sources: Use applicable statutes, regulations, agency guidance, and professional standards to verify findings.
  • Develop evaluation benchmarks: Help establish high-quality reference responses, assessment criteria, and examples of sound professional reasoning.
  • Provide actionable feedback: Clearly explain your evaluations and recommend improvements to AI-generated content.
  • Collaborate on quality: Apply project-specific evaluation guidelines and participate in quality reviews to support consistency and accuracy.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Put your professional expertise to work in a new way.

Rather than performing traditional government administrative functions, you'll apply the knowledge you've developed throughout your career to emerging AI technology.

Contribute to meaningful AI development.

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI reasoning and improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information.

Work remotely with project-based flexibility.

Participate in specialized assignments from anywhere in the United States, with opportunities for future engagements based on project availability and performance.

No AI background required.

We value professionals who understand their field and can recognize when an AI-generated answer is right, wrong, incomplete, or misleading.

Project Details

  • Engagement: Independent contractor, project-based
  • Location: Remote, United States only
  • Compensation: $35–$40 USD/hour
  • Schedule: Variable, based on project assignments and deadlines; weekday or weekend availability may be needed
  • Duration: Initial short-term pilot, with potential future project opportunities
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates must successfully complete a skills-based assessment evaluating domain expertise, analytical reasoning, and ability to follow project guidelines

Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed. Compensation is subject to completion of assigned work in accordance with project instructions and quality standards.

Ready to Apply Your Expertise to the Future of AI?

If you've built your career understanding government systems, interpreting regulations, evaluating complex information, or making informed professional assessments, we'd love to hear from you.

Bring your expertise. Help us build better AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Government SME opportunities with Volga Partners.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced professionals who bring more than familiarity with government processes. You should be comfortable analyzing complex information, exercising independent judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in government operations, public administration, regulatory compliance, government procurement, or a closely related field
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in at least one of the government specializations outlined above
  • Experience interpreting, evaluating, auditing, or applying government policies, regulations, or professional standards
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely
  • Ability to conduct independent research and validate information using authoritative sources
  • Comfort using digital platforms, online research tools, and structured evaluation guidelines
  • Current U.S. residency and ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment

Especially Valuable Experience

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Government Policy or Program Analyst
  • Senior Regulatory or Compliance Analyst
  • Government Auditor or Quality Assurance Specialist
  • Public Records or Privacy Compliance Officer
  • Government Procurement or Contracting Specialist
  • RFP Evaluation or Source Selection Specialist
  • Government Program Manager or Senior Eligibility Analyst
  • Public Sector Consultant or Regulatory Advisor

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

jobs.title: Senior Offering Manager - Mainframe Managed Services
jobs.excerpt: At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things!
jobs.description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose.

Honesty – Reliability – Curiosity – Collaboration – Passion

About the role and what you'll be doing:

Ensono’s Mainframe as a Service (MFaaS) suite is one of the most durable, mission-critical managed service platforms in the market. As we incorporate AI capabilities and next-generation platform innovations, this role exists to evolve and commercialize that portfolio — turning intelligence into offers that customers will buy.

This role is not responsible for defining core AI capabilities. Instead, it focuses on translating existing and emerging capabilities into productized, monetized services — including updating service definitions, pricing models, packaging, and positioning to align with market demand and client value.

You will operate at the intersection of product management, pricing strategy, and service commercialization, ensuring our managed services portfolio evolves from traditional, custom delivery to repeatable, scalable offerings with clear economic models grounded in an AI-First operating model. You’ll set the roadmap, align the stakeholders, and own the outcomes.

Service Evolution & Portfolio Refinement

  • Adapt and evolve existing managed service offerings (e.g., MFaaS) to reflect new platform capabilities (e.g., Telum, Spyre) and AI-enabled delivery improvements such as automation and productivity gains
  • Update and maintain service descriptions, SOW constructs, and feature definitions
  • Ensure offerings remain market-relevant, clearly defined, and differentiated
  • Keep every offering grounded in commercial reality: customer need, market timing, and Ensono’s right to win

Commercialization & Pricing Strategy (Primary Focus)

  • Co-develop and refine costing and pricing models in partnership with Product Pricing and Operations
  • Transition constructs toward standardized, scalable pricing approaches with forward-looking economics
  • Incorporate automation and AI-driven efficiencies into cost-to-serve models
  • Build and maintain pricing frameworks, SKU structures, and packaging tiers and bundles
  • Ensure all offerings are profitable, repeatable, and defensible in the market

Product Packaging & Monetization

  • Productize services into clear, sellable offerings — core vs. add-on capabilities, tiered service levels, and optional enhancements driven by AI or platform features
  • Translate technical capabilities into client-understandable value propositions and measurable business outcomes (cost savings, productivity, risk reduction)
  • Develop standardized proposal constructs and pricing guidance for Sales

Portfolio Roadmap & Lifecycle Ownership

  • Own and maintain the commercialization roadmap across the full MFaaS portfolio
  • Prioritize based on customer impact, commercial potential, and delivery feasibility
  • Ensure every roadmap item has a clear, documented answer to “Why this? Why us? Why now?”
  • Manage the full product lifecycle from ideation through commercial availability to retirement

Vendor & Ecosystem Integration

  • Assess and incorporate third-party vendor capabilities into service offerings, evaluating fit for integration, differentiation, and margin impact
  • Define how vendor technologies are packaged within managed services, priced and monetized, and positioned vs. alternatives (SaaS, ISVs, native tools)
  • Manage product-level relationships with key technology partners to ensure alignment with roadmap and commercial goals
  • Ensure Ensono maintains a cohesive “wrapper” and value layer across vendor-dependent services

Platform Feature Productization (Telum / Spyre / Next-Gen Mainframe)

  • Identify opportunities to package and monetize industry use cases using new platform-level capabilities
  • Translate hardware and software advancements (e.g., embedded AI processing) into new service features, differentiated offerings, and incremental revenue streams
  • Work with Engineering and Architecture to ensure offerings are deployable, operationally supported, and ready for scale

Go-to-Market Enablement

  • Develop and maintain product positioning, messaging, sales enablement materials, and offer definitions for pipeline and deal structuring
  • Partner with Sales to move from point-product or custom solutioning toward outcomes-led selling of standardized offerings
  • Support deal cycles with pricing guidance, packaging recommendations, and commercial clarity

Customer & Market Insight

  • Conduct ongoing customer discovery to validate assumptions, test positioning, and surface unmet needs
  • Monitor the competitive landscape across managed services, AI-enabled delivery, and platform alternatives
  • Turn market signals into roadmap and packaging decisions — not just decks

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Act as the bridge across Product & Consulting lines of business, Pricing & Finance, Delivery/Operations, and Sales
  • Ensure alignment between what is sold, how it is priced, and how it is delivered
  • Drive consistency across portfolio definitions and commercial models — and drive decisions rather than waiting for them

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

Required Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years in Product Management, Offer Management, or Service Portfolio Management, with clear ownership of commercial offer development in a managed services or technology services environment
  • Managed services background — strong experience across mainframe, infrastructure, or SRE services, and an understanding of how managed service offers are structured, sold, and delivered
  • Pricing & commercialization expertise — a proven track record of productizing services (custom → standardized) and developing or influencing costing and pricing models
  • Commercial and financial acumen — cost-to-serve modeling, pricing strategy, and margin optimization
  • Translation skill — you turn technical capability into clear packaging and sellable value propositions without losing either the technical or the business audience
  • AI-enabled delivery fluency — enough understanding of automation and AI efficiencies to reshape cost-to-serve and service design (this role applies AI to commercialization; it does not define the underlying AI capability)
  • Cross-organizational experience — you’ve worked across Product, Finance, and Delivery, and can drive alignment between them
  • Clear communicator — you can run a cross-functional meeting across pricing, finance, delivery, and sales and make sure everyone leaves knowing the decision and who owns what
  • Ownership mindset — you drive the roadmap forward, manage dependencies, and don’t wait for blockers to resolve themselves
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Mainframe ecosystem (IBM Z, z/OS, CICS, Db2); IBM LinuxONE experience a plus
  • Infrastructure Managed Services and/or SRE or Application Services
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled delivery (AIOps, automation, developer productivity)
  • Vendor ecosystem familiarity (IBM, ISVs, observability, security, and DevOps tooling)
  • Familiarity with next-generation mainframe platform capabilities (e.g., Telum, Spyre, embedded AI processing)

Success Measures

  • Adoption of standardized, productized service offerings
  • Improved pricing consistency and margin performance
  • Increased attach rates for add-on and enhanced capabilities
  • Conversion of platform innovations (e.g., Telum / Spyre) into revenue-generating services
  • Reduced reliance on custom pricing and one-off deal structures

Role Differentiator

This role is not an AI product strategy role. Success is defined by the ability to take what exists — AI capabilities, platform features, and vendor tools — and turn it into clear, priced, packaged, and sellable services at scale.

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off
  • Three health plan options
  • 401k with company match
  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and paternal leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Wellness program
  • Flexible work schedule

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $116,000 to 168,000 annually based on a full-time schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, include an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performanceand an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program

Job Summary

AI2IO is seeking a Manager, Software Engineering to lead the people, capability, and operating environment behind software that extends Autodesk Revit and supports architecture, engineering, construction, commissioning, and design workflows. The team builds and supports Revit add-ins, Blazor applications, integrations, installers, deployment services, licensing components, and related tools that streamline specialized engineering work. This is a formal people-management role for all engineers and Software Engineer Technical Leads on the Engineering Tools team. Candidates must bring a strong software-engineering management foundation and meaningful AEC and Revit domain experience. Candidates who combine software-engineering management with hands-on Revit use in mechanical, electrical, BIM or design technology, commissioning, or comparable engineering workflows will be especially well aligned.

Essential Functions

This role grows from complete ownership of people leadership and the Engineering Tools delivery environment toward broader workforce strategy, AEC and Revit capability development, productization readiness, management-system improvement, and organizational leadership. As the organization grows, expand impact through multi-team capability planning, development of technical and people leaders, management-system improvement, workforce strategy, and resolution of organizational challenges beyond the assigned specialty.

Lead and Develop Engineers

  • Serve as the formal people manager for all engineers and Technical Leads assigned to the specialty team through regular one-on-ones, clear expectations, timely feedback, performance reviews, professional development planning, and credible support for every direct report.
  • Provide recognition and development feedback throughout the year and address sustained performance concerns through clear expectations, documented support, follow-through, and appropriate organizational processes.
  • Connect individual goals to meaningful assignments, coaching, learning, mentoring, and increasing ownership without promising advancement before readiness is demonstrated.
  • Partner with Technical Leads to understand technical contribution and development needs while retaining accountability for career evaluation, formal performance decisions, employee relations, and team health.

Build Team Capability and Leadership Depth

  • Maintain a current view of capacity, critical skills, experience distribution, key-person dependencies, succession risk, and staffing needs.
  • Identify capability gaps and coordinate learning, pairing, assignments, mentoring, hiring, and onboarding plans.
  • Develop future Technical Leads and management candidates through scoped assignments, calibrated feedback, explicit readiness criteria, and partnership with current leaders.
  • Reduce leadership and knowledge-continuity risk through distributed ownership, documentation, coverage, and succession options.

Own the Sustainable Delivery Environment

  • Ensure teams have sufficient staffing, capability, role clarity, decision pathways, tools, and organizational support to deliver sustainably.
  • Partner with Technical Leads and Project Managers on delivery health, risk, dependencies, capacity, and recovery without replacing technical or project-management ownership.
  • Ensure material delivery problems receive appropriate management intervention, including staffing changes, escalation, cross-team negotiation, or leadership decisions.
  • Review recurring delays, incidents, rework, quality concerns, support burdens, and workload imbalance to identify organizational or capability improvements.
  • Protect teams from sustained overload and commitments incompatible with available capacity.

Connect Software Teams With AEC and Revit Context

  • Use practical Revit and AEC fluency to help software engineers understand the design, BIM, commissioning, and project-delivery context surrounding Engineering Tools work.
  • Help Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, and engineers clarify organization-specific Revit content, standards, parameters, families, model structures, workflows, and downstream constraints without assuming product or technical authority.
  • Recognize when staffing, sequencing, support, or training approaches do not reflect real design workflows, supported Revit versions, model integrity, user productivity, or discipline-specific needs.
  • Facilitate clear communication between software specialists and mechanical, electrical, commissioning, BIM, design-technology, and field stakeholders.
  • Promote solutions and practices that are understandable, supportable, maintainable, reusable, and appropriate for real engineering project conditions.

Build Specialized Engineering Tools Capability

  • Own workforce capability, staffing, development, and training plans spanning C#/.NET, Revit add-ins and API patterns, Blazor applications, data and integrations, installers, deployment, licensing, diagnostics, quality, support, and commercialization readiness.
  • Ensure the team has the mix of software-engineering and AEC-domain capability required to maintain internal tools while preparing selected products for broader use.
  • Develop learning plans that help software engineers understand Revit workflows and help domain practitioners work effectively with software teams.
  • Reduce single-person dependencies in organization-specific workflow knowledge, deployment, installer behavior, licensing, supported-version strategy, model-dependent testing, and operational support.
  • Support Productization, Deployment, and User Readiness • Partner with Technical Leads, Architects, Product Owners, Project Managers, Software Quality, Product Adoption, and support partners on releases, deployment, licensing, installation, compatibility, documentation, training, and support.
  • Plan the people, process, and capability changes required when selected internal tools are prepared for affiliate, contractor, client, or public use.
  • Use domain awareness to identify risks involving organization-specific content, external users, permissions, data handling, installer behavior, licensing, support, and adoption.
  • Ensure credible support and escalation coverage for Revit add-ins, Blazor applications, integrations, installers, deployment services, and licensing components.

Build Healthy, Candid Team Practices

  • Establish practices that support candid discussion of risks, uncertainty, mistakes, technical disagreements, workload concerns, and alternative viewpoints without individual blame.
  • Address observable patterns such as unresolved conflict, sustained overload, escalation failures, knowledge bottlenecks, or reluctance to surface delivery problems.
  • Maintain reliable communication rhythms so engineers understand priorities, decisions, role boundaries, and available support.
  • Address performance, conduct, and employee-relations concerns through appropriate management processes rather than transferring formal accountability to Technical Leads.

Lead Hiring, Selection, and Onboarding

  • Lead structured and equitable selection processes, calibrate interviewers, document evidence, and make clear candidate recommendations.
  • Own consistent onboarding expectations, including role clarity, access, relationships, learning objectives, 30/60/90-day plans, and ramp check-ins.
  • Evaluate onboarding effectiveness through independence, role understanding, contribution, and feedback and improve the process based on evidence.
  • Identify retention risks early and coordinate appropriate responses.

Maintain Clear Leadership Boundaries

  • Partner with Technical Leads, who own technical feasibility, estimates, dependencies, execution health, engineering standards, implementation direction, and team-level technical decisions.
  • Partner with Architects, who own cross-team architecture, technical standards, governance, and long-term technical direction.
  • Partner with Project Managers, who own the integrated schedule, formal stakeholder communication, scope coordination, project governance, and overall delivery process.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Business Analysts while preserving their authority for product value, priority, requirements, workflow analysis, and backlog readiness.

jobs.description:
Working Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm Mountain Standard Time

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Salary: 2,000 - 2,500 USD

Employer: AI company located in Phoenix, Arizona

The Role

This is a new kind of engineering role. You won't be a code monkey wired into a backlog. You'll own features end-to-end using Claude Code and other coding agents: design, implementation, testing, shipping. You direct the AI, you read every line it produces, and you ship the finished thing.

You'll work across the platform: Threo (the client workspace), Wingtip (agentic execution from plain English requests), Pylon (agent creation and runtime), and Canopy (the control plane for every client tenant).

Our stack spans .NET/C# and FastAPI (Python) on the backend, React on the frontend, and PostgreSQL for data. You don't need to know it all on day one — you need to ramp fast with coding agents and ship in stacks you haven't touched before. We hire for taste and velocity.

What You'll Do

  • Take a problem from rough idea to shipped feature: design, build, test, deploy, working from specs and repo-level agent instructions you and your agents both use. No handoffs for "the real implementation."
  • Read every line the AI produces. You're accountable for what ships, not the model.
  • Operate two, three, or more AI agents at once across separate work streams (new features, bug fixes, refactors), keeping each in its own sandbox or work tree and shipping from all of them the same day without losing state or scope.
  • Ship services in .NET 10 LTS / C# (ASP.NET Core, Minimal APIs, background workers).
  • Build and extend Python services using FastAPI for our agent execution engine and adjacent tooling.
  • Design and evolve data models in PostgreSQL: schema, migrations, indexes, query performance.
  • Build React 19 interfaces with the stable React Compiler — admin consoles, data grids, forms, and chat UIs.
  • Implement streaming chat and live updates, and integrate with LLM providers via tool calling and MCP servers, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.
  • Write tests, write docs, close the loop, and debug across services and stacks — the AI helps, but it doesn't excuse you from understanding the system. The bar is "that's done," not "the happy path works."
  • Ship via Docker and GitHub Actions to our cloud infrastructure.

What We're Looking For

We hire on AI fluency, judgment, and velocity, not years of experience. If you live in Claude Code (or Cursor, or Codex) and ship real software with it, we want to talk.

Must Have

  • Daily, fluent use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar). We care that you can direct an agent through a non-trivial feature without losing the plot — not which tool you use — and that your first instinct is to design with AI in the loop.
  • Parallel agent management. You can run multiple agents at once across separate work streams (features, bug fixes, refactors) and deliver shipped work from each.
  • Solid programming fundamentals. You can read and reason about code in at least one of: C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python. You understand HTTP APIs, relational databases, and basic async patterns. You can debug what you didn't write.
  • Product sense. You can look at a half-formed requirement, ask the right three questions, then ship something the user actually wants.
  • Ownership and clear async communication. When you pick up a feature, you finish it: tests, docs, no dangling threads, no partial solves left for someone else.
  • Quality checks on AI output. You ship the full loop — traces, trajectory-level evals, and guardrails against prompt injection — and can show a non-deterministic feature is safe in front of paying customers.

Nice to Have

  • Streaming systems (WebSockets, SignalR, or similar).
  • LLM integration work: tool calling and MCP servers, streaming, and retrieval or context engineering.
  • LLM cost and latency optimization: caching, model routing, token budgets.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Familiarity with MSP/PSA ecosystems (ConnectWise, Autotask, Datto RMM, etc.).

They have extensive experience in production-grade system design and a strong operational mindset. You will work closely with trading, infrastructure, and data teams to design and maintain systems that are fast, reliable, and observable.

  • Monitor, debug, and troubleshoot production systems and be a part of the on-call incident response team in a high-uptime environment.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of backend development experience building and supporting production-grade systems, with strong experience in distributed, high-availability, and/or high-throughput environments.
  • 3+ years professional experience building and operating production systems in Go, or a deep professional backend engineering background combined with experience using agentic development workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of concurrency, memory management, performance, and optimization, with the ability to apply these principles effectively to Go-based systems.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Localize is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our growing product engineering team.
jobs.description:
Localize is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our growing product engineering team. As Localize expands, the scalability, reliability, and performance of our infrastructure and applications have become paramount. As a critical member of our product engineering team, you will own and improve Localize’s technical infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling, including monitoring, alerting, and maintenance. Your scope extends beyond delivering product tickets: you will strengthen the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and be responsible for the scalability, stability, reliability, performance, and security of the Localize platform.

You will partner closely with leadership and fellow product engineers to translate business priorities and customer needs into execution, remove obstacles, and make thoughtful tradeoffs that keep the team moving forward. Like every product engineer at Localize, you are expected to be customer-obsessed and business-aligned: connect technical decisions to customer trust, product quality, and business outcomes. This role reports directly to the Engineering Manager.

This is a hands-on software engineering role as well as an infrastructure ownership role. You will be expected to operate at a senior backend engineering level, contributing production application code and owning complex changes from design through rollout and ongoing operation. You will also contribute across the stack when needed to deliver complete customer-facing solutions, balancing product development with infrastructure, security, and developer experience priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage Localize's infrastructure across AWS and Cloudflare.
  • Design, build, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and background processing workflows. Work hands-on in the Localize application, including the dashboard, public APIs, legacy workers, and BullMQ workers; not only the infrastructure that supports them.
  • Own complex product engineering work end to end: clarify requirements, propose pragmatic designs, implement application and infrastructure changes, and validate releases in production. Contribute frontend changes when needed to complete the customer experience.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment to data modeling, API contracts, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. Diagnose and resolve application-level performance and reliability issues, including inefficient queries, queue bottlenecks, and search behavior.
  • Raise the quality and maintainability of the codebase through automated tests, thoughtful code reviews, and incremental refactoring. Share knowledge and mentor teammates on backend design, debugging, and operationally sound software development.
  • Ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and security of Localize's data stores, specifically Redis and MongoDB, through effective configuration, monitoring, query optimization, and backup management.
  • Own and improve deployment process and release processes, emphasizing automation, repeatability, safe rollouts, and reliable rollback procedures.
  • Partner with product engineers to improve the full SDLC, including development environments, CI/CD, automated quality and security checks, and release readiness. Treat this work as a core engineering responsibility alongside product delivery.
  • Take a leading role in infrastructure security and SOC 2 Type II compliance, partnering with engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders to operate and improve technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, support audits, and remediate findings. Responsibilities include access management, vulnerability management, change management, logging, and backup and recovery controls.
  • Help lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improvements that protect customers and reduce recurring operational risk.
  • Prioritize infrastructure and SDLC improvements based on customer impact, business priorities, and risk. Communicate tradeoffs clearly and assess results through reliability, delivery speed, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Own and improve monitoring of uptime and performance using tools such as Datadog, Clickhouse, HyperDX, and more
  • Identify, plan and implement improvements and optimizations for infrastructure regarding cost, reliability, scalability.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation and maps of our infrastructure and dependencies.
  • Play an active role in Developer Experience enhancement
  • Actively learn new technologies and systems to improve the efficiency and capabilities of our infrastructure.

Technologies

Experience with the specific technologies below is a plus unless listed under Must-Have Skills. Security and compliance, including support for SOC 2 Type II, are core responsibilities of this role—not optional areas of involvement.

  • AWS: Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, Cloudfront, EC2, Elasticache, Route 53, VPS
  • Platforms: Kubernetes, AWS Beanstalk, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions
  • Languages: Terragrunt, OpenTofu, Terraform
  • Monitoring: Clickhouse, Datadog, HyperDX, Grafana
  • Security & Compliance: SOC2 Type II
  • Cloudflare DNS, Workers, Zero Trust (WARP)
  • Business Intelligence: Stitch, Metabase, Snowflake
  • Application Technology: MongoDB (Atlas + Cloud Manager), Typescript, React

Must-Have Skills:

  • 5+ years engineering experience. At least 4 years of experience in a Platform Engineer role.
  • Expertise in managing and optimizing infrastructure in AWS.
  • Redis and MongoDB, including configuration, monitoring, optimization, and management of backups.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools OpenTofu and Terragrunt
  • Experience with manual or automated deployment & release management.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and tools.
  • Hands-on experience securing production infrastructure, including least-privilege access controls, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and security monitoring.
  • Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable engineering practices, maintain evidence of control operation, and support SOC 2 Type II audit readiness and remediation.
  • Experience partnering with product engineers to improve the SDLC and balance feature delivery with reliability, security, and developer productivity.
  • A customer-obsessed, business-aligned approach: understand how infrastructure decisions affect customers, prioritize work by impact, and explain technical tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Skills in assessing and optimizing performance of infrastructure and applications for improved performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Demonstrated senior-level backend engineering experience: independently designing, shipping, and maintaining production application features and services, beyond infrastructure configuration and scripting.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency with Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript, including API development, asynchronous programming, automated testing, and debugging production systems.
  • Experience designing application data models and reliable background jobs, including safe retries, idempotency, and failure recovery. Ability to reason about performance and correctness across application code, databases, and queues.
  • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, learn the relevant parts of our application stack, and collaborate with product engineers to deliver complete features. Communicate designs and tradeoffs clearly, give constructive code reviews, and help teammates solve difficult technical problems.
  • Proficiency in command line scripting
  • Disaster Recovery Planning including data integrity and availability in case of emergencies.
  • Experience with APM and logging tools such as DataDog, New Relic, Sentry, or Kibana.

Nice-to-Have Skills or Experience:

  • Product Engineering languages and frameworks such as Typescript, React, Mongoose, LESS, and more
  • Applied LLM engineering:
    • Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar)
    • Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, and token management
    • Experience designing or implementing RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search
    • Familiarity with emerging LLM infrastructure patterns and protocols (e.g., MCP, tool/function calling, agents)
  • Working in a fast-paced environment where you’re accountable for your work and you’re passionate in working with customers

Benefits & Perks:

You’ll be joining a close knit and talented team, with plenty of opportunity for professional growth. We offer compensation + benefits that are on par with large companies, while also placing a high value on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • Competitive salary
  • 401(k) plan + 4% matching
  • 100% company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company-paid life insurance and AD&D insurance
  • Work anywhere in North America (we are 100% remote)
  • New Macbook (or computer of your choice)
  • Monthly stipend for home internet costs
  • Generous PTO package

About Localize:

The Localize platform is used by 700+ companies to automate the translation of their web and mobile applications and bring their products & services to new markets at record speed. We support organizations like The Bay Area Toll Authority in translating their payments website, Baptist Health in making their healthcare site multilingual, and the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education in offering their content in several languages. To see our product in action, click any of those links and use the website's language switcher to switch from English to another language.

Localize works by providing a code snippet (similar to the Google Analytics JavaScript snippet) that our customers add to their website/web app. The Localize snippet pulls in content from the page into the Localize dashboard where our customers log in to add translations and manage their content. Localize automatically deploys those translations to the customer's production site, reducing development costs and accelerating time to market.

We are a team of ~30 people working fully remote. We offer competitive pay, a full benefits package, and a culture with an emphasis on work + life balance.

To apply:

Along with your resume, send us a cover letter that showcases your personality and tells us why we should hire you. Previous experience working in a remote position is a must.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Go + TypeScript)
jobs.excerpt: Company Overviewhermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm and hedge fund.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm and hedge fund. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking experienced full-stack engineers to build the user interfaces and services for mission-critical financial applications: visual analytics platforms and data-driven tools used by traders, researchers, and analysts.

You will work on the TypeScript front-ends and the Go services that serve them. We are evolving our front-end applications into a modular, plugin-based platform that other engineers and teams build on—so you will build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs as much as end-user features, and also the Go services that ingest, process, and serve market and on-chain data to these applications. You will own your work from structured product requirements through to production.

This is a highly collaborative role in a fast-paced environment where clean design, high performance, and responsive UIs are critical to the business.

You don't need a background in trading or finance. We care most about engineering craft and will teach you the domain.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with traders, researchers, and product managers to translate complex workflows into elegant UI solutions.
  • Design and implement high-performance, responsive front-end applications using a current-generation TypeScript framework (Svelte, React, or Vue).
  • Design, build and operate Go back-end services with security and performance considerations baked into their design.
  • Own service boundaries and data contracts end-to-end, from Go services to typed front-end SDKs.
  • Build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs for a modular, plugin-based UI platform.
  • Build real-time UIs that ingest and render high-frequency market and on-chain data from multiple streaming sources.
  • Develop high-performance data visualizations for large, fast-updating datasets, using canvas-based charting (e.g. uPlot, TradingView Lightweight Charts) and D3.js for bespoke views.
  • Integrate the front-end with back-end services through typed SDKs and MCP-based interfaces, including real-time market and on-chain data.
  • Drive architecture and performance decisions for modular, extensible systems, with scalability and maintainability in mind.
  • Deploy and maintain applications, keeping them reliable and performant under heavy load.
  • Write and maintain automated tests and take part in code review to keep the codebase reliable and maintainable.
  • Support system maintenance and feature evolution with a high delivery cadence and short iteration cycles.
  • Mentor other engineers and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development, with production ownership on both back-end and front-end.
  • Strong, current TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and one or more modern front-end frameworks (Svelte, React, or Vue), with the adaptability to work primarily in the framework a team has chosen rather than staying tied to one.
  • Strong, current Go experience, able to design, build and operate production Go services independently.
  • Experience building reusable, well-structured UI components and shared abstractions.
  • Proven experience handling large datasets and real-time updates from back-end sources (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events).
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization and rendering strategies in data-heavy applications, including a solid grasp of the JavaScript runtime.
  • Solid testing discipline, with unit and integration tests as a normal part of delivery.
  • Genuine UI/UX sensibility—you can tell a polished interface from a rough one, and care about the difference.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and version control.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration in a cross-functional team.

Nice to Have

  • Background or strong interest in trading systems or financial platforms.
  • Exceptional design taste / portfolio-grade UI work.
  • Experience with relational databases, data warehouses, and caching strategies.
  • Experience with real-time or on-chain / crypto market data.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or other AI-native / agent integration.
  • Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, or shared component libraries used by other engineers.
  • Understanding of microservice architectures, continuous delivery, and zero-downtime deployment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or ELK.
  • Prior work in hedge funds, proprietary trading, or similar finance environments.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Screening – A screening session with a few on-the-spot technical questions to assess your fundamental knowledge and problem-solving approach.
  3. Assignment – A take-home assignment to demonstrate your approach, critical thinking, and relevant skills.
  4. Assignment Review – A discussion of your assignment, focusing on your approach, reasoning, and solutions.
  5. CTO Interview – Interview with the CTO to discuss your experience, technical expertise, problem-solving approach, and overall fit for the role.
  6. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.
